MUKTABODHA INDOLOGICAL RESEARCH INSTITUTEUse of this material (e-texts) is covered by Creative Commons license BY-NC 4.0. Catalog number : M00283 Uniform title: hāhārāvatantra Manuscript : NGMCP 5-4798 reel number A 204/6 Description: The Hāhārāvatantra (the Tantra of the Roaring Haa, Haa) teaches the worship of Kaula goddesses, especially forms of Kālī, with a very clear preference for Guhyakālī. Guhyakaalii is one of the most popular form of Kaalii in the Kathmandu Valley, although hardly known outside it. The main Tantra of Guhyakālī is the massive Mahākālasaṃhitā which may well have been redacted in Kathmandu Valley probably after the 14th century. It is likely that the Hāhārāvatantra is also of Nepalese as its preference for Guhyakālī suggests and absence of manuscripts or references to it outside the Valley. Another indication that this so is the presence in the text of the typical Nepalese corruption mahākarmārcana for mahaakramārcana denoting the Kaula liturgy for the worship of Kaula goddesses. This Tantra calls itself an atharvanasaṃhitā and so affiliates itself to the tradition of the Atharva Veda. This is probably because of its extensive treatment of magical rites, incantations and magical potions.
The worship of Guhyakālī is the subject of chapters 1, 3, 4 (as śiva), 6 (thousand names of Guhyakālī), 11, and 12, 13, 14. Chapter 2 is dedicated to Pratyaṃgirā, who is another form of Kālī. Chapter 5 contains a long exposition of a mantra called Kālikākavaca . Chapter 7 deals with the worship of goddess Turīyā.
Chapter 8 contains a description of the visualized form (dhyāna) of many Kaula goddesses.
hapter 9 contains descriptions of Yantras and their worship.
Chapter 10 deals with magical rites (indrajāla) including magical remedies for disease.
Chapter 11 deals with milder magical rites (prayoga) which may also be done for the benefit of others. The texts repeats constantly that these rites, some of which are performed in cremation grounds, should be done without thoughts or doubts (nirvikalpena).
Chapter 15 describes the Kaula worship (kaulikārcana) of Kālī in eight sacrificial vessels. Notes: Revision 0: December 17, 2003 Publication country : India

text.body:
<1a>
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīvīranātha uvāca ||
kailāśaṃ śikharāśīnaṃ devaṃ tribhuvaneśvaraṃ | praṇamya śirasā devī pṛchate kālikāharaṃ ||
oṃ namo guhyakālikāyai athāto'tharvaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ ||
śrīdevyāha ||
oṃ marmmābhighātinī namo namaḥ |
svāṃbhyaṅka(?) saṃsthitā devī dvaitādvaita vivarjitāṃ | pṛchate kālikā devī bhairavaṃ bhuvaneśvarī ||
pralayānalasaṃkāśaṃ jagadrakṣaṇa tatparaṃ | devādhidaivataṃ bhīṣmaṃ dvaitādvaitasya sthāpakaṃ ||
yena teṣāṃ pratṛṣyante teṣāntatra mahatphalaṃ | tatra teṣāṃ mahādharmo yadvaite nityabhāvataḥ ||
dvaitaṃ vikalpakaṃ caiva advaitaṃ kathayasva me | iti pṛchatī yā devī kālikā dakṣiṇāhvayaṃ ||
guhyakālyāḥ kramaṃ praṇyaṃ ṣaḍāmnāya prapūjitaṃ |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī mahāguhyaṃ pralayānalasannibhaṃ | kathayāmi samāsena gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
etadguhyatamaṃ guhyaṃ mokṣadaṃ kāmadaṃ paraṃ | kathayāmi tvayā devī samayī bhava sādhakaḥ ||
marmābhighātaṃ jagatāṃ sarvatraṃ prakaroti ca | na teṣāṃ pāpapuṇyaṃ ca advaite manasi sthite ||
jābhyantaraṃ na gachatti bhairavo yatra pūjyate | tasmāt pūjā mahāpuṇyā kālikā dviata nāśinā ||
advaitācāra yogena sādhakaḥ siddhi bhāgbhavet | dvitādvaitaṃ tu yeṣāṃ tu teṣāṃ siddhirna jāyate ||
gurorbhaktyā bhavet siddhi dvaitācāra yogataḥ | guruṃ ca devatāṃ maṃtraṃmekatvaṃ bhāvayet sadā ||
etacca yonā bhedena sadā māraka bhājanaṃ | gurureva paraṃ maṃtraṃ daivataṃ gurureva ca ||
gurureva bhavet kāli kālikeva bhavet paraṃ | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
naimittika mahāpūjā saṃkrame pūrṇimā kuhau | niśāyāmeva vai kuryād divā naiva kadācana ||
nityapūjā gṛhe kuryācchudrayā parayā mudā | ekaliṃge śmaśāne vā durgame(vā ūrjate) vā śivālaye ||
<1b>
catuṣpathe ekavṛkṣe śūnyagāre janakṣaye | bilvamūle ca vṛkṣe vā javāpuṣpatarauvapi ||
pūjayet kālikāṃ guhyāṃ yathā guru kramāgataḥ | devyāsta sādhanaṃ vakṣye śmaśānetha gṛhetha vā ||
pañcāmṛtasamāyukta pañcakhādyairviśeṣataḥ | madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca mudrā maithunameva ca ||
makārapaṃcakaṃ devī kālikā tuṣṭidāyakaṃ | rajakī cāṇḍālikā ca carmakārī tathā parāḥ ||
kaivartti kālinī caiva brāhmaṇī uttamā smṛtā | teṣāṃ madhye grahītavyā yadi siddhiṃ samīhate ||
etā siddhikarā devyaḥ kathitā guhyakālike |
dhyānaṃ paṭhet |
devyārūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā jātakrameṇa ca | yasya vijñāta mātreṇa kālikā siddhidā smṛtā || 1 ||
nīlotpaladalaśyāmā jyotirmaṇḍalasaṃbhavā | daśavaktrā mahādevī triṃśallocana bhūṣitāḥ || 2 ||
aṣṭottaraśatārddhaṃ ca bhujaḥ daṇḍairnarānanā | dīpakamūrdhva vaktraṃ ca caṇḍayogeśvarī mataṃ || 3 ||
tadadhaḥ siṃhavadanaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ siddhikālikā | tadadhaḥ pheruvaktraṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ saṃkarṣiṇīṃ smaret || 4 ||
kapīndrasya mukhaṃ vāme lohitaṃ kubjikā smṛtaṃ | dhūmrañca śūkaraṃ dakṣe trailokya ḍāmarāstathā || 5 ||
dakṣa vāme piṃgavarṇaṃ śrīsuṃdarī prakīrtitā | dakṣe nakraṃ ca hāritaṃ mahāhuṃkārinī smṛtā || 6 ||
gajavaktraṃ śubhraṃ vāme devī pratyaṃgirā tathā | dakṣe śyāmaṃ hayāsyaṃ ca siddhiyogeśvarī mukhaṃ || 7 ||
navavaktraṃ mahādevyā jagadrakṣaṇa tatparāḥ | sarve daṃṣṭrā karālā ca svajātodrāvarāviṇi || 8 ||
bhrūbhaṃga kuṭilā bhīmā kālāsyā śrīmukhottamā | piṃgalorddhvaṃ jaṭācaṃdra śvetakhadyota maulinī || 9 ||
saptāviṃśatirbhirmuṇḍaiḥ śroṇitodgārabhīṣaṇaiḥ | javākusuma utphullairmālābhiśca prakīrtitā || 10 ||
abhayaṃ kādya khaḍgañca khaṭvāgaṃ pāśaśaktikam | muṇḍaṃ dhanuścakra ghaṇṭāṃ vālapretaṃ camarvatam(?) || 11 ||
kaṅkāla na kulaṃ sarpaṃ ṣaḍasraṃ bahu kuṭṭinī | odikāṃ vahnipātraṃ ca tridaṇḍaṃ vastramudgaran || 12 ||
akṣasya (*)(?)śūla ḍamaru keśarī vāmavāhukaṃ | varadaṃ kartṛtajjaṃtya triśūlaṃ kuśadaṇḍakaṃ || 13 ||
rātrapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ vāṇaṃ paṃcapadmamataṃ gajaṃ | maṃdāraṃ churikāṃ kuṃtaṃ tomaraṃ puṣpamālikāṃ || 14 ||
<2a>
diṇḍimaṃ bhūśuṃḍī parighatomaraṃ ca kamaṇḍaluṃ | śruvā ca parśuputrīṃ ca nadyāvarttañca kuṇḍalaṃ || 15 ||
māṃsakhaṇḍaṃ vījapūraṃ srucaṃ ca dakṣavāhubhiḥ | vibhratīṃ vyāghra carmaṃ ca kālacarmottarī kṛtāṃ || 16 ||
hāḍālaṃkārabhūṣādyāṃ vīraghaṇṭāninādinīṃ | ghargharārāvaghorāṃ śrīnūpurārāvabhīṣaṇāṃ || 17 ||
kaṭakā hṛdakeyūra mahāsthi kṛtaśobhaṇāṃ | muṇḍamālā gale devyā āpādāṃtā valaṃvinīṃ || 18 ||
raktapadmamayīṃ mālāṃ śuṣkalādyābhirājitāṃ | brahmasūtrojjvalatkaṇṭhāṃ yogapaṭṭottarīyakāṃ || 19 ||
saumyāgra bhūṣaṇairyuktāṃ nāgarājādyalaṃkṛtāṃ | raktakuṇḍala yuktena paṃcakālāsane sthitāṃ || 20 ||
śivāsanaṃ tadūrddhaṃ ca nīlaṃ nālorddhva lāṃchitaṃ | mahārgharatnaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ || 21 ||
ekavaktraṃ trinetraṃ ca bhairavā haraṇāṃkitaṃ | kartṛkapāla hastaṃ ca ḍamarukhaṭvāṃgadhāriṇaṃ || 22 ||
evaṃ bhairava pīṭhaṃ tu devyā āsana musyate | paṃcapretāstadadhastaṃ brahmādyāḥ paṃcabhūtayāḥ || 23 ||
brahmāviṣṇuñca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ | pītaśyāma raktadhūmra śvetābhāḥ pañcakāraṇā || 24 ||
daṇḍacakraśaktiśūlakhaṭvāṃgāyudhadhārakāḥ | tarjanīmukhanikṣiptāḥ śivādhasthā trilocanā || 25 ||
piṃgarakta triguhyā hi phetkāra iva bhīṣaṇāḥ | vajradaṃṣṭrā nakhasparśā padmapṛṣṭhe śivottamā || 26 ||
śacī patyādi ratnañca diśāṃ varṇaḥ savarṇakaḥ | iṃdraṃ pītābhaṃ vajraṃ ca vahniṃ raktaṃ sa śaktikaṃ || 27 ||
yamaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca daṇḍāḍhyaṃ dhūmraṃ nair(-)ṛti khaḍgake | varuṇaṃ pāśaṃ śubhrāsyaṃ vāyuṃ śyāmaṃ kare dhvajaṃ || 28 ||
kuberaṃ kuṃkumagadāṃ śuklamīśāna śūlakaṃ | śūklaṃ kṛtayugaṃ pītaṃ tretāḥ raktaṃ ca dvāparaṃ || 29 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ kaliḥ śuklā ṛkpītaṃ yajuḥsāmaraktaṃ | kṛṣṇetharvaṇa vedādyairāsanaṃ sarvakāmadaṃ || 30 ||
<2b>
raktapadmāsanaṃ dvandva sahaśradalaśobhite | sahasrasūryajvālāgramāsanaṃ parikīrtitaṃ || 31 ||
padmoparisthitā devī nṛtyamānā sadoditā | athavā sukhamāsīnā sarvadevādhi yantritā || 32 ||
muktahuṃkārli udbhimnalājayantiṃ vicintayet | pratyālīḍha padādhīra sarvalakṣmī jayeścarī || 33 ||
evaṃ dhyeyā mahākālī jihvāgre navayauvanā | bhāvenākramya madhyasthā anākhye yā maheśvarī || 34 ||
iti dhyātvā ||
maṃtrākṣara bhedena dhyāna bhedena devyā rūpa bhedaṃ bhavati | sahasraśatacatuḥpaṃcāśaddvāviṃśati aṣṭādaśa aṣṭacaturbhujā kṛṣṇavarṇā raktotpalamitā siṃhapherukapibhaṃ tvak garuḍagajahaya kamala jyotirmmayavaktrā catuṣpaṃcāśadvājabhirnnānāśastrāstrairūpaśobhitā saptaviṃśati muṇḍāsanā mahāmuṇḍamālinī nararudhira kapālapūritā mukhaśoṇita nir(##-) veṣṭitā sarvabharaṇamaṇḍitā |
īdṛśīṃ tritayeddevīṃ kālikāṃ marmaghātikāṃ | catuḥṣaṣṭi tu marmāṇi vedhayanti vyavasthitāṃ ||
trimukhāṣṭa(?)bhujāśyāmā kapālamālā bhūṣitā | pibanti rudhiraṃ divyaṃ ghūrṇamāyata locanaṃ ||
pūjitavyā prayatnena paṭe likhya tu sādhakaḥ |
sarvakāmaphalapradā nararaktamadyamiśrena kālikāyāḥ sahamaṃtraṃ cintayet |
lekhitavyā prayantena paṭe sarvārtha sādhakaḥ mahāśaṃkha ghaṭitā vā narāsthi ghaṭitā naracarma likhitā vā etābhāvānviti kāṣṭhamayī pratimā kārayitavyā | pāśāṃkuśavajraḥ triśūlakhaṭvāṃga mudgara |
mṛtavālamuṇḍahastā kapālasurakta pūjitā | idṛśīttāṃ samākhyātāṃ dhyāyed yaḥ satataṃ priye ||
dhyāna pūjā visarjjana niyamādikaṃ sarvaṃ yathā śaktyā pūjāṃ kṛtvā kṣamākārayitavyā | dvārapālādikaṃ pūjāyāṃ prayojitavyā mṛtyukāla
<3a>
mahāmṛtyuḥ pārśvasthā ca sadākila etepi vidhi naikena bhāvyā advaitācāramārgamāsthitāḥ | kapālaśūlahastā ca dvārapālinī sarvavyāghra carmaparīdhānā kuṇḍaladalayādi muṇḍasarparatnajavā padmādi sarvāṃga vibhūṣitā | devadevī sārdhake śainnaṃkhayukta naracarma prāvṛttā daṃṣṭrākarālā raudramukhī aṭṭāṭaṭahāsāsañca svabhāva svajāti śabdarāvā prahasitā | nanānṛtyamānā pulakamukhāsu tṛṣṇā prajvalitakarāleli samānākālapāśa yamadaṇḍa tarjanī muṇḍahastā muṇḍamālālaṃkāra bhūṣitā kṛṣṇavarṇā bhayāvahā | bhairavamahākāla krodha mṛtyuṃjaya muṇḍamālābhūṣitā | kṛṣṇavarṇa mahākāyaṃ vetālārūḍhā aṭṭahāsinī kapālāyudha triśūla jambūka kākagṛdhra pecakaṃ śvānakaṃka vetālarākṣasaiḥ parivāritā | nandi mahākāla kṣetragaṇeśvara cakrakoṇe sthitā | sahasrākṣari | oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ chrāṃ phreṃ oṃ namo bhagavati
