<4a>
mohitāḥ sadya eva bhavanti | bhasmano japamātreṇa devā api mūrchito bhavaṃti kiṃ punaḥ kṣudra mānavāḥ asurasura sarvadevādīnāmapi mayā na kathitaṃ |
brahmādyāśca na jānanti kiṃ punaḥ sakyate mayā |
aṣṭāṃgulavaheḍikā kāṣṭhaṃ śmaśāna kāṣṭhaṃ vā aṣṭābhi maṃtritaṃ yasya gṛhe dvāre pathiñca tasya sarvāpiḍā jāyaṃte paścādayopi ādityo dayaṃ vinā nottiṣṭhaṃti sādhakasya padukā dhūliṃ gṛhyarāja kapālaṃ siddhyayārkaṃ saṃjapati jāpye na ārdrakale yā dvā athavā trivārajāpyeta yamichati cintayati taṃ sarvaṃ karoti sarvaṃ śmaśāne puṣpe cūrṇena sakṛt jāpyenaṃ yaspṛśatitaṃ tatkṣaṇāt pṛṣṭhato'nugachati | phreṃ caṃḍa caṇḍeśvarī huṃ phaṭ | devyāśca pūrvoktena na dhyātvā maṃtramāvarttayet | śirasi puṣpeṇa hatā tatkṣaṇāt kaṃpate loṭhate rodate hasate tathaiva lokāntarmadhyataḥ prathama ṛtu brāhmaṇa kanyakāyā aṣṭamyāṃ satatamaṣṭaśatā'bhimaṃtritaṃ guṭikāṃ mukhe prakṣipya adṛśyo bhavati svakīya rūpa parivarttanaṃ karoti | śṛgāla viḍāla pecakakākagṛdhrarūpoyamicchatitaṃ karoti | eteṣāṃ mattayoginīnāṃ saha vicaret asamayīṃ tān dṛṣṭvā gatvā yoginīnāṃ bhari(?) vedayet | śmaśāna bhasmākṣahimagci(?)taṃ kṛtvā yasya gṛhe niḥkṣipet kāṣṭhaṃ vā tṛṇādīnā nikhanet gṛhe śmaśānaṃ bhavet | gopāla tailika śauṇikakaivartra kuṃbhakāra ikṣuṇā sarṣṣapena bhasmanā nāsayet | śmaśāna kāṣṭhena vā sarva krayavikrayaṃ dūṣayati | kiṃ vahunāyadichati tatkaroti | kapālacūrṇa mahāpalaguggulumiśraṃ devyādhūpaṃ deyaṃ saptābhimantritaṃ yāvadvāramekaṃ viṃśati yasya nāma gṛhītvā dahet | śarkarāmvā prakṣipettena bhaṭṭārikena vāyathechati tena gṛhyate sarvavikāraṃ karoti | satataṃ mocayati
<4b>
patitena gṛhyante sarvavikāraṃ karoti | śatruvaṃśaṃ mārayati | nānyaḥ kaścinmocayati guggulu dhūpena mocayati | muñca muñca ityuktvo sarṣapasa vījasaptaluptena yaṃ śirasi tāḍayen | nityaṃ bhaṭṭārikā hetunā proṣitavyāḥ sarvasiddhā bhavaṃti | aṃdhakāre sthāpayet | tatraiṣāṃ bhagavati cāmuṇḍā devī devānāmapi mohayaṃti |
cūrṇayaṃtya surān sarvān devagaṃdharvakinnarā |
na sarvatrasthā ca niratā nitya jāpena manasā sarvaṃ karoti |
advaitañca sadābhūya daityākhyāne ca kārayet |
daityādi mahāmoha saṃsāra mohana bandhana mokṣakārakaḥ | vālātmarcayedatha vā tarppayedatha vā devyā maṃtreṇa kandalīyaṃ gṛhyato udakarṣeṇa mokṣa śivā samaya hṛṣikāni cintayet | daivatākāra marcyā devyāścaiva tu cintaye hṛdi pūrvaṃ rūpeṇa samastaṃ parivārito maṃtramāvarttate huṃkāraṃ vadet | tatkṣaṇaṃ vikalaṃ bhavet patato hi tatopi vā gātrabhaṃga ca labhate jvarameva ca | eṣa pratyayaprayoga vedya mahāmaṃtra samayīnāṃ pradāpayet |
ātmā ca vikaṭotkaṭasaṃbhramavilocanaṃ | aṭṭāṭṭahāsaṃ muktakeśaṃ jaṃbūkā rūpaṃ kapālamaṇḍite jvalitayudhadhāriṇaṃ |
pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ divyaṃ divya praharaṇānvitaṃ | raktapūrṇa kapālaṃ ca asthimālā vibhūṣitaṃ ||
bhairavātmānaṃ saṃciṃtya tataḥ siddhimacilāllabhet | devyāsinaḥ samastācca rakṣaṃtyā sarvataḥ sthitāṃ vidveṣe kakṣaḥ tailena śmaśāna karpaṭe likhet |
saptābhi maṃtritaṃ yasya nāmnā śmaśānake likhet |
sa vidiṣṭā pralāpayati ca māraṇe visaratyena kāreṇa citāṅkāreṇa śmaśāne karpaṭe likhya śmaśāna mṛttikayā pratimāṃ kṛtvā trikaṭu marditaṃ kārayet | tasya hṛdaye sarpaprahārāvagulitā prakṣipya dātavya agnau dātavyāṃ tāpayet | ahorātreṇa mriyate | uccāṭayet | śmaśāna karpaṭe likhya pālāśapatreṇa veṣṭayitvā dvāre likhanet | yatrātkramatitā uccāṭayati trigaṃdho japitaṃ bhavet | kanyā subhagā raktena likhet |
<5a>
subhagatvaṃ bhavati | madhu tāptā vayatiḥ | vaśaṃ karoti |
ācāryena pradattena vinā siddhirna jāyate | vṛthāta kariṣyanti anya taṃtrena mohitā ||
siddhyaṃti śīghraṃ vai japtvā niśāyāmayutena ca | ya imāṃ kāli'jānāti sa gururmokṣahammṛtaḥ ||
kṛtyā pūjāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā vatya(?) tāmbūlakādinā | gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ sukhāptaiñca(?) guruṃ caiva prapūjayet ||
tasmāt sarva prayatnena guruṃ saṃtoṣayet sudhīḥ | guru pūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā datvā svarṇādi śraddhayā ||
guhyaṃ sarvāṃ gṛhnīyātaṃ guruvaktrāt mahodayaṃ | rīktaḥ hastena gṛhnīyāt taṃtra sotrañca paddhatiṃ ||
na siddhyati mahādevī japtvā varṣaśatairapi | mohitāstu sarve loke guruve yatra dīyate ||
vastra hiraṇyā bharaṇaṃ yānaṃ tu gaja yājikaṃ | guru pūjāṃ sadā kṛtvā tataḥ kṣipraṃ ca siddhyati ||
akṛtvā tu guroḥ pūjāṃ rahasyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti ca | maṃtra tasya na siddhyati pare naraka bhāgbhavet ||
varṇāśramavibhāgena śāktā śrīkulaśāsane | vipra kṣatrīya viṭ(?) śūdrāstrī cāṇḍālā yataḥ samāḥ ||
guru pūjāṃ yataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ siddhyati nānyathā | vaikalpena vinaśyaṃti nirvikalpena sidhyati ||
pūjā vā havisargena japastotra valistathā | yathātmānaṃ tathā devī smartavyā parameśvarī ||
oṃ namo bhagavati cāmuṇḍe hūṃ <3> svarūpiṇī icche citte jrī hrīṁ <2> hrīṁ <2> guhyakālike sarvakarmakarī kṣrauṃ <2> phroṃ <2> huṃ <2> krīṁ <2> phaṭ huṃ phaṭ oṃ phaṭ pracaṇḍe kili <2> kici <2> mohaya <2> jaṃbhaya <2> hana <2> kava <2> kiri <2> grasa <2> hasa <2> chrīṃ strīṃ trīṁ <2> hrīṃ bhrāmaya <2> ghurmāvaya <2> nidrāvaya <2> prāṇān hana <2> prāṇahāri jīvahārī hara <2> māraya <2> ānaya <2> khāda oṃ gṛhṇa <2> huṃ phreṃ māra <2> kṣaṁ <2> phreṁ huṃ kraṃ māra <2> hara <2> kṣaḥ <2> hūṃ <2> jrūṁ srūṁ chrūṁ hrūṃ hūṃ hūṃ jaḥ khaḥ jaḥ <2> hāṃ <2> jalabhīṣaṇī bhairavī phreṃ marma
<5b>
chedanī phaṭ hrīṃ <3> kaha <2> raudra hūṃ <5> phaṭ <5> chrīṃ <3> cūṃ pheṁ marmamarmābhighāte hana <2> hūṃ <4> phaṭ <4> namaḥ svāhā ||
etad devyā hṛdayam
sarvakarmakarā kṣipraṃ svayaṃ bhairava bhāṣitaṃ |
grahanesyādi māṃ vidyāṃ mūlavidyāṃ sarvāṇi | pūrvāsādhane pūrvasiddhiṃ karoti | yamichati taṃ karoti | anekendrajālaṃ karoti mayūra picchena gaṃgā srotroṇi vārayet | yadicchati tatkaroti stambhayaṃti hanti paravalaṃbhaṃ jayati | vānasvaṅgādinā mahāstraṃ śikatāṃ prakṣiptvā staṃbhayatiḥ vṛkṣa mānayati sarvayoginīnāṃ sāmānyo bhavati | avyakta koṭi rūpāṇi karoti nāgaṃ kṣobhayati | pūrvaprakāreṇa marmābhighātaṃ karoti | svecchayā sarvaṃ karoti | nātra saṃdehāṃ caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ valindadyāt | bhaumaniśāyāṃ vāriṇāpi yathā śaktyā valindadyāt | sāmarthye sati paṃcakena ghṛta dugdhau danavaṭakale hyacoṣya peyādi jāṃ jalajala carādvinā kālīntarpayet | mānasena japa mātreṇa karoti | kiṃ vahunā etattu yogeśvarasyādhikāraṃ gṛhṇīyet | guroranujñā sidhyati na kadācana | nānyasyādhikāraḥ eṣā bhagavati advaite ca vyavasthitā sidhyate acire naiva guru bhaktyā maheśvarī sarvakhādyādyaiḥ samastā gurustamanu gṛhṇīyet | gurupatraikepi datvā sa sātrau kṣamāpayet | sarvasiddhi bhāgbhavet | yakṣiṇīṃ nāśinīṃ gaṃdharvīṃ rākṣasīṃ mātuṣīṃ arddharātre ākarṣayet | asiddheṣvapi sarvamaṃtrān śmaśāna dhūliṃ prakṣipena jvaragrahādīn samayati | sarvaṃ karoti vāmahastena strīyāṃ pṛṣṭhato tu gacchati | kāmonmahā bhavati | śivī bhavadgṛhāhantaḥ śiva bhūḥ māraṇe śmaśāna sūtreṇa mahābhāṇḍe trivāraṃ vadhvā akṣayo bhavati | asya hṛdaye sthita śivadarśanānmokṣa abhimantrita maṃtreṇa hara <2> ityuktā śmaśāne sūtreṇa kaṭi vadhvā sthāla śatān bhakṣayet |
<6a>
ānaya <2> ayaṃ kuru <2> iti ānayamṛlitabhaginī kapālipāśāṃkuśī viṃtati | yoginī mudrāṃ hūṃ patita bhrū kṣepaṃ sakṛt adho dṛṣṭiṃ vigalitā nitāṃ śuṣkālanī mahā sucati jihvā <2> lālanīlalāṭabhrunī yoginī yoginīnāṃ kāmaṃ ga(?)sahati devyādyā samastāṃ kiṃ punaranya jīvikā | atha vā pūjā sarveṣāṃ | aiṃ śrīṃ phreṃ kici <2> gurupādukebhyo namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ phreṃ kili <2> bhairava pāda phreṃ namaḥ | devī hṛdayena pūjayet | oṃ juṃ phreṃ yamāyā kici <2> hūṃ phreṃ namaḥ | oṃ phreṃ hṛdayāya kici <2> hūṃ phreṃ namaḥ | oṃ śrīṃ phreṃ nandi kili <2> phreṃ namaḥ | oṃ phreṃ hūṃ hrīṃ mahākālāya kici <2> hūṃ phreṃ namaḥ | oṃ phreṃ kici <2> mṛtyu phreṃ kili <2> hūṃ phreṃ namaḥ | oṃ phreṃ mahāmṛtyu phreṃ kici <2> phreṃ namaḥ | oṃ eṣā vidyā sarveṣāṃ vāma hastena pūjā sarveṣāṃ vāmena sādhanaṃ phreṃkāreṇa kṣetrapālāṣṭa kulamātarān guhyakālī yoginīnāṃ madhye hrīṃ <2> hreṃ phreṃkāra māyāvījaṃ na raktavṛṣṭiṃ karoti | siddhi prayogoyaṃ sarvatrāti durlabhaḥ paścādenena parapuraṃ praveśaḥ mārjjāra śivākākāde raktaṃ gṛhītvā raktavyaṃjanaṃ yatkiṃcid bhakṣādya dravyaṃ tadā karoti | hṛdayaṃ jāpyate ||
iti vāra prayogāti gopitavyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
śivaṃ bhave vāma hastena gṛhītvā hṛdaye jāpyate | athavā bhairava mantraḥ striyaḥ sparśamātreṇa kāmonmattā bhavaṃti | śmaśānasūtreṇa kaṭiṃ vadhvā svecchayā calati | tena tayā saha trailokyaṃ vaśamānayaṃti | tena kāmita manorathaṃ pūrayaṃti | te ca pade pade mūrchitā bhavaṃti | evaṃ siddhi prayogaśca devānāmapi durlabhaṃ | śivāstraṃ gṛhītvā mahāmṛtyu maṃtreṇa abhimaṃtrya | vāmakara pralepena tena hastena yasyastenaṃ spṛsati | sa praviśati mahāyakṣa maṃtreṇa liṃgaṃ spṛśati | punaḥ nānyastrīstanaṃ spṛśati | bhairava hṛdayena śivāsthi | aṣṭāṃgulaṃ gṛhe nikhānayet |
<6b>
sa paśu vāndhavai saha mriyate | mahākāla maṃtreṇa śivālāṃgulaṃ gṛhītvā | rātrau grāmāntare japet | sarva yakṣiṇyā gacchati | yamicchatitaṃ dadati ichayā virahati | nandi hṛdayena yasya ulūkāṣṭiṃ prakṣipet | te kṣayaṃ gachaṃti desthityāgaṃ kurvanti | yasya maṃtreṇa yasya gṛhe śmaśānāṃgāraṃ śivācarmeṇaveṣṭitaṃ kṣipet | tasya kulakṣayo bhavati | yamasya hṛdayena śmaśāna kulaṭaṃ gṛhya śivā carmeṇā muṣṭikāṃ badhvā tena yaṃ spṛśati niścetanā bhavati | bhūtena gṛhyate śivarttā hanāt | yamadaṇḍahataṃ sarve vinaśyati | yadmīyate yasya gṛhe aṣṭāṃguli nikhātite taṃ gṛhaṃ pretālayaṃ bhavati | mṛtyu hṛdayena mārjārī raktaṃ śmaśānāṃ janaraktaṃ gṛdhraraktaṃ aṃjayet adṛśo bhavati | sarvarūpāṃ karoti | bhagavati hṛdayena śṛṃgāra raktaṃ śiracāṃjana śuklaṃ nara tailena saha raktānāmikayā aṃjitena icchārūpeṇa icchārūpaṃ karoti | trailokyaṃ mohayati | athavā tilakañca śivācarmapādukāṃ kṛtvā nararaktaṃ raktapūrṇāsya bhagini hṛdayena japtvā saptadvīpān bhramayati | yamicchatitaṃ karoti | śivā rasanāṃ gṛhya trilohaveṣṭitaṃ mukhe prakṣipya śivī bhavati | mārjāra rasanayāṃ mārjāraṃ śvānena śvānaṃ ūlukena ūlukaṃ sarveṣāṃ rūpaṃ karoti | hṛdayenā maṃtritaṃ śivakusuma yutāṃ sarveṣāṃ mūkavaccā śivāroma muṣṭikāṃ kṛtvā hṛdayajjāpyena yaṃ hasati sa grahena gṛhyate | gugulu dhūpena mokṣaḥ | śivā cakṣuṣaṃ hṛdayena japtena netra yugmaṃ janayet | nirvāṇaṃ paśyati | vīlaṃ paśyati nidhiṃ paśyati | śivā viḍālayoḥ pracchaṃ śmaśāne dṛṣṭa śatāni maṃtrya tena yaḥ saṃhanyate sovibhūpo bhavati | saiṣaviḍālādi yaṃ anena hanyate meṣādi bhavati |
<7a>
adṛśyo bhavati rūpaṃ parivartayati | yamichatitaṃ karoti | śivolūka māṃsagugulumiśrena dhūpāt kasya stambho bhavati | mahāprete śvānayoni hṛdayābhi mantrya yasyā bhagaṃ spṛśati tena saha vasate yatra tiṣṭhati guhyakāli phreṃ phaṭ | madye na mokṣaḥ devyā hṛdayena aṣṭāṃgula pramāṇena kumāri vidvādaśāṃgulāni bhavaṃti | uparibhrāmena anyeṣāṃ liṃgaṃ tuṣī(?) bhavati | tasmin bhage anyāśeṣaṃ na pravisati | gṛdhra netra aṃjana vimiśreṇa mārjjāra raktena saha aṃjanaṃ pretapiśācaṃ darśayati | svaśiṣyeṣu pradātavyaṃ nānyeṣāṃ ca kapāṃcana(?) | tenāpi hi pradātavyā adhikārāya śāstrataḥ |
oṃ hrīṃ phreṃ guhyakālike phaṭ phreṃ hūṃ namaḥ | aiṃ śrīṃ phreṃ bhairavāya haiṃ hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ | śikhā |
aiṃ śrīṃ haiṃ mṛtyu hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ | netre |
aiṃ śrīṁ phreṃ huṃ mahāmṛtyu phaṭ phreṃ namaḥ | vaktre |
aiṃ śrīṁ hskhphreṃ hūṁ yamāya phreṃ namaḥ | hṛdaye |
aiṃ śrīṃ phreṃ hūṃ kṣamāya hūṃ phreṃ phaṭ namaḥ | kukṣau |
aiṃ hrīṃ phreṃ mahākālāya hūṃ phreṃ phaṭ namaḥ | jaṃghayoḥ |
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ nandine phreṃ hūṃ namaḥ | pādayoḥ |
oṃ śrīṃ hūṃ phreṃ hili <2> kici <2> hūṃ phreṃ namaḥ | kavace |
aiṃ hrīṃ phreṃ śrīṃ yamadaṇḍe phreṃ haiṃ hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ kṣayadaṇḍe phreṃ hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ | hastayo |
aiṃ hūṃ phreṃ hūṃ phreṃ phreṃ namaḥ | astre |
aiṃ phreṃ phaṭ hūṃ caṇḍe hūṃ phreṃ namaḥ | aṃgulyāṃ |
aiṃ hrīṃ hūṃ caṇḍikāyai hrīṃ <2> phreṃ <2> phre phaṭ namaḥ | aṣṭāṃgula pramāṇena kumāri vidvādaśāṃgulāni bhavaṃti | upari bhrāmena aṃnyeṣāṃgiṃga dūṣī bhavati | tasmin bhage anya śephaṃ na pravisaṃti | gṛdhranetra aṃjanamiviśreṇa mārjāraraktena saha aṃjanaṃ pretapiśācaṃ darśayati | sa śiṣyeṣu pradātavyaṃ nānyeṣāṃ kadācana | tenāpi hi pradātavyā adhikārāya śāstrataḥ | oṃ hrīṃ phreṃ guhyakālike
<7b>
phaṭ phreṃ huṃ namaḥ | aiṃ śrīṃ phreṃ bhairavāya haiṃ huṃ phaṭ namaḥ | śikhā |
aiṃ śrīṃ haiḥ mṛtyu huṃ phaṭ namaḥ | netra |
aiṃ śrīṃ phreṃ huṃ mahāmṛtyuṃ huṃ phaṭ phreṃ namaḥ | vaktre |
aiṃ śrī hma phreṃ huṃ yamāya phreṃ namaḥ | hṛdaye |
aiṃ śrī phreṃ huṃ kṣamāya huṃ phreṃ phaṭ namaḥ | kakṣau |
aiṃ hrīṃ phreṃ mahākālāya huṃ phreṃ phaṭ namaḥ | jaṃghayoḥ |
oṃ śrī hrīṃ nandine phreṃ huṃ namaḥ | pādayo |
oṃ śrīṃ huṃ phreṃ hiri <2> kici <2> huṃ | hṛdaye |
aiṃ śrīṃ phreṃ huṃ kṣamāya hu phre phaṭ namaḥ | kukṣau |
aiṃ hrīṃ phreṃ mahākālāya hu phreṃ phaṭ namaḥ | jaṃghayo |
aiṃ hrīṃ phreṃ śrī yamadaṇḍe phreṃ heṃ huṃ phaṭ namaḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ kṣayadaṇḍe phreṃ huṃ phaṭ namaḥ | hastayo |
aiṃ huṃ phreṃ huṃ phreṃ phreṃ namaḥ | astraḥ |
aiṃ phreṃ phaṭ huṃ phreṃ namaḥ | kavaca |
huṃ phreṃ namaḥ | aṃgulyāṃ |
aiṃ hrīṃ hūṃ caṇḍikāyai hrīṃ <2> phreṃ phreṃ <2> mṛtyuṃjayaṃ | ichayā sādhanet | mokṣayādbhāvamārgeṇa bhāvabhāvañca mokṣadaṃ arddhamātrā sāvalamba nirālamba bhageśvaraṃ nīlakarpaṭena mukhamācchādya praveśayet | atha tena puṣpaṃ prakṣipyayet | athavā prāṅmukha aśaṃke ca sa saṃkāyā kaule vāmekayā | samayavidyā |
oṃ namaḥ śrī cāmuṇḍe pracaṇḍe phetkāriṇī <2> duhi <2> phaṭ jālandhare mahālakṣmī caritre vārāhī nagare ceta durvāsinī karṇakubje mahākarṇī aṣṭamātarī māheśvarī brahmāṇī vaiṣṇavī indrāṇī kaumārī vārāhī māhendrī cāmuṇḍā mahālakṣmī śrīsiddhilakṣmī bhairavī guhya śrīmahākālīmāye mahāmāye sarvasiddhiṃ dade sarvasamṣāratāriṇī devī koṭakāmarūpavāsinī śmaśāna bhairava priye samarasa advaitocāra priye hrīṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā | aiṃ phreṃ hūṃ hrīṃ vūṃ śrīṃ kici <2> kili <2> hana <2> daha <2> grasa <2> he <2> phreṃ siddhi bhairavī sarvayoginīnāṃ samarasakāriṇī trilokavāsinī sarvagate viṣama durga sa
<8a>
vanaparvatavāsinī saṃgrāmavāsinī jayaṃ vijayaṃ prade pathe pathopavāsinī vṛkṣavṛkṣopavāsinī sarva sarva gate jaye jayati ajite aparājite | chrīṃ strīṃ staraṇī pūriṇī hrīṃ namaḥ samasamayati dviprabhavati pravisati khphreṁ khphreṁ chrīṃ strīṃ cūṃ phreṃ namaḥ svāhā | eṣā sarvaṃ yoginināṃ samayavidyā |
hūṃ bhairavasahitaṃ trailokya māte heḥ veṃ chreṃ namaḥ svāhā | āsāṃ sarvayoginīnāṃ samayavidyā |
bhairavabhairavīnāṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ sarvaśākinīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ mahāsamayavidyete | anayā uccārite na sarvayoginīnāṃ sarvadevānāṃ vidyādharādīnāṃ yakṣādīnāṃ sarvakṣetropapīṭhe kṣetre ca sarvatramānyo bhavati | sarvatraivakrāyate | sarvatrāvaddho sarvadyapi vinirmukto bhavati | jihvātvo khphreṃ kāradada hāhākārapūjā vasāne devīnī caṃdane samayakāle | citte cittaṃ saṃbhavecchiraṃ loṭayet | hṛṣṭapuṣṭa sarvatra mauniyāstri saṃdhyaṃ jāpet | devasthāne manasā hūṃ phreṃ uccārayet | tuṣṭho bhavati | anena samayavidyayāyamicchati taṃ karoti | devyā prathamaṃ maṃtraṃ sadya prokṣita mahāśaṃkha sūtramālayā trisaṃdhyaṃ japet | aṣṭaviṃśati jāpeta sidhyati | sarvamaṃtrāḥ sidhyanti | śmaśānadagdha kaṭivāsa kṛte jāpyena pratyakṣaṃ yāti | kruddhena pātayantī | devyai nivedyate | tena mahāmokṣo bhavati | udakaṃ japtvāyaṃ hanati tena nipātyate | yena sevitena yamicchati | śmaśānāṃgāreṇa śatajāpena yaṃ harati | śmaśānā bhasmanā vāsa kṛjjaptena vāhanet | tena sarve mṛtavanniśceṣṭā bhavaṃti |
<8b>
devyā hṛdayena siṃcet svastho bhavati | yathā bhairavastathārdha karoti | vāmena sarvakarmaṃ dakṣiṇena | eṣā bhagavati siddhidā icchārūpaṃ karoti | mahābhairavavacca svayaṃ bhavet | jarāmaraṇavacca jarāmaraṇavarjito bhavati |
sarvavyādhi vinirmuktaḥ sarvadoṣa vivarjitāḥ |
agnivat sarvaśatrūn tāpayati | kāryā kāryaṃ pṛcchati | khaḍgapādukāṃjana guṭikāṃ vasitvaṃ siddhyati | nānārasarasāyanādyaṣṭa siddhiṃ nānāvidhāneka kṣudra siddhisādhayati | nāsau kenāpi vadhyate | satata jāpyena manasā yamicchati taṃ karoti | anukaṃpā rajīvākvārīnnāśayati | vairiṇaṃ jvareṇa gṛhṇāpayati | vacasā mātreṇa sarvaṃ gṛhṇati | labhedbhairava jñānañca tridaśairapi durlabhaṃ | anena jñānamātreṇa devatā vindati svayaṃ | pralaya sṛṣṭikāro bhavati | jāpyameva sadākāryaṃ yogindrairapi tiṣṭhan gacchan bhuṃjan pivan svayaṃ maithunepi mānasa jāpaṃ na tyajet | taṃ dṛṣṭvā mohitāḥ sarve janaḥ mohitā bhavaṃti | rātrau sadā japet | uddiśya śarīrā bhavaṃti | kumārīnāṃ sadā pūjāṃ kuryādyathā vibhavaśaktinā | tato siddhiryoginīnāṃ bhavati ca striyā yadi siddhiṃ samīhate | meghatsaṃ bhayati | sphoṭa yati ājñayā devaṃ dharṣayati | ādityaṃ vārayati anena siddhirbhavati | saṃyogi bhairavaḥ svayaṃ | avaśyaṃ siddhyate devī bhairave sadā sthite | nānyathā siddhimāpnoti devatāpi kadācanaḥ | eṣa maṃtreśvaro rājāmaṃtrāṇāṃ pretanāyakāḥ | prāpayiṣyaṃti devyāstu putra tu nānyate viḍambakāḥ | yathāstu gṛhṇate devī śāddhya vinā prāpyate | narasyā vasya maraṇaṃ pātra sahasrake |
(kiṃ bahunā ājñā siddhirbhavati | hṛdayaṃ vā sarvasiddhiḥ sarve maṃtrāḥ sarvakāryāṇi kurvanti | tasya śmaśāne (**********) (***********)(?) | <ṭhis line is bottom of page.>
<9a>
anāvikṛtepivāyaḥ praṇata aparaparamamatanuṃ devyāyā guhyamuttamaṃ |
mukhena siddhyate sauce maṃtroccāraṇa vidhānataḥ |
bhairavaśca mahābhāgā hrīṃ chrīṃ cūṃ devyā hṛdayaṃ pratyekaṃ ca maheśvarī |
oṃ namo bhairavī prathamaṃ devī kṣobhiṇī ca dvitīyakaṃ | mahāpralayakāriñca tṛtīyaṃ marmameva ca ||
marmābhighāte tritrayaṃ caturthaṃ tu padaṃ likhet | paṃcamaṃ kili kili svevaṃ kici kici padaṃ tataḥ | hrīṃ chrīṃ amukaṃ kāryaṃ me kuru kuru svāhā ||
oṃ namo hrīṃ khphreṃ hūṃ phreṁ bhairavī kṣobhiṇī mahāpralayakāriṇī marmamarmābhighāte kili <2> kici <2> hrīṃ chrīṃ amuka kāryaṃ me kuru <2> svāhā | ityukto maṃtro deva durlabhaḥ | anena siddhyate vaśyaṃ trailokyaṃ sa carācaraṃ | triruccārita vidyāṃ nityaṃ saṃdhyāṃ jāpye deśasahasrāṇi mahāsamaye kṛtvā guru pūjā parāyaṇaṃ | tena siddhiṃ prajāyate | tataḥ pūrvasūcitaṃ kāryaṃ karoti |
sakṛ uccārite naiva sarvalokavaśaṃkarī |
pūrvoktaṃ sarvaṃ karoti | phreṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svahā | anuktābhyakṣūstā śruyate | kruddho japye sādhayataḥ yaṃ icchati taṃ karoti | jvarādāhe śūlena udvejayati | tadā kṛti pādā kṛṣṭi gṛhe gṛhṇāmi | manasā yāyena yamicchati taṃ karoti | prakṛtināsa ūhereti dayati dvikhaṃṇḍāṃ karoti | icchayā bhagavati siddhā advaita bhairavī tripurā tathā |
karoti sarvakarmāṇi yatte (***)(?) manasi saṃsthitā |
maṃtrān dṛḍhavratān śrutvā bhairavāṇānusāriṇāṃ | anyeṣāṃ caiva dātavyā bhairavājñāṃ vinā tathā | vicaredvai trilokeṣu lokānvai pūrayet sadā |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sadāsiddhi pradāṃ śivāṃ |
yasyecchayā pravartate jñānaṃ bhairavabhāṣitaṃ |
<9b>
manasā varjanī yena kṛtyaṃ tadīrañca nirīkṣite | kopinā nāśanaṃ bhuktvā na tṛpto vāpi tiṣṭete | paraiḥ saha evaṃ te kathitaṃ jñātvā dravya haste tato siddhe raktanī hasacarā gṛdhra śire ca viśeṣataḥ | śivaṃ jñāna samanvitaṃ | aṃjayet netra yugalaṃ | sarveṣāṃ vāmanetravimiśritāḥ | saptapātālaṃ praviśati | icchārūpaṃ karoti | parameśvaraḥ athavā gulikena vā aṃjanāṃjitamātreṇa siddhiyogī bhavati | raktanī lolūka gṛhya hariṇī vānarī caiva nāginī praharanāyikā yoginī paṃcagāṃ caiva siddhi kṣiti dvirā sadā mukhe gulikāṃ hemaveṣṭitaṃ prakṣipya nīlimi'sritā | punaraṇyamarcayitvā nilikā madhyantatsrāvayet | evaṃ kuruternvā yojanānāṃ śatāni ca dakṣiṇena saha aṃjayet | ākāśa gamyate kṣaṇāt | merumaṇḍala kailāsa sapta dvīpāṃ caturdaśa | bhuvanaṃ bhramayati | parameśvarī siddhiyogī karotyevaṃ prakāśaṃ cāti durlabhaṃ sakṛjjāpena vā kartavyā icchayā |
anyatkarmapravakṣyāmi kālikāmaṃtramuttamaṃ |
oṃ namo bhagavate guhya kālike siddhi bhairavī cāmuṇḍe chrīṃ <2> hrūṁ <2> hrīṁ <2> hara <2> hrūṃ <2> hrāṃḥ <2> suluṃgakālī suluṃgagamanā ||
khphreṃ phreṃ bhagavati aiṃ guhyakālike hrīṃ chrīṃ phreṃ strīṃ hūṃ | aparājite | hūṁ jaḥ <1> jaḥ <2> hrūṃ phreṃ jaḥ siddhasiddhiṃ hūṃ jaḥ | caṇḍayogeśvarī hūṃ phaṭ aṃ phreṃ evaṃ prāpya vaidikīṃ prasiddhāṃ yaṃ tu yātu luṃga yogini mudrāṃ prāpayiṣya triyoginaṃga vyavasthitāḥ |
siddhiṃ tu acireṇaiva bhairava mudrā mahābalā | varṇapaṃca sthito yogī sarvatatva paripūritaḥ ||
kili <2> ṛkāre vai yogāṃ kevala jñāna prapaśyeta mṛtyukālena jāyate |
etaṃtu paramaṃ tatvaṃ durlabho yogasaṃbhavaḥ | asyaṃ bhāva na mātreṇa sarvajñatkaṃ ca prayacchati ||
<10a>
devī kādyā tu tallakṣa jāyā siddhi kāraṇa hetavo yena guptā guptena haste vījākhyaṃ parameśvarī | śarīra yoge'ṣṭottaraṃ | ekāvai yadi vā sarve tadā ki namaste namaskāreṇa asiddhe nāpi prakartavyaṃ | anajyetā parityajet ||
oṃ phreṃ hrūṃ guhyakālī hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ siṃhakā sarvopadravāt tatra maṃtra yogāḥ | khphreṃ hara <2> hūṃ phaṭ daṃṣṭrākarālī phreṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā | pratyaṃgirā siddhimukhī vidyāvāra trayaṃ smaret yattaduccāṭayati vipattau saṃkaṭe ripupakṣabhaye raṇe smaraṇāt siddhirbhavati | na kiṃcit prabhavati tasya jāpī maheśvaraiḥ | anena prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣaṃ bhojyaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nabhīḥ | tathā paraṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ datvā dhyānaṃ paṭhanaṃ || adhikāra pūjāmaṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ nityapūjā adhikaṃ pūrvapūjā aṣṭamī navamī caturdaśī saṃkrāntī pūrṇimā kuru kujavāreti | mahāsiddhirbhavati | jvaragrahāriṣṭaṃ smaraṇamātreṇa naśyati |
śrībhairava uvāca |
yamudiśya mahāsaptayaṃ kṛtvā paṭhet | etat te kālikāyāḥ paramaṃ jñānaṃ prāṇātyadhikaṃ priye gopitavyamidaṃ siddhiṃ sarvakāryaparāyaṇaiḥ |
athocyate karmabhedaṃ viśeṣaṃ parameśvari yogavijñānamātreṇa yogī tridaśahā bhavet | ubhayostano parihastapaucha calanaśiraḥ | hastatarayoḥ pūrvabhruvenākāvāṃse nāsikāgre kaṇṭhe ca udare nābhau pādāṃguṣṭha mūlaṃ tayo bhrūbhaya pārśveṣu mūrdhni pṛṣṭhe vāhulocanayoḥ viduke jihvāmūle carantalāṃ gulamūleṣu pādaśirataḥ | etā marmapradeśāni gātraṃ vasate śivaḥ tata sparśayet | acaṃcalayoḥ guhyayo liṃga udare gude sarvasaṃdhiṣu paramarma saṃcarati nābhi grīvā vṛṣaṇe hṛdaye ca sadādeva tiṣṭhati
<10b>
paramaśivaṃ karṇacalatale grīvāṃ sa kapolayo sarvatra bhramate sadā | aiṃ daṃṣṭrāka eli aiṃ hūṃ phreṃ marme marmābhi phreṃ hana <2> hana <4> hūṃ phaṭ svāhā | sarva śmaśānodbhava kena svaśaṃyati marmābhighātena vā trisaṃdhyaṃ jāpyaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgula samavistaraṃ | pādayoriti sarvataḥ ūrdhve pūjāmaṃtra | kramāddravyaṃ tu rakṣayet | aṃgulyādvyaṃgula dvitricatuṣkramaśaḥ arddhāṃgulyapatrapala dravyaṃ suvarṇa hṛṣṭa tuṣṭa sphītasudhīraścā aṃgulo na paṃcapalāstathā | arddhāddhikena paṃcapalā dvau dvādaśa krama abhitvaritāḥ suśithilā | avadvinaḥ dravyamaṃgulyādaṃgulyā kṛtvā aṃśakena haredbhāgaṃ aṃgulyādaṃgulāṃ kṛtvā svakareṇa haredbhāge śeṣa dravyaṃ tathā viśeṣagaṇita śivalocanau | gṛdhraṃ viḍālalocanau ulūkaśiraṃ dagdhā sarvāṃjaneṣu bhāvayet ||
hṛdayamaṃtreṇa jāpyena aṃjayennetrayugalaṃ | naratailamubhāvitena | aṃjitamātreṇajanmodbhavāngārikāla dravyaṃ saṃkhyā pramānaṃ paśyati adṛśyo bhavati | siddhiyogeyaṃ icchayā sarvaṃ bhavati |
dhyānayogaḥ |
māraṇe kṛṣṇarūpī ca vaśye raktaṃ prakīrtitaṃ | uccāṭe dhūmravarṇaṃ ca śāntau śubhrā prakīrtitā ||
staṃbhane pītavarṇaṃ ca icchārūpaṃ maheśvari | etat paramaguhyaṃ ca tatvanirṇayameva ca ||
oṃ khphreṃ siddhikarālī hrīṃ chrīṃ hūṃ strīṃ phreṃ namaḥ svāhā |
eṣā sā paramā devī japitavyā sadā budhaiḥ | sarvakarmāṇi sidhyaṃti manasāsittiyeni(?) vai ||
punaḥ kā kathā cittaguhya yogena siddhiṃ yogīśvarī karoti | yogini melāpaṃ karoti | sarvasu svapnaṃ darśayati |
yogini melakaṃ caiva svayameva prajāyate |
anena kāryaṃ sarvaṃ karoti | icchāsiddhiścitta vācā bhavati |
<11a>
nānārūpī sakṛ uccāraṇena prāsayet siddhi gocaro bhavet | śivaṃ rūpaṃ paśyati sarvayoginī devyādyāstadā guhākhyāguhya hṛdayena raktavaliṃ datvā madhyamaṇḍalaṃ vidhāya lekhyā bhairava yoginī nānyena kadācana | kumārike avadhāropayati guhyapradeśe likhitavyāmadyaprāsanena | paramaguhya hṛdayena raktena valiṃ datvā hṛdayena hrīṃ kārāt tena paṃcāmṛtena śodhayet | madyādyaṃ sarvadravyaṃ gatvā kṛṣṭiṃ karoti | paramaṃ trān chedayati | teṣāṃ maṃtrānāṃ vāraṇā satrārādhitā bhavati | anena maṃtreṇa adhikārān dāpayen | svaśiṣye adhikārān datvā vācayet paṭhati sakulāṃ vimala kena narakaṃ na paśyet | hṛdaya japena sarvabhūtāṃ paśyati | yamicchati taṃ karoti | gurościtta vṛttiṃ kārayet | sarvasiddhikāraṇenāsya tatra taṃtreśvaro bhavet | yoginīnāṃ taṃtra māyānāṃ kuru ḍiḍāṃ kṣetrakṣetre advaita hṛdi saṃsthite |
etadvai paramaṃ jñānaṃ tava devī prakīrtitaṃ | nānyasya ca mayā dattaṃ guhyaṃ vai paramaṃ śivaṃ ||
devyā paśyaṃ tu tatpuṇyaṃ bhāgye naiva vidyate |
bhairavāvasthitaṃ yatra sakṛ smaraṇādasya karoti icchayā yoginī bhairavī guhyakālīkā sarvatatvanuśayutāḥ | yasya yogamārgasya ādhārājjaptena udakaṃ bhramayati | gṛhavat lakṣaṃ japtvā bhavedyogī sa yogī bhairavaḥ svayaṃ | anye'ṣṭa koṭī bhairavāti tasya roma kūpe vyavasthitāni |
athavāṣṭasahasrāṇi japtavyāni ca bhairavī | eka eva hi japtavyo dhyātvā rakṣāṇi bhairavī ||
evaṃ caiva mahāsiddhirvācayā sādhakasya tu | likhanāt paṭhanāraṃbhe kaścijjīvana haṃnyate ||
likhataṃ ca bhaveddevī madyaraktālakeva ca | bhairavasye ca bījaṃ ca carccikā raktameva ca ||
<11b>
māyāvījayuge naiva pratyuvedyogamārabhet |
jvalajvalanasamaprabhaṃ | ekākī nirjane vāpi madyābhiṣikta śaṃkhamālayā |
japato yasya sākhyātaṃ bhairavānāmaśeṣataḥ | saṃdhyāyāmbā niśāyāmbā kartavyaṃ japamuttamaṃ ||
ekākīśakti maṃtra sahāyo madyābhiṣiktaḥ sānando bhūtvā mahāśaṃkhamālayāraktāmbaro bhūtvā japato yasya sākhyātaṃ bhairavānāmaśeṣataḥ |
saṃdhyāyāmvā niśāyāmvā kartavyaṃ japamuttamaṃ | aṣṭamyāmbā caturyaśyāṃ pūjyapustakaṃ yatnataḥ ||
ārāme tu prakartavyaṃ tathaivābhyāṃ prayatnataḥ |
advaitācāra bhāva sadāyogī lītvadavratamupasthitaṃ | atha nīlakarpaṭayugalena paridhāya muktakeśaraktāṃgarāgomadirānandena japet | śaktī saṃnaddhha advaitācāreṇa sākṣāt bhairavo bhavet | atha saptadaśī jāpyena acirādbhairavo bhavet | ṣoḍaśākṣara jāpena puraścaraṇaṃ vāratraye narātro siddhiṃ parāguṃṭhita śarīraṃ nareṇacāreṇa sarvaśāstrādīn dhārayet | smaraṇamātreṇa yuddhe tasya kopi purato na tiṣṭhet | vyāghra bhallukakukkuṭa veṣṭikata śivakusuma yutāṃ paragṛhamukhe prakṣipya paśurūpaṃ karoti | abhyaṃṅganaśca gomāyumārjjāri śivasya vācāri rakte na peṣayet | anena sahasrāṃ japet | dviṣaṃ dravyamapaharati | paragṛhe sarvaṃ paśyati | adṛśyo bhavati | athavā guṭikā mukhena śivarasanā chāgarasanāpīta kapilāyā kṣīreṇa piṣṭaṃ lepayet | agniṃ staṃbhayati | mārjāra raktāṃ yuktāṃ (*)(?) guḍikāṃ mukhe prakṣipyaśceta maṇḍuka cūrṇasya raktena bhāvitena | cāṇḍāli raktena miśritena udakena vilāla netre nādho vaktra aṃjanena sadā japet | jalaṃ staṃbhayati | gṛhavadbhramayati |
<12a>
netrānāṃjitamiśrena cāṇḍālī raktamiśritaṃ | adṛśaṃ bhavati | tasyā raktena yaṃ likhyatitaṃ karoti | tasyā bhāgena sahamarddha akṣayaṃ bhavati | madya raktādi śmaśāna sūtreṇa vaddhā hastena vāmaspañcetena pītena vā raktenāṃ japet | sa virūpo bhavati | kapāla cūrṇaṃ mastake deyaṃ virūpo bhavati | ete sadā siddhi prayogāḥ | gopitavyāni bhairavī na maṃtrayati | cāṇye maṃtra sahasreṣu uktādyute | siddhidā uttamottamena nirmitāḥ |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu bhairavi deveśī sarvapāpa vināsanaṃ | lokapāpavināśārthaṃ hṛdikṛtostite guru ||
bhairavīti kathaṃ nāma śāstraṃ svayaṃ vāpi nārācāgraṃthārthameva ca | ekākṣarā dvicatuḥpaṃcaṣaṭsaptākṣarādi raktā na te jānanti sa pāpiṣṭhāḥ paṭhitā siddhimichaṃti aṣṭamahāsiddhi kṣaṇādapi kathyante | asiddhyante pāpapiṇḍayojitāḥ |
mālāmaṃtraṃ mahādevī śīghraṃ siddhi phalapradā | abhyāsena mahādevī janmakoṭi śatena ca ||
ekākṣarā na siddhyaṃti śatābhyāsa viyogataḥ | tena siddhena deveśi sākṣāt sa bhairavī bhavet ||
ekākṣaraḥ saptalakṣaiḥ siddhirbhavati sarvadā |
paṃcākṣaro ṣoḍaśalakṣairnavākṣarā navalakṣaiḥ | ṣoḍaśā'kṣarā saptalakṣaiḥ saptādaśākṣarā sa eva lakṣairviśākṣāḥ || viṃṣallakṣaiścatuścatvāriśākṣarā sa eva lakṣaiḥ navatyakṣarā caturllakṣaiḥ śatākṣarā trilakṣa jāpyaiḥ paṃcāśatākṣarā lakṣadvayena | sahasrākṣaro mahāmālā lakṣaiḥ puraścaraṇa siddhirbhavati | brahmacaryaṃ naraiḥ kṛtvā saṃkhyayā caturguṇānyeva kalau kartavyā niśāyāṃ śaktisaṃnaddho bhūtvā madirānaṃdanaṃdita sa muktakeśo
<12b>
bhūtvā na paṃcakena vā'thavā vāmapathena puraścaryāṃ kṛtvā yathoktasaṃkhyayā puraścaryyā siddhirbhavati | ekākṣarāḥ dvitricatuḥpaṃcaṣaṭsaptādi raktā na tejānaṃti mantrasamayaḥ prāpitāḥ paṭhita siddhimicchaṃti mahāṣṭasiddhiṃllabhante | yāvatpūrvajanmārjita pāpapiṇḍaṃ tāvanna sidhyati | tatpuraścaraṇa jāpena pāpanāśaḥ siddhirbhavati |
mahāmālā mahādevī śīghraṃ siddhi pradāyakaḥ | abhyāsena mahādevi janmakoṭiśatena tu ||
ekākṣarā na siddhyaṃti śatābhyāsa prayogataḥ | tena siddhyati deveśi sākṣācchiva samobhavet ||
mahāmaṃtraṃ mahādevi śīghrasiddhiphalapradā | yena vijñātamātreṇa yogī tridaśahā bhavet ||
etat jñātvā prayatnena guhya caṇḍī maheśvarī | mahāsiddhi pradākāli gurupādaprasādataḥ ||
graṃthān sarvān parityajya sarvayogān vratāni ca | maṃtrān sarvān parityajya kālikā maṃtramācaren ||
kalau tu kālikā maṃtrāḥ siddhaḥ satti śivājñayā | niṣkilikā mahāvidyā digpāla padabhāgprada ||
ye atra yuktā deveśi maṃtro bhairava bhāṣitāḥ | teṣāntadvākyamātreṇa trailokyamakṣayaṃ bhavet ||
oṃ namo guhya kālike hana <2> hūṃ <2> phaṭ |
mūlamaṃtraṃ japāt sarvasiddhiṃ karoti | etadviśeṣa karadevī mūlamaṃtrasya bhairavī |
sarvāmnāya parāṃ devī kālikā guhya nirmitā |
oṃ phreṃ siddhiṃ hskhpreṃ śkhpreṃ khpreṃ karāli khphreṃ hskhphreṃ khphreṃ phreṃ oṃ svāhā | śrīrāmo pāsitā || samudrakūle śrīrāmāya rāvaṇavadhārthe nāradena dattāṃ || 17 ||
rhrīṃ hskhphreṃ khphreṃ oṃ hrīṃ phreṃ siddhi karālī chrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ | parama śrīguhya brahmopāsitā || 16 ||
hrīṃ śrīṃ rhrīṃ hskhphrīṃ rahakṣamalavarayūṁ khphreṃ jrīṁ smlyūṁ rkṣrīṁ smkṣlyūṁ
<13a>
siddhi kāli phaṭ | tatra bheda vaśiṣṭho pāsitā || 17 ||
hrīṁ śrīṁ rhrīṁ hskhphrīṁ rahakṣamalavarayūṁ khphreṁ rhrīṁ rmlyūṁ rkṣīṁ khphrīṁ strīṃ chāṁ siddhi karāli phaṭ | hiraṇyakaśiphapā(?) sthitā || 17 ||
oṃ khphrai hskhphrīṁ oṃ phreṃ hrīṁ chrīṁ hūṁ strīṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ rhkṣmlvryīṁ śrīṁ oṃ hrīṃ hskhphreṁ khphreṁ śivopāsthitā || 17 ||
oṃ hrīṃ śrī khphreṃ oṃ hskhphreṃ haṃ rakṣamalavarayūṃ rkṣrīṃ rkṣrīṃ jrīṁ strīṃ chrīṃ juṃ phreṃ khphreṃ prīṃ nama kāli mahāsaptadaśi || 17 ||
tato hṛdayavidyā || oṃ khphreṃ hskhphreṃ khphreṁ hrīṃ ||
mahāhṛdayavidyā || <5> oṃ hrīṃ khphreṃ hskhphreṃ khphreṁ ktīṃ namaḥ amāvāsī | kiṃkartavyamapareṇa maṃtreṇa tyaktā śrīguhyakālikāṃ | devāśca grahanāgāśca sarve te ājñā siddhikarī siddhiḥ | tasyā siddhi maheśvari | ete viśeṣakarī devī prakāsya ca maheśvarī lakṣajāpena pūrvajanmārjita kaluṣaṃ dahet | dvitīya lakṣena viśuddho bhavati | tṛtīyena devyā saṃnidhānaṃ caturthena samarasaṃ paṃcameṇa maṃtramuddharet | ṣallakṣeṇasiddhirbhavati | tato yatheṣṭaṃ maṃtraṃ kārayet | oṃ phreṃjāmahadahapacamānamoṭaya ānaya gṛhnaya veddhā cavadajalpajāt praviśya marmeti ca sā sarvaṃ karoti | paṃcalakṣeṇa sarvayoginīnāṃ pūjanīyo bhavati | ṣaṣṭhe rudrātmanāṃ | navame mahābhairavaḥ koṭīnāṃ sarvajñā sadāśivo bhavatīti | evaṃ jāpena sarvaṃ karoti | cinmaṃtra cistāmujyayogāllakṣajāpena sarvaṃ siddhyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ | evaṃ jāpyāṃ yāvanmanośuddhirbhavati | tāvanmaṃtrai siddhiṃ kuto bhavati | karmakāṇḍe mānāpūjāṃdi nāmo
<13b>
hitānvavalokānte tatra caṃḍinaṃ paṭhati | punarsiddhirbhavatu micchati | pāpakarma sā kṛte siddhirbhavatiḥ | kālikāyā mayāproktaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhite siddhidaṃ | kuto'nyatra siddhiḥ kalau yuge mahādevī jāpyena siddhyate kramāt | kṣudra karmāṇi paṭhitamātreṇa siddhyaṃti | kintena kṣudrakarmāṇāpāpakāriṇo hetunā | tataḥ śrīguhyakālikā avaśya siddhidā tato'ntenirvāṇa maṃtrāḥ kathitā | khṃ bhedānte | phreṃ hskhphreṃ khphreṃ |
etat gopyaṃ mahādevī devānāmapi durlabhaṃ |
gurupadeśaṃ vinā na siddhiḥ | anāvikṛtāpi ye devi te devāpi na paṭhanti | bhāvinī te tatkṣaṇāt narakaṃ vrajaṃti | avaśyaśca maheśvarī | mānuṣāṇāṃ ca kā kathā utkīlitā doṣo tasmāt ahaṃ bhairavaṃ svayaṃbhūryasya tiṣṭhāmi | sarvadā dvaitamatānusāriṇaḥ | avaśyaṃ siddhyate devī suṣuptau yoginīnāṃ yathā na kasyāpi kathānīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ | agniguhyā bhrāmitavyā maṇḍalādinā yoge tathaiva ca mahāmāṃsahomat | mānasopacāreṇa sarvaṃ sidhyati | bhairavo bhavati | kriyāmaṃtrādikaṃ sarvakarmāṇi mānasena aruṇodaye sidhyati | māṃsayuktaṃ dhūpeṇa māṃsahomena hantavyānīti niścaye kriyā taṃtre |
śrīdevyuvāca ||
yathā bhairavakobhīṣma mama tuṣṭo maheśvara | akathyamapi deveśa nirvyātaṃ kathayā prabho ||
ye maṃtrā yogināṃ deva mānasaiḥ siddhidāḥ smṛtāḥ | bhāvena manasā vyāpti siddhidā guhyakālikā ||
yoginināṃ ca yā ceṣṭā tanme kathaya bhairava | utphulla nayano bhūtvā bhairavo vākya mabravīt ||
śrībhagavānuvāca ||
aṭṭahāsā ca pīṭhāṣṭa brāhmyādyā mātaraḥ sthitāḥ | tatraiva saṃsthitā nityā kālīṃ bhuvana pūjitā ||
<14a>
siddhirbuddhi mahādevī tvayā sṛṣṭosmi bhairavaḥ | kathayāmi parāṃ devīṃ guhyakālī samudbhavāṃ ||
oṃ namo hrīṁ phreṃ marmemarmābhighāte marmarakṣaṇī namaḥ samarakṣara sarvato me rakṣa <2> pūrvato aṃtarhitaṃ kuru <2> hrāṃ huṃ phreṃ gupa <2> gopaya <2> caṇḍike dhūmāṃgāriṇī trailokyaṃ vasamānaya <2> hili <2> sarvān mohaya <2> bhaṃjaya <2> kīlaya <2> kili <2> siddhe huṃ phreṃ ṭha ṭhaḥ |
etat siddhikaraṃ maṃtraṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamaṃ | mohanaṃ ca bhaved rakṣāṃ śikhāṃ vaddhvā na dṛśyate ||
siddhaṃ raktasūtreṇa granthivaṃdhena sarvato rakṣati | smaraṇamātreṇa jalagataṃ sthalagataṃ raṇāgni gataṃ vyāghracaurāhave viṣasiṃhato rakṣā(,)m karoti | sadā smaret śikhāṃ vadhvā sadā kāryaṃ athavā maṃtrī vījaṃ vādhārayet | śmaśānabhasmanā samopāsita vyāghra caurāhave viṣasiṃhato rakṣati | tadbhasmanā tripuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā athavā dṛśyopi dṛśyo bhavati | aiṃ marmemarmābhighāte ṭha ṭha siddhibhairavabhāṣitaṃ gurusaṃtoṣaladhva acireṇa siddhirbhavati |
te huṃkārāntaritaṃ divyaṃ nānābhāva prakirtitaṃ | kṣrīṃ strīṃ aṃjaritaṃ divyaṃ nānā śastra prakīrtitaḥ ||
chrīṃ hrīṃ kārāṃtaritaṃ divyaṃ paṃcikāra prakīrtitā | pheṃ huṃ aṃtaritaṃ divyaṃ hrīṃ huṃ saḥ saḥ antaritaṃ divyaṃ japāścaiva prakīrtitāḥ |śvetākṣī <2> varṣaṃtya viśitā padmāsana sthitā svāhā |
śveta sarvaṃ pivet kṣīraṃ varṣaṃ mātrā samāśritāḥ |
jaṃbūka gṛdhrābhyāṃmuśāntaye manasā japan udakena mahāśāṃtirgarjjati sarvapraharaṇo jvaraḥ | svaśarīraṃ dhyātvā sarvacakretha ca sthitā | valīpalitanāśanekaṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> varṣa <2> amṛtamaye krī phreṃ marmemarmābhighātike hāhāmamarakṣaṇaṃ sarvepi dravabhāsinī
<14b>
hana <2> hūṃ phaṭ | śāṃtopadravanāśini | oṃ kīṃ kīṁ kāṃ <2> phreṃ varṣa <2> kāṃ <2> namaḥ | evaṃ mūrdhnākṣīravāntaraṃ kāreṇa sarvagātra pūrṇavalipalitanāśane bhāvayet | sarvagrahakṣayarogādīnnāśaye siddhimaṃtroyaṃ aiṃ saḥ svecche hūṃ phreṃ svayaṃ pārśvachedanaṃ karoti | śivastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ pravakṣyāmi | uraṭṭacharadudara iṃ huṃ etajjalita pralayātala samaprabhaṃ |
vedhaṃ caiva pravakṣyāmi guru vaktrāmaru kramāt |
aiṃ marme <2> chedanī hara <2> vaṃdha <2> pāra <2> kapa <2> dhuna <2> hūṃ hrīṃ <2> phreṃ hara <2> marmemarmābhighāte gṛnha <2> hara heṃ hūṃ phreṃ amukasya mano vāk buddhi hṛdayaṃ smṛtiṃ hara <2> hrīṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> phreṃ <2> |
evaṃ śikhāvaṃdhalayaṃ nāsti | jāpyena dṛṣṭimātreṇa karṣayati | yaccintitaṃ tadviruccāreṇa sidhyati | māraṇe vikaṭotkaṭādina karoti samaprabhaṃ | rudhiracchaṭācchaṭita raktanetraṃ rudhiraṃ peyātra juṣaṃti daṃṣṭrā karāla lalajihvā ucchvāso chvāsavahulaṃ sarvaṃ tasya hṛdaye bhakṣayet bhyo kṣobhitā khaṇḍamuṇḍikariṣyati | aiṃ phreṃ marmemarmābhighāte hana <2> hūṃ phaṭ hai phaṭ hara <2> mara <2> māra <2> gṛhe <2> hrīṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> plūṃ <2> hrīṃ hūṃ <2> phaṭ <2> hana <2> bhakṣa <2> mahārākṣasīye ha <2> hūṃ phaṭ amukamāraya <2> hūṃ phaṭ | sarvapraharaṇādīn sarvadevān grahamānobhakṣātītaṃ māraya brahmaviṣṇuṃ kiṃ puruṣānyunaḥ kṣadramānuṣān vajre mudgara cūrṇitāṃ gṛdhra pṛṣṭhe tiṣṭhati | pherukākapecaka veṣṭitaṃ mahāpāśena vaddhaṃ cintanīyaṃ uccāṭane kṣekāra madhye marmemarmābhighāte | puruṣeṇa naya <2> nayānaya <2> uccāṭaya <2> aiṃ phreṃ phaṭ | amukamuccāṭaya ūrdhvakeśī hūṃ phreṃ namaḥ | dhyānenaṃ pāpanāsaṃ na vacasā pāpaṃ nāśayati | aiṃ marmemarmābhighāte dhūmre dhūmrā kule
<15a>
viṣadṛṣṭiṃ chrīṃ <2> amukasya amukena saha virodhaṃ kuru <2> vidveṣaya <2> durbhage hūṃ phreṃ svāṃśena vidveṣe kalahe japtavyaṃ vidveṣaṃ karoti | aiṃ hrīṃ <2> marmemarmābhighāte saṃhāriṇī bhaṃjaya mohaya <2> hrī hūṃ samuraye amukaṃ vaśaṃ kuru <2> hūṃ <2> vivātarakṣaṇī chrīṃ <2> vidveṣakara jāpyenāmukaṃ vaśaṃ karoti | rājādīnāṃ puṣpatāmbūlādīnāmanasā japyeṇa ete prayogā paṭhita siddhāḥ triśūlena sarvāṇi dhyāyet prāṇaiḥ krodhe vahnogni dahana triśūlā ruḍha sādhye vidveṣa śeṣa uccāṭane akulamanaḥ vaśe śāṃttamanaḥ evaṃ karma sarvādhi akṣarāṇāṃ haraṇaṃ vakṣe pustake ye ca tat maṃtraṃ siddhāṃtayogamamantraistrailokyaharaṇaṃ | aiṃ marmemarmābhighāte caṃḍiṇī hrīṃ <2> kaṭṭa <2> hara <2> prahara <2> achoṭaya <2> sarvākṣarāntaṃtraṃ maṃtrādi sarvajñānāṃ amukasya hara <2> hrīṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> haiṃ haraṇī <2> achoṭanī hrīṃ | evaṃ jāpyabhāvena haraṇajñāna vijñāna yogatantrādīnāṃ trailokyasya krāṃ hrīṃkāreṇanāśaye yaṃ maṃntitavyaṃ anena jāpyena anyaṃ vā trailokyaṃ pravalināmākarṣaṇāya pāśāṃkuśena evaṃ devyādyāna ākarṣanaṃ | aiṃ cāmuṇḍe phreṃ caṇḍe hūṃ dara <2> hrīṁ māraya <2> khphreṃ marmemarmābhighāte phaṭ daha <2> hūṃ hūṃ draṃ kṣaṃ hūṃ phaṭ sarvabhūtaśākinyādīnāṃ sarvabhūtadamanī mahāmāriṇī huṃ bhairavī bhairava sahite hūṃ phaṭ kṣuṃ hūṃ <2> phaṭ <2> | sarvaduṣṭadamanaṃ sarvatra yojyaṃ aiṃ hūṃ phreṃ caṇḍabhairavīṃ daṃṣṭrotkaṭaṇī sarvanāgā bharaṇamuṃdrite haiṃ <2> hūṃ <2> sarvanāgān paca <2> daha <2> saptapātālavāsinī durgaṃ smara <2> hrīṁ <2> huṁ <2> kaṭa <2> viṣabhakṣaṇī sarvanāgakule chedanī hūṃ phreṃ <4> haḥ <4> kṣaḥ <3> hūṃ <5> sarvanāga kṣobhinīye svāhā | nāgakṣobhinī vinirvaśī karaṇī mahāvidyā kāryakāle paṭhanīyā vyayāhūtīṃ karā jvalitā kārāṃ jvalana madhye gatāṃ | huṁkāramadhye kṛtvā bhagaṃ jvalayet | yāvan mūrddhvo paṃthā me niścala kroṃ
<15b>
krīṃ kāreṇa kaha <2> pātaya <2> śvetadṛṣṭi dhyānāt jvarāpayeti kumārikāṃ athavā marmekāmnānmaje cala <2> hūṃ <2> hrīṁ <2> maṃdirāmatte | siddhijāpyena | oṃ hūṃ phreṃ marmemarmasaṃkocanī manamanodbhavaṃ hrīṃ <2> hrīṃ mahābhairavī siṃhasārdulavyāghrādinī sarvapaśudamanīmardinī hūṃ <3> phreṃ mṛgeśvarī caṇḍinī chrīṃ <2> strīṃ <2> huṃ <2> phaṭ he svāhā | siṃhādi sarvapaśūnāṃ sādhanī mūlakarmavidyā sarvakarmakarī ājñāpayati vānāttara praviṣṭe parvatādiṣu | aiṃ caṇḍe marmamohinī hrīṃ <2> huṃ <2> phretkāro karāli kili <2> sarvapakṣī rājārājñi sarvapakṣirājadamanī chrī <2> hūṃ <2> haiṃ <2> phaṭ haiṃ namaḥ svāhā | sarvapakṣī rājārājñī sarvapakṣī damani aiṃ mahāvāruṇī marmemarmābhighāte mohinī hūṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> hūṃ <2> hiri <2> saraṇḍa <2> makarakuṃbhīramatapakacchapādīnāṃ sarvajīvadamanī chrīṃ <2> vāha <2> hrīṃ <2> hraḥ <2> gṛhna <2> phaṭ | kuṃbhīramakarakachapamatsyādiṣu rājñī siddhiḥ siddhāmanasā smaret | sarve te vaśagā bhavaṃti | oṃ caṇḍe mahāvetāli marmemarmābhighāte hūṃ <2> strīṃ vetālasiddhiṃ me dara <2> chrīṃ strīṃ hrīṃ <2> phaṭ he ||
vetāla siddhi japena śmaśāne bali pradānāt | tena kiṃkareṇa yamichati taṃ karoti | oṃ cāmuṇḍe daṃṣṭrākarāle marmavidyā te hūṃ <2> sarvabhūtasādhinī haiṃ <2> kili <2> kici <2> hūṃ <5> heṃ sarvabhūtasādhini | oṃ cāmuṇḍe phreṃ vikaṭotkaṭe hraṃ <2> hana <2> phaṭ <2> dama <2> vāha <2> mohaya <2> jaṃbhaya <2> staṃbhaya <2> sarvāndaya <2> mardaya <2> khphreṃ hreṃ <2> marmemarmābhighāte huṃ <3> dama <2> haiṃ <2> vāha <2> chrīṃ dara <2> hrīṃ <2> hara <2> sarvatrailokyavāhinīṃ huṃ phreṃ kili <2> hrīṃ chrīṃ <2> hūṃ strīṃ pheṁ namaḥ svāhā ||
trailokya mohinīvidyā manuṣyāṇāṃ tu kā kathā | sarveṣvapi kavaśveṣu vinodepi na dṛśyate |
<16a>
maṇḍalaṃ śmaśānodbhavena bhasmādīnāṃ sadā mahāsamayaṃ abhiṣekaṃ abhāvināna prakāśayet | gurubhaktiṃ vinā sarvaṃ na siddhyati | rātrau yatpūjāyā devyai yat prakalpitaṃ vastrālaṃkāra hiraṇyarajatakāṃśyatāmrādi bhakṣapeyopahārādi siṃdurādi ādarśakaṃ kaṭikākajalādikaṃ svaguruve tajjāpāyai dikṣitāyai yatprakalpitaṃ vastrālaṃkāra hiraṇya rajataṃ kāṃśyatāmrādi bhakṣapeyopaharādi nivedayet | atra varṇadharmo nāsti | kālikulārṇave sarvamekavarṇa mudāhṛtaṃ vipracāṇḍāla tulyaṃ syāt | varṇabhinne matibhraṃsaḥ kālikā vimukhī bhavet | advaitena tayā pūjā kālikā sumukhī sadā laghutaṃtrena(?) prākāśya gurubhakti vivarjitaḥ | ātmasaṃbhāvitā ye gurudūṣakāḥ | na teṣāṃ kālikā kathanīyā bhairavaṃ sākṣā guruṃ paśyati sarvatatvapāraga sarvajña sarvakartāraṃ śivatatvaṃ samarpayet | devi sa śiṣya siddhi bhājanaṃ guru chāyāṃ na laṃghayet | viprakṣatriyavaiśyādīnāṃ vṛṣalādapi tatsiddhinādapi kālikā brahmādistasvānta vyāpini tadanugā sarva eva krama guruṃ kṛtvā praṇamya maṃtropadeśaṃ grāhya | munirvikalpena tena kadācit samayaṃ na praṇamet kākaparasparamivaleṣayet | evaṃ guru laṃghitamātreṇa siddhirhānīryāti svayaṃ yāti rasātale | na gurornāma gṛhnīyād yoginīnāṃ tathaiva ca | mahānarakapāto bhavati | ācāryasya guṇāgrāhyā doṣā naiva kadācana | guṇena siddhiruddiṣṭā dveṣeṇa narakaṃ vrajet | sanmaṃtrā sarvagātre dhyāyet | dhyātvā svaśiṣyānāṃ dīkṣayet | gurave sarvaṃ nivedayet | hānī aśva bhūmiratnavastrālaṃkārādikaṃ deyaṃ | svarṇaraupyaṃ aparamanorocitaṃ sarva vai pradātavyaṃ gurave | svayaṃ bhikṣāntaṃ bhojayitvā guruṃ toṣayet |
<16b>
khphreṃ mahācaṇḍayogeśvarī kāpālinī hūṃ phaṭ yogeśvarī kāpi śakti yauvanodvratā svaṃrūpā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā sugaṃdha vātā kāmayituṃ | dātavyā guroravaśyaṃ gurureva guhyakālikālikā siddhaye yo cikitsā yā gurave sādhyagaṃ karoti avicakṣaṇaḥ | maheśvarī tasyā pramāṇa sahasrāṇi yāti | vai aśubhāni vai | mahānarakaṃ yāti śivājñayā etat tena paraṃ jñātvā mohanneva tu kārayet |
na ghṛṇaṃ na ca lobhaṃ ca mohaṃ kopaṃ tathaiva ca | na cāhaṃkāra mātsaryaṃ divānidrāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
na śivāṃ hākayed devīṃ javāpuṣpaṃ na dhārayet | brāhmaṇena namaskuryāduttarācaryadeśikaḥ ||
guhyāti guhyaṃ vakṣyehaṃ yoginī samayakramaṃ | oṃ aiṃ hskhphreṃ aiṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ kaṭ <2> ānaya <2> alpādatama hrasvādvahutara sarvamānaya <2> aśoṣaṃ kuru <2> bhakṣyabhojyādinā chrīṃ <2> hreṃ <2> hūṃ <2> āruṇavārāhi aṃ a tanmamuktakeśī khaṃ pracchamne tadudakaṃ vāmahaste gṛhyā karṣayet | puratasthānī sthāpayet | oṃ hrīṃ kāli <2> mahāyoginināṃ hrīṃ <2> āraya <2> bhaya <2> pūraya <2> aśoṣyamadyaṃ kuru <2> vrūṃ hrīṃ phreṃ namo vāruṇī ghuru <2> bhara <2> chrīṃ hūṃ <2> gluṃ slūṃ pluṃ mluṃ nlūṃ aśoṣamahāvāruṇī aṃ aḥ doṣāntaṃ ca <2> yāṃ rāṃ lāṃ vaṃśopavitraṃ kuru <2> aṃ āṃ krāṃ guhyājñā avatara <2> namaḥ svāhā | pātraṃ kuṃbhabhakṣayāmi | aiṃ hrīṃ hūṃ cāmuṇḍe raktalocane māṃsa utpātaya <2> śodyaitaṃ bhakṣaya <2> jalpa <2> haṃsa <2> bhrama <2> ākula <2> śoṣaya <2> name koriṇī hrīṃ hara <2> namo mahāpretasaṃkule hūṃ gṛhna <2> hūṃgāya <2> hūṃ nṛtya <2> chrīṃ <2> praviśya <2> hrīṃ roṣaya <2> hūṃ <2> bhrāmaya <2> amukaṃ jvareṇa gṛhna śākinyādīnāṃ gṛhnāpaya <2> hūṃ grahe mahāgrahe
<17a>
hūṃ bhūtamātre vetālī hūṃ phreṃ sarvāriṣṭa jvaro bhavati | japadhyāna yogāt | oṃ phreṁ hūṃ siddhi cāmuṇḍe chrīṁ hrīṃ śrīṁ icchārūpiṇī caturdaśa | bhuvanaṃ hūṃ phre sarvakṣīrāmālinī icche svāhā | oṃ namo haṃ hūṃ phaṭ sphoṭaya cāmuṇḍe daṃṣṭrā karāle kili <2> hūṃ <2> chrīṃ hrīṃ <2> unmūlaya <2> utpāṭaya <2> bhaṃjaya <2> hana <2> kramāvaya <2> jaya <2> saṃcāraya <2> haṁ gṛhṇa <2> unmūlinī cāmuṇḍe mahāmāri triśūla vajre yena hūṃ <2> phaṭ mahāmohinī namaḥ svāhā sarṣapeṇa bhasmena vā samutpāṭayet | siddha vacasā vṛkṣaṃ parvatakapālādīnāṃ sarvālaṃ utpāṭayati | oṃ namo cāmuṇḍe mahāvajreśvarī śīte phreṃ hūṃ triśūlīṃ kuśena niruddha <2> dharaḥ (***)(?) ya <2> hara <2> mahābhayakāriṇī sarvayogavyādhiharaṇīṃ hūṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> hrīṁ <2> trīṃ <2> phreṃ phaṭ <5> phṭ | vidyutkoṭi tejasevana <2> hana <2> oṃ hūṃ gṛhna phaṭ <5> namaḥ svāhā | triśūle (*)(?) tarjani ke (*)(?) nāthaṃ udakaṃ dhārayet | sarṣapaṃ sphoṭayati meghān vārayati | mūṣala tatanduka bhaktakāṣṭhikā kulaculalani saṃhārikīkayā ulūkhala paṃcāvanakamudgarasaṃhāriṇī yoginī praharaṇā dehalī kaṇḍanīkāṃjīkuṃbhastān muhārikā rajasthā catuḥpatheka liṃge ekavṛkṣaguhyapradeśe śmaśānaśceti samayasāmagrīṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ maṃgalavāsare samayavārake pūjāṃ kṛtvā sādhayet | oṃ phreṃ namo śmaśāna vāsinīṃ dhūmre hāriṇī cāmuṇḍe ākarṣaṇī hrīṃ kaṭṭa <2> chrīṃ amukasya raktaṃ piva <2> dhāraṇaṃ(?) sarvacoṣaṇī cūṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> rakta priye <2> nheṃ <2> phaṭ raktavarṣaṇī hri phre <2> svāhā | raktavṛṣṭi samaye yoginīnāṃ japena siddhyati | mahācaruṃ bhakṣaṇīṃ | imāṃmuccāryā raktaṃ nalikāyāmapakṛṣṇa ākarṣayet | paścāt svātpra(##?)
<17b>
kumāri anāmikā raktaṃ dahet | bhaṃgārikā bhavati | sarvasaptajanma prāpyamātreṇa na siddhyati māṃsamahāmāṃsaṃ bhakṣayet siddhi carusādhana icchāmātreṇa dvitīyapiṇḍa kṛtvā parapurapraveśaṃ karoti | hreṃ hreṃ kāreṇa jaḥ (*)(?) hrīṃ ceti parivartanaṃ | aiṃ namaḥ cāmuṇḍe siddhikāli marmemarmābhighāte chrīṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> hūṃmāra <2> dara <2> bhakṣa <2> khāda <2> saha <2> madha <2> āma <2> chrīṃ <2> bhoṃ phreṃ phreṃ hana hūṃ <2> phaṭ namaḥ svāhā | vyāghracarmaśivācarma vāsa ca paṭalaṃ naracarma na vā vocchānakaṃ uddharitvā carmavokānakaṃ prakṣipya cho ye vaśa sarvacarusamataṃ kṣiptvā | sakṛjjaptvā hunet | tatpatena saṃśayaḥ | mūlamaṃtreṇabhāvaṃ trailokyaṃ hanti | kaṃ punaḥ kṛudramānavān taṃ sarvaprahastaṃ gataṃ marmakoṭiśataṃ karoti | icchayā siddhe svapitṛnnapi hanet mārayet | krodhadhāraṇe kā kathā punaḥ parasainyanāsanaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūlamaṃtraṃ jñānine | yena vijñāna mātreṇa bhaṃjayet koṭi śatāni ca jaya bhāvaścāpi karma viśeṣaṃ yojayet | oṃ namo hūṃ phreṃ phaṭ hūṃ <2> namo marmemarmābhighāte parapiṇḍābhighātinī | paravala paralokaṃ jñātya vāhi kuvānduṣṭā vindha <2> salpa <2> sphoṭaka <2> luṇṭha <2> dhara <2> jāha <2> ākrama <2> hṛdayanetrakaṇṭhe ākrama | hastapādajaṃ ghabhaṃjamoṭa <2> dhara <2> hara <2> bhakṣa <2> aṃdhakāraṃ kuru <2> asakṣamaṃtraṃ darśaya <2> mahābhayaṃ kuru <2> hūṃ <2> phaṭ <5> phreṃ hrīṃ <2> hūṃ mahāmoha hanaḥ hraṃ <5> phaṭ <5> svāhā | iyāṃ hi paramāvidyā siddhibhairavabhāṣitāḥ paṭhitaḥ siddhibhaṭṭārikāyā dvajāgre ca secayet | athavāgrato jayeddhyāyet | nāgapāśena vaddhvā mahākṛṣṇa dhūlīdhūmadhūsara <2> hūṃ <2> phaṭ duṣṭacaurāṃ pātayet | mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā tasyāsi māyāṃ yā pākramannikhanet | bhaṭṭārikā pūjā maṃtra bhāvena brahmādyāstaddhṛdaye
<18a>
yo vi(?) kiṃ punaḥ kṣudramānavādgṛhe vidyāyā likheccakraṃ vyavasthāyāṃ saṃpūjya ca sarvaduṣṭacauro padravān agnivānādi vacaṃ(?) nāśeyet | evaṃ pūjā manothavā | oṃ namo hūṃ phreṃ marmemarma saṃvinī vadha <2> nāgapāśena sarvamadhyāt kuṭṭa <2> mahāṃkuśena tāḍaya <2> sphoṭaya <2> hana <2> dama <2> hana <2> hūṃ hrīṃ <2> meghasādhinīnāṃ sādhaya <2> ājñāpaya <2> daha <2> paca <2> māraya <2> chrīṃ <2> pracaṇḍe phreṃkāriṇī sarvameghadamanīya varṣāya <2> hreṃ <2> phreṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> ṭhaṭha(?) meghasādhinī meghāḥ siddhyanti jāpena | ājñayā vācā sarvameghā varṣayaṃti | eṣā ca pṛṣṭhamāruhya yatrecchati tatra gacchati | yamicchati taṃ karoti aiṃ hrūṃ <2> hreṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> marmemarmābhighāte chrīṃ <2> nānā vimānavāsinī vimānasiddhirmedada hūṃ phreṃ svāhā | vimānasādhinī vidyānāgavimāna siddhyate | aiṃ marmemarme sarvamarma saṃkocinī hūṃ <4> hrīṃ sarvaśatrusādhinī śaṃkhacakratriśūlavajrāṃkuśa pāśaśaradhanustomaramudgaravajraśūcīkanayakuṃtaparaśūlaguḍaśrachāṭa anekanānāśastradhāriṇī sādhinī hrūṃ ha hrīṃ mahāmāyā mahāgaurī śaṃkhacakratriśūlavajrāṃkuśapāśaśaradhanustrīmudgaravanabhūvīkanayako sarvaśatrusādhinī amukaśastrasiddhiṃ dada <2> chrīṃ sarvasādhinī mahābhagavati sarvaśastra pūṃ(?) kule phreṃ hūṃ <5> heṃ phreṃ ṭha ṭhaḥ | eṣā vidyā sarvaśastrāni sādhayet | sarvaśastrāni bhavaṃti |
yāni tāni śastrāṇi svarūpāṃ kṛtvā janayet |
anena vidyānukūle prakaṃpito valividhānānāṃ sādhakasya jihvānimaṃtī | kartṛchepa gṛhītavyā sa tasya evaṃ śastro bhavati | tāṃ gṛhyayamichatitaṃ karoti |
amoghasiddhiṃ kiṃ vahunā yāni yāni siddhiṃ na śruyate |
<18b>
tāni tāni kālikāmaṃtreṇa kurvataḥ sādhakaprāptā mahākālikā viciṃtya bhūye yathā sukhaṃ nānākroñjayathechayā siddhi yogī bhavet tasya advaitayogabhāvataḥ | atījñānīsarvāni bhakṣayet | advaitī bhagavatī rasarasāyaṇam bhavati | divya cakṣujñāna mūlamaṃtraṃ japtvā sādhitākāramvā hūṃ chāṃ amṛtavatīṃ phreṃ nānāsiddhiṃ sādhinīṃ hūṃ <2> sarvarasa ghrāṇaharī chrīṃ <2> jaṃsa chrī sāstrī niyamādi manena vā sarvakuru <2> namo siddhi cāmuṇḍā sugaṃdhavatī | oṃ hūṃ hreṃ bhakṣa <2> khāda <2> praviśya <2> śuddhāni śraddhave daha <2> paca <2> paritrāpa <2> duṣṭadravyāṇi bhasmīku <2> phreṁ heṃ kāriṇī svāhā | sarvabhakṣaṇe sarvasarvadravyayoḥ | aiṃ huṃ mahādhvani saṃkule marmemarmo bhavet hrīṃ <2> vācavatī chrīṃ mamavāce bhara <2> hṛdaye kaṇṭhamukhe praviśya kruddha <2> avatara <2> vadahne hūṃ śrīṃ sarvajñoḥ śrīṃ svāhā | eṣā vācavatī mahāntamāṃ imāṃ jñāyate mahādevī saṃjñāsādhako bhavet japtavyā dhyātavyā sāṃti vā niyamena mānāvidhāti vedāni sarvaśāstravadananicitte japtavyā atha yatheṣṭacārī athavā strīsvarūpī (*)(?) sugaṃdhadehati vastraprāvaraṇī | siddhe vedāt sarvaśaśāstra udgrāhayati | na tena sahadevāṣaṃ vahi tatra śakyate sarvakarmakarī yogīnāśavatī prāptavayaṃtta siddhā bhavati | guhyaguṇenāpi pradāpayet | oṃ namo mahāmāye huṃ phreṃ trailokya trāṃtte chrīṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> dhāraya <2> yatra dhanadhānya suvarṇā hiraṇyadārakaṭa svamahāsiddhidarī ca mahāgaurī smṛti medhā (*)(?) vāse abhrarūpa saubhāgya sarvakāmyakāri siddhi cāmuṇḍā pūraya <2> hrīṃ sarvamanorathe nāsya yaṃ padāṃ varṣa <2> varṣāpaya <2> nidhiṃ dada <2> aṣṭaiścaryyaṃ dada <2> aṣṭaiścarya
<19a>
dada <2> putradhana āyusaubhāgyaṃ dada (*)(?) dhanadhānyaṃ daha <2> saṃtatahome taṃ sarvavṛddhiṃ kuru <2> dhana de <2> hrīṃ <2> strīṃ phreṃ ratnameghe varṣa <2> sarvayakṣān ādesa <2> ājñāpaya <2> śrīyaṃ rājyaṃ dada <2> sarvaṃ kuśalaṃ kuru <2> avighnaṃ kuru <2> namo mahāyakṣarājārājñī hrīṃ strīḥ chrīṃ <3> mahādhanade mama sarvadhanaṃ prayacchasiddhi gaurī huṃṭha namaḥ <3> svāhā | eṣāṃ paramavidyādāridraduḥkhanāśinī japeddhyāyet sarvarantraṃ prayacchati | pūjāṃ vidhinā pūjayitvā bhūrje likhitvā dhārayet | aputro labhate putraṃ saubhāgyaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca siddhisiddhi caṃ jāyate | sarvāpadavinirmukto bhavati | homena gṛhe sarvasaṃpadāndadati | tadvā mahārājavidyā satataṃ japet | mahādhanendraṃ karoti | saubhāgya antaraṃmaśaśca | bhavo bhagavati siddhi anaṃtāṃ dāpayet | anena siddhiyogī sa dhanedra koṭi samujvalī bhavati | oṃ namo bhagavatī phreṃ hrīṃ mahāmāye sarvamarme saṃkocini huṃdhura <2> vaṃdha <2> mahāpāśena kaṭṭa <2> mahāmudgareṇa cūrṇaya <2> mahāparśupāśāṃkuśa kanayakauntaśastrībhindipālakaṣaṣṭhikaṣadhyādinī aśeṣaśastrādin <2> moṭabhaṃja <2> chrīṃ hrīṃ hūṃ mamarakṣa <2> mahārakṣe mamavatra ṣaṣṭhī marmārakṣa <2> ḍhakva <2> śoṣaya <2> phreṃ <2> huṃ sarvaśastrānmoṭaya <2> mamaśakāśe mayā āgachaṃ <2> bhasma kuru <2> daha <2> bhaṃja <2> moṭa <2> staṃbhaya <2> mohaya <2> toṭa toṭa māra <2> bhaṃja <2> sarvaduṣṭannivāraya <2> namo bhagavatī mahāgaurī siṃhavāhinī huṃ phreṃ sarvaśastravāriṇī hana <2> huṃ <5> phaṭ <5> ṭha <3> namaḥ svāhā | paṭhita siddhā ipsita karma karoti | sarvaśastravāriṇī śatrūpahitāmupaharatī | manuvīryadhāraṇe sarvaduṣṭagrahannāśayati sarvapāpahaṃti | sarvopasarganāśayati |
<19b>
anayā vidyayā sarvasidhyati | sarvaśatrubhiraparājito bhavati | atha yantratrikoṇapaṃcāraṣaṭkoṇa aṣṭāradaśa patrāṇi bhūrje likhet kālikāyā sāpa hāritā huṃ chrīṃ madhye kṣreṃkāraṃ hrīṃkāraṃ adhopari evaṃ caraṇo mūrdhno yāvanti raṃdhraṃ kṛtvā jvalitākāradina karakoṭi samaprabhaṃ | sarvagātreṣvevaṃ catuṣaṣṭhi yaṃtreṣu cintayet tataḥsthā varaṃ jaṃgamaṃ vedhayet | kiṃ punaḥ kṣudramānavān yojanānāṃ sahasrāṃnte nikaṭe yadi kā kathā | evaṃ khphreṃ yāṃ khphreṃ rāṃ khphreṃ lāṃ khphreṃ vā khphreṃ śāṁ khphreṃ vāraṃ <54> | niśvāsena svaśarīraṃ dagdhvā punaḥ nisvāsvena mūlamaṃtreṇa khphreṃ vāṃ khphreṃ laṃ khphreṃ lūṃ khphreṃ lūṃ khphreṃ vāra <54> śarīraṃ utpādya amṛte plāvya tiṣṭhet apacārādi parapraṇītaviṣāgniśastrāstraṃ tatkṣaṇāt apamṛtyu svāpadādi bhayaṃ na paśyati | nābheradhasmāt | śivaśaktiparā tiṣṭhati kāṇḍa ākāra śvetavarṇaṃ srava(*)(?) amṛtātmakaṃ sarvaśāstrapurakaṃpita sighraṃ uttaritaṃ mātmānaṃ vicintayet | etaddhi paramaṃjñānaṃ jarāmaraṇanāśanaṃ | guhyaṃ paramakaṃ gopanīyaṃ nākārastaṃ manepīte vajraveṣṭitaṃ | pīte pītaṃ dhārāvarṣaṃtaṃ staṃbhane manasepsitaṃ hyeṃkāraṃ varuṇārūpa | yakārāgama saṃyutaṃ sarvāriṣṭakarī devi vyaṃgamāgatayogataḥ | uccāṭanaṃmastu hrīṃkāra paramajñānaṃ hā hī puṃso samaprabhaṃ | gamāgamayogena samānayet | āliṃgya vaśaṃ karoti noccāṭayati narādhipā | sarvasvamapahārati | svamukhe cintayati | vaśamānayati | cittaṃ harati | siṃhavyāghramahiṣagaṇḍagavayatarakṣuvarāhavāhanā devī cittinīyāstathā śravaṇakārtikī siṃhinī pūrvāvāhanā svaguhyātmānaṃ kālikāyogasamaṃ dhyāyet | sitapadmāsanasthoparacitaṃ saptadvīpāṃ yogindro siddhināmarūpī ca jñāyate | yoginī jaṃbhinī caiva hāriṇī siddhisādhanī sarvajñā kāmarūpīṇī jñāyate |
<20a>
yoginī jaṃbhinī caiva hāriṇī siddhisādhanī | sarvakāmasvarūpī ca oṃṣadhī siddhi pradāpriye ||
anena aṣṭa mahāsiddhi bhakṣaṇe kalpajīvinaḥ |
vaśīkaraṇādi sarvāṇyaiva kārayet | ye bhaktā te prajā aśeṣa graṃthā koṭi śatāni sarvāṇi kurvaṃti manasepsitāni karmāṇi karoti | ete oṣadhī siddhāsarvakarmaparā |
yogini pādalepena jaṃbhinī mohadāriṇī |
ākarṣaṇī devī trailokyaṃ āgnayet | tathā siddhisādhana arcane | sarvavyādhi vināsinī | oṃ hrīṃ bhamva <2> laya <2> sarvajñākāmarūpinī rasarasāyane | aṃjane mahāpārvatināṃ samīpe prāpyate | guṭiko sarve sarvakarmakarāḥ | atha atharvaṇa saṃhitāyāṃ | āveśaṃ kathayāmi | āvaiśaṃ mūla aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hskhphreṃ rhskhphreṃ rhskṣmlvryūṁ khphreṃ siddhikarālī phreṃ strīṃ chrīṃ hrīṃ āgaccha <2> khphreṃ mahācaṇḍe dhrī thrīṃ āvedhaya <2> phreṃ kroṃ āveṣaya <2> hrīṁ hskhphrīṁ śrīguhyakālī ājñā avatara <2> hūṃ chrīṃ huṃ namaḥ svāhā | mālā āveśamaṃtra oṃ khphreṃ hskhphreṃ khphreṃ oṃ jāpa <108> | ayutaiva pūrvasevāṃ kṛtvā puraścaraṇa pūrvakaṃ kṛtvā ajāmiṣena pāyasena hutvā karmācaraṇaṃ puraścaraṇānantaraṃ kāmyena yadi veśaṃ kriyate | tadā pratimādiṣṭaṃṇḍileyaṃntrādiṣu yathā vatpūjāṃ kṛtvā devyā puṣpaikaṃ gṛhitvā kareṇa tāpayedyadā puṣpaṃ dūrvādikaṃ ca bhramate bhramamānena sūtre(?) vikāraṃ prakāśyate tadā sa vidhānaṃ jñātvā tatkusumaṃ gṛhītvā spṛśenmaunena yasyāṃ kumārikāyāṃ vāṃ tatsannidhau gatvā taḥptyā mūrdhni puṣpaṃ datvā yadā rodanādi kukṣi śiraḥ pīḍādi vikāraṃ darśayati tadā nirjanasthānaṃ nitvā caturviṃśati tatva nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṃgādi vinyasya saṃpūjya āveśamaṃtrajāpa <108> saṃpūjyamūlena tridhā pūjā stotra trayāṃjali pradā na daśayet |
<20b>
tato mudrādi nidānaṃ | pādāṃguṣṭhamavalokayet | adhikaṃ ucchvāse tacchvāvarddhane | pādāṃguṣṭhena bhūmīṃ na spṛśatiḥ | ūrdhvanetra vikāśayeti yoginārāyaṇenaṃ lalāṭe spṛśanmanamasthā cāpi yogināṃ vāmena yoginī darśayaṃti | dakṣiṇena cchomaṃ kaṃ cibukaṃ spṛśati | amaṃtrayati | karṇayati | kuśalākuśalaṃ kiṃkaromitijaṃbhiścālayati | jihvāṃlālayati bhojyārthī samayaṃ vadati | mukhaṃ vistārayati | daṃṣṭrā raudrayati | krodhasvabhāvaṃ hṛdayaṃ spṛśati saṃtoṣaṃ jānuṃ spṛśati kukṣi spṛśati | lalāṭaṃ skaṃdhaṃ hṛdayaṃ spṛśati | mābhaiṣīrvadatīṃ ekāṃgulaṃ tarjjatī darśayati | kupitākāraṃ nāsikā kocayati | atrā saṃsūcī varttate abhivādayati pratyabhivādane kapālamudrāṃ darśayati | mauliṃ spṛśati icchārūpaṃ karoti | mahāṃkuśamudrāṃ darśayati | kāryasiddhiḥ khaḍgamudrā abhiṣṭalābhaḥ kṛtāṃjalirmudrāṃ prārthayati | kapālamudrāṃ vāruṇīṃ pivāmi ūrddhvaṃlebheṃti | kiṃ prajāmi | daṃṣṭrāṃ darśayati mahāsamayāṃ kurute nṛkuṭiṃ dhārayati śiraścālayati | mayātvaṃ bhakṣayāmite daṃṣṭrā kiṭi kiṭā payate | tvayāmapi aparādhaṃ kṛte | hastaṃ mārjayati | mayābhakṣaṃ kartavyaṃ | hūṃkāraṃ darśayati | niṣedhayati digavalokayati | phreṃkāramudrāṃ darśayati | tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati | vāhudvayaṃ lālayati | jvārakṣayāmi | bho hanuṃ lālayati | aṣayāmi | locanā vrahanālayati | tvayāhaṃ paravaśī kṛtaḥ mukhaṃ moṭayati | abhaktositi cakṣanmīlayati | mama śarīrābhāvikosīti | nāśā śrotre spṛśati | gaṃdhapuṣpadhūpaṃ dehīti | pṛṣṭhaṃ spṛśati śayāmīti triśūla mudrāṃ
<21a>
darśayati | āgatosmiti | rūdrāṇi aṃguṣṭhaṃ darśayati | brahmāṇī padmamudrayā rudrāṇī aṃguṣṭhena vaiṣṇavī vāma madhyamayā iṃdrāṇī anāmikā kaumārī kaniṣṭikā cālena lakṣmī yonimudrayā vārāhī daṃṣṭrā karālayati cāmuṇḍā oṣṭhaṃ lelihyate jihvayā | nakhāgreṇa bhūmīṃ spṛśati tava iṣṭa viyogo bhavati | vāmahastena bhūmīṃ tāḍayati | tava mṛtyu bhaviṣyati | hastamuttārayati | tava śatrurnāśayati | pārśvāvalokādajito bhavati | dakṣamullāsayati | nirjanaṃ bhavati | aṃgadhūtvā tvāṃ natyājayāmīti | jihvāṃ lālayati | tava vāṃchāṃ pūrṇayāmi | (**********)(?) cittaṃ saṃlagnāti | abhayena bhayaṃ nāsti | cittaṃ pradarśayati | prasannayati | cidralamudrayā prasannaṃ varaṇe prārthitaṃ saṃpradaṃttaṃ abhayena tava bhayaṃ nāstī | evaṃ āveśe kumārī pūjāpi mudrayā bhadrābhadra nidānaṃ | karmoloparikaṃkapālācaraṇastha guhyajapa mahāsiddhisādhane yatheṣṭacārī | icchārūpeṇa nānācarusādhanī bhavati | kāli pecikā nayanau raktapittameva ca | aṃjanenāṃ jayet | adṛśyakaraṇaṃ paraṃ | nānārūpa icchābhimaṃtrītaṃ cāṇḍāliraktamiśritena sahasrāṇāṃ dravyamapaharati | adṛśena paragṛhaṃ praveśayati | yathecchayā śastrādayo bhavaṃti guṭikaṃ mukhe kanakena veṣṭitā cāmuṇḍāliṃ prathamakusumaṃ caṃpakasya kāvapasya tasya pītaṃ ca kanake veṣṭitaṃ | mukhe prakṣipya yasya tasya svecchayā nānārūpāṇi karoti | cāṇḍālī prathamakusuma atra dhūpena dagdhapaṭhahastenāgniṃ vārayati | kṛṣṇapecikāṃ vimiśrītaṃ aṃjanena kṛṣṇā paranayanau haritālalodhrabhūlatā vaca samasta
<21b>
pṛṣṭa aṃjanena sahājapeta rātrau yathā sukhaṃ bhramati sarve lohitā bhavaṃti | tasyākṣe haritāla vacālodhra bhūlanāvacasaṃmiśritaṃ | aṃjanena saṃyutaṃ divyavyavaharikā bhavedrātrau sarvadravyaṃ dṛśyate | bhūmigatāśca ulūkanetraṃ bhāvitāyāṃ | aiṃ namo hūṃ phreṃ marme sarvakarmasaṃmocanī | bhairava sahite trailokyamātre dhara kara <2> hrīṃ <2> samu <2> sāma <2> re <2> dhūmanetrāya huṃ chrīṃ <2> phreṃ māṃ <2> idaṃ dara <2> māṃ idaṃ paca <2> māṃ vāca <2> jaṃbha <2> staṃbha <2> moha <2> hana <2> dara <2> hrāṃ uṃ hūṃ uṃ pheṃ <2> tarjaya <2> havya kavya <2> vāhanāya manojvāla hrīṃ chrīṃ phreṃ māra <2> idaṃ dara <2> idaṃ paca <2> māṃśā ca <2> hrīṃ chrīṃ hūṃ <2> yatrā gatolita trayaḥ <2> jaḥ kālāgni rājñā payati hūṃ lu <2> dhūmranetrāya hūṃ phaṭ pheṃ varṣa <2> nirvāpaya <2> bhīravī bhaja hūṃ | evaṃ japtvā tarjanī chāyā kilaya <2> vaṃdha <2> ā sphoṭaya <2> saṃkocaya <2> namo hūṃ amoghaśalye vighna <2> kiliya <2> hūṃ pheṃ sādhaya <2> hūṃ <2> namaḥ ṭhaḥ namaḥ svāhā | eṣa vai paramo maṃtra | sadyaḥ siddhi mahotsava kilite sarvaduṣṭānāṃ daityānāṃ ca maheśvari | amoghakālikā devī cintanīyā athavā kṛṣṇamayīṃ puttalikāṃ viddhāṃ kaṇṭakena trīṇivārī prakārena nāma grahaṇaṃ kṛtvā catuṣpathe tiṣatet | sarvamāmaṃtrayati maṃtritā bhavati | athavā prakṛte na nānā kaṇṭakena viṃdhayet | cūlī uparimyā payet | mahāśūlarogena gṛhyate | yadi paśyate mriyate | ghaṭikājaṃbhe ulkāstaṃ vā muccārayati | somasūryamārgeṇāmāgamekṣayo upasarga kālajñāneka darṣaka puriyante śubhāśubhaṃ jānāti yāvat | sarasaṃcārayogaṃ athādyo paramaguruvaktra vinirgatāṃ | vividhajñāna divyanirīkṣiṇaṃ | yogamārgati vyavasthitā |
jñānāmṛtamidaṃ jñānaṃ trailokyaṃ paśyate kṣaṇāt |
<22a>
gurupūrvaparāṃ kṛtvā gṛhitvā tu prayatnataḥ |
yogābhyāsena trailokyaṃ jānāti | alaṃvatrā pustakaṃ vinā sarva paṭhati | haradarśanamātreṇa jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ | oṃ namo marmemarmavati huṃ pheṃ mahānta mahājaya mahāvijaye mahāparājite mama rahasyaṃ devyasarvato jaya vijayaṃ kuru <2> hrīṃ sarvan mohaya <2> anenakākaṇṭha anajīvṛṣṭiṃ mṛti buddhi sarvamākramya <2> chrīṃ <2> hrīṃ phreṃ siddhi cāmuṇḍā mahājaya huṃ phaṭ namaḥ ṭhaḥ <3> śikhāvaṃdhana jāpena smaraṇe lekhanedhāna japyeka yojyaite | vyavahāre rājakule vivāde kalahādyapiṣu ye mahā asya śāstra uktā maheśvara samaye ca rahasye prakartavyaṃ yogine nātmanā |
anyathā na rakaṃ yānti gurubhakti vivarjitāḥ | gurutyaktvādhikaṃ kāryaṃ dine dine maheśvarī ||
protsāhane mahāśubhaṃ | pūjāvastradharaṃ caiva śeṣataḥ yathā svedaṃ na yāyāti tathā kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ | akriyamāne vai devi sarvopadravān karomyahaṃ | narakajātaṃ mahānisaṃkṣebhaṃ kārayāmyahaṃ | dhanaṃ ca devidasyādenopahanaṃ śukaṃ pāśya guhyadeśe jana varjite | tena devi tuṣṭāhaṃ bhavāmi | jālaṃdharaṃ oḍiyānaṃ devi koṭakollagiryā aṃdhadeśaṃ pūritāṃ | aṭṭahāsaṃ kāmarūpaṃ ujjanyāṃ ca prayāge nepāle jayaṃtaṃ sahasra anekapīṭhakṣetre nānā devatādyakṣarākṣasanāgānāṃ gaṃdharvaveṇuvināpaṭhahamādādyavachinna kulepakūlakṣetrapīṭha mahānūnaṃ paricintaye dehastaṃ saṃkalakalāyamānaśabdena cājyeṣṭā śarīraṃ cintayet | tatra pṛthivyaptejovāyurākāśameva ca | evaṃ cintaya dehasthaṃ jñānaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ kṣetropakṣetraṃ svayaṃ pīṭhopapīṭhaṃ atra ūrdhvameva cakrātmānaṃ sarvapīṭhamayaṃ devīṃ dhyāyet tasmādātma prabhaṃ svayaṃ pūjayet |
<22b>
nānādevagaṇāḥ sarve nānāgaṃdharvakojñeyannānāvādyaṃ nānā carupūjā śobhitāṃ nānāśāstrayogāṃtaramaṃtra nānārūpatayā taruṇī vilāśini yutā hṛdaye cintayet kailāsaṃ aṣṭakulaparvataṃ sakṣudra pātāla nānājīvagatā samākīrṇaṃ saṃcintayet | yathā sukhaṃ sarvalokapālānmātṛbhairavān sarva pathivyapete śaivāyurākāśameva cintayet yathā yatra yuktaṃ yathāyaṃ pūjayet | ātmānaṃ sarvamayaṃ cintayet | adhogatā savānjyasyasaṃbhramahatāṃ bhayākulāṃ anekaprataraṇavarjitāṃ abrāhmaṇa kurvati mūrchitā cintanīyā | oṃ hrīṃ hreṃ phreṃ phaṭ nādagarjitāṃ jvālājvalitātmakāṃ | mahākrodhākulaṃ dhyātavyā deva sarvāśca dūtikāśca ātmānaṃ evaṃ dhyātavyaṃ yogendreṇa tu sarvadā etāste kathitāḥ samādhayaḥ hanaḥ huṃ phaṭkāra bhāvanāt | eṣākālikāsiddhi bhairavī tāraṇātmikā gopitavyā prayatnena yogindrena ca sarvadā | gopite ca mahāsiddhirjāyate acirādapi | yalloka viruddhaṃ tatsarvaṃ yatnena gopitavyā | eṣā guptā parāguhyā guhye catuparāparaṃ | paraśiṣyena dātavyaṃ devatāṃ maṃtrameva ca | na śrāvayet maṃtrapūjoparaśiṣyeṣu kaulikāḥ prāṇāghāte na vaktavyaṃ sveṣṭa devaṃ kadācana | tena guhyena vaktavyaṃ siddhyate gopanād dhruvaṃ | svakīyaṃ parimaṃguhya manyaṃ caiva prakāśayet | sa eva tu mahāyogī bhairavaḥ parameśvara ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
akathyaṃ kathitaṃ deva rahasyaṃ parameśvara | sāvarṇyaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ paraṃ ||
aparaṃ ca mahādeva kathayasva yadi priyaṃ | kālikā paramaṃ jñānaṃ jñānīnāṃ yasye mohajaṃ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu bhairavi cāmuṇḍe phetkāriṇi pureśvari | nirviśeṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi snehāt kamalalocane ||
mānāyogaratā nityā kālikā viśvarūpinī | viśeṣato yogasāraṃ gururevaparaṃ bhajet ||
<23a>
dvivarga prathamaṃ vījamadvaita paramaṃ sthitaṃ | kālarūpāsane yasthaṃ svara dviguṇa bheditaṃ ||
śikhānādasamāyuktaṃ huṃkārāntaravasthitaṃ | etat paramatatvaṃ vai smaraṇāt pāpanāśanaṃ ||
samayena vihīnena guruvaktrān maheśvarī | tatkṣaṇādbhadramāpnoti yastvayā kathitaṃ priye ||
uccāreṇoccaredvāpi piṇḍaiśca pravikalpayet |
nityaṃ bhāvanā |
anayā jñānamātreṇa trailokyādhipatirbhavet | manasā sarvakarmāṇi karoti yoginaḥ svayaṃ ||
vandhāvaṃdhantathā chedaṃ gamanāgamanaṃ punaḥ | lakṣyādi peyabhojyaṃ ca icchākāmitvameva ca ||
atra dānādikaṃ muktaṃ rogavyādhigrahādikaṃ | jvalanaṃ dīpanaṃ caiva maṃtroccāraṇato bhavet ||
mantroccāraṇamātreṇa bhairavatvaṃ labheddhruvaṃ | adravyena tu yā pūjā sā pūjā naraka pradā ||
aśuddhāni ca sarvāṇi jvālayet parameśvarī | sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca nānārūpī maheśvara ||
ājñāsiddhivaro bhūtvā kālāgni sadṛśo bhavet | praṇamya rudraṃ vakṣyāmi trailokyaṃ dahanaṃ paraṃ ||
bhakṣyābhakṣaṃ peyāpeyaṃ tasya pāpaṃ na vidyate | na hantā vinayaścaiva rogavyādhistathaiva ca ||
na hantā pātakaṃ caiva devādyā yakṣarākṣasāḥ | nāgāśca nṛpagaṇapralayakālābhairavīte prakīrtitā ||
saṃketaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi rūpayoga vyavasthitā |
oṃ phreṃ huṃ mūlavījaṃ | atha te ca paramakaraṇe | traṃ ḍuṃvara huṃ ja rahuṃ dhara ḍūṃjara ḍuṃ para ḍuḥ hara ḍuṃ kṣaraṃ ḍuṃ huṃ <5> phaṭ gurumukhā devalabhate | ete maṃtravarāśubhrāḥ etā jñātvā devī paratatvālayaṃ gatāḥ sa yogī yathecchayā vicaret | icchā ca hṛdisthitiḥ anena sarvayogī smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yānti te |
ekaikaśca mahāvīryā trailokya dahanātmakaṃ | pūrṇatejo mahādevī ekībhāvavatāṃ priye ||
<23b>
trailokya mātmanā bhasmīkaroti |
devamānavanāgānāṃ yakṣagaṃdharvarākṣasāṃ | saptarasātaraṃ samudrān parvatā adīṃśca cūrṇayati kṣaṇena ca |
asya na bhāṣitaṃ devi tadābhinnaṃ prayojayet | huṃkārāntaritā hyete vidveṣe parikīrtitā ||
chrīṃkārāṃtaritā caiva bhairavecchā prakīrtitā | phreṃkārāntaritā vāyu rūpā caiva prakīrtitā ||
phaṭkārāntaritā sā māraṇe evābhicārake | cūṃkārāntaritā hyete vidveṣo pariyojayet ||
kṣaṃkārāntaritā hyete uccāṭeṣu prayojayet | hrīṃkārāntaritā hyete staṃbhane ca prakīrtitā ||
huṃkārā phaṭkārāntaritā vajra śṛṃkhalā | aṃdarśanaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ śūlaṃ khaḍgaṃ vajraṃ sidhyati vidyādhara nāgayakṣarākṣasacūrṇataḥ | yathā yojyastathā karoti | yasya gṛhe uccāryate jāpyate pavyate sarve bhairavopamāvo bhavati | darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kurvati | kapāpakariṇā maṃtrayanī yat | ācāryeṇa śiṣyasirasi maṃtritaṃ puṣpaṃ datvā śiṣye dāpayet | parasiṣyaṃ na bodhayet | daṇḍavat praṇāmena tatvā nānādravyaṃ svātma priyāṇi namaskṛtya kṣamāpayet | oṃ bhairavāya jvara <2> yathepsayā me kuru <2> bhairavī sahitāya huṃ namaḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ <2> kaṭṭa <2> dheṣṭa <2> marmemarmaptaṃ hāriṇī chrīṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> moṭaya <2> gṛhna <2> chedaya <2> phreṃ hrīṃ caṇḍe raktanetre ṭha ṭha | raktarūpā sarve vaktrā ceṣṭayākamva gṛhna <2> jīvaṃ anyaṃ vā paripicchate sati sarvaṃ jarāṃ sadāsiddhi bhagavati aiṃ chrīṃ <4> phreṃ hrīṃ <5> siddhi <2> mama siddhābhagavati sarvatra aiṃ siddhi chrīṃ <5> ṭha ṭhaḥ manasā sarvasaṃkrāmati | yamichati khānapānaṃ | aiṃ hrīṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> namo siddhi vāruṇī pūraya <2> ha <2> asaṃkhya samudroyaṃ | machrīṃ <2> hrīṃ chrīṃ svāhā paramavāruṇī | oṃ namo cāmuṇḍā phreṃ huṃ hasanī hrīṃ <2> hūṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> yamane sā dṛṣṭi
<24a>
jagat staṃbhane | bhogabhāvena icchayā vrīṃ <2> vraṁ <2> keṁ <2> hūṃ phaṭ | smaraṇena sarva dṛśyate | aiṃ chrīṃ <2> siddhiyoginīye hrīṃ <2> hūṃ <2> chrīṃ nānāgaṃdhavati sugaṃdharī ākarṣanī mahāsugandhotkaṭ anantaragaṃdhodvaharānte hrīṃ chrīṃ trailokya mohanāṃ prīthamāse aiṃ hrīṃ chrīṃ phreṃ siddhi <2> mama siddhā bhava sarvatra ca oṣadhī siddhi bhairavī divyanāthā bhairavasahitā jñāpayati ucchāha devadattasya kuru <2> mācala <2> tiṣa <2> siddhi <2> chrīṃ huṃ phaṭ hrīṃ mahāmarma jīvani svāhā | anena sarvoṣadhī siddhiḥ khphreṃ hskhphreṃ khphreṃ | aṣṭamahāsiddhiṃ dadāti sarvavyādhiṃ pātayati | prayogamātreṇa vaśyoccāṭane vidveṣaṃnnābhicārakaḥ māraṇaprabhṛti rasarasāyaṇādikaṃ guṭikāṃjana pādalepa sarvāṃkaṃ karoti | vālānulepe sidhyaṃti sarva vali | aiṃ namo chrīṃ hrīṃ praviśya <2> mama sārvamarma saṃjīvanī sarvamarma saṃrakṣaṇī <2> udbhavaprīṇaya <2> pūraya <2> hrūṃ svīṃ amṛtavarṣa <2> pṛthivyaptejovāyurākāśameva praveśayet | jīvāva <2> vāyu rūpe hrīṃ chrīṃ strīṃ himārasātale <6> mṛtaṃ jīvati marmodbhave svāhā | eṣāmṛtasaṃjīvanividyā siddheriṣṭavyādhināsinī rogopasargagrahaṇī jvaraśūlaṃ śāmyati | nānākarmakarī kasyāpi na prakāśayet | yogakrīḍāyāṃ kurvata yathāvayaṃ prabhāṣate | kapālikāraktinī narake teṣāṃ raktayojitā | gorocana vimiśritalaktaka adhivāsasāśānodbhava raktagolitaṃ | nānāpuṣpanirmalaṃ raktapuṣpamaṇḍitaṃ mahāṃjanāṃjitaṃ huṃ phaṭ mukhe yatheṣṭacārī yogadaṇḍakararūpīṃ icchārūpī vāruṇī pramantamadyamasabhojī alobhī karoti | kṣetropakṣetra sthitaḥ
<24b>
sarvābharaṇaṃśca dhārayet | gṛhapūjāsthāne śāṃti ghṛtadūrvādadhi tilajalena vā | tato aśayet bhaṭṭārikā madhye sthāpya yujya pudyapuṣpadhūpādinā mālāpuṣpādinā mālāpuṣpādinā saṃsthā(?)dyamāṃsamadyādi nānākhādyaṃ ca paṃcanavaprakāreṇa na mam kṛtvā yogatavyavasthayā tatra ye praviśanti te svargagāmine bhavaṃti vigata doṣāḥ gṛhepi gṛhajanākrāmaṃti teṣāṃ striyāṃ anyathā na doṣo bhavati ||
laṃghanasparśanena teṣāṃ adṛśyo bhavaṃti | puṣpāṃjali vitalāna doṣā bhavaṃti sarva iṣṭaśca saṃpadyate || bhairavamaṇḍale vaṃdhaṃ sarvadeva devīnāṃ āveśayitvā sthāpayet | mahāmaṃtraṃ taptvā bho gṛhna <2> chidrānusāriṇo duṣṭān bhakṣa <2> māraya <2> | evaṃ sādhaya samasthito mahāguhyapradeśe sarvatrailokya pātanī prarasthātavya mahāyoginī ācāryāyai aparāyai samaya sthite | atha vidyāṃ pravakṣyāmi śatroriṣṭakaraṃ paraṃ divyastambhakaraṃ mantraṃ navātmā vighna hṛtparaṃ | oṃ namaḥ śrīcāmuṇḍe huṃ phreṃ hrīṃ kālikarālī hrīṃ dara <2> chrīṃ chara <2> sarvavittānusāriṇāṃ māra <2> rala <2> hana <2> bhaga <2> vaṃdha <2> moha <2> pātaya <2> ghātaya <2> marmemarmābhighāte hana <2> huṃ phaṭ | sarvamarma chidrakān duṣṭān vidha <2> bhakṣa <2> nāśaya <2> sarvāriṣṭaṃ kuru <2> varṣa <2> hasa <2> kṣobhaḥ aṃdhakārakāriṇi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ cakṣurvā gām(?) buddhi hṛdayaṃ kaṭṭa <2> hastapādaṃ vurmakarakarmacaraṇaṃ sarvagātrān bhaṃjaya <2> moṭa huṃ phreṃ hrīṃ <4> daramanosiddhi chrīṃ <2> sarvasamayapratiṣṭhānāṃ rakṣa <2> ācārye rakṣa <2> gopaya <2> aṃtavihitaṃ kuru <2> huṃ <2> phaṭ <5> phaṭ hrīṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> huṃ hraṃ haṃ māṃsaśoṇita priye | huṃ gṛhna <2> hūṃ gṛhnāpaya <2> kili <2> kici <2> sarvaduṣṭabhakṣaṇīye hana <2>
<25a>
hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ | eṣā bhagavati siddhīye sarvaduṣṭavināsinī | samayamaṇḍale vighnāntare smaraṇīya marmasaṃsanāṃ sarvakampavaliḥ | oṃ hrīṃkāraṃ śire vinyase cchrīṃ phreṃ āṃ hṛdaye pāśākulā pīścā veśayati | brahmādyāḥ kiṃ punaḥ kṣudramānavān | sarvākṛṣṭī | prakṛtau | ete kṛtvā sadā siddhā nānāpūjā guṇaiḥ kṛtvā | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ nānāvastrādikaṃ dadyāt | anyaṃ vā tathaiva khānapāna tāmbūla bhojanānāṃ ata prakārameva evametantri vedaye gurureva parameśvarī śrīpūrvā vai sarvayoginyā hūtaṃ kārayet | etat sarvamavaśyameva kartavyaṃ narakaṃ yāti bhayāvahā | etat kṛtvā sarvaṃ śubhagā syāt | śrīśāṃtyādi putrasuyajanaṃ | dhanavarddhanaṃ devyāyāṃ prathamasamācārān cihnā bhavaṃti | vigraha śastra saṃpātaṃ | raktadarśanaṃ śaktikṣobhaṃ śivadarśanaṃ śivārāvaṃ nānāsvapnaṃ rakṣahāni ukṣahāni udvigna āvittiśca retāni nimittāni bhavaṃti | iyaṃ bhaṭṭārikā yatra tiṣṭhati | tatra devāpi urddhaṃ na gacchaṃti | gacchaṃte sapta narakaṃ pataṃti tatkṣaṇāt | atha trailokya pratyaṃgirā chedanī mahāpratyaṃgirā sūryabhūrje abhilikhya yaṃtraṃ dhārayet | mama maṃtraṃ taṃtra paraprayogādi duṣṭagraha na rogavyādhi śatrorbhayaṃ nāsti devādi vaśaneti sakṛt smaraṇā trailokyaṃ vaśameti | sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | tasya brahmadaṇḍopi daṇḍo aṣṭasiddhirllabhate ||
pramodakālī yaṃtra mūlaṃ |
oṃ namo huṃ phaṭ huṃ phreṃ guhyakāli hrīṃ <2> cāmuṇḍe lolajihve hrīṃ <2> ṣṭrī <2> kaṭṭa <2> toṭraya <2> sarvāśca śoṣaya <2> trailokye ye taṃtra maṃtra prayogā pratyaṃgirāyā yā pādāṃ sarva upadravān mṛgarogān vyādhi viṣama tasya mātreṇāpi ye mama krodhaścintayaṃti
<25b>
doṣāṃ nasyāśca yadi rūpakān sarvān hana <2> chrīṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> hūṃ <2> hūṃ phaṭ <5> namo rudrāya tridaśāya rudrāyāṃ hiṃsakān devāyakṣārākṣasāḥ nāgagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ mahoragān grahamātarān śastrāstra caurasiṃhavyāghrādi sarvapaśujātīnāṃ parvatanadīsamudrāṃ aṃnyānvāsavaṃ janasthala gataṃ aṃtarikṣa gatāṃ sarvāṇi hana <2> hūṃ <5> huṃ phaṭ <5> daha <2> kuhata <2> hrāṃ phaṭ kṣuḥ phaṭ hūṃ <5> chreṃ phaṭ <5> marmemarmābhighāte hana <2> hūṃ hrīṃ namaḥ svāhā | śrīṃ hrīṃ chrīṃ <3> mamarakṣaraṇattavatī | eṣā vidyā paṭhita siddhāsarvakarī paramavidyeyaṃ svayaṃ svaśiṣyāya pradātavyaṃ | raktakaṃcukayā nārī raktavarṇaprāvaraṇena tu pumān |
naṭadāraktasaṃyuktaṃ parvatānyapi sāṃtayet |
tasya rūpāni vakṣyānigarahe tu yathā hi saḥ kāsate hikke te caiva mūhurtte ca muhurmuhu |
evaṃ tasya bhavedrūpaṃ śaradaṃte bhavedbudhaḥ | cikitsāṃ tasya vakṣyāmi yena sampadyate sukhaṃ ||
ajākṣīrasariṣapasvetāṃ ca girikarṇikāṃ | asaudararase naiva tena saṃpadyate sukhaṃ ||
oṃ cāmuṇḍe giriprāhaya durge jahe svāhā | garakaraṇe maṃtraḥ | oṃ namo muṇcā durge svāhā | mocana maṃtrāḥ | bhallātikarasaṃguṃjā tathā maṇḍilikārikā |
gṛhagodhāsamāyuktaṃ cūrṇe gātreṣu dāpayet | saptāhā jāyate kuṣṭhaṃ jāyateti vravedanā ||
asya pratyānayet |
nimbasarkarayā yuktaṃ tataḥ saṃpadyate sukhaṃ | pralepo vārka tu svasāmānyaṃ kārayet budhaḥ ||
bhūñjita mudgayūṣena jāṅgalpena rasena vā | etayā kripayā caiva tataḥ saṃpadyate sukhaṃ ||
tallātakarasaṃguṃja ti(?)ṣaṃ citrakameva ca | kapikachusamāyuktaṃ lūtākaraṇamuttamaṃ ||
lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi jāyate na tu tatkṣaṇāt | aṃgāni dhamatyantaṃ kṣupyate ca muhurmuhuḥ ||
evaṃ tasya bhavedrūpaṃ lūtāvisphoṭa lakṣaṇaṃ | cikitsāṃ tasya vakṣyāmi yena saṃpadyate sukhaṃ ||
<26a>
uśiraṃ tagarañcaiva priyaṃguṃ candanaṃ tathā | raktacaṃdana kuṣṭhaṃ ca lepaṃ lūtā vināsanaṃ ||
oṃ namo bhagavate umāmaheśvarāya kuhanī kuhanī svāhā | yogatalūtāprarauharitāvadbhavatiti piṃci |
kṛṣṇasarpaśiro gṛhya vane sarisṛpāṃ kṣipet | bhaktaṃ ta kaviṣoktaṃ tu kṛṣṇasūnneṇa veṣṭayet ||
valmīkaṃ mṛttikā veṣṭaṃ tata svetaṃ tu yāvayet | sūryakaṃ tat tu jānīyāt tato gṛhya rasarṣapān ||
karikachusamāyuktaṃ ripormūrddhati dāpayet | suratavagrīṣme vaśaṃtairalūtā karaṇamuttamaṃ ||
prasvinne ca tatogātre lagne tasmin ca saṃbhavet | lūtāṃ tu sasaviṣokte yā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
pratyānayate tatasmin pūrvokte naiva kārayet | iṃdrasthānairmṛttikā grāhya vajraṃ kṛtvā vicakṣana ||
kṣetre tu pātayedyasya tasya sasyaṃ vinasyati |
maṃtre na yojayet |
oṃ vajrīna pātaya vajraṃ marapatiṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā |
yanyāgāre kṣiped yasya yasyāgāramvinaśyati |
uddhṛtena mokṣaḥ |nimvakālaye gṛhe smaśānāṅgoktaḥ daheto tato bhasmani saṃgṛhyatru(?)mūrdhani dāpayet | sarvalokasaṃvikṣipraṃkṣipramuccāṭayate na cara |
gṛhe vā vikiredyasya tat gṛhaṃ naśyate dhruvaṃ |
oṃ carasi mohanī jayabhīṣanī svāhā | catuṣpathe mṛttikā gṛhitvā gomayena sahaprati kṛtiṃ kṛtvā grāmamadhye pauttalikāṃ niṣanet kanaka tuṣāgrāmeṣu sahasra juhuyauthāḥ agniṃ prajvālyataṃ bhasma vikṣipet | oṃ namo bhagavate kālāya daha <2> paca <2> bhaṃja <2> mohaya <2> staṃbhaya <2> uhyādaya(?) <2> | evaṃ rudrājñāpayati arddhasavarimahāhite bhasmaratikha <2> huṃ phaṭ khe | grāmanagara vairīnāmutsādayati gomayena pratikṛti kṛtvā dṛṣanautasyati kṛṃtayet ṣaṇṭhīṃ bhavati | anena maṃtreṇa | oṃ namo bhagavate umāmaheśvarāya | oṃ kāma
<26b>
prabhave huṃ hana <2> cetane yamuñca <2> svāhā | atha bhagavatā vaśiṣṭhena viśvāmitradārānāśārthāya imā vidyāvatāritā syesāne tailamādāya vāmapādayomuka | amukasya bhagaṃ vaṃdhāni visphurastaṃbhasaunitaṃ pāte bhagavatyā nāsti loke vicintittayā parivapi nimīto vā paṃcānyat bhagamardakāṃ sa caite vimukhāyāstu varjayitvā tu maithunaṃ | oṃ cara <2> bhaga svāhā | sahikṣīraṃ yavakṣāraṃ pādau kṛtāścayāmukā |samālabhā tadā tavyaṃ khaṃjī bhavati dāhajvarāṃ | śiskapiṃsālitaṃ(?)dulamā <2> nālena peṣayet | anena lepitaścaiva sukhi bhavati tatkṣaṇāt | nīlamākṣikaḥ pārāvat kṛṣṇasarpasya sānitaṃ abhyaṃge tu pradātavyaṃ aṃgasaṃkoca kārakāṃ palāśāti viṣāścaiva tilatailena pācayet |
saṃkocitānāmaṃgānāṃ pratyānayanamuttamaṃ | haritālaṃ punacūrṇaṃ kanakī vījaṃ tathaiva ca ||
etat ḍaṃtmattakaścaiva yāṃta sā attamaṃvrajet | kṣīraśarkarayā yuktaṃ pāyayedvatathāturaṃ ||
bhūkarasya tu māṃsena svasthāvarathābhāva bhavikṣati |(?)
maṃtrena yogataḥ |
oṃ namo unmattakāranī pisācinī vañca <2> svāhā | iṃdrajavapārāvatapurīṣaṃ kanakaphala |
samāyuktaṃ tu dhūpoyaṃ grahamādanamādiset |
pratyānayanaṃ ghṛtena dhūpaṃ diyate | svastho bhavati maṃtritaṃ | oṃ gṛhna <2> vārāhī subhage svāhā |
guḍaṃkaraṃjavījāni punarācūrṇaṃ tu tatsamaṃ | pānaṃ lepā ca dātavyaṃ unmaṃttī karaṇamuttamaṃ ||
pratyānayanametasya sarkarāghṛtagorasaṃ | stapuṣpaṃ dātavyaṃ svastho bhavati nānyathā ||
vāgulyā vitṛtāmanā kṛtvā sāmudralavanaṃ kṣipet | karavīrakāṣṭhenāgniṃ antadhūmena taṃ dahet ||
punarlavanaṃ saṃgṛhya dviṣatāṃ saṃpradāpayet | kṣipraṃ bhavatyaptā vaṃdhe ripu cakṣaḥ prajāyate ||
vibhītta karavīrābhyāmaṃjjayet tasya cakṣuṣā | pratyānamaname tasya niraṃdhī karaṇaṃ paraṃ |
<27a>
gauraśarṣapāmalakī cūrṇaṃmarkakṣīreṇa bhāvayet | vahusaḥ bhagaśamenena snāna bhāvananāvena |(?) kā jāyati mūrddhajāmathita snānena mokṣa ||(?)
vakṣye gadāgadaṃ yogaṃ rājaśatruvimardanaṃ | yena yojita mātreṇa ripuṃ hanyān(?) mahītale ||
tebhirase(?) kṛtśī(?) kartuścaturbhirāti dvistathā | oṃ(?)sopaniṣado nāma śatrūnīṃ mūrdhni tiṣṭhati ||
prathamaṃ tatra yogaṃ vyādhikaraṇaṃ vividhaṃ | sarvaśatru vimardanaṃ bhūtajvaragrahakaraṇaṃ dvitīyamadhyasya te | tṛtīyamuccāṭanāṃ | vidveṣaṃ caturthakaṃ paṃcasamutpādanaṃ proktaṃ | jalastaṃbhanaṃ tu ṣaṣṭakāṃ saptamaṃ avikaraṇaṃ | unmattaṃ caṣṭamaṃ smṛtaṃ | aṣṭāṅgato samākhyāto yoga oḍīśimbaraṃ tanu | satraiva brāhmaṇena guruvena cāryupakārine | prayoktavyamidaṃ sastraṃ jiṣṭājyodadhikasya cittasmāt kulu sthānāsāṃgasāgaropi mahiplavān | sūryo vā patate bhuvo na cedaṃ mithyā bhāṣitaṃ | yathā ceṃdrasya vajūṃtapārāṃ vai varuṇasyaḥ tu yamasya tu yathā daṃḍaṃ nāyaṃ sarṣaḥ praśāmyati | tathaivaitā mahāyogāḥ prayuṃjyā cchatrumūrdhani | api mṛtā nivarttaṃte amādyonātra śaṃsayaḥ | susaṃhṛṣṭau prahṛṣṭena saṃyukte nāntarātmanā | puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇa sarpenaṣādayitvā tu mānava |
śastre nāsya śiraḥ chitvā (***) rudhiraścayet | tacchastramakṣayaṃ yena karaṇe caṃdripālakāḥ ||
ye cānye śastrajā tāni sarvāstraṃ saṃkṣayedbudhaḥ | hālāhalāṃgalī mūlaṃ karavīraṃ sa citrakaṃ ||
mākṣikaṃ karkaṭañcaiva svetāśca gṛhaśolikāṃ | evaṃ ca sarvaśastrānāṃ pralepe samudāhṛtā ||
tilachinnabhinā cemulokaṃ yāti yamakṣayaṃ | ulūkamuṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhyaṃ lavanenātha pūrayet ||
sthāpayet tāmrapātrena saptāhaṃ tu vicakṣaṇaṃ |
<27b>
vibhītakasya kāṣṭhena aṃtadhūmena nirdahet | lavanaṃ taṃtu saṃgṛhya ripuṃ dadyād vicakṣana ||
unmatto bhavate kṣipraṃ yāvanna kriyate kriyā | vibhītakama ricābhyāṃ mañjayet tasya cakṣuṣi ||
pratyānayanametatu duṣṭaṃ tasya mukhāvahaṃ | kīṭaṃ ṣadvitukaṃ gṛhya kṛṣṇavṛścikajaṃ śiraḥ ||
etat karkaṭaṃ cūrṇaṃ dadyācchayāsane ripo | visphoṭo jāyate tīvraṃ saptarātrairna saṃśayaḥ ||
mriyate tena dāhena pratyānayana varjitaṃ | mātuluṃgasya vijāni ṣaḍvinduviṣameva ca ||
kapi kacchukaromāni hiṃgubhallātakaṃ tathā | etāni samabhāgāni tathā maṇḍalikālikā ||
cūrṇametat ripraṃ dadyād vastrasayyā saneṣu ca | agnidagdhā ivasphoṭā jāyaṃte tīvravedanā ||
saptāhairmriyate jaṃturyadi na kriyate kriyā | nilotpalaṃ sakumudaṃ raktacaṃdanameva ca ||
tathā kurkaṭapittaṃ ca peṣayitvā pralepayet | etat kṛte vidhāne tu tataḥ saṃpadyate sukhaṃ ||
jalaṃ haste tu saṃgṛhya soṣayitvā vinā naraḥ | viṣṭā madhye kṣipedyastu necchaṃti vidhi saṃyutā ||
ahorātraṃ śarīrena bhramate naṣṭa cetasā | athecche jīvitaṃ tasya viṣṭhā prakṣālayet tataḥ ||

vaṣaṭ śruvāyai <2> | hlāṃ(?) glau pāṃśumuṣṭyauṃ hrīṃ nadyāvartāyai <2> lhūṃ kuṇḍalāyaiḥ | mlū māṃsakhaṇḍe <2> | oṃ phalāya <2> | dhrīṃ sauḥ śūlyai namaḥ | iti catupaṃcāśada svaṃ saṃpūjyā khphreṃ hrīṃ mahācaṇḍayogeśvarī ṭhrīṃ dhrīṃ thrīṃ phaṭ <4> caṇḍiyogeśvarī nirvāṇa śrīkālikā devī śrīpāda | khphreṃ caṇḍakapālinī mahākāli siddhi śrīkāliparāsiṃhavaktrasiddhikāli śrīpādukāṃ | ūrdhvaktrasiṃha <1> āṃ khphreṃ hāriśca geyo ucamahāmaṇi vā vaktraṃ kālasaṃkarṣaṇī śrīpādā śivā nkṣīṃ hskhphreṃ khphreṃ ḍaṃ caṃ mahāyogeśvarī kolavaktranḍāmareśvarī śrīpāda kola <3> | hrāṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ khphreṃ caṃ ḍaṃ mahāyogeśvarī kapi vaktra kubjikā śrīpāda kapi <4> sklhrīṃ hsphrīṃ hsroṃ khphreṃ yogeśvarī caṇḍamahātākṣī vaktra śrīsuṃdarī śrīpāda garuḍa <5> rjrīṃ(?) khphreṃ hūṃ strīṃ mahācaṇḍa yogeśvari makaravaktra jhaṃkāriṇī śrīpāda makaraḥ <6> klīṃ strīṃ cchrīṃ hrīṃ khphreṁ caṃ ḍaṃ yogeśvarī mahāpratyaṃgirā gajavaktra śrīpāda | gaja hāṃ chrīṃ khroṃ khreṃ yogeśvari mahācaṇḍa hmkṣmlvryaṃ hayavaktra siddhiyogeśvari śrīpāda haya <8> | oṃ phreṃ siddhikarālī mahācaṇḍaṃ thrīṃ dhrīṃ ṭhīṃ kālagrāsini guhyakāli śrīpāda naravaktra <9> | gāyatrī | khphreṃ kālarātrī vidmahe kālasaṃkarṣaṇī dhīmahi tatra kāli pracodayāt | mūlamaṃtreṇa mūla devī pūjā <3> | ṣoḍaśī <6> | saptadaśā <12> | navākṣarī <9> sahasrākṣarī <1000> | oṃ hrīṃ hūṃ hāṃ phreṃ kṣeṃ ko namaḥ | hskhpreṃ mahācaṃḍayogeśvarī hskṣmlvryūṁ hsraiṃ sklhrīṁ hsreṁ | sāṃbhavī japtaḥ | oṃ hsau phreṃ hskhphrīṃ aiṃ phraiṃ spheṃ | oṃ guhyacāmuṇḍā japaḥ | oṃ hskhphreṃ | śrīcāmuṇḍāyai pādu | navākṣarī tarpaṇaṃ <108> | oṃ khaṃ brahma oṃ tatsvaṃ brahma | oṃ jyotistvaṃ brahma | oṃ jogastvabrahma | oṃ huṃ <9> jāpya vī ṣu(?) oṃ parkaprasādenapikaṃti paramayogini paramākṣara prasādena
<34a>
prathamapātraṃ namāmyahaṃ | oṃ daṃ daṃ darpani diyate devi devatā daṃ daṃ daṃ pīmide vidvitiya pātraṃ namāmyahaṃ <2> | oṃ taṃtaṃ trīmūrti brahmā viṣṇu maheśvaraṃ trailokyatāraṃti devi <3> namāmyahaṃ <3> oṃ caṃ caṃ caṃdravadanī cakramadhye jadhāsanijacarācara pravaṃdhaṃti he he vi <4> namāmyahaṃ <4> | oṃ paṃ paṃ paṃcavāṇapāna pivaṃtithānaṃdavarttato nityaṃ paṃcanamāmyahaṃ <5> | oṃ ṣaṃ ṣaṃ ṣaṭcakra samīhitaṃ ṣaicārikarmapātraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ namāmyahaṃ | oṃ saṃ saṃ saptapradoṣairvimuktai sorataddhātai sohaṃ rarekṣā saptame namāmyahaṃ <7> | oṃ śaṃ śaṃ śastrabāhuṃ śasurāṃtaka saṃghārani he devi aṣṭame namāmyahaṃ <8> | oṃ naṃ naṃ navadurge naramālā vibhūṣitaṃ naranārāyanaṃ nirākāraṃ navamaṃ pātraṃ namāmyahaṃ <9> |
