(***)(?) mākoṭarākṣīmasimalīnamukhī muktakeśī rudaṃtī nāhaṃ tṛptā vadaṃti jagadakhilamidaṃ grāmamekaṃ karoti | hastābhyāṃ dhārayaṃti jvaladanalaśikhā saṃnibhaṃ pāśamugraṃ daṃtairjaṃvūphalābhaiḥ pariharet bhayaṃ pātu sāṃ bhadrakāli ||
iti dhyānaṃ |
kuṃkumodaragarbhābhāṃ kici yauvanakālinīṃ | mṛlālakomalabhujāṃ keyūrāṃgadabhūṣanāṃ ||
tulākoṭi paribhrāṃta padapadmadvayatvitāṃ | mānikya hāramukuṭakuṇḍalādi vibhūṣitāṃ ||
nilotpaladṛśaṃ kiṃcidudyatkucavirājitāṃ | karābhyāṃ bhrāmyat kamalāṃ raktavastrāṃgavāsinīṃ ||
hemaprākāramadhyasthāṃ ratnasiṃhāsanopari | dhyāyet kalpatarormūle devīṃtāṃ dhanadāyikāṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
aṃjanādi nibhāṃ devīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīṃ | raktanetrāṃ muktakeśīṃ śuṣkamāṃsāni bhīṣaṇāṃ ||
pīgāṃkṣīṃ vāmahastena madya pūrṇaṃ sarāvakaṃ |
<65a>
sadyaḥ kṛta śirodakṣa hastena dadhatiṃ śivāṃ | smitavaktrāṃ sadāvāmaṃ māṃsacarvaṇaṃ tarpaṇāṃ ||
nānālaṃkārabhūṣāṃgīṃ tanmāṃmattāṃ sadāsavaiḥ |
iti dhyānaṃ |
madhye sudhābdhi maṇimaṃḍapa ratnavedi siṃhāsane pariṇatāṃ coparipītavarṇāṃ | pītāmvarābharaṇasālyaratnavibhūṣitāṃgīṃ devīṃ namāmi dhṛtamudgara vairi jihvāṃ ||
jihvāgramādāyakareṇa devīṃ vāmena śatruṃ parīpīḍayaṃtī | gadābhighātena ca dakṣinena pitāṃvarā nyāṃ(?) dvibhujāṃ namāmi ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
raktāṃ kṛṣṇavilocanāṃ trinayanāṃ kharvāṃścalaṃ vodarīṃ | vandhūkāruṇajihvikāṃvaradharābhīti karāmunmukhī ||
dhūmrārcirjaṭilāṃ kapālavilasat pāṇidvayāṃ caṃcalāṃ | sarvajñāṃ smarahṛtkṛtādhi vasaṃtī paiśācikitāṃ namaḥ ||
iti dhyānaṃ |
śaśadharamivaśubhaṃ khagaṃ pustāṅkapāṇiṃ suruciramati śāṃtaṃ paṃcacūḍaṃ kumāraṃ pṛthutara varamokṣaṃ padmapatrāyatākṣaṃ kumati dahanadakṣaṃ maṃjudyovaṃ namāmi ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
savyena pāṇi kamale na japādi pūjāṃ śṛṃgāraśīlana vidhau khalu dakṣiṇena rākāśudhākaramarīci tu vāragauraṃ dhyātvā catuḥ patha taṭe vṛṣamastakasthaṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ |
dhyānaṃ vakṣye mahādevī sarvasiddhipradāyakaṃ |
śaśadharamiva śubhraṃ khaḍgapustāṅkapāṇiṃ suruciramatiśāntaṃ paṃcacūḍaṃ kumāraṃ | pṛthutaravaramokṣaṃ padmapatrāyatākṣaṃ kumati dahana dakṣaṃ maṃjuśrīyaṃ namāmi ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
kṛṣṇāṃ lambodarīṃ bhīmāṃ nāgakuṇḍalabhūṣitāṃ | muktakeśī lalajjihvāṃ raktāṃvaradharāṃ kaṭau ||
pīnonnatastanīmugrāmahānāgenaveṣṭitāṃ | śavasthopari deveśī tasyopari kapālike ||
nāsāgradhyāna niratāṃ mahāghorāṃ varapradāṃ | caturbhujāṃ dīrghakeśīṃ dakṣiṇasyorddhavāhanāṃ ||
vibhutīṃ nalinīmekāṃ vāmorddhaṃ pānapātrakaṃ |
<65b>
varābhayadharīṃ devī madhasyā dakṣavāmayoḥ ||
pīvaṃtī raudhirīṃ dhārāṃ pānapātraṃ sadāśive | sarvasiddhipradsaṃ devīṃ nityaṃ girī nivāsinīṃ ||
locanatrayasaṃyuktāṃ nāgayajñopavitinīṃ | dīrghanāśāṃ dīrghajaṃghāṃ dīrghāṃgīṃ dīrghajihvikāṃ ||
candrasūryāgni bhedena trilocanasamanvitāṃ | śatrunāśakarīṃ devīṃ mahābhāsāṃvara pradāṃ ||
vyāghracarmaśirovaddhāṃ jagattrayavibhāvinīṃ | sādhakānāṃ sukhaṃ kartāṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkarīṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ dhyāyed durgajyotsnā mayaṃ punaḥ | tasyopari punardhyāyed devīṃ vāgīśvarīṃ tathā ||
muktākāṃti nibhāṃ devīṃ jyotsnājālavikāsinīṃ | sādhakānāṃ sukhakartṛ sarvalokabhayaṃkarīṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ dhyāye durgā jyotsnā mayaṃ punaḥ | tasyopari punardhyāyet devīṃ vāgīśvarī tathā ||
muktākānti nibhā devī jyotsnāṃ jālavikāsinīṃ | muktāhārayutāṃ śubhrāṃśśikhaṇḍavimaṃḍitāṃ ||
vibhratiṃ dakṣahastābhyāṃ vyākhyāṃ varṇasya mālikāṃ | amṛtena tathā pūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ divyaṃ ca pustakaṃ ||
dadhatīṃ vāma hastābhyāṃ pītastanabharānvitāṃ | madhyekṣīṇāṃ tathā svacchāṃ nānābharaṇavibhūṣitāṃ ||
ātmabhedena dhyātvevaṃ tataḥ saṃpūjayet kramāt |
iti dhyānaṃ ||
savya pādasarojena prālaṃkṛtamṛgādhiyāṃ | vāmapādāgradalitamahiṣārurunirbharāṃ ||
suprasannāṃsuvadanāṃ cārunetratrayānvitaṃ | śavanūpurakeyūrajaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitāṃ ||
vicitrapaṭṭavasanāmarddhacandravibhūṣitāṃ | khaḍgakheṭakavajrāṇi triśūlaṃ triśikhaṃ tathā ||
dhārayaṃtī dhanupāśaṃ śaṃkhaṃghaṇṭāṃ saroruhaṃ | vāhubhirlalitairdevīṃ koṭicandrasamaprabhāṃ ||
samaṃ bhūtairdivisaṃdairdevairākāśasaṃsthitaiḥ | stūyamānāṃ modasāvāṃlokapālādibhiḥ sadā ||
iti dhyānaṃ |
<66a>
nīlotpalaiḥ sarojairvāhutvā vai śravaṇāyate | vyāghracarmaparidhānāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāṃ ||
raktavartulamīmāṃkṣīṃ jihvayālolayā'surān | carvayaṃtīṃ mahākālīṃ kālānalamivāparāṃ ||
kṣobhayaṃtīṃ jagatsarvaṃ sasurasuraparvataṃ |
iti dhyānaṃ ||
siṃhaskaṃdhādhisaṃrūḍhāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitāṃ | caturbhujāṃ mahādevīṃ nāgayajñopavitinīṃ ||
raktavastraparidhānāṃ vālārka sadṛśīṃ tanuṃ | nāradādyairmunirgaṇaiḥ sevitāṃ bhavasuṃdarīṃ ||
trivallī valayopetāṃ nābhināla mṛṇālinīṃ | ratnadīpamaye dvīpe siṃhātasamanvite ||
praphullakamalāruḍhāṃ dhyāyet tāṃ bhavagehinīṃ |
iti dhyānaṃ |
dvibhujāmaṃvikāṃ caṃḍi khaḍgakharparadhāriṇīṃ | nānālaṃkāraśubhagāṃ raktāṃvaradharāṃ śubhāṃ ||
sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ prasannāsyāṃ trilocanāṃ | muṇḍamālāvaliramyāṃ pīnnonatapayodharāṃ ||
śavoparīmahādevīṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitāṃ | śatrukṣayaṃ karīṃ devīṃ sādhakābhiṣṭasiddhidāṃ ||
sarvasaubhāgyajananīṃ mahāsaṃpatpradāṃ smaret |
iti dhyānaṃ ||
hemābhāṃ vibhrati dorbhikūrpanā svanasādhane | pāśāṃkuśau sarvabhuṣāṃtāṃ gaurīṃ sarvadā bhajet ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
sakalaśaśirājamauli nāvaddhapāśāṃkuśarucirakarāṃ dhruvaṃ dhaji | vāruṇāṃ amaranikaraṃ vaṃdyāṃ tīkṣaṇanāśātule yāśramakusumayutāsyātsaṃpade pārvatīvaḥ |
iti dhyānaṃ |
paṃcavaktrāṃ mahāraudri pratirakta trilocanāṃ | śaktiśūladhanurvāṇakhaḍgakheṭa varābhayān ||
dakṣāṃdakṣabhujairdevīṃ vibhrāṇāṃ bhūribhūṣaṇāṃ |
iti dhyānaṃ |
daṃṣṭrā koṭi viṃśakaṭo dhūradamā(?)śāṃdrādhakare sthitā | khaṭvāṃgāni nirūḍhadakṣiṇakarā vāmena pāśaṃ śiraḥ ||
śyāmāpiṃgalamūrdhvajābhayakarīśārdūlacarmāvṛtā cāmuṇḍā śavavāhanī japavidhaudhyeyā sadā sādhakaiḥ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
<66b>
dhūmravarṇā mahādevī trinetrā śaśiśekharā | jaṭājūṭasamāyuktā vyāghracarma paricchadā ||
devāṃgāmasthimāṃsā tu kartṛkāṃ ca karāmbuje | koṭarākṣī sudaṃṣṭrā ca pātāla sa nibhodarā ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
pūrṇacandrānanāṃ gauri vicitrāṃ varadhāriṇīṃ | pīnottuṃgakucāṃrāsī sarvajñāmabhayapradāṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
kuraṃganetrāṃ śaradinduvaktrāṃ viṃvādharāṃ candanagandhaliptāṃ | vināṃśuṃkāṃpīnakucāṃ manojñāṃ śyāmāṃ sadā kāmadhudyāṃ vicitrāṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
prasannavadanāṃ gaurīṃ pakvaviṃvādharaśriyāṃ | raktāṃvaradharāṃ vālāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradāṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
kāmeśvarī śaśāṃkāśyākhelakhaṃjanalocanīṃ | sadālolagatiṃ kāntiṃ kusumāstraśinimukhīṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
suvarṇavarṇāṃ gaurāṃgīṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāṃ | nūpurāṃgadvahārābhyāṃ ramyāṃśca puskare kṣaṇaṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
padmāsanāṃ śyāmavarṇāṃ pīnottuṃgapayodharāṃ | komalāṃgī smare mukhīṃ raktoparadalekṣaṇaḥ ||
iti dhyānaṃ |
trailokya mohanīṃ devīṃ vicitrāṃvaradhāriṇīṃ | vicitrālaṃkṛtāṃ ramyāṃ nartakī veśadhāriṇīṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitāṃ | maṃjīrahārakeyūra ratnakuṇḍalamaṇḍitāṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ |
vāgīśvarīṃ mṛt snātāṃ nīlendīvaralocanāṃ | vāgīśvareṇa saṃyuktāṃ devīṃ tāṃ praṇamāmyahaṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ mudrāṃ caṃdrāṃ vāṃ bhadrakālikāṃ | karaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktāmathodaśabhujāmapi ||
ugracaṃdrātanurūpaṃ darśayāmāsadānavaṃ | jvālākarālavadanaṃ aṣṭādaśabhujānvitaṃ ||
divyaśastrāstrakalitaṃ muṃḍamālābhayaṃkaraṃ | vidīrṇaśṛkkayugalaṃ ghoradaṃṣṭrāti bhīṣaṇaṃ ||
calatsaudāmaṇitulya rasanāṃ nādadāruṇaṃ | tadrūpaṃditijo vikṣyatyamilayatalocane ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
<67a>
aṃbhoda syāmalāgīmativikaṭadatīṃ lolajihvāṃ jaṭālāṃ vāme puṇḍaṃ dadhānāṃ karakamalatale dakṣiṇe candrahāsāṃ | śṛnkradvaṃdvāstracārādvayadharavadanapretadorvallikāṃcī mādhvīkonmattanetrāṃ śavahṛdayagatāṃ naumikālīṃ karālīṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
varāṃkuśe pāśamabhīti mudrāṃ karairvahaṃtīṃ kamalāsanasthāṃ | vālārkakoṭi pratimāṃ trinetrāṃ bhaje māhādyāṃ bhuvaneśvarīṃ tāṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
ādhāre taruṇārkaviṃcaruciraṃ hemaprabhaṃ vāgbhavaṃ vījaṃ manmathamindugopakībhaṃ hṛtpaṃkaje saṃsthitaṃ ||
raṃdhre brahmapadasya śāṃtamamalaṃ somaprabhaṃ bhāśvaraṃ | sredhyādyaṃti padadvaya tava śive taṃ naumi śaivaṃ paraṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
pītāṃvaraparīdhānāṃ pīnonnatapayodharāṃ | jaṭāmukuṭaśobhāḍhyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharāṃ ||
śatrorjihvāṃ mudgaraṃ ca vibhrati paramāṃ kalāṃ |
iti dhyānaṃ |
devī ṣoḍaśa vārṣikīṃ śarabhagāṃdārvīrasā ghurṇitāṃ śyāmāṃgīṃmaruṇāṃ varāṃ pṛthukucāṃ guṃjāvalī śobhitāṃ | hastābhyāṃ dadhaṃti kapālamamalaṃ tīkṣṇāṃ tathā kṛtṛkāṃ | dhyāyenmānasa paṃkaje bhagavatīṃ ucchriṣṭa cāṃḍālinīṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ devīṃ karṇānāyata locanāṃ | trinetrāṃ dīrghaṃtacaṃgīṃ kālāgni sadṛśopamāṃ ||
iti dhyānaṃ ||
evaṃ yañcitayed devīṃ jāyate narapuṃgavaḥ | kṣatriyesu yathā rāmo deveṣu ca puraṃdaraḥ ||
bhujaṃgeṣu yathā tārkṣyaḥ krūrakārye yathā śaniḥ | śaṃkuteṣu yathā senomaṃtrajño valavāṃ tathā ||
idaṃte paramaṃguhyaṃ saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ mayā | iyaṃte kathitā vidyā sugopyāyāsamācaraiḥ ||
tava snehena bhaktyā ca vaḍvohaṃ parameśvarī |
[iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre arthavarṇasaṃhitāyāṃ mahākarmārcanapaddhatau nānādevatāmaṃtradhyānakathananāmāni paṭalaḥ] ||
<67b>
atha viśeṣa prayogamāha |
śrībhairava uvāca |
purākailāśaśikhare nānādhātū vicitrite | nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite ||
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe siddhacāraṇa sevite | śivabhaktaiḥ surairdevaḥ pannagaiśca virājite ||
yogadhyānaika nipunaistatvacidbhiḥ samanvite | āyudhaiścetanāvadbhiḥ rudīrita jayasvanaiḥ ||
ekanetrairdvinetraiśca netrairapyanyanetrakaiḥ | ekapādairdvipādaiśca tripādaiśca sahasrasaḥ ||
mahākrūrairmahābhīmaiḥ karālaiśca virājite | kaṃvalāśca narairnāgairgītavādyairvirājite ||
indrādyairlokapālaiśca vāṇādyairasuraistathā | durvāsādyaiśca munibhiḥ samaṃtātparisevite ||
evaṃ bhūte tu kailāse devadevaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | jyotirmayo mṛtajapo yogiciṃtyaṃ sadāśivaḥ ||
avyaktovyakta kūṭosau yatrāste tu svayaṃ śivaḥ | viṣṇunāstūyamānastu prahṛṣṭaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
kadācidupariṣṭoyamekānte paraṃ śivaḥ | hṛṣṭapuṣṭaprasannātmā sṛṣṭīsaṃhārakārakaḥ ||
ekāṃte devadeveśaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī śuci smitā | upagamya śanairvākyaṃ pravāca jagadaṃvikā ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
devadevajagannātha karuṇākaraśaṃkara | varṇāśramāśca dharmāśca saṃdehāśca mayā prabho ||
kautukāni sa kalyāṇi purāṇādinī sa prabho | śrutāsarvaṃ mayātatva sarvajñastri yataḥ svayaṃ ||
maṃtraṇāṃ nirṇayo yastu yaṃtrāṇāṃ nirṇayastathā | ācāro viṣame loke yogābhyāsaḥ sudurlabhaḥ ||
anekadhyānayogena vedātkopi hi dṛśyate | tathaivāgamabhedeṣu uditā hi na saṃśaya ||
evaṃ dvijāśca saṃtajajñā dṛśyaṃte kleśabhāginaḥ | pāṣaṃḍibhiḥ parābhūtā nāstike vedanindike ||
vināmaṃtrairjapairhomairnakleśena mahāprabho | tatkṣaṇājjāyate siddhiḥ susiddhāsarvakāryadā ||
<68a>
māraṇoccāṭane kṛṣṭe vidveṣe staṃbhanastathā | mohane abhicāreṣu kāryārtheṣu ca sarvadā ||
vinode ca vivāde carinavairijayestathā | etat sarvaṃ yathā deva siddhyate sādhakasya hi ||
vicārya devadeveśa rahasyaṃ paramaṃ vada |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
vedācāro mayā prokto munīnāṃ ca mahātmanāṃ | siddhadharmaśca muktānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vaiṣṇava ||
saurasāṃkhyaṃ mayā proktaṃ vahūnāṃ siddhidāyakaṃ | śāstraṃ ca vahudhā proktaṃ bhairavaḥ vahudhā priye ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ jñānaṃ caiva prakāśitaṃ | rahasyaṃ paramaṃ bhadre sarvatrāpi na śaṃśayaḥ ||
rahasyahīnamaṃtrastu dhyānaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ | na sidhyate varārohe kalpakoṭi śatairapi ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
prasādaṃ kuru deveśa sukhopāyaṃ vada prabho | rahasyaṃ ca subodhaṃ ca sadyapratyayakārakaṃ ||
vināhomena jāpena puraścaraṇa kena ca | kalau tu siddhyate deva tathopāyaṃ vadasva me ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
sādhusādhumahāprājñe lokānāṃ hitakāriṇī | ida(?)marthanna kenāpi pṛṣṭohaṃ padmalocane ||
śṛṇu caikāgra cittātaṃ rahasyaṃ kṣaṇasiddhidaṃ | kalpaciṃtā maṇiṃ nāma guhyādguhyataraṃ mahat ||
sarvāgamasyasāraṃ ca maṃtrāṇāṃ sāramuttamaṃ | arthavaṇasya vedasya sārātsāraturaṃ paraṃ ||
asmin kalpe bhaviṣyaṃti cintāmaṇi mayaṃ śubhaṃ | yaṃtrāṇi vahudhā devī kāmākarmakarāni ca ||
etatkalpaṃ sadā yasya likhitaṃ vidyate gṛhe | saṃpūjyate pratidinaṃ prabhāvaṃ caiva jāyate ||
alpamṛtyubhayaṃ nāsti nāsti caurabhayaṃ tathā | bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ prabhāvo naiva jāyate ||
etasya saṃśaye nūnaṃ na śidhyati kadācana | aviśvāso na kartavyaḥ sādhakena varānane ||
abhicāraṃ bhavet kalpamaviśvāsairna saṃśayaḥ |
<68b>
saṃśayena kṛtaṃ yaṃtraṃ viparitaṃ prajāyate ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā śucirbhūtvā pūjayet kuladevatāṃ | lekhanīyaṃ prayatnena ekānte yaṃtramuttamam ||
yasya kasya prayogasya vidhireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | dinatrayaṃ prakurvīta pūjāyogavidhānataḥ ||
trirātraṃ bhūmisāyī syāt brahmacaryarataḥ śuciḥ | tridināśrāyate svapnaṃ sādhakasya śucismite ||
siddhiṃ sādhyamarīṃ caiva susiddhamathavā dhruvaṃ | svapnaṃ tu darśayeccaiva svapne maṃtrādhi devatāḥ ||
yadā na jāyate svapnaṃ tadā sādhyaṃ vinirdiśet | no cedyayā śubhaṃ svapnaṃ tatvārthe ca vinirdiśet ||
śrutvā deva mukhāt svapnaṃ phalasiddhirvidhānataḥ | yadā nivāritaṃ svapne tadānyad yaṃtramuttamaṃ ||
vilikheccaivaṃ yaḥ kuryāt siddhireva prakīrtitaḥ | ata eva māyā proktā yaṃtrāṇi su vahūnī ca ||
yena yaṃtreṇa saṃsiddhiryeṣāṃ yo hi prajāyate | tena te naivatad grāhyaṃ niṣiddhaṃ bhuvanaṃ tyajet ||
vidhirekhaḥ prasiddho vai yaṃtrāṇāṃ bhūtale kalau | maṃtrakoṣṭhe tu paśyaṃti siddhisādhyādi sādhakā ||
na teṣāṃ jāyate siddhiḥ kati doṣaiḥ kadācana | na caika sādhako lākenaikaḥ prakṛtikojanaḥ ||
na caikaṃ rāśi nakṣatraṃ na caikā kuladevatā | yaṃtraṃ vījaṃ tathā maṃtraṃ caturdhā bhavati priye ||
siddhisādhyapariśceti susiddhastu tathāpara | siddhaḥ siddhyati kālena sāddhyaḥ siddhyati dānavā ||
ariḥṣṇaṃteti(?) śūlena susiddhastatkṣaṇārthadaḥ | tasmādeva tathārāśī kālalagnagrahodayaṃ ||
sādhakasya manobhāvaṃ samyagjñātvā samācaret | etadrahasyaṃ paramamuditaṃ riddhidāyakaṃ ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
rājavaśyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ śṛṇu devī suśobhane | kāṃśyabhāṃjanamāni ca śuddhaṃ bhasmādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ ||
jātikāṣṭena vilikhet rocanā caṃdanena ca | sādhyanāmalikhet madhye vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ ||
<69a>
tasyoparidalānyaṣṭau cakrāgre tatra nirdiśet | tato veṣṭayahasya ca vartulaṃ vā tathā priye ||
tasyopari prakurvīta padmaṃ ṣoḍaśa karṇikaṃ | akādi svarā lekhyāḥ dale pūjyadi sa kramāt ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak rekhābhistisṛbhistathā | mallikājāti kusumaiḥ śitāṃbhojaiḥ prapūjayet ||
anyaiśca śvetakusumaiḥ sugaṃdhaiḥ śvetapatrakaiḥ | saṃpūjya yaṃtrarāyatraṃ mahāmohana saṃjñakaṃ ||
etatsaptādinaṃ kṛtvā trilohairveṣṭayet tataḥ | yo dhārayet tu śirasi vāhau caiva gale tathā ||
yo siddhā purūṣo vāpi kṛtaniścaya saṃjñakaṃ | kiṃkarā dravate sarve vaśībhūtāṃ sadaiva hi ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ vai vījasaṃjñakaṃ | rājavaśyaṃ karaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ janavaśya karaṃ tathā ||
ekapaṃktau samālikhyaṃ hrīṃkārāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ | hrīṃkārapuṭitaṃ paścāt sādhyanāmalikhedadhaḥ ||
punaśca carturo vījān hrīṁkārādyānadhastathā | rekhādvayaṃ catuḥkoṇaṃ bhurjapatre likhedbuddhaḥ(?) ||
rocanākuṃkume naiva śrīkhaṇḍena tathaiva ca | anāmī raktasaṃmiśraṃ likhedyaṃtraṃ suśobhanaṃ ||
etadyaṃtraṃ tadā kuryād yadā kruddho narādhipaḥ | kṛcchate nigaḍairvaddhaṃ sarvasvaṃ cāpi nāśitaṃ ||
tadā yaṃtrarājaṃ tu saṃpūjyavidhivatsvayaṃ | nānāpuṣpaistu naivedyairmāṃsaiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
yathāśaktyā tu saṃbhojyāṃ kumāryo brāhmaṇāstathā | yoginyaśca suvāsinyo namaskṛtya suniścitaṃ ||
tadyaṃtraṃ muṣṭinādāyaṃ gacchedvai rājamaṃdiraṃ | tatkopaṃ samayatpāśuvaśīkaraṇamujamaṃ ||
prasādastakṣaṇādevī jāyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi svāmivaśyaṃ manoharaṃ | yaducchet svāminaṃ kartuṃ yāvajjīvaṃ vaśaṃ naraḥ ||
tiryak rekhādvayaṃ kuryād dīrghaṃ dakṣiṇakottare |
<69b>
aṃte tu karṇikāṃ kuryād dakṣiṇe cottare punaḥ ||
praṇavaṃ ca tathā śrīṃca sādhanāma tathaiva ca | tadaṃte śrīṃpraṇavaṃ ca likhenmadhye ca sādhakaḥ ||
uparyapi dale śrīṃca adhobhāge trayaṃ tathā | dakṣiṇottara pūrve ca daleṣu ca likhet kramāt ||
kṣakārāḥ sa visargāṃtā koṇe śrīṃkāravījakaḥ | evaṃ likhitvātadyaṃtraṃ rocanābhūrjapatrakaiḥ ||
sarāvasaṃpuṭe kṣiptvā pūṭayedagninā tataḥ | uddhṛtyasvāṃgaśītaṃ tu yaṃtrabhasmapivennaraḥ ||
yāvajjīvaṃ bhavet tasya sa vaśornātrasaṃśayaḥ | tṛtīyaṃ tu samākhyātaṃ svāmi vaśya karaṃ paraṃ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
yadā kasyāpi kenāpi kāye niḥśāsitaṃ bhavet | tadā mahābhiyogena divyakopaṃ prakārayet ||
tamodanāyāpi tathā divyaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ | rocanā kuṃkume naiva ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bhurjapadmake ||
koṇe koṇe ca hrīṃkāraṃ madhyadeśe likhennaraḥ | koṇāṃtepi ca hrīṃkārān vilikhet tu vadrevahi ||
sādhyanāmalikhet madhye hrīṃkāreṇa ca saṃpuṭaṃ | uparyadhastu madhye tu sākārāṃścaturo likhet ||
sarāvasaṃpuṭaṃ kṣiptvā pūjayed bhakti bhāva kṛt | dvitīye hrīṃ tadā kṛṣya yaṃtrarājaṃ supujitaṃ ||
divyakāle śikhāyāṃ tu vaddhā yaṃtraṃ prayatnataḥ | maunasye vilikhedbhāraṃ vegavegena mānavaḥ ||
na dahyante tadā kiṃcid yaṃtrarāja prasādanaṃ | divyastaṃbho bhavennūnaṃ sa loke sādhutāmiyāt ||
rocanā kuṃkume naiva likhed yaṃtraṃ subhūrjake | hrīṃ saḥ vaḥ sādhyanāmā ca yaṃtraṃ hrīṃsaḥ tathaiva ca ||
paścādudveṣṭayet samyak catuḥkoṇaṃ tu lekhayet | uparyadho madhyadale trikoṇe kaṃ likhennaraḥ ||
hrīṃkāraṃ ca sakāraṃ ca sakāraṃ hrīṁkārameva ca | evaṃ daleṣu saṃlekhyāṃ prativīja catuṣṭayaṃ ||
sarāvasaṃpuṭe kṣiptvā saṃpūjyavidhinā tataḥ | duṣṭānāṃ ca mukhastaṃbhaṃ sa vaśo bhavatī kṣaṇāt ||
rājakopaharaṃ nāma duṣṭamohanakaṃ paraṃ |
<70a>
evaṃ saptadinaṃ kāryaṃ yāvat kāryaṃ tu śoṣayet ||
yadā kruddhaḥ prabhubhūtadyā kartuṃ hi vāṃchati | tadātmajīvarakṣārthaṃ yaṃtraṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ likhet ||
āṇiya bhūrjapatrāṇi likhettattadvayorapi | madhye nāmalikhitvā tu catukoṇaṃ tu rekhayā ||
evaṃ saptacatuḥkoṇaṃ likhelloha śalākayā | tasyopari dalān triṇi vilikhet tu caturdaśa ||
īśānādau likhellālālilīlū dakṣiṇe lalau | prācyāṃgāre tathā levalaṃ laḥ syādathacottare ||
evaṃ dvādaśadale nyasya pratyekaṃ vījamekakam | triśūlaṃ tu catuḥkoṇe sa vinduṃ vilikhennaraḥ ||
tasyoparikṣipennūnaṃ samānīya mahāśilāṃ | paścātatsanmukhaṃ gachet kopastasyottarāṃ mukhaḥ ||
mṛtyuṃjaya mahāyaṃtraṃ prāṇarakṣā karaṃ paraṃ | yadā tasyopari krūddhaḥ kālopi hi durāsadaḥ ||
tadāpi yaṃtrarājoyaṃ rakṣate ca na saṃśayaḥ |
śrībhairava uvāca |
vivāde vijayārthaṃ ca yaṃtraṃ kuryāt manoharaṃ | madhye nāmalikhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ ||
caturdalaṃ tataḥ kuryād vījayuktaṃ tu mānavaḥ | hrīyaṃ pratidale nyasya rocanā kuṃkumena tu ||
bhurjapatre samālikhya duṣṭamadhye kṣipet tataḥ | tato gacched vivādārthaṃ vijayaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
vivāde vijayaṃ nāma yaṃtraṃ devesu pūjitaṃ | tadeyaṃ yasya kasyāpi yadichet siddhimātmanaḥ ||
yadā tu daiva taṃtreṇa dravyaṃ naṣṭa prajāyate | dhaniko yācate dravyaṃ vividhanodhamaṃrnakaṃ ||
tasyadā manana(?) śaktirdravyābhāvāt kathaṃcanaḥ | tadā tasyaiḥ pradānārthaṃ yaṃ yaṃtraṃ sādhāraṇaṃ mahat ||
<70b>
rocanā kuṃkume naiva bhūrjapatreti visṛte | ṣaṭkoṇasya tu madhye tu sādhyanāma pratiṣṭhitaṃ ||
koṇānaṣṭaiva saṃlekhyaṃ kliṃkārāṃścatuḥsaṃkhyakān | kliṃkāramekaṃ vilikhet koṇopari susaṃsthitaṃ ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak vartulaṃ yaṃtramuttamaṃ | paṃcaviṃśati hriṃkāraiḥ cakravat pariveṣṭayet ||
punastadveṣṭayet samyagvartulaṃ pūrvavat tataḥ | etat saptadinaṃ yaṃtraṃ pūjayed vidhivat tataḥ ||
pratyahaṃ pūjayed devīṃ mahāmāyāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | mārkaṃḍeya purāṇoktaṃ devī māhātmyamuttamaṃ ||
japet saptadinaṃ yāvat tato homaṃ tu kārayet | ante pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyād bhojayet kalpakā dvayaṃ ||
pratiślokaṃ ca juhuyāt pāyasaṃ ca tataḥ paraṃ | tasya homaṃ pradātavyaṃ dhanikovaśyatāmiyāt ||
na yācate sa tu dravyaṃ vāṇijyārthaṃ dadāti ca | yadā rājakule duṣṭā bhavaṃti paricāriṇaḥ ||
paiśūnyaṃ kāryavṛttaṃ ca kurvate harnisaṃsadā | tadā kuryāt mahāyaṃtraṃ duṣṭamohana saṃjñakam ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | tatrāsyāṣṭa dalaṃ kṛtvā vījāni vilikhet tataḥ ||
sakārāḥ sa visargāṃtāstasya koṇeṣu sarvataḥ | praṇavaṃ mukhadik lekhyaṃ caturdikṣu krameṇa ca ||
tatastadveṣṭayet sarvaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ dvirekhayā | svaraktena saṃlekhya bhūrjapatre manoharaṃ ||
etadyaṃtraṃ ca saṃpūjya prakṣiped dugdhamadhyataḥ | duṣṭāḥ sarve vinaśyanti rājyamānaṃ bhavet tataḥ ||
ekaviṃśaddinaṃ yāvat tāvat tatraiva yaṃtrakaṃ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vivāde jayavarddhanaṃ ||
vyavahāre bhayaharamidaṃ yaṃtraṃ praśyasete | pūrvapaṃktau samālekhya hrīṃ syā hrīṃ tathaiva ca ||
tasyādhaḥ sādhya nāmātha catuḥkoṇena veṣṭayet | koṇe koṇe dalaṃ kṛtvā madhya deśe tathaiva ca ||
dakṣiṇe rodanaṃ vījaṃ nauhṛt pekṣaṃ tathaiva ca | paścime staṃbhavījāni vāyavyekṣaṃ tathaiva ca ||
<71a>
uttare kṣobha vījāni īśānekṣaṃ tathā nyaset | evaṃ cāṣṭadale nyasya vījāni dvādaśaiva hi ||
sarāvasaṃpuṭe sthāvya yaṃtrarājaṃ yathāvahaṃ | abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairdīpaiścāṣṭabhireva ca ||
lokapālāṃśca saṃpūjya bhojayitvā kumārīkāṃ | validīpaiḥ prapūjyātha aṣṭadikṣu krameṇa ca ||
tāvat pūjyaṃ prayatnena yāvat kāryaṃ tu siddhyati | vyavahāra jayaṃ nāma vivāde vijayastathā ||
rājñāṃ kule vivāde ca jayennātra saṃśayaḥ | mānonnatirbhavet tasya yaṃtrarājaprasādataḥ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
yadicchedvaśagaṃ kartuṃ yāvajjīvaṃ varānane | tadā yaṃtraṃ prakurvīta gāṇapatyaṃ tu siddhidaṃ ||
bhūrjapatraṃ samānīya viśṛtaṃ chidravarjitaṃ | anāmāraktasaṃyuktaṃ dviradasyamadaṃ tathā ||
yāvakasya rasaṃ caiva rocanāṃ ca tathaiva ca | etaccatuṣṭayaṃ yojya jāti kāṣṭhena vai likhet ||
hrīṃkārāḥ saptasaṃlekhyāḥ pūrvapaṃktau varānane | adhaḥpaṃktau tu saṃlekhyaṃ kroṁ hrīṁ klīṁ klīṁ tathaiva ca ||
sādhyanāma tathāgaṃdha tataḥ paṃktau tṛtīyage | klīṁ hrīṁ karti vījāni hrīṁ hrīṁ tathaiva ca ||
ekapaktau caturthaṃ tu hrīṃkārāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ | evaṃ saṃlikhya vījāni dvāviṃśati samānakaṃ ||
paścāntaṃ veṣṭayet samyak pūrvapaścima uttare | prāṅmukhāstu susaṃlikhyā gakārāstrīśasaṃkhyakāḥ ||
sukṣetrāttu samānīya mṛttikāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇikāṃ | tathā gaṇapatiṃ kṛtvā yaṃtraṃ tasyodare kṣipet ||
saṃpūjyagandhapuṣpādyairimaṃ maṃtramudīrayet | imaṃ maṃtraṃ mudāvaśyaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ kuru prabho ||
idaṃ maṃtraṃ samuccārya hastamātraṃ likhatya ca | kṣiptvā tatra gaṇādhvasaṃ pūrayitvā ca mṛttikā ||
yāvajjīvaṃ bhavedvaśyo gaṇarājaprasādataḥ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi janavaśyakaraṃ paraṃ ||
<71b>
madhye nāma likhitvā tu īkāraṃ vilikhedadhaḥ | oṃ namo namo lekhyaṃ paścime pūrvake dale ||
oṃ ajite ajite caiva likhedakṣiṇa uttare | rājavaśyakaraṃ nāma yaṃtrarājaṃ manoharaṃ ||
tridinaṃ pūjayennityaṃ brahmacarya ratonaraḥ | hemaṃ ca rājataṃ vāpi paṭṭasūtraṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
yaṃtrasya dhārayet pṛṣṭhe vāhumūlegaletha vā | sarveṣāṃ caiva yaṃtrāṇāṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtita ||
śubhago darśanīyaśca svajanānāṃ ca vallabhaḥ | yaṃtrasya dhāraṇād devī sa bhavennātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
karpūrakuṃkumairlekhyaṃ rocanā gurukeśaraiḥ |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
jagadvaśyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ śṛṇu devī suśobhanaṃ | karpūro mṛganābhiśca candano rocanā tathā ||
jātikāṣṭhena saṃlikhya yaṃtrato vījapaṃcake | paṃktau tṛtīye saṃlekhyaṃ ṭhakāraṃ tadanantaraṃ ||
ukāraṃ ca jagannāma ṭhakāraṃ tadanantaraṃ | hrīṃkāraṃ ca tataḥ śānte evaṃ vai vījapaṃcake ||
tasyāpi vilikhennūnaṃ ṭhakāraṃ tu caturthake | evaṃ vījāni saṃlikhya catuḥkoṇaṃ tu sthāpayet ||
dvirekhāyā mahākāyaṃ jagadvaśyakaraṃ paraṃ | triloha veṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā dhārayed vāhu madhyataḥ ||
jagadvaśyaṃ bhavet tasya yaṃtraṃ yāvacca tiṣṭhati | saṃpūjya nityamevādau yaṃtradevārcanādiṣu ||
yadātabhṛtyaḥ krūddhe syāt yata sarvaṃ prakāśate | na śakyate nirākartuṃ deśakālavalena tu ||
tathā ca mohanārthoyaṃ svasyārthasya ca siddhaye | yaṃtra paiśācakaṃ nāma kartavyaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
madhye nāma likhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | caturdalaṃ prayatnena vījayuktaṃ manoharaṃ ||
hrīṃkārāścatvāro lekhyādalamadhye caturdiśaṃ | lekhanyābhūrjapatreṇa rocanayā likhennaraḥ ||
tatastaṃ dadhimadhye tu kṣipedyantraṃ varaṃ śubhaṃ | sa vaśo jāyate nūnaṃ yaṃtrarāja prasādataḥ ||
yaṃtrapiśācikā nāma bhṛtyavaśyakaraṃ paraṃ |
<72a>
na deyaṃ yasya kasyāpi svayaṃ rudreṇa bhāṣitaṃ ||
krūra prakṛtikaḥ svāmī yadā saṃsevyate janaiḥ | sevyamānopi hi sadā krudhyatyeva durāsadaḥ ||
kharaiḥ parivṛto nityaṃ durācāro mahīpatiḥ | uttamo vādhvamo vāpi mleccho vā paṭutāṃ gataḥ ||
yaṃtraṃ kālānalaṃ kuryāt tasya vaśya prasiddhaye | sādhyanāmākṣarā lekhyā hrīṃkāraṃ garbhamadhyagāḥ ||
yāvat tasyā kṣarānāmnītā vṛtta eva hrīṁ tathā | ikāramaṃtraṃ saṃlekhyaṃ rocanā bhūrjapatrake ||
trirāvṛtta catuṣkoṇaṃ dīrghagaṃ phūlavat kṛtaṃ | rājikā pratimāṃ kuryāt tatpādaśya ca pāṃśunā ||
hṛtmadhye prakṣipet tasyā yaṃtraṃ kālānalaṃ mahat | saṃpūjya pratimāṃ tatra cūlhī pārśve nikhanya tu ||
ajāraktena saṃmiśraṃ bhaktadhūpaṃ tathaiva ca | balidānaṃ pradātavyaṃ digpāla prītaye tadā ||
oṃ mahākālāya svāhā ||
iti maṃtreṇa juhuyādaṣṭottaraśataṃ tathā | tadaiva bhaktaṃ sājyaṃ tu rakta puṣpaistu miśritaṃ ||
yaṃtrakālānalaṃ nāma tridaśairapi pūjitaṃ | vāṇijyārthaṃ tu vāṇijya lābhārthaṃ vāvatāmapi ||
teṣāṃ madhye yadā kopi praduṣṭo jāyate janaḥ | mādeśa prabhūrvāpi tadā yaṃtraṃ prakalpayet ||
hrīṃkārodara madhye tu sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ likhet | upariṣṭāt tataḥ kuryāccaturdikṣu krameṇa tu ||
paścādveṣṭaya yaṃtraṃ ca catukoṇaṃ dvirekhayā | koṇe triśūlau dvau dvau tu caturdikṣu prakalpayet ||
evaṃ yaṃtravaraṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā tu prayatnataḥ | svaraktena tu saṃmiśraṃ rocanābhūrjapatrake ||
vilikhya yaṃtravat kṛtvā svarahasi kṣipet tataḥ | tatkṣaṇājjāyate vaśyaṃ mahākrūropi mānavaḥ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
yadā mahāvalaḥ śatruḥ parikartu hi vāṃchati | tadātatsānu kūlyārthaṃ yaṃtraṃ kurvīta kaṃcukaṃ ||
<72b>
sādhyanāmalikhenmadhye caturdalena veṣṭayet | ikārāśceti kāraśca visagāṃtaṃ caturdiśaṃ ||
ekaṃ kādyaṃ likhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | śmaśānabhasmanālekhyamarkapatradvayopari ||
saṃpuṭaṃ melayitvā tu vedhayet kaṃṭhakaistataḥ | likhanyāt pūjaye yaṃtraṃ śmaśāne niśi pūjitaṃ ||
validānaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhūtale prayato naraḥ | tatkṣaṇājjāyate śatruḥ sānukulo na saṃśayaḥ ||
kaṭukākhyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ duṣṭasya mohanaṃ paraṃ | yathā śaktyā dakṣiṇā ca kālarātriśca priyatāṃ ||
suhṛdvaṃdhavako vāpi śatrurvā kruddhate yadi | tadā kopaśāntyarthe kuryādyaṃtraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu vedhayet kaṃṭhakairataḥ | upayedhaścottare ca dakṣiṇe ca viśeṣataḥ ||
viṃducaryaṃ caturdikṣu veṣṭayitvā likhet tataḥ | huṃkāraṃ tu likhed garbhe viṃdu madhye tu yatnataḥ ||
dakṣiṇe cottare caiva prasādhyaṃ nāmaveṣṭayet | aṃte huṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ madhyaṃ cedyaṃ prasādataḥ ||
etadyaṃtre tu saṃlekhyaṃ tatra yaṃtra suvistare | kaṃṭake nāyasāne ca vilikhet somavāsare ||
kulālamṛttikā madhye yaṃtraṃ kṣiptvā tu gorakaṃ | pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena yasmātkopaṃ praśāmyati ||
yāmadagdhaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ sadyaḥ kopa haraṃ paraṃ | akrodhana satyavādī jamadagnirdṛḍhavrataḥ ||
rāmasya janakaḥ sākṣāt satvamūrte namostute | evaṃ maṃtraṃ samuccārya pūjāṃte nityameva hi ||
evaṃ saptadinaṃ kāryaṃ pūjopaharaṇaṃ paraṃ | saptame hanibhoktavyā brāhmaṇāvedapāragaḥ ||
naivedyaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ māsamahāsvarṇayet | krodhastu hṛdayādi dvā prasanno jāyate kṣaṇāt ||
ekapaṃktau tu saṃlekhyaṃ hrīṃkāratritayaṃ śubhe | tasyādhastātsamālekhyaṃ nāmavairamanasya ca ||
tataḥ paṃktau tṛtīye syāt hrīṃkāra tritayaṃ punaḥ | tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak catukoṇaṃ tu lekhayā ||
tataścāṣṭadalaṃ kuryādvījamāsaṃ prakalpayet | hrīṁ trayaṃ dalamadhye tu caturdikṣu prakalpayet ||
<73a>
koṇe koṇe dalaṃ nyasya hrīṁkāraṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ | rocanā kuṃkumaṃ caiva mṛganābhiṃ tu candanaṃ ||
ekīkṛtya likhedyaṃtraṃ bhūrjapatresu vistṛte | dadhodasyāṃ śite pakṣe sādhakaścottarāmukhaḥ ||
tadyaṃtraṃ pūjayennityaṃ rātraurātrau varānane | bhogairnānauvidhaiḥ puṣpairvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
evaṃ saptadinaṃ kṛtvā tadaṃte ca catuṣṭayaṃ | striyaṃ saubhāgyasaṃyuktā bhojayet saptasaṃkhyayā ||
śaṃkarasya priyā devī lalite priyatāmiti | rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi saubhāgyaṃ dehi vāṃchitaṃ ||
etat maṃtraṃ samuccārya tataścāsya visarjayet | tadyaṃtraṃ cātunāveṣṭā svakaṇṭhe dhārayet tataḥ ||
śubhagārūpasaṃpannā patipriyatarā bhavet | lalitākhyā mahāyaṃtraṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyakārakaṃ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī prayatnena yaṃtraṃ tṛtīyasādhanaṃ | yaṃ likhya priya nāmāni saṃkīrapuṭitaṃ śubhaṃ ||
adhopari tathā lekhyaṃ sākāradvitayaṃ śubhe | tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak vartulaṃ lekha ekayā ||
tasyoparidalānyaṣṭau hrīṃkārasahitān likhet | rocanā kuṃkumeṇaiva bhūrjapatre samālikhet ||
tridinaṃ pūjayen nityaṃ rātrau rātrau tu pūrvavat | tatasnātvā caturthehni pūjayet śubhagātrayaṃ ||
anaṃga vallabheddevī tvaṃ mesaṃ priyatāmiti | evaṃ priyamahāvaśyaṃ kartuṃ me smara vallabhe ||
etanmaṃtraṃ samuccārya pūjayitvā ca tāḥ striyaḥ | tadyaṃtraṃ dhātu saṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā kaṇṭhetha dhārayet ||
patirdāso bhavet tasyā yaṃtrarājaprasādataḥ | saubhāgyamatulaṃ tasyā jāyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
sa patniṃ na gaṇā yāti sarvasaubhāgyamandritā | ekāsuvāsinī pūjyā caturdaśyāṃ śite tare ||
pakṣe pakṣe rati prityai pūjyaṃ yaṃtraṃ tu nityaśaḥ | yāsāṃ tāsāṃ na dātavyaṃ yaṃtraṃ saubhāgya vardhanīṃ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
yoṣidvaśyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devī suśobhanaṃ |
<73b>
rocanā kuṃkume naiva śrīkhaṇḍa mṛganābhinā ||
bhūrjapatre tu saṃlekhyaṃ jāti kāṣṭhena yaṃtrakaṃ | aiṁ hrīṁ klīṁ ca tato nāma aiṁ hrīṁ klīṁ tathaiva ca ||
evaṃ saṃpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā catukoṇaṃ tu veṣṭayet | uparyadhopi saṃlikhya dve vījānya prayatnataḥ ||
aiṁ hrīṁ klīṁ ca tathākṣiṃ ca aiṃ cāṃte ca punastathā | koṇepi diśya vījāni aiṁ hrīṁ klīṁ ca tathaiva ca ||
dalākṛtistu kartavyā madanasya tu kāṣṭhakaiḥ | tasya madhye tu nikṣipya yaṃtraṃ sarveṣu pūjayet ||
bhogaiśca vividhairgaṃdhairdhūpairdīpaiḥ phalai śubhaiḥ | rātrau rātrau prakurvīta dināṃte pratyahaṃ śubhe ||
evaṃ kṛte tu sā nārī dāsī nūnaṃ prajāyate | yaṃtraṃ śrīkāmarājākhyaṃ yo vidvaśyakaraṃ paraṃ ||
saṃpūjyāścandane nātra rājikā pratimānaraiḥ | kāmo naṃgaḥ paṃcaśaraḥ kaṃdarpo mīnake tanaḥ ||
śrīviṣṇutanayo devaṃ praśanno bhava me prabho | evaṃ maṃtraṃ prakartavyaṃ yāvat sā vaśyatāmiti ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi mānināṃ mānamardanaṃ | yaṃtraṃ pradurlabhaṃ loke mānināṃ khyāti mardanaṃ ||
turaṃgasya tu raktena rocanā bhurjapatrakaiḥ | praṇavaṃ ca tathā hrīṁ ca sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ pṛthak ||
nāmākṣarāṇi sarvāṇi hrīṁkāra puṭitāni ca | aṃtādyaṃ praṇavaṃ lekhyameka paṃktau tathaiva ca ||
tatastadveṣṭayet samyak catuṣkoṇaṃ ca rekhayā | uparyadhaśca saṃlekhya pūrvavadvījasaṃpuṭaṃ ||
tiryag bhāge dvi paṃktau tu pūrvavat taṃtrasaṃpuṭaṃ | koṇe dalākṛtiṃ kṛtvā madanot kṛti madhyataḥ ||
evaṃ yaṃtraṃ susaṃlekhya madana pratimāṃ śubhāṃ | mane desya tu kāṣṭhena kṛtvā hṛdi vinikṣipet ||
sa raṃdhra hṛdayaṃ kuryāt tathā yaṃtraṃ su tiṣṭhati | saṃveṣṭya prakṣipet nūnaṃ yaṃtraṃ tasyorasi sphuṭaṃ ||
raktacandanamālyaiśca pūjayetyahaṃ tataḥ | ekaviṃśati dinaṃ yāvat sā tasya vakṣyatāmiyāt ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rājastrī vaśyakārakaṃ | yathā tat dṛṣṭiṃ pātena kāmavāṇa kṛtā iva ||
<74a>
pataṃti sahasā dṛṣṭvā maninyo mada vihvalāḥ | rocanā kuṃkume naiva bhūrjapatre likhennaraḥ ||
karpūreṇa samaṃ yaṃtraṃ jātikāṣṭhe vidhānataḥ | ṣaṭkoṇasya tu madhye tu tasya nāma pratiṣṭhitaṃ ||
krīṁkāraṃ sarvato lekhyaṃ koṇopari tu sarvataḥ | pūrvakoṇaṃ tarāle tu hrīṁkāraṃ dvitayaṃ likhet ||
koṇamadhye likheccaivaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ pūrvasaṃsthitaṃ | tatsarvaṃ veṣṭayet tasya vartulaṃ lekhayāt śubhaṃ ||
dakṣiṇe tridalaṃ kuryādī(?)śānepi dalaṃ tathā | hrīṁkāraṃ dalamadhye tu krameṇa pravilekhayet ||
evaṃ saṃlikhyata yaṃtraṃ pūjayed bhaktibhāvanaḥ | gaṃdhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sutai vedyaiḥ śuklāṃvaradharaḥ svayaṃ ||
cintayet tāṃ striyaṃ rātrau yaṃtrasya purataḥ sthitāṃ | evaṃ saptadinaṃ kuryāt tadante brāhmaṇa trayaṃ ||
saṃbhojya vividhairbhojyaiḥ kāmākṣā priyatāmiti | śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād bhojayet sādhakastrīyaṃ ||
trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā vāhumūletha dhārayet | taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājaramaṇī kaṃdarpojjvalapīḍitā ||
svayaṃ saṃprāthayennityaṃ kākathetara yoṣiti | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi nijamekaṃ mahāphalaṃ ||
taṃ yo dhārayate nityaṃ strīṇāṃ priyataro bhavet | yā strī dhārayate bhaktyā sā saubhāgyavati bhavet ||
saubhāgya jananaṃ vījaṃ nṛṇāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ | etadvījākṣaraṃ gopyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit ||
sakāraṃ ca hakāraṃ ca kakāraṃ ca tathaiva ca | rakāraṃ ca dakāraṃ ca ikārāntaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ ||
evaṃ krameṇa saṃyojyaṃ akṣarāṇāṃ ca ṣaṭkakaṃ | ikārasvara saṃyuktaṃ bindunā pariśobhitaṃ ||
rocanā nīrayuktena bhurjapatre likhennaraḥ | tridinaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā hemena veṣṭayet tataḥ ||
puruṣo vāhu mūle ca nārī ca galake punaḥ | dhārayet vījarājāṃ yata sphuṭaṃ daurbhāgyanāśanaṃ ||
mahāsaubhāgya jananaṃ śrīśivena puroditaṃ |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ saubhāgyadāyakaṃ | strīnāmeva samuddiṣṭaṃ yaṃtraṃ karaṇasaṃjñakaṃ ||
<74b>
asyaivadhāraṇāddevī vaṃdhyā garbhavatī bhavet | mṛtavatsā tu yā nārī sāpyenaṃ yaṃtramuttamaṃ ||
dhārayejjāyate devī jīvaputrā na saṃśayaḥ | rocanā kuṃkumeṇaiva bhūrjapatre likhet tataḥ ||
praṇavaṃ tu likhet pūrvaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ tadanantaraṃ | tato ramananānāthaṃ hrīṃkārāntaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ ||
hakāraṃ ca caturdikṣu dalamadhye vinirdiśet | uparyadhopi vilikhet krauṃkāramekamekakam ||
hakāraṃ ca caturdikṣu dalamadhyeṣu vinyaset | oṃkāraṃ ca tathā hrīṃ ca yakāraṃ ca tathā likhet ||
dalamadhye punarlekhya metadvīja catuṣṭayaṃ | koṇe koṇe dale lekhyaṃ madhyadeśe tu sādhaka ||
evaṃ yaṃtraṃ ca saṃlekhya pūjayecca dinatrayaṃ | bhojayet mithunaṃ caikaṃ lokeśaḥ prīyatāmiti ||
paścāt taṃtu sanāveṣṭana suvarṇena viśeṣataḥ | vartulamavaniṃ kṛtvā hāramadhye tu dhārayet ||
dhāraṇājjāyate devi saubhāgyamatulaḥ mahat | jīvavatsā bhavennūnaṃ vaṃdhyātvaṃ ca prasāmyati ||
kāmalākhyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ tu brahmaṇā punaḥ | na deyaṃ yasya kasyāpi sādhakena varānane ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yaṃtramātrasya darśanaṃ | raktacaṃdanamiśreṇa svaraktairbhūrjapatrake ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | caturdalaṃ tataḥ kuryād vījaṃ yuktaṃ manoharaṃ ||
huṁkāraṃ dalamadhye tu pratyekaṃ vilikhet kramāt | evaṃ yaṃtraṃ suracyātha valipuṣpairmanoharaiḥ ||
prakṣipet ghṛtamadhye tu ākṛṣṭistridinād bhavet | etadyaṃtraṃ mahāgopyaṃ rakṣanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
na deyaṃ yasya kasyāpi yadicchetsiddhimātmanaḥ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ traipurakaṃ mahat ||
rocanānīrayuktena bhūrjapatre likhennaraḥ | madhye nāmalikhitvā tu huṃkāra puṭitaṃ śubhaṃ ||
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhet tasya nāmagarbhamanoharaṃ | saukārāt vilikhet koṇe madhyena bindubhūṣitān ||
evaṃ yaṃtraṃ susaṃpūjya ghṛtamadhye vinikṣipet | pratyahaṃ saṃjapennityaṃ prārthayet tripurāṃ punaḥ ||
<75a>
ākarṣayen mahāvegā devadattaṃ mama priyaṃ | tripure deva deveśī stubhyaṃ vāsya prayacchatu ||
prārthayet manunānena tripurāyaṃtraṃ sādhayet | evaṃ kṛte saptamehni ākṛṣṭirjāyate śubhe ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi māninī karṣaṇaṃ śubhaṃ | rahasyaṃ sarvayaṃtrāṇāṃ tatkṣaṇāsiddhidāyakaṃ ||
na vācyaṃ yasya kasyāpi yaṃtrarājaṃ suduṣkaraṃ | dakṣiṇā nāmikāraktena vāme karatale likhet ||
praṇavaṃ ca tathā klīṁ klīṁ etat paṃktau likhennaraḥ | tasyā hyeti tritayaṃ traṃyaṃ bhūtasyādho likhet kramāt ||
tasyāpyadho likhennāma ramanyāścaiva suvrate | trikoṇaṃ veṣṭayet paścād vījānāmuparo priye ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tu saṃpūjya tatraiva kusumai śubhaiḥ | yāmamātreṇa sā nārī samāyāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
yaṃtraṃ śrīkāmarājākhyaṃ devānāmapi durlabhaṃ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ vai devamātṛkāṃ ||
karṣaṇaṃ naranārīnāṃ śṛṇu devī mahāphalaṃ | lākṣārasaṃ haridrāṃ ca maṃjiṣṭhāṃ bhurjapatrake ||
lekhanīyaṃ prayatnena ekānte yaṃtramuttamaṃ | madhye nāmalikhitvā tu trikoṇaṃ veṣṭaye tataḥ ||
taccāpi veṣṭayet paścād vartulaṃ yatnataḥ priye | tasyopari svarālekhyā ākārādyāśca ṣoḍaśa ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭayet sarvaṃ lekhayā netra saṃkhyayā | tasyaiva pādadhūlyātha prakuryācchālabhaṃjikāṃ ||
tasyā yonau tu saṃkṣipya yaṃtrarājaṃ supūjitaṃ | evaṃ kṛte tu kṛṣṭā sā samāyāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
vahunātra ki muktena patināsamamā nayet | yaṃtrarājaṃ mahāgopyaṃ deva mātṛka saṃjñakaṃ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī mahāyaṃtraṃ stambhanaṃ sarvavairiṇāṃ | vivāde vyavahārāṇāṃ mukhastaṃbhī bhaved dhruvaṃ ||
yadākāla vaśā devī kalahaḥ saṃprajāyate | tadā kuryān mahāyaṃtraṃ jihvāvedhanakaṃ paraṃ ||
rocanā bhūrjapatreṇa sulekhyaṃ suvicarcitaṃ | ṣaṭkoṣṭhakaṃ prakurvīta rekhādvitayakena ca ||
<75b>
koṣṭhamadhye likhed vījaṃ yāti kāmi sahaikakaṃ | hakāraṃ ca sakāraṃ ca lakāraṃ tadanantaraṃ ||
vakāraṃ ca rakāraṃ ca yakārāṃtaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ | ukārasvarasaṃyuktaṃ mastake rephabhūṣitaṃ ||
vindumātrārddhasaṃyuktaṃ saṃyoge varṇaṣaṭkakaṃ | svaradvitayasaṃyuktaṃ bindunā paribhūṣitaṃ ||
evaṃ saṃjāyate vījaṃ mukhastaṃbhanasaṃjñakaṃ | koṣṭhe koṣṭhe tu saṃlekhyamekaikaṃ vījamuttamaṃ ||
evaṃ vījāni saṃlekhya rekhā dvitīyake na hi | vījoparigatāṃ kṛtvā koṇaśede caturdiśaṃ ||
vāhyarekhorddhvato lekhyā triśūlā mastakoparī | sarvato lekhayā cānte triśūlātvilikhe kramāt ||
evaṃ dvāviṃśa saṃkhyakāstriśūlāgre pratiṣṭhitāḥ | śūlāṃtarāle sarvatra tathopari likhet kramāt ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yātrā staṃbhaṃ tu suṃdarī | śirā saṃpuṭe saṃlekhyaṃ pītadravyena śobhanaṃ ||
rocanā haritālaṃ ca haridrā ca manaḥśilā | kuṃkumeṇa samāyuktaṃ pītadravyaṃ pracakṣyate ||
kuṃbhamohani vījāni ekapaṃktau likhennaraḥ | tasyāpyadho likhennāma mohanāṃte pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
tatastadveṣṭayet samyak catuḥkoṇaṃ tu lekhayā | koṇe koṇe triśūlaṃ tu madhye madhye tathaiva ca ||
evamaṣṭha triśūlāni kṛtvā yaṃtroparisthitān | saṃpūjyapītakusumaiḥ yaṃtrarājaṃ suśobhanaṃ ||
dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairnānābhakti samanvitaiḥ | evaṃ saṃpūjyataṃ yaṃtraṃ bhūmi madhye kṣipet tataḥ ||
mṛdāpūryaśame deśe yaṃtrasyopari yatnataḥ | gamanaṃ staṃbhayatovamiti kāryaṃ vicāraṇāt ||
yathā ropita bhāṇḍāpi nāyatvavapi me sadā | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vācāṃstaṃbhan tu sundari ||
prativādi mukhastaṃbhaṃ yaṃtraṃ khyātaṃ tu bhūtale | pītadravyena saṃlekhya śilāsaṃpuṭa madhyataḥ ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu trikoṇaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | tatastadveṣṭayet samyag vartulaṃ lekhayā punaḥ ||
<76a>
tasyoparidalānyaṣṭau prakurvīta tataḥ paraṃ | dalamadhye nyased vījaṃ lakāraṃ bindubhūṣitaṃ ||
evaṃ cāṣṭadale lekhyaṃ pūjayet kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ | pītavarṇaistathā dhūpa dīpanaivedyakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayeccaikaṃ pāyasena guḍena ca | tato niṣanya bhūmau tu sthāpanaṃ pūrvavat tataḥ ||
prativādi mukhaṃ staṃbho jāyate nātra saṃśaya | etadyaṃtraṃ mahādevī sugopyaṃ kathitaṃ tava ||
karṇikāraṃ kulatthaṃ ca caṃpakaṃ svarṇaketakīṃ | dhattūraṃ pītavahidrāṃ nāgakeśarameva ca ||
tadā yaṃtraṃ prakurvīta sugamaṃ phalasiddhidaṃ | khaṭikapātu saṃlekhya svabhīttau vegataḥ priye ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu śatrostu vidhivat priye | tasyopari sthitā rekhā vasusaṃkhyāyate kramāt ||
lekhā tu triśūlaṃ tu tallikhecca digaṣṭake | tatraiva tu susaṃpūjya svetaṃ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
anyaiśca svetagandhaiśca śvetavastrairmanoharaiḥ | brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayeccaikaṃ sa śivaḥ priyatāmiti ||
vivādepi sabhāyāṃ ca mukhastaṃbhaṃ karotvayaṃ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vahnistaṃbhaṃ manoharaṃ ||
divyakāle prakurvīta yaṃtrarājaṃ suśobhanaṃ | pītadravyena saṃlikhya bhūrjapatre varānane ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu kroṃplāmādyaṃ tu saṃpuṭaṃ | uparyadhopi vilikhet kroṃkāraṃ sumanoharaṃ ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭayed devī catuṣkoṇaṃ tu lekhayā | tasyopari caturlekhaṃ lekhanīyā prayatnataḥ ||
koṇāntarāle saṃlikhya lakāraṃ bindubhūṣitaṃ | evaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ lekhyaṃ lakārāṇāṃ tu vījakaṃ ||
koṇāṃte tvaṣṭasaṃlekhyā triśūlāssarvathā priye | evamaṣṭatriśūlāni likhedatha prapūjayet ||
saṃpūjya brāhmaṇaṃ bhojya yaṃtraṃ bhūmau vinikṣipet | vahamānodayamānena madhye yaṃtraṃ vidhāya ca ||
yāvat tasyopariyāti salilaṃ trakhacaṃḍinī | tāvaddagdho mahāstaṃbho jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
divyasaṃ staṃbhanaṃ nāma yaṃtraṃ devaiḥ supūjitaṃ |
<76b>
na deyaṃ yasya kasyāpi yadicchetsiddhimātmanaḥ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ vahninivāraṇaṃ | yasmin gṛhe sthitaṃ yaṃtraṃ tatranāgni bhayaṃ kvacit ||
yasya haste sadā nityaṃ yaṃtrarājaṃ manoharaṃ | svapnapyagni bhayaṃ tasya kadācinnopajāyate ||
valātkāreṇa kartavyamagni grahaṇakaṃ priye | vidyamāne tathā yaṃtre auṣadhi vā valādhike ||
pādaspṛṣṭo yathā sarpo daśatyevananyamati | tathā staṃbhopi deveśi vatvātkāreṇa vā janaiḥ ||
apamṛtyuṃ yadā devī haredvai vaidyako rasaḥ | tathā yaṃtropi deveśi apāṃtarabhayaṃ haret ||
śrīkhaṇḍarocanā himena tu leṣanīyaṃ yaṃtraṃ tu bhūrjevavidhivaccatu suvisṛtena | nāma svakīyaṃ pravilikhya madhye suveṣṭayedvarttulaṃ lekhayāthā |
tasyopari dalaṃ nūnaṃ cakāraṃ bindubhūṣitaṃ |
pūrve ca dakṣiṇe caiva paścime cottare punaḥ | etatsarvaṃ tu saṃveṣṭya catuḥkoṇaṃ tu lekhayā ||
trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā vāhumūlegalathavā | athavā vāhumadhye tu kṣīramadhye viniḥkṣipet ||
saṃpūjya ca nityamevaṃ devavadvijayapradaṃ | agneḥ sakāśāt bhītiryāsāsya kvāpi prajāyate ||
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayedekaṃ yaṃtrarājasya tuṣṭaye | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi priya staṃbhana kārakaṃ ||
yadā kopi valāyāti śaritopi varānane | tadā tat staṃbhanaṃ kuryād yadā hyasu smito bhavet ||
pīta draveṇasaṃmiśraṃ yatphalaṃ kaṣṭa(?)saṃbhavaṃ | khaṭikāyāṃ likhedyaṃtraṃ karake kāṣṭhasambhave ||
yakāraṃ garbhamadhye tu sādhyanāma pratiṣṭhitaṃ | tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak catuṣkoṇaṃ tu rekhayā ||
tasyopari catuṣkoṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ vilikhedbudhaḥ | koṇedalākṛtiṃ kuryāt madhyadeśe kvacit kvacit ||
dalamadhye lakāraṃ tu vinduyuktaṃ likhet priye | evaṃ vilikhyasaṃpūjya vidhivadyaṃtramuttamaṃ ||
<77a>
adhomukhaṃ nibadhniyāt karakaṃ gṛhamadhyataḥ | tatra stambho bhaved devī nātrakaryāvicāraṇā ||
tathāpi ca tato yattu gatvāpi vasamātyasau | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vairiṇāstaṃbhanaṃ paraṃ ||
khaṭikayāsu saṃlekhya śilāsaṃpuṭa madhyagaṃ | hrīṃkāraṃ garbhamadhye tu sādhyanāmapratiṣṭhitaṃ ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak catuṣkoṇaṃ tu lekhayā | evaṃ yaṃtraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ likhitvā yaṃtrakaṃ paraṃ ||
aṃte koṇe tu śūlāni caturdikṣuḥ catuścatuḥ | vilikhet pūjayed yaṃtraṃ vidhivat kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
saṃpuṭe vilikhitvā tu sthāpayed yaṃtrakaṃ śubhe | tatkṣaṇājjāyate śatrormukhastaṃbhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ picchūnamuttamaṃ | śatrostaṃbhayate vācaṃ gatiṃ buddhiṃ varānane ||
rocanā bhūrjapatreṇa likhed yaṃtraṃ suśobhanaṃ | krokārai puṭitaṃ kāryaṃ akṣaraṃ nāmasaṃbhavaṃ ||
hrīṃkāra puṭitaṃ paścādvitīyamakṣaraṃ punaḥ | nāmākṣarāṇi yāvanti tāvat saṃpuṭitāni ca ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭayet sarvaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ tu lekhayā | koṇe koṇe dalaṃ kuryād dirghavījena saṃpuṭaṃ ||
yakāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca rakāraṃ ca tathaiva ca | ikāraṃ ca vakāraṃ ca yakāraṃ tadanantaraṃ ||
evaṃ krameṇa saṃyojyamakṣarāṇāṃ tu ṣaṭkakaṃ | ukārasvarasaṃyuktaṃ mastakoparibhūṣitaṃ ||
bindunādasamāyuktaṃ vilikheddala madhyataḥ | evaṃ tu dale tu saṃlekhya vījaṃ vai surapūjite ||
dalāntarāle saṃlekhyaṃ kroṃkṣaścaiva caturdiśaṃ | evaṃ saṃlikhya yaṃtraṃ tu pūjayed rakta candanaiḥ ||
raktapuṣpaistathā vastraiḥ svaraktena ca sundarī | yathā śaktyā pradātavyā dakṣiṇāṃ brahmasaṃbhave ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścāt vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet | paścādyaṃtraṃ likhanyāsu bhūmimadhye vinikṣipet ||
buddhistaṃbhaṃ gatistaṃbhaṃ vākstaṃbhaṃ ca varānane | piśunastatkṣaṇāddevī jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
<77b>
śrīdevyuvāca ||
tvaritāṃtāna kīṃ dṛṣṭyā nihataṃ rāvaṇaṃ yuddhiḥ | pūjitā rāmacandre sātvaritāṃ tāṃ namāmyahaṃ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇudevī prayatnena yaṃtraṃ daurbhāgya varddhanaṃ | vivāde naranārīnāṃ yena saṃjāyate sadā ||
rocanā kuṃkume naiva bhūrjapatre varānane | likhed yaṃtraṃ mahādevī nānā saubhāgyanāśanaṃ ||
kuryāt tīryagānā rekhāḥ pūrva paścima saṃsthitāḥ | dīrghā vai koṣṭake kuryādaṣṭasaṃkhyā suci smite ||
tatmadhyoparibhāge ca ekaikaṃ vilikhet kramāt | madhye nāsākṣaraṃ devī dvivāraṃ tu punaḥ punaḥ ||
tanmadhye cakrame naiva te naiva vilikhet tataḥ | ajite tyuparilekhyaṃ svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikaṃ ||
evaṃ saṃvilikhet yaṃtraṃ gacheccaiva śarittaṭe | ubhayo kūlayorgrāhyā mṛttikāmauninā śubhā ||
tayā gaṇapatiṃ kṛtvā yaṃtraṃ tasyodare kṣipet | godugdhaiḥ stapanaṃ kuryāt gaṇarājasya sundarī ||
arcayedvividhaiḥ puṣpairmodakairvahubhistataḥ | saṃpūjya vālakān bhakṣyairgaṇeśaḥ priyatāmiti ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ gaṇarājaṃ śucismite | śarāvasaṃpuṭe kṣiptvā saṃpuṭoparivinyaset ||
aghoreti amogheti vinyaset saṃpuṭopari | bhūmisthaṃ saṃpuṭaṃ kuryānnikhanyātha prapūjayet ||
daurbhāgyamatulaṃ prāpya nārīsīdatyaharniśaṃ | puruṣeṇa sahaitāṃtu surūpāmapi suvrate ||
puṃliṃge yojitaṃ yaṃtraṃ nārī na sahate bhujā | daṃpatyordveṣaṇaṃ devī rahasyaṃ paramaṃ sadā ||
nānyatra saṃprayoktavyaṃ yaṃtrametanmama priye | na deyaṃ yasya kasyāpi viparitaṃ prajāyate ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śatru vidviṣaṇaṃ paraṃ | paraspara mahādveṣaṃ śatrūṇāṃ jāyate paraṃ ||
vidveṣite na yuktena lekhanyā kākapicchayā | śmaśāna karpaṭe lekhyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ varānane ||
<78a>
hrīṃkāraṃ ca akāraṃ ca biṃduyuktaṃ tataḥ paraṃ | hrīṃkāraṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca ekapaktau likhet tataḥ ||
adhaḥ paṃktau tato nāma caturdalaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | caturdalaṃ tataḥ kuryāt dveṣo dvitaya bhūṣitāṃ ||
daramadhye tathā lekhyaṃ madhyadeśe tathaiva tu | ajāraktena saṃmiśraṃ raktaṃ naivedyakaṃ bhavet ||
valipuṣpaiḥ prapūjyātha yaṃtraṃ rātrau varānane | yoginīṃ bhojayeccaikāṃ guruṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ ||
udveṣe śivagehe ca sthāpyaṃ yaṃtra na saṃśayaḥ | śmaśānepyathavā sthāpyaṃ gṛhe na kadācana ||
śatrūṇāṃ jāyate dveṣaṃ kramenaiva na saṃśayaḥ | sarvaśatruṃ saṃdveṣaṃ na nāma yaṃtrarājaṃ mahāphalaṃ ||
ekānte karaṇāyaṃ vilokāntena kadācana | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣāmi vandhuvidveṣaṇaṃ paraṃ ||
śmaśāna karpaṭe lekhyaṃ lekkhanyā kākapicchayā | meṣasvarūdhire naiva ghṛṣṭāṃgāraṃ smaśānajaṃ ||
sādhyanāmalikhitvā tu trikoṇaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | adhopari ca rephorddhaṃ saṃlekhyaṃ bhūtarātriṣu ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak catuṣkoṇaṃ tu rekhayā | koṇe koṇe triśūlānāṃ saṃlekhyaṃ ca catuṣṭayaṃ ||
caturdikṣu samaṃ lekhyaṃ caturlekhyoparisthitaḥ | evaṃ saṃlikhayedyaṃtraṃ saṃpūjya pūrvavat punaḥ ||
saptāṅgulirlikhanyātha pūrayedbhūmi madhyataḥ | yātrāsu teṣāṃ mārge ca tatraiva prakṣipet tataḥ ||
parasparaṃ mahādveṣo vandhunāṃ saṃprajāyate | yasya pāde patatyeva sāpi daurbhāgya bhājanaḥ ||
jāyate nātra saṃdeho yaṃtrarāja prabhāvataḥ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣāmi vidveṣaṃ svānibhṛtyajaṃ ||
viṣeṇa raktamiśreṇa lekhanyā kāpi kacchayā | śmaśane karpaṭe lekhyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ mahāniśi ||
sādhyanāmalikhedgarbhaṃ vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ |
<78b>
tasyopari adhobhāge rakāratritayaṃ punaḥ ||
yakāraṃ purato lekhyaṃ tīryagbhāgye dvivījakaṃ | yakāraṃ ca rakāraṃ ca visargāntaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ ||
evaṃ saṃlikhya yaṃtraṃ ca vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | evaṃ yaṃtraṃ tu saṃlekhyaṃ teṣāṃ mārge nikhanya tu ||
sa jāyate mahādveṣaḥ svāmi sevaka yoḥ sadā | yāvat yaṃtraṃ tu bhūmisthaṃ dvaya dveṣaḥ pravarttate ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi jagadveṣakaraṃ paraṃ | yaṃtraṃ bhayānakaṃ nāma daurbhāgyasya vivarddhanaṃ ||
kākolūkasya raktena riśabhuraktena vā punaḥ | daurbhāgya lekhanāthaśca lekhanyā kākapicchayā ||
vilekhedbhūrjapatre tu sādhyanāma niśi priye | kṛṣṇāṣṭamyā caturdaśyāṃ likhedyaṃtraṃ manoharaṃ ||
sādhyanāma likhenmadhye ṭhakāra pariveṣṭitaṃ | ṭhakārāṇāṃ ca saṃkhyāstri viṣamaṃ veṣṭayet sadā ||
tatastu vartulaṃ veṣṭya durbhagāṣma(?) veṣṭayet | etadyaṃtraṃ susaṃsthāpya bhūmau vā tṛṇa madhyataḥ ||
yāvad gṛhe hi tad yaṃtre sopi tadgṛhagaḥ sadā | tāvadvisvaśya śatruḥ saṃjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
pūjākramastu pūrvoktāṃ yaṃtra devī nṛṇāṃ sadā |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ śatru sumāraṇaṃ | etadyaṃtraṃ susaṃlekhya kapāle tu narasya ca ||
śmaśānaṅgārakaṃ ghṛcchā dhatūrakarasena tu | śmaśāne caiva saṃlekhya sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ ||
trikoṇaṃ veṣṭayet paścādraṣādvitaya śobhitaṃ | ūrdhvarekhā tu kartavyā sarvatrāpi varānane ||
sarāva saṃpuṭe kṣiptvā yaṃtraṃ taṃ saṃprapūjayet | valimāṃsaṃ toya hāraistu svaraktena viśeṣataḥ ||
etadyaṃtraṃ tu tatraiva nikhanyādyatra prapūjayet | krameṇaiva mahāvyādhistato vai maraṇa bhajet ||
ekajīvaṃ valiṃ datvā uddhṛte jīvate hi saḥ | nocaidyamapuraṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāt ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
<79a>
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ śatrupranāśanaṃ | māraṇaṃ pravalasyāpi śatrormṛtyurna cānyathā ||
viṣeṇa haritālena bhūrjapatre likhennaraḥ | sādhyanāmalikhitvā tu lekhanyā kākapīcchayā ||
lekhane vidhirekaiva pūrvoktamāraṇe hitā | vāraṃ vāraṃ kimuktena graṃthavistārakāraṇaṃ ||
hrīṁkāraṃ garbhamadhye tu sādhyanāma pratiṣṭhitaṃ | tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak trikoṇaṃ pūrvavattriyā ||
koṇe koṇe triśūlena vilikhyātha prapūjayet | pūjane vidhiryaḥ proktaḥ sarvatrāpi ca māraṇe ||
manuṣyāṅghri nali madhye kṣiped yaṃtraṃ supūjitaṃ | kṣiptvā śmaśāna bhūmisthāṃ nalikāṃ tu sayaṃtrikāṃ ||
akasmāt maraṇaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | anugrahaṃ pūrvoktaḥ sarvatrāpi ca māraṇe ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi māraṇaṃ dūradeśajaṃ | śmaśānāṃgārakaṃ ghṛṣṭā ajāraktaṃ tathaiva ca ||
viṣaṃ caiva tu saṃghṛṣya kṣipennara kapālake | saṃpuṭe caiva saṃlekhya lekhanyā kākapicchayā ||
sādhanāmalikhenmadhye huṁkāra puṭitaṃ śubhaṃ | tataścāṣṭadalaṃ kuryād gṛhe saṃsthāpayed yathā ||
caturdiśaṃ tu saṃlekhya huṁ phaṭ dalamadhyataḥ | tatastadveṣṭayet samyak vartulaṃ vai dvirekhayā ||
huṁkārairveṣṭayet paścād viṣakteḥ sarvataḥ priye | tatastaṃ saṃpuṭaṃ mele bhasmanā pūrayecchubhe ||
agre rūpari saṃsthāpyaṃ pūrayitvā yathoditaṃ | deśāntara gatasyāpi śatroḥ saṃjāyate jvare ||
pratyahaṃ jvalanīye tu stokaṃ stokaṃ tu sundarī | dine ekānta viṃśat ca sarvatra jvalayen niśi ||
tasmiṃneva kṣaṇe śatrurmaraṇaṃ jāyate priye |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi māraṇaṃ sarvadehināṃ | rudhireṇa manuṣyasya śmaśānāṃgāra vṛkṣayet ||
viṣeṇa ca tathā lekhyaṃ karpaṭe vai śmaśānaje | sādhyanāmalikhitvā tu huṁ phaṭ dyutitayaṃ tathā ||
<79b>
evaṃ trivāraṃ saṃlikhya tripaṃktau tu varānane | tatasvadveṣṭayet samyak vartulaṃ tu trirekhayā ||
rājikā pratimāṃ kuryāt śatroścaraṇapāṃśunā | hṛtmadhye yaṃtrakaṃ kṣiptvā śanaistāpya tu puta(?)līṃ ||
śatroḥ kramakrameṇaiva dāhaṃ śokaṃ ca jāyate | śiro yathā ca mahati tṛtīyehni prajāyate ||
hastapādāṃ gadāhaḥ syāt maraṇaṃ saptame dine | jāyate nātra saṃdeho vimukto na ca saṃśayaḥ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi māraṇaṃ sarvadehināṃ |
yaṃtraṃ strīpuruṣasya ca |
vibhītakasya tu patre tu śmaśānabhasmanā likhet ||
ṛturaktaṃ tu saṃmilya lekhanyā kākapicchayā | sādhyanāmalikhenmadhye stambhe sābhani saṃyutaṃ ||
tatastrikoṇaṃ saṃveṣṭya paṃcakoṇaṃ tathopari | manuṣyaṃ narake kṣiptvā naraṃ saṃpūjya sūtrayā ||
tatsūtra śaktyā yā devī tatastatpūjyapūrayet | bhūmadhye'tha nikhanyātha śmaśānetha yato niśi ||
tataḥ saṃyatanāt paścāt śatruḥ mitrasya vīkṣaṇāt | mriyate saptarātreṇa mokṣa pūrvokta eva hi ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śatrohamuccāṭanaṃ paraṃ | anāmāraktasaṃlekhya bhūrjapatre varānane ||
gaṇapati vijāniyā prahitaṃ praṇavādikaṃ | ekapaṃktau samālekhya huṃgaṃ ca nāmameva ca ||
paṃktau dvitīya saṃlekhyaṃ tṛtīya vilikhet tataḥ | huṁgaṃdhaḥ svāheti likhitvā kramaso naraḥ ||
tatastadveṣṭayet saṃyak catuḥkoṇaṃ dvirekhayā | raktāmbaradharo devī raktagandhā tu lepanaḥ ||
caturdaśyāṃ sādhakastu mahārātrau likhet kramāt | pujanaṃ raktakusumaiḥ raktagandhaiḥ phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
kumārī bhojanaṃ rātrau yathā śaktyā tu dakṣiṇā | dhyānastu deva devasya gaṇanāthasya sundarī ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sadya uccāṭanaṃ paraṃ |
<80a>
viṣeṇatālake naiva likhet kākaṃ tu pannake ||
śmaśānajeṃ tu lekhanyā kapiccha samudbhavā | sādhyanāmalikhet paścād vāyasodara madhyataḥ ||
pūjane lekhane caiva pūrvoktastu vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | adhomukhaṃ tu taṃkākaṃ lavamātraṃ tu dakṣiṇe ||
vibhītakasya dakṣeṣu vandhayet prayato niśi | evaṃ kṛte tṛttīye hrīṃ sthānāduccāṭanaṃ bhavet ||
yādayaṃtraṃ tu tatrasthamudvignastāvaṃ deva hi | naro ca na gṛhe tasya sukhaṃ na labhate kvacit ||
videśagamanaṃ tasya saṃśayena ca jivītaṃ |
śrībhairava uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi uccāṭanaṃ sarva dehināṃ | kākolūkasya raktena bhūrjapatre likhennaraḥ ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | caturdalaṃ tataḥ kuryāt drekhatritaya śobhitaṃ ||
yakārodara madhye tu viśargāṃtaṃ pratiṣṭitaṃ | pūjākramaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ dhyānādeva vivarjitaṃ ||
khaṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tu tadyaṃtramucchiṣṭodana miśritaṃ | dīyate bhakṣaṇārthaṃ ca vāyase dhyo dine dine ||
deśaṃ saṃtyajya yātyeva grāmañcaiva tu kākathā | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaṃtramuccāṭanaṃ paraṃ ||
nimbapatrarasairlekhyaṃ lekhanyā kākapicchayā | bhūrjapatro parikṣiptaṃ vidhiḥ pūrvokta eva hi ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | caturdalaṃ tataḥ kuryāt vījayuktaṃ manoharaṃ ||
ravauha iti vījāni dalamadhye pṛthak pṛthak | saṃpūjya pūrvavat paścān nikhanyātha prapūjayet ||
adhomukhaṃ tu tadyaṃtraṃ pūrvokta vidhinā tataḥ | evaṃ kṛte saptamehni uccāṭayati nānyathā ||
bhrāmyadeśaṃ videśaṃ ca tṛṇavat parībhūyate |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi yaṃtramuccāṭanaṃstriyaḥ |
<80b>
gardabhasya tu raktena lekhanyākākapicchayā ||
phalake ca likhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | tataścāṣṭadalaṃ kāryaṃ vījayuktaṃ manoharaṃ ||
khakāraṃ tu viśargāntaṃ hrīṁkāraṃ tadanantaraṃ | evaṃ yaṃtraṃ susaṃlekhya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
nikhanya bhūmau saṃpūrya pūrvavaccāpyadhomukhaṃ | uccāṭayati sthānāt tu calate vāyu parṇavat ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi trailokyoccāṭanaṃ paraṃ | kṛṣṇakukkuṭa raktena bhūrjapatre likhennaraḥ ||
sādhyanāmalikhitvā tu trikoṇaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | punastrikoṇaṃ saṃlikhya dvitīyantu varānane ||
tatopari vibhāge ca hrīṃkārāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ | etadvibhāgaṃ saṃlikhya vījānāṃ ravisaṃkhyayā ||
tato vartulaṃ saṃlekhya pūjayet pūrvavat punaḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā tu tadyaṃtraṃ vadhnīyācca suto gale ||
yathā saṃkhyāśca varjita tathā loke kṣaṇāta hi | uccāṭayenna saṃdehastatkṣaṇāt surasandarī ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaṃtra uccāṭanaṃ paraṃ | niśācara rasairlekhyaṃ bhūrjapatre na saṃśayaḥ ||
sādhyanāmalikhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | tasyāścāṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā vījayuktaṃ manoharaṃ ||
tataśca lekhyaṃ phaṭ iti pratyekaṃ dalamadhyataḥ | tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak vartulaṃ lekhayaikayā ||
saṃpūjya vidhivat paścād yaṃtraṃ saṃcūrṇayet tataḥ | khāne pāne pradātavyamuccāṭo jāyate dhruvaṃ ||
yaḥ pūrvaṃ jānakādeśā daraṇyaṃ samapadyataḥ | nistīrya prāptavān śītāṃtaṃ rāmaṃ praṇatosmyahaṃ ||
adhikāramahaṃ vakṣye sarvopadravanāśanaṃ | saptamyāṃ pīṭhikāyāṃ tu śānti puṣṭikaraṃ sukhaṃ ||
śāntirakṣākaraṃ nāmā khyātaṃ sarvatra durlabhaṃ | na deyaṃ yasya kasyāpi yadicchet siddhimātmanaḥ ||
śṛṇu devī paraṃ guhyaṃ yaṃtraṃ rakṣākaraṃ paraṃ |
<81a>
vālastrī puruṣāṇāṃ ca mahārakṣākaraṃ smṛtaṃ ||
kāṃśya pātretha yaṃ lekhyaṃ sutithau śobhane dine | rocanā kuṃkume naiva karpūreṇa viśeṣataḥ ||
mṛganābhi samāyuktairjāti kāṣṭhairlikhennaraḥ | ūrdhvaṃ aṣṭau rekhāsti yatra sthitāścatācasi ||
evaṃ bhavaṃti cet koṣṭhā ekona paktyā tu saṃjñakāḥ | akārādi svarālekhyā upalikhya tathaiva ca ||
vyaṃjanāḥ kramato lekhyā te naiva kramataḥ kramāt | evaṃ saṃlikhya vījāni triśūlāni likhet tataḥ ||
pratirekho pare nūnaṃ caturdikṣu kramāllikhet | kroṃkārāḥ ṣaṭdyaṃ lekhyāḥ pūrve caiva tu paścime ||
evaṃ saṃlikhya tadyaṃtraṃ pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ | puṇḍarīkairśitāṃ bhojaiḥ śatapatrairmanoramaiḥ ||
mālatī yūthikābhiśca ketakairmallikaistathā | vakulaiśca yathā lābhaṃ phalakeyai phalodbhavaiḥ ||
nirgandhaṃ raktavarṇe tu puṣpaṃ yatnena varjayet | sa karpūraiśca tāṃvulairdhūpairgandhaiḥ śitotparaiḥ ||
evaṃ dina trayaṃ pūjya naivedyairvividhaiḥ priye | japet saptaśati nityaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tu dinatrayaṃ ||
saṃbhojya pāyase naiva yatheṣṭhena ghṛtena tu | tridinaṃ bhūmisāyi syāt bhojanādgandhalepanāt ||
uddhṛtya guṭikāṃ kṛtvā trilohairveṣṭayet tataḥ | taccheṣaṃ caiva pāṇiyaṃ pāṇiṃścaiva varānane ||
vālasya jāyate kṣobho vidyayā vai niyojitaḥ | guṭikāṃ dhārayed devī vāhumūle galethavā ||
dhāraṇāt tasya yaṃtrasya upasargaḥ praṇasyati | alakṣmīḥ kalahaścaiva daurbhāgyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
yatpareṇa kṛtaṃ kiṃcit tatsarvaṃ vipraṇaśyati | śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ nāma devānāmapi durlabhaṃ ||
prathamaṃ yaṃtrarājākhyaṃ sarvapratyayakārakaṃ |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ cauranivāraṇaṃ | sarpavyāghrabhayaṃ nāsti yaṃtre karatale sthite ||
<81b>
lekhanavidhiḥ pūrvokto dravyaṃ pūrvoktameva hi | sarvatra śāṃtike devī vidhiranyāna vidyate ||
pūjanaṃ caiva pūrvoktaṃ nijamasyāpi tādṛśaḥ | bhūrjapatre tu saṃlekhya dvitīyaṃ yaṃtramuttamaṃ ||
hrīṁkāraṃ garbhamadhye tu sādhyanāma pratiṣṭhitaṃ | tasyā devi tu saṃyojyamakāraṃ tadanantaraṃ ||
lakāraṃ ca yakāraṃ ca yakāraṃ ca pratiṣṭhitaṃ | ūkāraṃ svarasaṃyuktaṃ śānti vīja manoharaṃ ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭaye samyak catukoṇaṃ dvirekhayā | triloha veṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā vāhumūle galetha vā ||
sarpavyāghrabhayaṃ hanti caurabhayaṃ haraṃ tathā | vividhoya dravaṃ haṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāt ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ daurbhāgya nāśanaṃ | nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa narānāṃ caiva sarvadā ||
lekhane vidhiḥ pūrvokto dravyaṃ pūrvoktameva ca | lekhanī pūrvamuddiṣṭā bhūrjapatre likhennaraḥ ||
sādhyanāmalikhitvā tu trikoṇaṃ tu dvirekhayā | tasyopari catuṣkoṇaṃ rekhādhi traya śobhitaṃ ||
koṇe koṇe triśūlantu pūrvokta vidhinā tataḥ | trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā vāhu mūle galetha vā ||
dhārayed vidhi pūrvantu nārī vā puruṣotha vā | vividhopadravaṃ haṃti tasyāgarbhaṃ ca dhārayet ||
saubhāgyamatulaṃ poṣyaṃ devavatmodate sadā ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi jvaravināśanaṃ paraṃ | bhūtajaṃ tu jvaraṃ hanti vidyate vaidikoditaṃ ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pūrvavannikhanet tataḥ | śmaśāne tu divaiva syānnirāhārena mānavaḥ ||
catuṣkoṇo parilekhet koṇabhavamaṣṭadalaṃ yathā | madhye nāmalikhitvāt narakārasya tu saṃpuṭaṃ ||
dalamadhyeṃtarāle tu rakāraṃ saṃpratiṣṭhitaṃ | evaṃ viṃśanti(?) rephāḥ syuḥ sarvataṃtra krameṇa tu ||
saṃpūjya bhūme saṃpūjā valipuṣpairmanoharaiḥ | tatkṣaṇādyāti tadbhūta jvararūpaṃ ca dāruṇaṃ ||
<82a>
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vālānāṃ śāntikārakaṃ | yaṃtraṃ rakṣākaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvopadravanāśanaṃ ||
pūrvokta vidhinā lekhyaṃ dravyairpūrvoditaiḥ kramāt | bhūrjapatro paridevī pūrvoktavidhinārcanaṃ ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | tataścāṣṭadalaṃ kāryaṃ vījayuktaṃ manoharaṃ ||
sakārānta visagāṃtāḥ(?) dale pratyekasau nyaset | saṃpūjyavidhivat paścād vāhu mūle galetha vā ||
dhārayed yaṃtraṃ jatunā lohatritaya veṣṭitaṃ | śākinyo cātha ḍākinyo vālagrahāstathā pare ||
gachanti vālakaṃ muktvā yaṃtra rājasya dhāraṇāt | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tṛtīyaṃ jvaranāśanaṃ ||
pūrvokta vidhinā lekhyaṃ bhūrjapatre suśobhane | sādhyanāma likitvā tu yakārasya tu saṃpuṭaṃ ||
trikoṇaṃ veṣṭayitvā tu nyased vījānī coparī | evaṃ saṃlikhya saṃpūjya vadhnīyādṛkṣi kare ||
jvaravālesu kāryeṣu valyārthe dadhi bhaktikaṃ | vālovāpyathavā vṛddho jvarān mucyeta tatkṣaṇāt ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vālajvaravināśanaṃ | pūjayitvā vidhānena sarvajvaranivāraṇaṃ ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu vartulaṃ veṣṭayet tataḥ | ūrdhvaṃ yonya gataḥ pṛṣṭhe vakārasya tu saṃpuṭe ||
tataścāṣṭadalaṃ kāryaṃ vījaṃ yuktaṃ tu sarvataḥ | pratyekaṃ dalamadhye tu nakāraṃ vindubhūṣitaṃ ||
dalākare tu hrīṁkārāṃ (**********)(?) vinyaset | evaṃ saṃlikhya saṃpūjya sīta toye vinikṣipet ||
mucyate tridinād yogni jvarād dvadvānnasaṃśayaḥ | uṣṇodakena saṃkṣipta saṃkṣiptaṃ jvaraṃ naśyati ||
hastamūle tu tadvaddhaṃ jvaraḥ velāsamudbhavaṃ | nāśayen nātra saṃdeho bhūtayaṃtraṃ surasundarī ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vālānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sadā | yaṃtraṃ jvaraṇarakṣākhyaṃ āyurvṛddhikaraṃ paraṃ ||
<82b>
pūrvoktaḥ vidhinā lekhyaṃ dravyaiḥ pūrvoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ | bhūrjapatre tu saṃlekhya sādhyanāma tu madhyataḥ ||
tatastaṃ veṣṭayet samyak catuṣkoṇaṃ tu lekhayā | tasyopari catuṣkoṇaṃ triśūlau koṇato likhet ||
koṇāntare likhed vījaṃ vakāraṃ bindubhūṣitaṃ | uparyaḥ tarale tu hrīṁkāraṃ vilikhedbudhaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃlekhya tadyaṃtraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā vadhnīyāt kaṃṭhamadhyataḥ ||
tayopasargā ye kecid yogāḥ śarīramānasāḥ | īrṣyā kopastathā rekhā dantanā saṃbhavet punaḥ ||
na vādhate vālakasya stanyadoṣaṃ kadācana | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhūtā pasmāra nāśanaṃ ||
śākinī bhūtavetālairgṛhīto vāpi vāruṇaiḥ | tadāta mocanārthāya kuryādyaṃtraṃ manoharaṃ ||
svasthasya tu prakurvīt śatrudoṣairna gṛhyate | dravyaiḥ pūrvoditairlekhyaṃ pūrvokta vidhinā tataḥ ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu bhūrjapatre varānane | vartulaṃ veṣṭayet saṃlekhyaṃ tasyopari valāṣṭakaṃ ||
hrīṁkāraṃ garbhamadhye tu pratyekaṃ vilikhet punaḥ | evaṃ saṃlikhya saṃpūjya lohatritaya veṣṭitaṃ ||
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ trilohaṃ paricakṣate | vālānāṃgalake dhāryaṃ yaṃtraṃ tripurabhairavaṃ ||
mucyate vālako rogairapasmārādvarānane | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sarpāsaṃrakṣaṇaṃ paraṃ ||
sarpādibhiryathā vālaḥ prauḍho vāpi viśeṣataḥ | na daśyaṃte yathā devī pramādādaghriyati te ||(?)
pūrvoktavidhinā lekhya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | madhye nāma likhitvā tu vartulaṃ tu dvirekhayā ||
saṃveṣṭya ca dalānyaṣṭau haṃsavīja yutāḥ pṛthak | trilohairveṣṭayitvā tu vāhumūle tu dhārayet ||
naśyaṃti darśanāt tasya daṃdaśūkāścaturdiśaḥ | pramādāt patitāḥ pāde tiṣṭhaṃti staṃbhitā iva ||
atha daṃṣṭaḥ pramādena viṣaṃnaivādhirohateḥ |
<83a>
sarpānāṃ staṃbhanārthāya yaṃtraṃ garuḍabhāṣitaṃ ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ḍākinī trāśanaṃ paraṃ | bhūtapretapiśācādyai ḍākinī brahmarākṣasaiḥ ||
yadā śatrurnaraḥ kopi nārī vā vīrakopi vā | tadā yaṃtraṃ prakurvīta nāśārthaṃ bhūtarākṣasāṃ ||
khaṭikayā likhitvā tu karpaṭe tu stāne(?) śubhe | tīryagrekhā caturastu adhastāt paṃktirekhayā ||
evaṃ bhavāṃ kāṃti koṣṭhā dvādaśaiva varānane | hrīṁkāraṃ pratikoṣṭhe tu vilikhya tu prapūjayet ||
valipuṣpopahāraiśca tato dhūlyāḥ prapūrayet | saṃsthāpyāgrai cārūpāṇi jvalayet khadirā nale ||
rudantaṃ ca mahābhūtaṃ copamānaṃ palāyate | tatkṣaṇādvālakaṃ muktvā deśatyāgena gacchati ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi jvaravināśanaṃ paraṃ | tāmbūlapatre saṃlekhyaṃ caṃculasyeta kaṃṭhakaiḥ ||
sādhyanāmalikhitvā tu kroṃkāra puṭitaṃ śubhaṃ | ṣatkoṇasya tu madhye tu koṇeṣu praṇavanyasyet ||
koṇopari tu hrīṁkāraṃ sarvato vilikhet kramāt | tāmvulaṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ ca pūjayitvā pradīyate ||
yaṃtrasya bhakṣaṇāddevī jvaro yānti na śaṃsayaḥ | ekāntaraḥ kṣaṇādeva nātrakāryāvicāraṇā ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi garbharakṣākaraṃ paraṃ | gajamaddena saṃlekhyaṃ bhūrjapatre suśobhane ||
gajasya tu madābhāvāt kaṃṭhoṣṭhaṃ sarvataḥ kṣipet | madhye nāma likhitvā tu catuṣkoṇaṃ dvirekhayā ||
saṃveṣṭyakarṇikāḥ kāryā vartulāttu caturdiśaṃ | yakāraṃ ca rakāraṃ ca visargāntaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
karṇikā madhyato lekhyaṃ pūrvavat pūjayet kramāt | lohaikena tu saṃveṣṭya garbhinyāḥ kaṇṭhato nyaset ||
sukhātyu sūtirbhavati chalachidraṃ ca naśyati |
<83b>
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi antarvatnī surakṣaṇaṃ | yaṃtraṃ yoni yathā yāti cāraṇaṃ bhūtanāśanaṃ ||
pūrvokta vidhinā lekhyaṃ dravyaiḥ pūrvoditaiḥ kramāt | bhūrjapatre vidhānaṃ ca madhyadeśe vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
praṇavaṃ ca yathā hrīṁ ca ādyaṃtaṃ nāmato likhet | vartulaṃ ca catuṣkoṇaṃ dīrghaṃ saṃveṣṭya lekhayā ||
uparyadhopi tridalātkoṇekaika pratiṣṭhitaṃ | hrīṁ kṣaṃ ca tathā hrīṁ ca koṇe dala gataṃ likhet ||
evaṃ saṃlikhitaṃ yaṃtraṃ sarvakāryena saṃśaya | yoniśūlaṃ śīraḥ śūlaṃ bhūtadoṣaṃ pranaśyati ||
sukhaṃ prasūtirbhavati vyathā varjena saṃśayaḥ | rahasyeyaṃ samākhyātaṃ yaṃtrarājaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tṛtīyaṃ jvaranāśanaṃ | dravyaiḥ pūrvoditairlekhyaṃ bhūrjapatre varānane ||
madhye nāmalikhitvā tu trikoṇaṃ veṣṭayet punaḥ | catuṣkoṇaṃ śikharākāraṃ tasyoparilikhedbudhaiḥ ||
yakāraiḥ sa viśargāntairviṣamairveṣṭayet tataḥ | saṃpūjya tasya velāyāṃ vadhnīyāddakṣiṇe kare ||
jvaro yāti na saṃdeho bhūtajastu tṛtīyakaḥ | rogayonaivasamāyātyeva vanaṃ yojyaṃta caikadā ||
iti te kathitaṃ devī yaṃtrasādhanamuttamaṃ | samāsena mahādevī indrajālamataḥ śṛṇu ||
[iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre atharvasaṃhitāyāṃ yaṃtrasādhano nāma paṭalaḥ] ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi senāstambhanamuttamaṃ | bherīmṛdaṃgapaṭahastaṃbhaṃ nānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ ||
śilāyāṃnvitamekhyātaṃ tapanāyat svayaṃbhuvā | anurādhā tripuṣyārdrānnatitrayajayāsu(?) ca ||
ravivindu(?) śukracandrādervāsare śukrapakṣake | dhanatrikona kendrasthāḥ śubhāḥ pāpābhavatrigāḥ ||
bherīmṛdaṅgapaṭaha tāḍiteṣu ca karmayet |
<84a>
susuddhe nāyase lagne karmakārī vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
yatkuryāt sadṛḍhaṃ vṛttaṃ nirmalaṃ jayavardhanaṃ | gavāgnirāmaniśithe muktakeśi ca lagnataḥ ||
pārodivī diśaṃ gatvā carmakāri purādvahiḥ | samyak carmāvavaddha kuryāt sūrya svarodaye ||
taṃ maṃdadhvani nādena paraṃ śatru palāyanaṃ | raktadhattūramūlaṃ vā kaṃdaṃ vālāgalo bhavaṃ ||
kadalīkaṃdasaṃyukta citi bhasma ca peśayet | savītamarkaṭī padmaṃ madalagnāmamadhyagā ||
kuryāddīrgha praṇādaṃ tu śrutvā senāpalāyate | lāṃgalī gṛhagodhā ca vātāli yātanaṃ śivaṃ ||
cūrṇayet sarṣapaiḥ sārdhaṃ svagātraṃ tena lepayet | taṃ dṛṣṭvā dharaṇīśa araṇyamānaṃ parasparaṃ ||
iti para senāstambhanaṃ ||
atha khaḍgastambhanaṃ ||
ketakī mastake netre tāluyūle mukhe kṣipet | khaḍgena caraṇe hṛcche khaḍgastaṃbha prajāyate ||
etāni triṇimūlāni cūrṇitāni ghṛtaiḥ pibet | ahorātrau tataḥ śastrairyāvajjīvaṃ na vādhyate ||
śirīṣamūlaṃ puṣpārkaṃ grāhayet peṣayejjalaiḥ | arddhāhāroddhṛtaṃ paścājjalaṃ cārdhake pibet ||
yāvaddhitāni tatpātaṃ tāvadvastrairna vādhate | tanmūlaṃ ca gale vaddhvā khaḍgairmeṣairna vādhate ||
puṃkhīpuṣpoddhṛtaṃ sūtraṃ varadāyodare kṣipet | ṭaṃvarāṭaṃ karaṃ yasya phalaṃ madhye vinikṣipet ||
tatphalaṃ mukhamadhyasthaṃ śastrastaṃbhanakaṃ paraṃ | graste ravau samuddhṛtya śarapuṃkhī samanvitaṃ ||
vaktreyo dhārayenmaunī na sa khaḍgena bhidyate | samūlapatraṃ śākhāntu viṣṇukrāṃtāṃ prapūrṇayet ||
tailapakvaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tenāṃgāni vimardayet | khaḍgādi sarvaśastrāṇāṃ bhavedyuddhe nivāraṇaṃ ||
vajramātrakakaṃ tāpyaṃ kāṃtabhasmasamanvitaṃ | madyaṃjaṃ vīrajairdrāvaiḥ saptakhaḍge tataḥ punaḥ ||
<84b>
brahmavṛkṣasya vījāni karmamātrānirājikāṃ | vadhyā vayaṃ ca viṃvāṃ ca piṣṭvātaṃ maṃgalaṃ kuru ||
pūrvaṃ yanmarditagolaṃ laghumattapuṭaiḥ pacet | taddhauraṃ dhārayedvaktre śastrastaṃbhakaraṃ paraṃ ||
sarveṣāmuktayogānāṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ smareddhṛdi | āyudhaṃ saṃmukhaṃ śastraṃ samurddha ca nivārayet ||
oṃ ahokuṃbhakarṇa mahārākṣasakaikasi garbhasaṃbhūta parasainya bhaṃjanaparasainya bhaṃjana mahāsacān rudrośāpayati svāhā ||
sarvayogānā anena maṃtreṇa aṣṭottara sahasre japte siddhiḥ | atra sarvoṣadhayaḥ uttarābhimukhaḥ samutpāṭayet(?) ||
iti khaḍga staṃbhanaṃ ||
athāgni staṃbhanaṃ ||
kumāryā kolavṛkṣasya raso meṣavasānvitaḥ | liptamātronaṃ(?) rasyene(?) vahni madhyena dahyate ||
nalukāpāṭalī mūlaṃ rauvālakusumaṃ samaṃ | mandūkavasayā piṣṭvā liptagātro na dahyati ||
śvetaguṃjārasai naiva sarvāṃgalepano na vai | aṃgārarāśi madhye tu bhramamāso na dahyati ||
athāgni staṃbhaguṃṭikā ||
vāmapādaṃ vāmahastaṃ kṛkalāsasya pūrvavat | saṃgṛhya siddhakai veṣṭaṃ vahnistaṃbho mukhe sthitaṃ ||
pādalepanāgni saṃcaraṇaṃ
udghāṃtapannanirmālyamaipyaṃ(?) paribhadrakaṃ | maṇḍakaṃ vasayā sārddhaṃ pṛṣṭvāmṛdvagnināpacet ||
tena pādapralepana bhramedaṃgāraparvate | bhṛṃgarāja kalikaṃrdamaṃḍūka vasayā pacet ||
mṛddhagninā tato lepāt pādayoḥ pādake caret ||
gālūvartitamasṛsājaśaikasāhi(?) liptaye | sparśena kṛti jāyante tuṣārakaraśītalā ||
athānna pākastaṃbhanaṃ
dagdhvādau tulasī kāṣṭhaṃ śālyālyā vātha secayet | kharamūle tadaṃgāraṃ jvala cūlyāṃ niveśayet ||
kāṣṭhabhāraśate nāpi annapāko na jāyate |
athāṃgārabhakṣaṇaṃ |
pippalīṃ mariṣṭvaṃ śuṇṭhī pitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
<85a>
diptāṃgāraṃ narobhuṅkte na vaktre dahyate kvacit |
atha gṛhadāhastaṃbhanaṃ ||
saptadhā himavan maṃtraṃ japtvā toyena tāḍitaḥ | vahniḥ śāmyati raudropi dahyamāne gṛhe sati ||
oṃ himālayasyottare pārśve mārico nāma rākṣasaḥ | tasya mantra purīṣābhyāṃ hutāsanaṃ staṃbhayāni svāhā ||
atha saptadīvya staṃbhīni |
śirīṣamūlamādāya ravivāre tu pūrvagaṃ | udakenaṃ samaṃghṛṣṭvā lalāṭe tilake kṛte ||
taptadīvyajayo bhavet |
kumārī sūtraṇaṃ piṣṭvā lipta hastakaro bhavet | diptāṃgāraistaptalohairmantra yukto na dahyati ||
aṣāḍhe navamaṃḍūkavasayālepayet karau | dhārayet tapta lohaṃ tu vahnistaṃbhanamuttamaṃ ||
taptaghṛtastaṃbhanaṃ |
kāminī kuṣumosīśrīkharajalaṭṭihibhadduḥkhasamāsya bhaktaṃ | karamūle spṛśati kvāthitaṃ ghṛtatailaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ spṛśanna dahyate ||
tadanu viṣadivyastaṃbhanaṃ |
saṃjātamātrago vatsa viṣṭā grāhyātaro tataḥ |
bhakṣayitvā viṣaṃ khāde dviṣadivya jayo bhavet | putraṃ jīvaphalāmajjā niṣkamātre tu bhakṣite ||
prātasūptaviṣaṃ khāde dviṣadivya jayo bhavet |
atha tanduladivyastaṃbhanaṃ ||
maricaṃgadhircetvāṃ carvitvā gilite sati | ravi tandulaje divya kṛta doṣopi śuddhyati ||
syādvārāhi śikhi mūlaṃ kṣīreṇa saha pesitaṃ | staṃbhayet taṃdulaṃ divyamavarohayavyadyadi ||
athāśanistaṃbhanaṃ ||
ravivāre mṛtā yāsauḥ kīlāstasyāḥ pravadhyate | caturdikṣu catuḥkīlān gṛhītvā cihnayet svayaṃ ||
rakṣayet nāt(?) prayatnena rudramaṃtreṇa maṃtritān | caturṇāṃ dāpayeddhaste ye dhāvanti ca vegataḥ ||
aśaniḥ śalabhāmedyāyāṃti varyopalāḥ svayaṃ | yāvad gachaṃti te dūraṃ tāvad vādhāna vidyate ||
<85b>
gatyante saṃsthite tatra vyāmamātraṃ japet manuṃ | kīlakānnikhanet tatra pratyāga sasvamaṃdiraṃ ||
kīlakān prātarādvāya rakṣayet svagṛhaṃ sadā | vajrapātena tatrāsti tadgrāme nagarepi vā ||
vaddhaṃ yathā tathā yāvat tāvat kāryaṃ puraśceteḥ |
asya prayogasya maṃtraḥ ||
oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya uḍḍāmare svarāya sarvaduṣṭānme niṣūdayā śaniṃ nāśaya bhaṃjaya svāhā | ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ atha jalastaṃbhanaṃ |
rājiraśiraḥ sthitvā tatmaniṃ ca samāharet | tadvaktre nikṣipeddhīmān jalastaṃbhanamuttamaṃ ||
trilohaveṣṭitaṃ hṛstaṃ kṛṃkalāśasya dakṣiṇaṃ | sa maṃtraṃ dhārayed vaktre svecchayā saṃcarejjale ||
samudrepi na saṃdeho narasto yena vādhyate |
asya prayogasya maṃtraḥ ||
oṃ agnaye udara svāhā |
kṛkalāśasya pittena rocanenāṃ japedvṛśau| jālāṃtara sthitaṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyate maṇi śuktikaṃ ||
atha buddhistabhanaṃ ||
bhṛṃgarājāyamārgai ca siddhārthā saha devikā | tulyaṃ tulyaṃ vacā śvaitā dravameṣāṃ samāharet ||
lohapātre vinikṣipya dvidināṃte samuddharet | tilake sarvaśatrūṇāṃ buddhistaṃbhakaraṃ bhavet ||
triniṣkaṃ mṛtanāgaṃ tu muṃḍaṃ vā kāṃtameva ca | pibedārdrastu payasā vacaḥ staṃbhakaraṃ nṛṇāṃ ||
pūrvatrayeṇa yogena jīvedmacaṃdratārakaṃ | samyak kāṃsya maye pātre dhātṛ cūrṇaṃ śitāṃvunā ||
rātrau palaikaṃ saṃlehya prātaruthāya bhakṣayet | vali palita nirmukto vatsarān mṛtyujīd bhavet ||
brahmavṛkṣasya paṃcāṃgaṃ chāyāśuṣkaṃ sucūrṇitaṃ | madhvājyābhyāṃ likhet karṣaṃ kanajalājalet ||
jīvedvarṣasahasraikaṃ divyakāyo mahāvalaḥ | brahmavṛkṣasya puṣpāṇi chāyāśuṣkāṇi kārayet ||
triśatpalaṃ tu taccūrṇaṃ caturviṃśat palaṃ ghṛtaṃ | ekīkṛtya kṣiped bhāṇḍe taṃ ruddhvāya rāśigaṃ ||
<86a>
kṛtvā māsān samuddhṛtya bhāgān kuryāccaturdaśa | bhāgaikaṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ bhuṃjiyāt tāmra bhājane ||
evaṃ māsatrayaṃ kuryād vajrakāyo bhaven naraḥ | tasya mūtrapurīṣeṇa tāmraṃ bhavati kāṃcanaṃ ||
brahmavṛkṣasya vījāni cūrṇitāni pṛtaiḥ sahaḥ | pūrvavaddhānya madhye tu kṣiptvā māsaṃ samuddharet ||
palaikaṃ tu sadā khāde dūnmarān mṛtyujid bhavet | valipalitanirmukto jīvedbrahma dina trayaṃ ||
śveta pālāśa paṃcāṃgaṃ cūrṇitaṃ madhunā sahaḥ | varṣaikaṃ bhakṣayen nityaṃ māsāmṛtyujarāpahā ||
brahmāyurjāyate siddho varṣaikaṃ bhakṣayet sadā | śarīraṃ bhasmanāmargha ṣaṭmāsā mṛtyujid bhavet ||
jīvedbrahmayugaṃ yāvad divyakāyo bhaven naraḥ |
atha vīryastaṃbhanaṃ ||
kavālaṃgamasi kṛtvā padmasūtreṇa veṣṭayet | dhārayet kaṭi deśe tu vīryastaṃbhana kṛdbhavet ||
ekaliṅgaṃ samādāya chāyā śuṣkaṃ tu kārayet | apakva madhunāsārdhaṃ mardayitvā pradāpayet ||
ātmaliṃgaṃ tato marghaṃ ratikarma samācaret | atimātraṃ bhavatyāsu mūrchā bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||
kṛṣṇamārjāravālaṃ tu saṃgṛhītaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | dhārayet kaṭideśe tu vīryastaṃbhanamuttamaṃ ||
kanyākartitasūtreṇa vaddhaṃ kaṭitaṭe dṛḍhaṃ | śvetaguṃjā tato mūlaṃ vīryastaṃbhanamuttamaṃ ||
dehadaṃ kāla mūlaṃ tu haridrākuṃkumaṃ śaśi | locanaṃ sahadevī ca sarvaṃ tulyaṃ vicūrṇayet ||
viṣamuṣṭyattha tailena cūrṇaṃ māloḍya lepayet | liṃgaṃ tena ramedrāmāṃ cīraṃ vīryasthiraṃ bhavet ||
śvetārka tulikā karti divyasūkara me daśā | yāvajjalati dīpoyaṃ tāvadvīryasthiro bhavet ||
iṃdravāruṇikā mūlaṃ puṣpaṃ nagnaḥ samuddharet | bhūṣaṇaiśca gavāṃkṣīraiḥ piṣṭvā kuryād dṛṭaṃvaṭīḥ ||
chāyāśuṣkā sthitā vaktre vīryastaṃbhakarī nṛṇāṃ |
<86b>
raktāpāmārgamūlaṃ tu somavārenimaṃtrayet ||
bhaume prātaḥ samuddhṛtya kaṭyāṃ vadhvā ca vīryadhṛk | duṃdubho nāmasya suryaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇastamāharet ||
tasyāsthi dhāraṇāt kaghāṃ(?) naro vīryaṃ na muṃcati | tanmuktā mucyate vīryaṃ siddhayogī udāhṛtaḥ ||
saha devīya mūlaṃ tu tatsamaṃ padmakeśaraṃ | piṣṭvāmaṅ dhvājya saṃyuktaṃ lepānnābhau tu vīryadhṛk ||
śleṣmānta tasya kulasya vīryaṃ yujyā samāharet | ajākṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭvā bhuktvā ca sarvavīryadhṛk ||
sūraṇaṃ tulasī mūlaṃ tāmbūlaṃ saha bhakṣayet | na muṃcatī naro vīryaṃ karṣakena pṛthak pṛthak ||
preṣayedvālikāmūlaṃ umantā yasya sūtrataḥ | tena liṃga pralepena naro vīryaṃ na muṃcatī ||
karpūraṃ ṭaṃkanaṃ sūtraṃ munipuṣparasaṃ madhuḥ | mardayitvā nipātena liṃgaṃ yāmaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ||
jalaiḥ prakṣālayelliṅgaṃ bhavedrāmā yathocitaṃ | vīryaṃ cetpuṃsāyāmamātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
kṛṣṇadhattūramūlena pāradaṃ gharṣayed dinaṃ | trilohaṃ veṣṭitaṃ vadhvā kapāntaṃ vīryavad bhavet ||
paśupati jalaṃ piṣṭvā vānarī mūla lepitaṃ | kartitaṃ liṃga nayati karakīra tasyatāditi ||
saptāhaṃ chāgasalila bhāvitaṃ karavāruṇi | goḍhāvartanavidhinā karoti ratasādhanaṃ ||
siddhaṃ kuśuṃbha tailaṃ ca bhūmilatā varṇamiśritaṃ | caraṇābhyaṃgena ratīlau(?) karoti naraṃ varaṃ kharotsāhaṃ ||
nīlotpala sītapaṃkaja na kesaramadhuśarkarā valikena surate ciraṃ kriḍati dṛḍhaliṃgonābhivivaraṇe ||
atha vaśīkaraṇabhedāḥ ||
bhūtāla vaṭamūlaṃ tu jalena saha peṣayet | vibhūtyā saṃyuto maṃtrī tilako loka vaśya kṛt ||
atha rājavaśyam ||
devadāru paripelavakuṣṭaiścandanāguru |
<87a>
bhujaṃga keśarai ||
kuṃkumena madhunā ca nirmito dhūpa eva ca ||
kṛte nṛpa vaśyaḥ ||
kuṃkumaṃ candanaṃ caiva rocanā śaśimiśritaṃ | gavāṃkṣīreṇa tilakaṃ rājavaśya karaṃ paraṃ ||
cakramardasya mūlaṃ tu hasta ṛkṣe samuddharet | rājadvāre bhaved vaśyo haste vadhvā ca vādajit ||
pūrvaphālguṇi nakṣatre grāhaṃ dāḍima vījakaṃ | kare vaddhvā bhaved vaśyo yadi rājā puraṃdaraḥ ||
aśleṣāyāṃ gṛhītantu nāgakeśaracandanaṃ | vare vaddhe bhaved vaśyo yo rājā pṛthivīpati ||
atha strīvaśyakaraṇaṃ ||
triśatyamātmato(?) yena mardayitvā vilepayet | pūgīphalaṃ pradātavyaṃ vaśyamāmaraṇāntikaṃ ||
eṇakoṇaṃ svavīryeṇa marddayitvā pralepayet | saṃmohanaṃ bhavet kṣipraṃ yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
kapiliṃgaṃ samādāya mardayedātmatejasā | cūrṇena sahadātavyaṃ kāminījanamohanaṃ ||
śaraṭaṃ mithunibhūtaṃ hatvā tacchalyamāharet | ātma toyena dātavyaṃ kāminījanamohanaṃ ||
ātma toyena saṃdhṛṣya dadyāt paṃca palaiḥ saha | cūrṇena saha dātavyaṃ vaśyamāmaraṇāṃtikaṃ ||
kapi pittamātma vījaṃ mṛganābhyāthamardayet | guṭikāṃkārayet tena daṃdyāduttama yoṣitam ||
vaśī bhavati sā sādhyā śarīrena dhanena ca | prāṇeśvaraṃ vihāyāsau na jīvatī na saṃśayaḥ ||
caṭakāsthira cūrṇena dadyāt mohana kṛd bhavet | tatmāṃsamātmavījena mardayitvā pradāpayet ||
ṣaṇmāsakaṃ bhaved vaśyaṃ kāmadaṃ harṣakārakam | pūrvoktamātmano yena gharṣayet pakṣa varjitaṃ ||
yathā pūrvaṃ pradātavyaṃ mohanaṃ maraṇāntikaṃ | tatpakṣa cūrṇapānena tatpakṣo vikalo bhavet ||
kaṭu trayena tatmāṃsaṃ bhakṣayed goghṛtena tu | kāmasaṃdīpanaṃ tasya bhave deva na saṃśayaḥ ||
<87b>
tastimātmavījena mardayitvā pradāpayet | khāne vā yadi vā pāne mohanaṃ maraṇāntikam ||
atha ṭiṭṭībhaśalyena tatpittaṃ parimardayet | enaṃ rocana yā sārddhaṃ dadyāt paṃca palaiḥ sahaḥ ||
yoṣito vasamāyāṃti sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ | khaṃjarīṭasya paṃcāṃgamantardhūpena dhārayet ||
aṃjayannayane netraṃ lokaika vasamuttamaṃ | bhāradvājasya picchena svavījaṃ dhūrta vījakaṃ ||
mardayitvā pradātavyaṃ cūrṇena vaśakṛd bhavet | gharāvatasya(?) hṛccakṣuḥ svaraktaṃ locanaṃ tathā ||
jihvāmalasamāyuktaṃ aṃjane strī vasā bhavet | śaraṭasya vāmanetraṃ madhutailena cāṃjayet ||
yāṃ paśyati narorāmāṃ tatkṣaṇāt sāvaśā bhavet | tasyaiva dakṣiṇaṃ netraṃ sauvīramadhunā sahaḥ ||
aṃjitākṣasya sā vaśyā yā strīrūpābhi garvitā | svetārkaṃ navanītaṃ ca ajāraktena miśritaṃ ||
aṃjayet netra yugalaṃ rāmāvaśyakaraṃ paraṃ | manaḥśilāṃ priyaṃguṃ ca nāgakeśararocanaṃ ||
aṃjitākṣonarorāmāṃ dṛṣṭvā (***)(?) vati dhruvaṃ | triṃśatkanakavījāni ṣoḍaśendu yavāstathā ||
godantaṃ naradattaṃ ca piṣṭvā śukrena loḍhayet | lalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā vaśī kuryāt tilottamāṃ ||
kaṃṭakaṃ madhuyaṣṭīṃ ca rocanāṃviti bhasma ca | kākajihvāṃ samaṃ kṣaudraṃ tilake strī vaśā bhavet ||
puṣpe puṣpaṃ tu saṃgrāhyaṃ bharaṇyāṃ ca phalaṃ tathā | śākhāṃ caiva viśākhāyāṃ haste patraṃ tathaiva ca ||
mūle mūlaṃ tu saṃgṛhya kṛṣṇonmattasya ca kramāt | piṣṭvā karpūra saṃyuktaṃ kuṃkumaṃ rocanaṃ samaṃ ||
tilake strī vaśaṃ yāti yadi sākṣādaruṃdhati | indravāruṇīkā mūlaṃ puṣpe nagnaḥ samuddharet ||
kaṭu trayeṇa vā kṣīraiḥ piṣṭvā tadgālakī kṛtaṃ | candanena samāyuktaṃ tilakaṃ strīvaśaṃkaraṃ ||
<88a>
karaviṃkaśirastu tulyaṃ svetārkasya tu mūlakaṃ | maṃjiṣṭhā bhakṣapāne ca dante romāṃ vaśa nayet ||
raktamūtrapurīṣi ca śravaṇānnayanātmalāṃ | miśrikṛtya pradātavyaṃ bhakṣapāne vaśaṃkaraṃ ||
śilāṃtamālapatraṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ rocanāmapi | piṣṭvā natikṛte kṛtvā liptadehothavāṃjanaṃ ||
naranārī nṛpājñānāṃ nityaṃ premāspadaṃ bhavet | saṃghṛṣya kalikāminī pittage rocanāmapi ||
vāmahastakaniṣṭhānta tilakasya vaśā bhavet | viṣṇukrāntā śvetagiri karṇikā markaṭī jaṭā ||
sahamūlena devyāśca rocanā raṃjitāvunā | peṣayitvā kanyakāyātatmaye tilake kṛte ||
vaśī karoti nikhilaṃ jagannāstyatrasaṃśayaḥ | tamālapatrāṃ janapadma candana priyaṃgubhīrocanayā samāṃśakaiḥ ||
kṛtāṃjanenāṃjita locanaḥ pumān yamīkṣayentaṃ | kurute vaśaṃ janaṃ lākṣāpānaṃjitavāso vahuśaḥ śukla cā sṛjā ||
bhavitaṃ śoṣayitvāśca tena kurvīta vartikāṃ | saurājanaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca vicūrṇaṃ gatā ca vartulāṃ ||
varāhasteha bharite dīpapātrebhidheyatāṃ | prajvālya kajjalaṃ tasmād gṛhītvā tanayo naraḥ ||
aṃjitā kṣobhavet tasya sakarāḥ sarvaśāstrayaḥ | sa priyaṃgu vacā kuṣṭaṃ sūkṣmelā nāgakeśaraṃ ||
saśarjarasasiddhārtha dhūpaḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ | jaṭāmāṃsī bhṛṃgarājenakhakuṇḍarūśīkalaiḥ ||
lākṣā kṛṣṇāṃgurū spṛktā gandhapadmai samāsakaiḥ | dhūpaḥ sugandha nāmādau māraṇārāvasaṃnibhaṃ ||
vaśīkaroti trailokyāmiti pūrvamudāhṛtaṃ | karpūramadhūkallola śuklasaṃlikasādhanā ||
gāṃbhīramatī hṛdayaṃ tāsāṃ tiṣṭhati saṃtatam ||
iti strīvaśyaṃ |
atha pativaśyakaraṇaṃ |
mālati puṣpasaṃyuktaṃ kaṭutailaṃ supācitaṃ | etalliptabhagā rāmā ratau mohayate patiṃ ||
<88b>
khaṃjarīṭasya māṃsaṃ tu madhunā saha peṣayet | anena yoni lepena patirdāsau bhavet punaḥ ||
karpūraṃ devadāruṃ ca sa kṣaudraṃ pūrvavat phalaṃ | saiṃdhavena tilairbhāvyaṃ saptavāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||
tatpiṣṭā lepayed yoniṃ ratau dāsaḥ patirbhavet | paṃcāṃga dāḍimaṃ piṣṭvā śvetasarṣapa saṃyutaṃ ||
yoni lepe patiṃ dāsaṃ karot pati sudurbhagā | rocanaṃ matsya pittaṃ ca pṛṣṭhā tu tilakī kṛte ||
vāmahaste kaniṣṭhāyāṃ patirdāso na saṃśayaḥ | svayonau ratikāle tu rocanaṃ nikṣipet punaḥ ||
svapuṣpaṃ bhāvayet tena tilakaṃ pati vaśyakaṃ | sumetā(?) kaṃṭhakāryaśca mūlaṃ ca girikarṇikā ||
tāṃbūlena pradātavyaṃ dāsavat kurute patiṃ | samūlāṃ cūrṇayet dhātrīḥ vastre vaddhā nidhāpayet ||
svayonau ṛtukāle tu tridinānte samuddharet | navanītena nikṣiptaṃ taccūrṇaṃ pācayed ghṛtaṃ ||
tatghṛtaṃ bhojayedevaṃ patirdāso bhavat palaṃ |
atha gajavaśyakaraṃ ||
uttarāyāṃ samādāya prātarasvattha candakaṃ | pṛthagevaṃ kare vaddhvā gajavaśya karaṃ nṛṇāṃ ||
aṃkolaṃ tailasaṃmiśraṃ kuryāddudrānta cūrṇikaṃ | anena spṛṣṭamātreṇa mahāhasti vaśo bhavet ||
varāha karṇi saṃcūrṇaṃ akālītala bhāvitaṃ | te naiva spṛṣṭhamāteṇa mahāhasti vaśo bhavet ||
atha vājikaraṇaṃ ||
svarase bhāvitaṃ dhātri cūrṇaṃ sītājyapi madhumiśritaṃ | kṛtvā tu piyadugdhena tṛpyaṃt strīśatairapi ||
gokṣurakaṃ kṣuraṣṭaḥ śatamūlī vānarī nāgavalāti valā ca | cūrṇamidaṃ payasā niśīpeyaṃ yasya gṛhe pramadāśatamasti ||
yavakalamamāṣa cūrṇaistulyago madhūmamāgadhisahitaiḥ | pālikā ghṛta pakvaṃ tu bhuktvā kṣīraṃ saśarkaraṃ pītaṃ ||
<89a>
ghṛtamadhusahadevānvita sarojakalipta nāmekavāraramamānasyana tṛpyaṃti manaḥ ||
tenāpi ramatīṇāṃ vījaṃ kṣurakaṃkakaṃ |
cūrṇikṛtena sakalaṃ ||
nipīya payasā rātrau naraḥsyā vurjayoratau ||
pippalilavanopetācchāgade kṣirasarpisā | sādhitāṃ bhakṣayed yastu sa gacchet pramadā śataṃ ||
mocakasya phalaṃ tulyaṃ sarpiṣā madhunā mamaṃ | liṭṭāni pīyadugdhaṃ ca prāpnoti ratimuttamā ||
yadyaśca gandharividāri gokṣuraṃ vārāhīmāṣaṃ ca śatāvarī ca | guñjāphalaṃ cāmalakaṃ sālmalī niryāsamete tu saśarkarānvitā ||
niṣkatrayaṃditamukhamalālehyaṃ rātrau pibet kṣīrayutaṃ ca tadvarat | māsārddhamātreṇa sahasra yoṣitāṃ dine dine bhogasamṛddhidā bhavet ||
śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ samaṃ gandhaṃ vadīrī citra kaṭṭavaiḥ | mahyakāṃ caurajaindrā vai stri dinaṃ tacca golakaṃ ||
sadyokṣatājamāṃsasya piṇḍaḥ neṣṭhaṃ viśeṣayet | tatpiṇḍaṃ tilatailena lohapātre śanaiḥ pacet ||
yāvat māsaṃ raktavarṇaṃ tataḥ sūtaṃ samuddharet | tridinaṃ muśalī kvāthe bhāvitaṃ śītayā yutaṃ ||
niṣkaikaṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ rasoyaṃ madaneśvaraḥ | vidālī kandacūrṇaṃ tū kṣīrājyena palaṃlihan ||
ramestrīṇāṃ śataṃ nityaṃ ratyagā tatvamāpnuyāt | dhātrī phalasya taccūrṇaṃ bhāvayet tatphala dravaiḥ ||
ekaviṃśati vārācaiḥ śoṣyaṃ paśya punaḥ punaḥ | tatpādāṃ saṃtmṛtaṃ lohaṃ madhvājya śarkarāyutaṃ ||
palaikaṃ bhakṣayen nityaṃ niśīkṣīraṃ pivedanu | dhātrīlohaprabhāvena ramayet kāminī śataṃ ||
śuddha sūtaṃ samaṃgandhaṃ karaktotpaladaladravaiḥ | yāmārdhaṃ ca punargandhaṃ rasārdhaṃ tatra nikṣipet ||
pūrvadrāvairdinaṃmargha rasārdhaṃ gandhakaṃ punaḥ | datvā taddinaṃ saṃmarghakāca kuryānniveśayet ||
<89b>
dinaikaṃ vālukā yaṃtre suṣkamuddhṛtya cūrṇayet | bhūkuṣmāṇḍa kaṣāyeṇa bhāvayedvitasaptakaṃ ||
chāyāyāṃ tāsitātulyaṃ niṣkaikaṃ bhakṣayet sadā | valāmūla svavījaṃ ca muśalī śarkarāsamaṃ ||
gavāṃkṣīraiḥ parārddha caira(?) tu rātrau sadā pibet | anantaṃ vardhate vījaṃ rasoyaṃ madanodayaḥ ||
mṛtaṃ tu pārada svarṇaṃ tulyaṃ marghaṃ dina trayaṃ | muśalī triphalā kvāthairvājigandhakaṣāyakaiḥ ||
kadalī kaṃdajairdrāvaistadgolaṃ cādine puṭe | bhūdhare dinamātraṃ tu samuddhṛtyātha mardayet ||
dinaikaṃ pūrvavidrāvaistadvadhvāmapacet puṭe | punaḥ marghaḥ punaḥ pācyaṃ evamaṣṭapuṭaiḥ pacet ||
śalmalī gī(?)taniryāsairbhavaśarkarasāsaha | khādenniṣkasya nityaṃ dhārayedvyaya niścitaṃ ||
gokṣīraṃ markaṭī vījaṃ pālārddhe pācayedanu | sarvo godharttanaṃ kuryāt saṃpacaiḥ śālmalī rasaiḥ ||
rasakāma kalākhyeyaṃ mahāvīrya karī nṛṇāṃ | prāraṃbhe rajāsā strīṇāṃ mardayedbhasmasūtakaṃ ||
mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ ca tāraṃ ca gandhakaṃ ca samārdataḥ | śitāmadhvājyasaṃyuktaṃ niṣkaṃbhakṣyāya yaḥ pibet ||
ratikāma ratī nāma kāminīramaṇehitaḥ | śuddhasūtaṃ samaṃgaṃdha ahaṃkharjura tai dravaiḥ ||
marditaṃ cārditaṃ paścād yāmasaikata yaṃtrake | raktagastya dravairbhāvyaṃ dinaikaṃ tatsitā yutaṃ ||
niṣkamātraṃ sadākhādedrasomadanavardhanaḥ | ajasya vṛṣaṇaṃ kṣīraiḥ pakvatilasitāyutaṃ ||
yathecchaṃ bhakṣayedyotu ramayait kāminī śataṃ | paladvayaṃ śuddhasūtaṃ gandhakaṃ ca rataḥ śubhaṃ ||
karṣakaṃ māritaṃ svarṇaṃ palaikaṃ tu mṛtābhrakaṃ | raupyaṃ bhasmaja tu niṣkaṃ sarvaṃ paṃcāmṛtairdinaṃ ||
