mardyarūdhvādinaṃ pacyādbhūdhare ca samuddharet |
<90a>
piṣṭvā paṃcāmṛtaiḥ khādairguṭikāṃ vadarā kṛti ||
anaṃga sundarīkhyātā rāmānāramayecchataṃ | śālmalī mūlacūrṇaṃ tu madhvājya śarkarāyutaṃ ||
ekaikaṃ bhakṣayeccānu sītākṣīraṃ ca pācayet | śālmalyubhya dravairmadyaṃ palaikaṃ śuddhapādaraṃ ||
śuddhagandhaṃ trisaptāhaṃ mardayetta dravaiḥ pṛthak | samavetauḥ punarmadya ghṛtairyāma catuṣṭayaṃ ||
tadgolaṃ vandhayedvastre ghṛte yāmadvayaṃ pacet | tatastaṃ śālmalī drāvairmardayed divasa trayaṃ ||
nikṣipet kācakuryāt tat vālukā yaṃtrake pacet | kṣiptaṃ ca śālmalī drāvaiḥ kupigarbhe dināvadhi ||
sarvamevaṃ samuddhṛtyamiśrayet sītayāsamaṃ | niṣkamātraṃ sadākhoderasāyaṃ madanāyakaṃ ||
muśalīsaśitākṣīraupalaika pācayedanu | kāminī vāṃ sahasraikaṃ kṣobhayennimiṣāṃtare ||
śuddhasūtaṃtrayo bhāgāḥ bhāgaikaṃ tāmravarṇakaṃ | kṛtvā piṣṭāni rūdhvādharaṃ bhākaṃdāvale punaḥ ||
mṛttasaṃcopitaṃ paścād dinaikaṃ karī cāgninā | evaṃ saptadinaṃ paṃcyādekaṃ ekaṃ dinaṃ dinaṃ ||
uddhṛtyavandhayedvastrairdṛḍhe caturguṇe punaḥ | kṣudrasaṃcūkamāsānte chāgīraktagatāṃ pacet ||
olāyāṃ ca ahaṃ yathā evaṃ raktaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | guḍucyā kāka pippalyāṃ kadalyāḥ kokilākṣakaiḥ ||
gokṣīrodvānarīmūlaiti mūlasya tvacondravaiḥ | pāyasai tatkaṣāyairtado(?)lā yaṃtre dinaṃ trayaṃ ||
tataḥ kṣīre sitā yukte tadvadvalyādi nāvadhiḥ | uddhṛtya murālī kvāthairmadyayārme catuṣṭayaṃ ||
rasapūrṇe tu nāmoyaṃ khādenmāṣasitāyutaṃ | gokṣīrī vānarī vījāṃ guḍucīrgajapippalī ||
kokilākṣasya vījāni marjākārpāsa vījakaṃ |
<90b>
satāvarī caraṃ bhavā phalaṃ madhusamaṃ bhavet ||
sarvatulyāsitā yojyā madhunā lolitaṃ lihet | palārdhamanupānaṃ syāt tajaḥ peyaṃ gavāṃ payaḥ ||
kāminīnāṃ sahasrāṃte ramayestu mahāvalī | bhūrje kūrmaṃ samālikhya tārakena ṣaḍāṅgulaṃ ||
pṛṣṭhe tuṣṭānsamālikhya sādhakaṃ madhyato likhet | bhūrjapatre samālikhya kuṃkuṃmena triśūlikāṃ ||
na paśyaṃ sa yathāṃ dhvastu buddhorno phalati dviṣaḥ | mālāmaṃtrodhunā vācyo yathā sarvajña bhāṣitaḥ ||
yathā pūrvamayākarma yathādho trihināgaṇāḥ | nikṣipya sannito corddhaṃ tathā tadyaṃtritedhunā ||
kṛtvā tu bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ mālāmaṃtraṃ samālikhet | oṃ śatrumukhastaṃbhani kāmarūpa āḍili karī ||
hrīṁ hraṁ phaṭkāriṇī mamaśatrūnāṃ devadattādīnāṃ mukhaṃ staṃbhayavijṛṃbhaya mama sarvavidveṣiṇāṃ mukhastaṃbhanaṃ kuru <2> hrīṁ hreṃ phaṭkāriṇī svāhā |
idaṃ hi staṃbhane śreṣṭhaṃ sadya pratyaya kārakaṃ | bhairavī rauravāmaṃtrādā kṛṣya viduṣāmayā ||
iti mukhastaṃbhanaṃ ||
pāṭalīmūlamāgṛhya puṣpāṣṭamyāṃ yathāvaraḥ | abhimaṃtre mahāmaṃtre māyābhistaṃ triśūlakaiḥ ||
vāhuvandhaṃstataṃ kṛtvā khaḍgai vai staṃbhaye dhruvaṃ | vajraṃ kaṃkāriṇī māye variṇī āyekara khaḍgaṃ tu khaṃḍini bhaṃjanitāḍani khukhulī ye svāhā ||
iti khaḍgastaṃbhanaṃ ||
triśūlaṃ ca kuṭhāraṃ ca jarāṃ caiva tu sarvaraṃ | guṭikāṃ vatturāṃ caiva sarvāstān dhvaṃśaye manuḥ ||
oṃ hrīṁ huṃ jalamaṃkuṭhāramaṃ sarvalamaṃtulāṃ maṃguṭikāmaṃ evaṃ bhūrje samālikhyaṃ paṃca bījena saṃyutāḥ ||
pāṃcālyāḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā dagdhāṃvujāvunā pivet | advaita cittamālaṃvya nirviśaṃ kona saṃśayaḥ ||
japet sarvaṃ mahādivyaṃ divyājñāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ | oṃ jalajalasamayī dhātū dharaṇīga aṇanamayī ||
<91a>
iti paṃcāliya svāhā ||
evamutvā saptavārān lākṣāṃ likhitvākṣarāṃ dahet | staṃbhanoyaṃ samākṛṣṭaḥ satvataṃtrā tu bhairava ||
iti ṣaṭ divyastambhanaṃ ||
rājādistuṣyate yena na bhayaṃ ca nṛpāditaḥ | siṃhoragamahāvyāghra yakṣavāta bhayantathā ||
uktānuktaṃ ca yat sarvaṃ bhaya sadyo vinaśyati |
oṃ hrīṁ staṃbhanī sāvarī harasāranalikṣā huṁ phaṭ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ sitakākālikānetraṃ bhelasī ca tripatrikā |
mohannaguṇa puṣpā ca vicakṣu ṛṣa eva ca | ekīkṛtvā japeccakṣustadā cakṣurnivandhayet ||
indrajālaṃ mayākhyātaṃ dṛṣṭi stambhanamuttamaṃ | naiva paśyati paśyantaṃ paśyaṃte na tadyathā ||
yaṃ yaṃ darśayate bhāvaṃ taṃ taṃ loko hi paśyati | iti cakṣuḥ staṃbhanaṃ kiṃ jalkaṃ sita padmasya vījaṃ sākhoṭakasya ca ||
śāpuṃkhāśataṃ netre nābhilepā sthiro haraḥ | śukrasya staṃbhanaṃ hyetat senaketu samāhṛtaṃ ||
candraloke nirodhaṃ ca ye manasyaṃ ca vibhramā |
iti śukrastaṃbhanaṃ ||
śitikāmayamākṛṣya khuragopāthabhūlatā | varatī deha cūrṇaṃ tu tṛṇasya nalukā tathā ||
ekīkṛtya kṣiped yonau yonistaṃbhanamuttamaṃ | pittaṃ rohita mīnasya tathā caitatpalūtikāḥ ||
keśarājasamāyuktaṃ peyaṃ bhakṣaṃ kriyānvite | staṃbhayedviṣasaṃbhūtaṃ palitaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
iti valipalita staṃbhanaṃ ||
vanamūlakamaṃtrī ca tathā pānāṃgamastrakaṃ | eṣāṃ kṛttiṃ samādāya yathā lābhena buddhimān ||
pūjayet tu malaṃ mūtraṃ veṣṭayet kaṃpi taṃtutā | nihite mriyate bhūmau nirodho malamūtrayoḥ ||
eṣa yogavaro dṛṣṭo guhyakālikamaṃtrake |
<91b>
iti malamūtra staṃbhanaṃ |
paṭehanuṃ samālikhya garjayaṃtaṃ mahāvalaṃ | nāgaṃ vai saṃlikhed dakṣe kare uccāṭite tava ||
tatra maṃtra likhet ghoraṃ staṃbhanaṃ hara nirmitaṃ | saṃgrāme darśayed rājā dhvaje vijayamicchayā ||
staṃbhayet sarvasainyāni nātrakāryāvicāraṇā |
oṃ huṁ phaṭ mahābhairava rūpiṇī sarvaśainyāni staṃbhaya svāhā |
iti senāstaṃbhanaṃ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mohanaṃ yogamuttamaṃ | yena yojitamātreṇa mohayet sakalaṃ jagat ||
harapriyā sahadevī vījamekaika eva ca | madhvājo na samāyojya tilakaṃ mohanātmakaṃ ||
eṣa yogavaro divyaḥ śaktivījasamanvitaḥ |
iti naranārī staṃbhanaṃ |
oṃ namo bhagavatī bhagamālinī visphura <2> nityaklinne drava <2> hrīṁ kārākṣarekṣarakṣaktīṁ hsau svāhā ||
anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa abhimatryatriḥ peṣayet | tilakaṃ kārayedvidvān yadiśenmohitaṃ jagat ||
mohayaṃcāṃgakaṃ piṣṭvā liptaliṃga prayatnataḥ | tatastu śukrassutaṃ sāpita ṣaḍet parikīrtitaḥ ||
pratyakṣa niyato yogo bhagamālinī saṃjñakaḥ | raktamohāhite catrī svāsaścādhenu maṃtrayet ||
iti jagatmohanaṃ ||
śitobhānuḥ sitāguṃjā gṛhasya caṭakastathā | kuṣṭhaṃ syāṃgā sṛjāyuktaṃ tilakaṃ mohanātmakaṃ ||
puṣpena yojayennityaṃ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaṃ |
iti naranārī mohanaṃ ||
uktāmohātmakā yogā dṛṣṭoyaṃ svayameva tu | tilake bhakṣaṇe vāpi lepane vāpi yojayet ||
nārī ṛtumatī vālā taruṇī prauḍhīkā tathā | sīmante cātha sragdhupairgaṃdhaistāṃvūla cailakaiḥ ||
vījane sthāpayet tatra kṛtvā tu snāna karma ca | japet puṣpa vihṛdyāṃ sa āhatasya golakaiḥ ||
mohayaṃ cāṃgasaṃyuktā vaṭīṃ pranvitāṃ caret |
<92a>
aṣṭottara śataṃ kṛtvā paṭṭasūtreṇa graṃthayet ||
mohanīṃ ca tapentena nibhṛto rātrau nirākulaḥ | ayutena bhavet siddhiḥ kampate vasudhātaṃlaṃ ||
yakṣagandharvakinnarya athonyā api yoṣitaḥ | garuḍāpsarasonāga hāṭakerśvara kanyakāḥ ||
mugdhāstatra samāyāṃti muktakeśāśca vihvalāḥ | nagnā ghaṭitasūnāḥ dhṛṣṭāḥ kiṃ punarnarayoṣitaḥ ||
gurusthānena kurvītaṃ mātrā yatrāvatiṣṭhati | balātsaṃgrāhayennityaṃ mugdhā vā mṛyate vasā ||
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena pratyakṣaṃ suparirakṣitaṃ | lakṣaikena tu japtena kāmadeva samo bhavet ||
gajendra dravamadhupai nārībhirveṣṭito bhramet |
iti mahāmohanarājavasyam ||
meṣaśṛṃgī ajāśṛgīkākamācītriśūlīkā | dehajaiḥ paṃcabhiryuktaṃ tilakaṃ mohanātmakaṃ ||
kathyate ca mahāyogaḥ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaḥ | saṃmohanaṃ bhayivide kuḍera mohe mohaniye svāhā ||
evamabhimaṃtritaṃ kṛtvā saptavārān vicakṣaṇaḥ | dadāti pūgasaṃyogaṃ vaṭapatrakasaṃyutaṃ ||
mohito niyate yatra tatra gacchati nānyathā | vikreśaṃ vamatiṃ dadyāt kropi hi na kupyati ||
iti mahāmohinī ||
svaśiracchiyate(?) mugdhe naiva jānāti vihvalaṃ | eva dhūliṃ prayogā tu sarvarīmahanirgataḥ ||
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena yadi checcirajīvinaṃ | gopitaṃ sarvataṃtreṣu tatra vai kuhakārṇave ||
yogasya satyatāṃ dṛṣṭvā utsukena mayādhunā | nāgarāṇāṃ hitārthāya spaṣṭametadudāhṛtaṃ ||
mugdhasya harsapālasya svīkṛtārājyasaṃpadaḥ | dinai dvādaśī muktā svavāṃchā casaṃkakarṣavaiḥ ||
suyoṣita svayaṃ yogā mayā cātra na gopitā | latā harita varṇābhā atisūkṣmā payonvitā ||
vaṭapatra samaṃ patraṃ syādrakta sannibhaṃ |
<92b>
tasya laṃghanamātreṇa diṅmohotha prajāyate | bhakṣaṇena mahāmūrchāṃ śaṃkare yadi dīyate ||
vaṭapatrī parijñānaṃ vahubhiḥ parikīrtitaṃ |
iti mohanaṃ |
oṃ sāvarīmāye puṣpamūlasānīye tu brahma pasāyeyaṃ nāmimāṃ mohamiti hu aninayasayatva sa cādi hi kiṇi svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa vāhya diśo nivāsita ciṃcinī vṛkṣatalanī śabdena mayaṃ gṛhyacauyaṃ saptābhirmaṃtrayet | tayā dhūlyāyo hanyet | samohito bhavati | athavā yasmin gṛhe nikṣipe tatra sarve lokāḥ suptā niśceṣṭāḥ saṃmohitā bhavaṃti | yadīṣṭaṃ tat kriyate svecchayā | iti mahāmūrchā ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vaśīkaraṇamuttamaṃ | yena vijñāna mātreṇa trailokyaṃ kriyate vaśaṃ ||
jāti mātaṃgīkā caiva tathā moha latātmikā | brahmakarparasaṃbhūtā vaśyagolaka nirmitā ||
bhītāmadhuratā vāpi madhugolakamiśritā | cāṇḍālī rasasaṃpūrṇā vaśīkaraṇamuttamaṃ ||
nāgābhelakābhītācādha puṣpī ca kroṭikā | haradaitya samāyuktā vaṭī nityaṃ vaśaṃkarī ||
jāti caiva tu cāṇḍālī rudaṃti kṛtāṃjaliḥ | kākamācī samāyuktā vaśya golakayojitā ||
dehajaḥ paṃcabhiryuktaṃ gorocana samanvitaṃ | haradaitya samāyuktaṃ pūṃgaṃ dadyād vaśaṃkaraṃ ||
iti kāle ca pāretonāryāvāsāṅghriṣu kṣipet | sa bhaved vallabhastasyā yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
mohani traya yaṃtrākhyā hastinīṃ caiva mohayet | drāvaṇaṃ ca sadā kuryāt madhukarpūraṭaṃkaṇaiḥ ||
bhūrjati jyeṣṭhakāyuktāṃ varāṃgaṃ mardayet sadā | yasya yasya hi yo bhāvā tena tasya samācaret ||
hantakacchoditvayogāḥ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakāḥ | bhallāṭakasya vījāni tathā vai gaja pippalīḥ ||
aśvagandhā samāyuktaḥ sargasarpiḥ samanvitaḥ | etairvimardayelliṅgaṃ pakṣaikaṃ liṅgada(?)dvaye ||
hastinī vaśyatāṃ yāti kiṃ punarvaḍavā mṛgī | kathitā ḍāmare tantre tathā vai guhyakālike ||
sadyaḥ siddhikarā yogā prapaṃca sahitāḥ śubhāḥ | kṛṣṇakākāli cakṣurbhyāṃ golakena samanvitā ||
aṃjalīvada saṃyuktāmarkamaṃtīni pūrayet |
<93a>
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ valiṃ datvā vidhānataḥ ||
na lākṣamadhūnā yuktaṃ nirvāṇe tu samāhitaḥ | cakṣustenāṃ jayeddhīmān yadicche bhuvanaṃ vaśaṃ ||
yaṃ yaṃ paśyati bhāvena yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate punaḥ | taṃ taṃ saṃsādhayet kṣipraṃ suparīkṣā yathā kṛtaṃ ||
valimaṃtra samāveṣṭaṃ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ kariṇī namaḥ | śaulipakṣasamāyuktaṃ aligolakamiśritaṃ ||
sarvadikṣu valiṃ datvā sādhayet kaṃjjalaṃ sādhanam | pheṃ huṃ phaṃ phaṭ huṃ phaṭ phaṭkāriṇī hrīṃ jvala trailokyaṃ mohaya mohaya svāhā ||
anena mantreṇa svāṃgalepaṃ golakena mukhābhyaṃjanaṃ tilakaṃ ca kṛtvā rājagṛhaṃ viśet | vādivarga kuryād yūte kāryanyāyasaṃgrāmādi kṛte jayaṃ kuryāt ||
asya prabhāvena | iti guhyakālyāḥ prayogaḥ ||
coditā vahavo yogā maṃtrataṃtra mahāvalāḥ | kintu siddhānate sarve durbodhapaṭṭasaṃvṛtāḥ ||
tasyādyogamahaṃ vakṣye sapta taṃtu vivarjitaṃ | kharparasyamate dṛṣṭaṃ yadṛṣṭaṃ sāmalāmataḥ ||
prāvṛti śūlinī gaṃḍīraktākhyā ca pracoditā | kṛtāṃjalī ca vāgeśī etāṃ dhūlī kṛtāṃvarā ||
kurvaṃti satataṃ mohamekatvena niyojitāḥ | oṃ hrīṃ huṃ phaṭ phreṃ guṃjarīt bhramarīkaike yo puṣkasī lalajjihvī vetāli rākṣasī madavāhinī he avatara raha <2> kaha <2> prasphura <2> sphu <2> khetaliha kici <2> phreṃ pravasī ālī huṁ phaṭ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ | iti kṛtvā valiṃ datvā mālālaṃvita śira ānīyasthālyāṃ prakṣipya jvālayitvā nirbhṛtanidhāyayet tatra sthāne paṃcopacāravidhinā pūjayet | uktamaṃtreṇāṣṭottaraśatamabhimaṃtrya śṛṃgālāsthī kīlakaṃ nidhāpayet | tato valiṃ sarvadikṣu dadyāt |
trisaṃdhyāṃ nityaṃ samāhitaḥ kāryaṃ saptāhaṃ sādhayet | eṣamaṃtravaraḥ proktastatraivakharpare mate ||
<93b>
etasyaiva prabhāvena kharpareṇa ca dhīmatā | martye vai sādhitaṃ sarvaṃ vaśyaṃ kṛtvā naraṃ nṛpaṃ ||
na paśyanti narāḥ kepi sarvasva haraṇe kṛte | deyā deyaṃ na jānāti dadāti sakalaṃ dhanaṃ ||
svakāntāmarpayetmugdhaḥ svadehamapi cārpayet | vihvalā jāyate nārī kuṃjarī śivamohitāṃ ||
prayāti niyate yatra krayavikraya dāyinī | atrasakāṃ na kurvīta mayābhikṣṇaṃ parikṣitaṃ ||
brahmayā malataṃtre tu purāproktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā |
oṃ hrīṃ staṃbhāmāraṇaṃ proccāṭaya hana hana raha raha hrīṃ sāravijanaje caurāśimārastaṃbhanaṃ nayati astra staṃbhanaṃ anaṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā |
etatsarvaṃ staṃbhayati śailasamūhadaṃ śudṛṣṭaṃ tadarpyase gṛhītvā | vṛṃhanā ūphalasya ca araphalavijanaḥ naracarmavilepena jale bhavati nirbhayaṃ ||
iti jalanirbhayaṃ ||
kākamācī ajāśṛṃgī triśūlī meṣaśṛṃgīke | dehajau paṃcake raktaṃ kuryāt tamohanātmakaṃ ||
tatasto māṃsamādāya ubhayorvākyasaṃyutaṃ | homaṃ tu kārayet sthālyāṃ bhūtigrāhyā vicakṣaṇe ||
uttarīya samaṃ kuryāt pucchayormahiṣaśvayo | devadattasya nāmnā ca siddhiṃ caiva vadhārayet ||
oṃ vidveṣaṇī kolamukhī ghoravadane kuru <2> vidveṣa <2> troṭaya <2> toḍabhaya svāhā | maṃtreṇānena cakṣuṣīkākālayakāṣṭānihunet ||
oṃ hrīṃ svāṃ hāṃ oṃ tathā ayamaṃtro yathā | oṃ hrīṃ hai haṃ te hraṃ hantu mohanī svāhā | rasakoṣā saha dadāti vā | iti maṃtreṇa tilakaṃ kuryāt mohini bhavati na saṃdeha |
puṣpayogena kṣiptvā mukhe jale nirudhasvo sadhāraṇaṃ kapālaṃ cūrṇitaṃ | kṛtvā śrīvidyā sadyo bhavati nānyathā | hastau pādau krameṇa pūgena saha dātavyaṃ mohanaṃ caiva kārakaṃ |
vyāghra tailaṃ vakṣiptkā jagatmohanaṃ caiva kārayet | viṣṇukrāntā phalaṃ caiva puṣpanakṣatre utpādyayaṃ ghṛtena sahitaṃ ||
<94a>
kajjalaṃ sanmādayutenākallena sarvajana priyo bhavati | keśarīṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ dhvajayāṃ cāpya parājitāṃ ||
pūṣamūlasamaṃ kṛtvā aṃjayet sarvajana priyo bhavati | bhṛṃgarāja gorocana tilakaṃ kṛtvā mayūraśikhāṃ mūla utpādyate śirasidhārayet |
duṣṭo hi vaso bhavati saha devi bhramaṃ norjāta masimūlāstāsvaṣakaṃ samabhāgakṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vaśyaṃ bhavati mastake | śveta dūrvākṛṣṇavidyāṃ mūlaṃ ca raktasya ca anāmikā raktaṃ citrānakṣatrayā samaṃ ||
paranārī bhavet tasya bhakṣite yadi dīyate | viṣṇukrāntā bhaven mūlaṃ pitvā pitvā bhavennaraḥ ||
sūtidūṣyā bhavennārī vaśyā bhavaṃti nānyathā |
cāmuṇḍe <2> janaprajana svāhā ||
anena maṃtreṇa saptavāraṃ maṃtrī japed vahudhā vāmā vaśyā bhavati dunducchiṣṭa cāṇḍālīnī mātaṅgīnī sarvavaśīkaraṇāya svāhā ||
iti maṃtreṇa saptavārātmaṃtritaṃ bhukto cchiṣṭadānāt |
yasya dīyate sarva vaśyo bhavati | oṃ viśveśvarī kāmeśvarī amukīṃ vaśamānaya svāhā ||
anena maṃtreṇa saptavārān maṃtrī jñena(?) yasyā dīyate sāvaśyā bhavati ākulā ca | oṃ hrīṃ namo bhagavatī cāmuṇḍāyaini śmaśāna vāsinī amukī mānaya svāhā | iti maṃtraṃ sakhāyāṃ ekaviṃśati vāraṃ japitvā saṃkhyāyāṃ na vaśyā bhavati | kṛṣṇasvānaṃ poṣavātri(?) pathe pātayitvā dakṣiṇa pādasyāsthi khaṃ guru ḍaṃ ekāṃgula pramāṇaṃ ravivāra ānayitvā saṃkhyā pārśve sthāpayitvā saptāṃgulasyā datvā āmaṃtreṇa | oṃ phreṃ phreṃ svāhā amukaṃ amukī oṃ aphreṃ phreṃ sahe madala iti ākarṣaḥ vaśyaṃ | dhattūraphalāṃtare pūgaphalaṃ sthāpayitvāḥ catuṣpathe devabhakṣyāṃ aṃdho na varjayet ||
<94b>
tasapari maṃgalavārādārabhya mūtrayet | pratyahani aparamaṃgalavāreṇa cūrṇa | sahitaṃ dāpayet | strīpuṃso āyata bhavati | mayūraśikhā mūlaṃ piṣṭātāmvulena saha khāditaṃ devaṃ cūrṇaṃ saha vaśyo bhavati | manuṣaṃ choditaṃ vīyate yadi syānnityaṃ muṣṭhikau hastābhyāṃ dhārayitvā punaḥ saṃgṛhyatattilaṃ khāditaṃ deyaṃ chuṃchuṃdarī śubhadine na cānyathā yudhī deyaṃ tadā siddhirbhavati | tasya viṣṭhāṃ ca saṃgṛhya kajjalaṃ pātayet kapāle tilakaṃ kuryād vīparīte tāmeti yudhitena vaśyante skandaṃ śirasi varjitaṃ | āścaryaṃ kurute japtvā iti kavandhadaḥ ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vidveṣakaraṇaṃ paraṃ | saṃpratyayakaraṃ yogaṃ nānātaṃtre vinirgataṃ ||
kākakākāripakṣaṃ ca romacāṣaviḍālayoḥ | dvijātyajaśiraḥ keśaṃ roma vā putailāṣṭaviṣasaṃyutaṃ ||
ekīkṛtya bhaved yogī siddhānta hṛdaye sthitaṃ | nivenā pūritaṃ kṛtvā vadanaṃ vā dveṣa saṃyutaṃ ||
ubhayorapi samādāya nāmavākyasamanvitaṃ | sahasraikaṃ huned yogī muktakeśo digamvaraḥ ||
homāṃte saṃgrahed bhasma viṣayuktaṃ tu kārayet ||
hrīṁ tuṃḍe viṃḍe daṃṭe huṁ ṭhaṃ tridveṣiṇī aiṃ devadattasya yajñadantena ca ubhayorapi vā vicheṣaṇaṃ kuru <2> svāhā | eṣamantraḥ samākhyāto mahoḍḍiśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
niyataṃ ca vahiḥ kuryād ghoraṃ vidveṣaṇaṃ paraṃ | niṃvakākālayaṃtītvā kicilladrana saṃtyajet ||
rājikālavaṇaṃ cājyaṃ viṣaṃ siddhārthakaṃ tathā | ekīkṛtya kṣipet pātraṃ trāhikā cāru sādhite ||
tataḥ somaṃ samādāya ubhayorvākyasaṃyutaṃ | homaṃ tu kārayet sthālyāṃ bhūtirgrāhyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
uttarīya samaṃ kuryāt pucchayormahiṣāśvayoḥ | devadattasya nāmnā ca siddhiścaivāvadhārayet ||
<95a>
oṃ vidveṣiṇī koṣamukhī ghoravadane kuru <2> vidveṣaya <2> troṭaya <2> toḍaya svāhā |
maṃtreṇānena cakṣuṣikākālayakāṣṭāni hunet | vidveṣa homaśeṣasya bhasma caiva tu saṃgrahet ||
āsane śayane gātre vastre vāsa gṛhe tathā | kṣipedveṣa samākāṃkṣī ityevaṃ kālikā mate ||
nirvisakaḥ sadākuryāt saṃdeho na ca vidyate | mātrā putrayostu vairaṃ syāt kimanyasya tu vismayaḥ ||
mukhasyāṃ sṛjamā gṛhya mārjālasya tathaiva ca | viṣabhagasamāyuktaṃ vimbapatre samālikhet ||
ubhayorapi nāmāpi sahamaṃtra samanvitaṃ | paścāt saṃmohayet maṃtrī viṣasarpiryutaṃ punaḥ ||
svasthāne ca kurvīta kuryānnityaṃ śmaśānake | nibhṛte vāpta deśe tu janasaṃkula varjite ||
ubhanaṃ bhava ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ |
anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa juhuyāda yutena ca | muktakeśaśca digvāsā niṃvalepita vigrahaḥ ||
paripūrṇakapolastu nimvapatraiḥ sadārakaiḥ | mukhe vai tatsamāsaṣṭa tadā homaṃ samācaret ||
paścime codayed bhānuryadimerūḥ prakampate | vahniḥ śītalatāṃ yāti sāgaro yadi suṣyati ||
tathāpyayaṃ na vai yogo mithyātva mupagacchati | harṣabhairava maṃtrasya vidveṣaḥ kathyate dhunā ||
kathyate vāpi saṃpatyā sadā vistara sādhanaṃ | yasya yogānu vandhena vidveṣaḥ kriyate kṣaṇāt ||
asthisaṃhāramāgṛhyamatsodarī tathā punaḥ | āṣuviḍālayornetramekī kṛtya tu peṣayet ||
śayyāyāmāsane vastre vigrahe cānulepite | veṣadveṣo bhaved deyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇāt ||
kuṭajasya tu mūlāni śigru netra yutāni ca | sapharī cakṣuṣā yuktaṃ lepanaṃ vairakāraṇaṃ ||
durbhagasya rajo gṛhyaṃ renuṃ mahiṣagardabhāt | mṛtakasya tathā puṣpaṃ nārī rajaḥ samanvitaṃ ||
<95b>
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi uccāṭana vidhikramaṃ | mṛtakasya ca puṣpaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ cailameva ca ||
pretālayāt samāgṛhya yasya gṛhe nidhāpayet | aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ tatrasyoccāṭanaṃ yataṃ ||
uddhṛtya jāyate śāntiḥ satyametadudāhṛtam | rajvāvadhvāhninātasya mṛtakasya śmaśānake ||
rajjunitvākṣipedaṅge gṛhe tasya palāyatam | ubhrānta patramādāya vāyu vījaṃ tatolikhet ||
dveṣṭhaṃ nāmalikheddharme māṣī viṣarasena tu | uccāṭanakaroyogassatyastatra udāhṛtaḥ ||
kṣipecchatru gṛhe dvāri dehalī mastake budhaḥ | uccāṭāṃgapaṭaṃ govānāvākṣiṇaṃ ca mastakaṃ ||
etāni vandhayet pāde vāhau vā vidhṛtaṃ tathā | śatrunāmāṅkitaṃ kṛtvā ākāśe prakṣipedbudhaḥ ||
uccāṭana karasadyodyoga saṃvartakoddhṛtaḥ | kiṃ na vai mastake pāde athavā khaṃjarīṭake ||
nivandhayed bhūrjapatre saṃpanna dveṣa keśavaṃ | tata palāyana kuryāt maṃtreṇānena vā punaḥ ||
oṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaḥ devadatta uccāṭayaḥ | nimbapatra bhallapatraṃ puṃnāgasaṃbhavaḥ punaḥ ||
ekīkṛtya gṛhe kṣipte sadya uccāṭakārakaḥ | gopure ca tathā śṛṃge hayasthāpiṣure tathā ||
kṛṣṇo ragaśiraḥ kṣiptaṃ gṛhe śatroḥ punaḥ kṣipet | satyaṃ uccāṭayatyeṣaḥ sa kuṭuṃvaṃ na śaṃsayaḥ ||
homayogaṃ pravakṣyāmi mahoccāṭanakārakaṃ | ye noccāṭanamātreṇa dūradeśāntare vrajet ||
rājikālavaṇaṃ nītvā vījakaraṃjakasya ca | udbhrānta kākapakṣe ca ekīkṛtya prayatnataḥ ||
hunedvyāsanake maṃtrī tasya bhasma tu saṃgrahet | bhasmamuṣṭiṃ gṛhe kṣiptvā śīghramuccāṭanadvidhaḥ ||
oṃ phaṭ dhavalamukhī svāhā | patraṃ niṃvasya saṃgṛhya ayutaikena saṃyutaṃ |
<96a>
tasya saṃlepanaṃ kuryādvayakoṣṭa sarirajaiḥ | śatrornāma tato nītvā sa kule tanu bheditaṃ ||
tadbhasma tu samāgṛhya kṣiped vidveṣi maṃdire | tasya coccāṭayedvāhyanaṃ kuryātridinena na saṃśayaḥ ||
oṃ huṁkūṭayaḥ vāma vāhu ucche vichalacilliṇikarahakaccorarajemokija iti ha ane moha devarasaṃ tatage deśāntarasarge śaśyed bhurate uccāṭaye svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa villinipakṣa sārdhaṃ śatadvayaṃ hunet agni nibhṛtena etena śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavati |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vidveṣanāma saṃnibhaṃ | yena bhakṣitamātreṇa tatkṣaṇātmaraṇaṃ vrajet ||
daṃṣṭrā sā raktakatakhacchedāt pramadāpayet | atha bhallātakī yuktaṃ dāpayet madhusarpiṣā ||
tatkṣaṇāt mriyate aṃge śikhāgre viṣasaṃnibhaṃ | nilamakṣikamāgṛhya pucchaṃ śṛṃgālakaṃ tathā ||
ekīkṛtya yagedattaṃ viṣamārayate dhruvaṃ | gomāyu gṛdhrayorguṃjā kṣiptvā vaktre vidhārayet ||
paścāduddhṛtyatāṃ guṃjāṃ bhakṣaṇe tu pradāpayet | jāyaṃte sphoṭakā ghorā viṣamāviṣasaṃnibhāḥ ||
hanīguṃjāphalā caiva taila siddhārtha saṃbhavaṃ | khāne pāne pradātavyaṃ śatrormāraṇamuttamaṃ ||
palāsīmūlamādāya kaṭu tailena saṃyutaṃ | deva priyasya vījena ekīkṛtya pradāpayet ||
mṛyate nātra saṃdeho yadi śakraḥ svayaṃ bhavet | karavīrasiphāsadya siddhārtha tailasaṃyutā ||
mohavījayutāṃ yogaḥ sadyomaraṇakāraṇaṃ | sphaṭikī vīja tailena bhakṣayet kanako bhavaṃ ||
bhakṣaṇe dīyate yasya mṛyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | dugdhena dīyate yasya jihvā hālāhalasya ca ||
puṭakālaṃ viśeṣeṇa sayātiyamamandiraṃ | vajrīkṣīra yutaṃ kṛtvā sūtikā piṣitaṃ pacet ||
<96b>
tatkṣaṇāt mṛyate śatrurvahudhā jalpitena kiṃ | pūtyaṃ u(?) kaṭu tailena miśrikṛtya pradāpayet ||
sayo bhakṣaṇamātreṇa na śevai mṛyate dhruvaṃ | māṇikyaṃ māṃsaṃ saṃgṛhya kaṭutailena saṃharet ||
bhasmabhakṣaṇamātreṇa mṛyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | kṛṣṇā hi dantamūlena hemavījāni bhāvayet ||
khāne pāne pradātavyaṃ śatrumāraṇamuttamaṃ | raktacitrakamūlaṃ tu śaṃkhaṭaṃkana cūrṇakaṃ ||
ekīkṛtya pradātavyaṃ tasya vīkīra saṃyutaṃ | bhakṣaṇāt mṛyate sadyaḥ puruṣaḥ kāla coditaṃ ||
śavalāhiṃ samāyadāpayet bhakṣaṇe sudhīḥ | tatkṣaṇāt mṛyate śatruḥ pratikāro na vidyate ||
vitasti kāmabhakṣaṇe dadyān madhunā saha miśritaṃ | sadyo mṛtyumavāpnoti bhakṣako nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
taṃtunā bhakṣayed yastu mayūrajaṭharopitaṃ | sadya eva naro yāti anivāryāyamālayaṃ ||
madhuṣarpi samāyuktaṃ yo bhakṣeredekakālataḥ | sadyastu mṛyate sākṣāt asādhyastridaśairapi ||
viṣakoṭika tailaṃ tu lavaṇena samanvitaṃ | alpāyurbhakṣayedyastu mṛyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
sarpasya vadanaṃ nitvā vyāghrakuṇḍasupeṣitaṃ | khāne pāne pradātavyaṃ mṛyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
vyādhasyaṣṭā vanaṃ gṛhya chuchuṃdaryāḥ śakṛntathā | karavīra samāyuktaṃ sadyo vai māraṇaṃ dhruvaṃ ||
ete yogāḥ samākhyātā nānā maṃtra samudbhavāḥ | sadyaḥ siddhikarāḥ sarve gopanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ||
[iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre athavarṇasaṃhitāyāṃ nānāmaṃtraprayoga indrajālapaṭalaḥ] ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahārogaharaṃparaṃ | sadyoroga prasamanaṃ triṣu lokesu viśrutaṃ ||
ādau kuṣṭhaharaṃ samyak kathayāmi samāsataḥ |
<97a>
saraṭaḥ ṣaṭpadaścaiva tathā karpaṭavṛścikaḥ | cūrṇi kṛtya kiṣipet taila paścādaṃgaṃ tu mardayet ||
aṃga sra(?)kṣaṇamātreṇa kuṣṭhaṃ saṃ naśyate dhruvaṃ | śirasaḥ kṛmīmāgṛhyaḥ tāṃbūlena tu pūrayet ||
mukharogo bhavet tasya hāhārāve prakīrtitaḥ | saṃkoca kaṃṭakaṃ gṛhya yasya madhye nidhāpayet ||
tasya saṃjāyate śūlamati ghoraṃ sudāruṇaṃ | vanamūṣikaśca mlaviṇī hi haṃsī rūpitaṃ tathā ||
ajitenya parilekhyaṃ svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikaṃ | aparājite nyadhobhāge svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikaṃ ||
evaṃ saṃlekhya yaṃtraṃ tu gaccheccaiva śarittaṭe | ubhayoḥ kūlayo grāhyā mṛttikā mauninā śubhā ||
tayā gaṇapatiṃ hutvā yaṃtraṃ tasyopari kṣipet | godugdhatarpaṇaṃ kuryād gaṇanāthasya sundarī ||
arcayedvahubhiḥ puṣpairmodakairvahubhistutaṃ | saṃpūjya vālakānbhakṣairgaṇeśaḥ priyatāmiti ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ gaṇarājasucī smite | sarāva saṃpuṭe kṣiptvā saṃpuṭo parivinyaset ||
aghoreti aghorati vinyaset saṃpuṭopari | bhūmisthaṃ saṃpuṭaṃ kṛtvā nikhanyā'tha prapūjayet ||
daurbhāgya maṇḍalaṃ prāpya nārī sadityaharnisuṃ | puruṣo na sahetāṃ ca surūpāmapi suvratāṃ ||
puṃliṃga yojitaṃ yaṃtraṃ nānā tu sahate tu tam | daṃpatyordveṣaṇe devī rahasyaṃ paramaṃ sadā ||
nānyatra saṃprayoktavyaṃ yaṃtrametat mama priyaṃ | na deyaṃ yasya kasyāpi viparītaṃ hi prajāyate ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi siddhimaṃtramanuttamaṃ |
oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya yamarūpine kālasaṃkṣepāyaḥ ete saṃhara <2> śatruṃ <2> nāśaya <2> amukaṃ hana <2> paca <2> ghātaya <2> huṁ phaṭ svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa ghocaṃtā(?) yatkiṃcidvarṇamabhimaṃtrya śatravedayātmāraṇaṃ bhavati | oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya
<97b>
sarvabhūta hitāya ca sarakṣabhagavān sarvabhagavān devītmutāṃta śīghraṃ kuru <2> mocaya <2> sarvarudrebhyo namostute svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa pūrvavadukta pratyānayanayogānteṣu prayuji tataḥ svastho bhavivati | oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya śivarūpine śikhāṃ vandhaya sarvāsāṃ sarveṣāṃ śivamastu vaḥ nara <2> rakṣa <2> sarvabhūtabhayaṃ kuru <2> muru <2> sarvabhayebhyaḥ svāhā | atha vidyā yogā prayoktī tanauśī svāṃvadhnīyādrakṣa bhavati | oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya vyāghracarma vāsaḥ saṃniṣasmāya muktāṭṭahāsāya mana <2> satyaṃ kṛt saṃnidhiṃ kuru <2> sasa <2> dhara <2> svāhā | idaṃ maṃtraṃ savotsādana yogeṣu prayogaṃ kārayennaraḥ | evametena yogena śāntirbhavati nānyathā | oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya karālarūpiṇe pracaṇḍāyoccāṭaya amukasya mūlaṃ vandha <2> mara <2> daha <2> paca <2> śighraṃ muccāṭayā hi huṁ phaṭ svāhā |
anena maṃtreṇa aṣṭottarāvadhi śatena maṃtritaṃ kṛtvā sarvamuccāṭayati kākolūkasya pakṣaṃ tu homena tatkṣaṇā muccāṭayati | oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya gara <2> dara <2> bhaṃja <2> kuru <2> moṭaya <2> nagaramaṇḍala patirājñā pacati svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa dūṣitāyo hi malaṣṭa satābhimaṃtritaṃ kṛtvā prakṣiped goroyacchamudakastaṃ bhavati | viṣonirviṣo bhavati | ataḥ paramaṃ janāni bhavati |
jaṃvūkasya ca varāhasya netranāśā tathaiva ca |
eteṣāṃ ca samāhṛtya matrāṇi rudhiraṃ tathā | ādyodyajanamevāsi samaṃ saṃgṛhya samuddharet ||
anenāṃjita netrastu adṛśo bhavati kṣaṇāt | ulūkasya ca gṛddhasya tathā mārjāra varāhayoḥ ||
eteṣāṃ netramādāya śrotāṃjanasamanvitaṃ | sūkṣmacūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvamaṃtraṇe yoge cakṣuṣī ||
paśyate dirghamāraghonaṃ rātrau paśyed yathā divā | śṛṃgārasyātha vā gṛddhasya mahiṣasya viḍālayoḥ ||
kākaśūkaraṃ yoścaiva netrāṇi tu samāharet | srotāṃjanasamāyuktamaṃjayeccakṣuṣīvaraḥ ||
<98a>
anenāṃjita netrastu rātrau paśyed yathā divā |
eteṣāṃ yogānāṃ maṃtraḥ |
oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya śivāya jyotiṣānan daso diśa bhavatu svāhā |
ekarāṣito bhūtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ | kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāvidhiṃ ekaliṃgamāsthite ||
dyotamāna ca tasyaiva vā pādena dālapidvigāhayet |(?) śmaśāne nirdaheccaiva kharamūteṇa nidhāpayet ||
tamevāgāraṃ saṃgṛhya alaktaṃka saṃpuṭa | kāyo nāma ca likhet yasya satvareṇa gṛhyena vā ||
oṃ kāka kṛṣṇājinaṃ amukasya jvaraṃ nāśaya svāhā | jaṃvūkavṛkṣamāruhya ayutaṃ japet tat siddho bhavati || oṃ cāmuṇḍe kha <2> khāhi <2> amukaṃ gṛhe na gṛhāpaya svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa mānuṣasya kapālaṃ gṛhya cūrṇī kṛtya cāmuṇḍāyai dhūpaṃ dīyate |
yasya nāmnā saṃgṛhya gṛhyate gugguladhūpena mokṣaḥ | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pādapracāraṇamuttamaṃ ||
sitāyākākajaṃghāyā mūlaṃ saṃgṛhya buddhimān | tasya rasaṃ tu saṃgṛhya tila tailena pācayet ||
auṣṭacarma upānākhyaṃ kṛtvā tamabhimaṃtrayet | te naivābhyajā tailena yadhyo pāde vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
sarvasibhujavo bhūtvā gavāṃ sthāne nivartayet | siddholūkavasā caiva auṣṭacarma upānahet ||
paṃcayojanaṃ gatvā tu punarasāṃtāni vartate | bhavate nātra saṃdeho uḍḍīsasya vaco yathā ||
oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya nānā vadacalena cala <2> svāhā |
caturbhuktodhito bhūtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ | devamabhyarcamīśānaṃ valiṃ dadyād vidhānataḥ ||
vāyavyadiśamaśrito tailāni abhimaṃtrayet | tatastu jāyate siddhi uḍḍisasya vaco yathā ||
aṣṭau sahasrameteṣāṃ pūrvameva vidhiyate |
<98b>
sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ sādhanaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ ||
oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya jñāpaya velāpathacāriṇe aparimita parākramāyakini svāhā |
sauvarṇagiri karpāsi kaṭu tailasya saṃkhayā | vasāmākṣika saṃyuktaṃ sarvamekatra kārayet ||
kaṭukānyasya saṃgṛhya alakṣitaṃ tu sthāpayet | abhimaṃtrā tatastailamāvartyāṣṭa śatāni tu ||
abhyaṃga pādamukhāt sa gached yojanaṃ śataṃ | punaḥ khekṣipraṃmrīte saravairo nivartate ||
mṛtakṛkalāsa cūrṇaṃ kṛtya sarāvasaṃpuṭe | nidhūmata dahemagnau siddhārthaṃsita cūrṇaṃdaṃ ||
miśrabhasmagṛhītaṃ tu yasya gṛhe vinikṣipet | tato mānuṣyanāṃ caiva mohitā bhavati sadā ||
tadeva cūrṇaṃ yasya pāda pāṃśumiśritaṃ saptabhi maṃtritaṃ pathe niṣānayet | tadeva cūrṇaṃ ātmendriya miśritaṃ yasmai dadāti sa vaśo bhavati ||
tadeva cūrṇaṃ gośṛṅge prakṣipya nikhanedyasya ṣaṃḍho bhavati | tadeva cūrṇaṃ gorocana miśritaṃ tilakaṃ kṛtvā rājapriyo bhavati ||
oṃ namo rudrāya udyādana hana <2> daha <2> paca <2> amukaśīghraṃ vaśamānaya svāhā |
kāsmaryāmūlasya gṛhya savarakusumaṃ ketakī sa lakṣaṇaṃ piṣṭvā sa bhṛṃgaṃ triphalā yuktaṃ sa tailamācamya ca tasokṣme lohaṃ pradadyā īmaṃ valitalagasmā samakasthitaṃ | keśākāsaprakāśaṃ bhramarakulanibhaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva kuryāt | aṃjanaṃ padmamūlaṃ nīlotpalamathāpi vā | ayoraṃjabhṛṃga rājaṃ patraṃ savarasya ca | etattu kāyike bhaṃge rasataṃ kātha saṃyutaiḥ tailasya kuḍavaṃ gṛhya sasairmṛdvagninā pacet | māsārdhe kṛśarāhāronasyametat pradāpayet | tataḥ pāda same divase niyataṃ kṛṣṇamūrdhvajaḥ | kumāraśca kṣumedhārvā mukhe notpala gaṃdhinā |
<99a>
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ valīpalīta varjitaḥ | ādāya tila puṣpāṇi sarpirhayakṣaraṃ tathā ||
madhunā saha saṃyuktaṃ śiro lepaṃ pradāpayet | lepenānena jāyante keśāhasta taleṣvapi ||
utpalaṃ payasā yuktaṃ māṃsaṃ bhūmau nidhāpayet | snehena palitaptaṃ ca keśānāṃ paramaṃjanaṃ ||
utpalāni tilāḥ kuṣṭhaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukameva ca | snehena palitaptaṃ ca keśānāṃ raṃjanaṃ paraṃ ||
nāgacūrṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāt mukhtā(?) cāpi rasāṃjanaṃ | anena keśā jāyanta cūrṇaṃ pāda taleṣvapi ||
nīlotpalamusīlaṃ ca candanaṃ nāgakeśaraṃ | śāli vā nakha kuṣṭaṃ ca ajakṣīreṇa pācayet ||
tailameti vipakvantu romaraṃjanamuttamaṃ | triphalānimva vījāni vacācotpala sāri vā ||
bhṛṃgamadhuka saṃyuktaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ tilasya ha | ājamāhiṣa gavyādi navanītaṃ samāharet ||
lohabhāṇḍe samāloḍyamāsaṃ bhūmau nidhāpayet | anenamakṣaṇācchīrṣerdanārddharoma saṃbhavet ||
paritīnikaromaṃ ca vadhirāṃ savṛconnayet | nīlakeśīkasaṃdhanya(?)taṃḍūlaiḥ sarvataṃ dahe ||
chiroveṣṭitayā taṃtu kṛṣṇataṃḍula sarvatu | dahe chirovisthita pātaṃ tu kṛṣṇa taṇḍula sarvatu ||
dahecchrirovisthitapāta kṛṣṇaḥ syāttriphalākṣikaḥ | manaśilā ca tailaṃ ca keśāni gukṣayetmahaṃ ||
pṛkārānāsane śreṣṭaṃ keśānāṃ ca vivardhanaṃ | bhallātakaṃ viḍaṃgāni rajasela mayorajaḥ ||
sauvaccalasamāyuktaṃ tilān kṛṣṇāstu dāpayet | kalkavānavaśirolepānnirmale sthāpayet tataḥ ||
mūrdhataścaiva vadhvā tu keśānāṃ raṃjanaṃ paraṃ | kākahṛdayā sa triphalā bhṛṃgarājarasāni tu ||
tulyabhāgāni etāni lepanaṃ tu tathaikatā | tailamebhirvipacyaṃ tu keśānāṃ dīrghakārakaṃ ||
kuṭilākarāstathā keśāḥ karṇotpala samaṃnibhāḥ |
<99b>
oṃ kṣipanī utpathasya patha muṃca <2> svāhā |
udakoparijāpyasyedeyaṃ sukhena prasūyate | bhuvanasya ca mūlāni śvetaguṃjāyutaṃ tathā ||
samabhāgāni madhunā yoni lepāni sā mukhe | sobhanaṃ janayet putraṃ balavīryasamanvitaṃ ||
nīlapuṣpamayāmārgaṃ saunikaṃ cītrakaṃ tathā | vacākuṣṭasamāyuktaṃ pītvā nārī prasūyate ||
alāvuvījagopitaṃveta saṃrajani dvayaṃ | adho puṣpī vacā vāsā candanāṃścaiva peṣayet ||
etena yonimālepya maithunaṃ ca nisevayet | putraṃ janayate hṛdyaṃ yādṛśaṃ manasaḥ priyaṃ ||
prasthaṃ pṛthaga gomūtrasya tailasya kuḍavaśya cet | ṛtu snātāpi cennārī api vaṃdhyā prasūyate ||
akṣimahiṣagarbhinyā avimūtraśatāvarī | sama bhāgāni sarvāṇi ajasarpiḥ samanvitaṃ ||
ṛtusnātāpī cennārī api vandhyā prasūyate | śuklapakṣe vaṭachukta puṣpa yoga samanvitaṃ ||
ṛtusnātāṃbhasā pitvā nārī garbhavatī bhavet | aśvagandhakaprāyeta kvathitaṃ sītalaṃ payaḥ ||
pitvā ṣātrā samāśleṣādapi vandhyā prasūyate | vījapūraka vījāni cūrṇaṃ vā nāgakeśaraṃ ||
pitvā yenāmamādagarbharatau yāhi samāśrayet | śarkarotpalayaṣṭāṃgī raktacandanaśarivā ||
sravamāneṣu garbheṣu yojyaṃ tandula kāriṇā | padmotpalasya mūlāni madhukaṃ śarkarāstilāḥ ||
savamāneṣu garbheṣu garbhasthāpanamuttamaṃ |
iti garbhasthāpanam |
madhukaṃ candanaṃ caiva sarpiṣamāmeva ca | gūḍha garbhāpi cennārī kṣiprameva prasūyate ||
ājarūḍhasya mūlāni nābhiṃ yoniṃ pralepayet | liptamātrā tu yā nārī kṣiprameva prasūyate ||
puṣpena cāturaṃ mūlaṃ pṛṣṇiparṇyāḥ samāhitaḥ |
<100a>
visalpakaraṇe harṣe gūḍhagarbhe prasaśpte(?) ||
panasūrasya patrasya nābhiṃ kalpena lepayet | nābhilepa prasiddhārthaṃ garbhasthasya prakarṣaṇaṃ ||
aparāpātane garbhe pippalyādi rajaḥ kṣipet | śālimūlākṣa mātraṃ vā pūrvādamlena vā punaḥ ||
kaluṣasya ca mūlena lāṃgulyā vā vṛṣena ca | piṣṭena gṛddha sabhāryā yoniṃ nābhiṃ ca lepayet ||
paṃcamūlasya nikvāthaṃ taptalohena saṃyutaṃ | sūtikāroganāśāya pivedvātaditāluyā ||
saśarkarudhiraṃ pitvā pramadā tu prasūyate | nisvakāṣṭasya dhūpena dhūpayitvā bhagaṃ tathā ||
maithunaṃ yānisaṃvena sā prasūyeta mānuṣi | palāśasyāṃkuraṃ yāme peyatpuṣpadaśame dine ||
śravate garbhanārīnāṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | lohitapittatagaramaricaṃ pipalī samaṃ ||
etāni samabhāgāni madhunā yoni lepayet | divālepamidaṃ kṛtvā rātrau mithuna gāminī ||
bhagena lubhate nārī poṣīnnityaṃ(?) prasūyate | gośṛṃgaṃ vṛhati bhogaṃ sahadevīṃ priyaṃgukaṃ ||
mayūrāṇḍarasāṃścaiva ekatra paripeṣayet | etena yonimālepya maithunaṃ yāni secate ||
tāsāṃ dhārayataṃ garbha yadi parākrama prajā | vatigairikasyākṣamātrapiṇḍamālepya snāpayet ||
tiṣya nakṣatrapānena yoni gacchati prasūyate | gairikaṃ ca haridrāṃ ca śūkṣmalepā pradāpayet ||
atikrānta tṛtīye tu garbhanāśanamuttamaṃ | piṣṭaṃ lāṃgalīkāmūlaṃ kulastho(?)dakasaṃyutaṃ ||
pānaṃ ca sahatīkṣṇena garbhanāśanamuttamaṃ |
iti garbhanāśanaṃ |
citrakasya tu mūlāni kvāthayet mṛdunāgninā | bhagaṃ prakṣālayet tena gāḍhatvamupagacchati ||
saurāṣṭri khādiraṃ cūrṇaṃ kvāthayet mṛdunāgninā |
<100b>
bhagaṃ prakṣālitaṃ tena gāḍhatvamupajāyate ||
śaṃkhapuṣpīvacāmāṃsī somarāji tathaiva ca | navanīte māhiṣakalke gāḍhi karaṇamuttamaṃ ||
tuṃvā patraṃ ca lodhraṃ ca samabhāgāni kārayet | dadyāllepaṃ bhagasyadaṃ prabhṛtādhyakṣyatāṃ bhavet ||
yā purohakaṃ cūrṇena bhagamālepayet sadā | maithunaṃ tu nisecetaḥ punaḥ kāmyo bhaviṣyati ||
padmena tu tamālena cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | ajākṣīreṇa tatpiṣṭvā guṭikāṃ kārayed budhaḥ ||
daśarātraṃ prasūtā tu yonyāṃ prakṣipyakanyavat(?) | kaumāraṃ vrajate bhāvaṃ yogenānena nityasaḥ ||
palāśoduṃbaraphalaṃ tilataila samanvitam | madhunā yoni mālipya gāḍhikaraṇamuttamaṃ ||
iti gāḍhikaraṇaṃ |
mātuluṃgarasaṃkṣaudra aṃjanaṃ kaṇṭhakālikā | leparājaṃ pacedena strī cittotmādakālikā ||
koṣṭhikārakrimikuṣṭha viṣṭhaṃ pārāvatasya ca | madhuśiriṣavījāni lepoyaṃ smaranāṃtikaṃ ||
dvāvetau leparājānau pradyumne nāvatāritau | garbhitā strīṇāmājaṃsinmikaṃ(?) vyugni sadā ||(?)
aṃjanaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ ca devadāru ca śarkarā | marīce dvevacākuṣṭhaṃ hastimūtreṇa peṣayet ||
etat pānaṃ pradātavyaṃ yā nārī garbhitā bhavet | śatapuṣpaṃ tathā kṣaudraṃ ketakī vṛhatī phalaṃ ||
eṣaḥ lepaḥ prayoktavyo vaśīkaraṇamuttamaṃ | sayyādo priyaṃguṃ ca tagare padmakeśaraṃ ||
gomūtraṃ peṣayed yena madhunā saha lepayet | lepasvataṃ gāḍhānāṃ vandhakīnāṃ sukhāvahaḥ ||
pippalī saindhavaṃ kuṣṭaṃ sendhavaṃ lavanaṃ tathā | manaḥśilā samāyuktaṃ lepoyaṃ maraṇāntitaṃ ||
<101a>
pippaliṃ taṃdulaṃ caiva madhumadhukameva ca | kapikacchurasaṃyuktaṃ lepoyaṃ maraṇāṃtikaṃ ||
kanakavījaniryāsaṃ madhu pippali taṃḍulaṃ | vārtākarasasaṃyuktaṃ lepoyaṃ maraṇātikaṃ ||
oṃ naṭe kucaṭe svakinī svāhā |
brahmadaṃḍī dadhirasapippalīmarīcānī ca | eṣalepaḥ prayoktavyāḥ nārīnāṃ hṛdayā kulaḥ ||
oṃ caṃcabhā devīra namostute svāhā |
ātmanastu bhavedduktaṃ ātmakarṇa malāstathā | ātmanaṃ ca bhavet śukraṃ phenasyāpi samaṃ bhavet ||
annapānaphalapuṣpaṃ gandhavastra tathaiva ca | garbhitāyai pradātavyaṃ vase tiṣṭhati kiṃkaraḥ ||
udbhāntapatraṃ bhramarasya pakṣaṃ dvaurājadaṃttau mṛtakasya mālyam | etana nārī sahacūrṇi tāṃgī pathe pathe tiṣṭati rodamānā ||
puṣkarasva tu vījāni pippalī taṃḍulaṃ sadā | aṃjanaṃ dhāva puṣpaṃ ca manu vā pānamuttamaṃ ||
ajāmūtraṃ gatamadaṃ pippalīśāli vā madhuḥ | garbhitāyai pradātavyaṃ nārīnāṃ pānamuttamaṃ ||
gorocanāḥ kulatyaṃ ca vilvapeśī manaḥśilā | etāḥ sarvāsamīkṛtya prakṣipettāmra bhājane ||
saptarātrasthitaṃ tatra tailamenajācayet | tattailaṃ bhagasālipya bhaktīramanu gacchati ||
prāptamaithunabhāvā tu patiṃ dāsaṃ kariṣyati | kuṃkumaṃ śatapuṣpaṃ ca priyaṃguṃ dve ca locane ||
aśvamūtra samāyuktaṃ avasānāṃ vaśaṃkarī | māttuluṃga phalaṃ grāhya soṣayitvā viśeṣataḥ ||
lavanaṃ yacca sāmudraṃ cūrṇaṃ tu tatra saṃnyaset | saptarātraṃ caraccaiva ātmamūtreṇa bhāvayet ||
sarāvasaṃpuṭaṃ kṛtvā aṃtardhūmena dāhayet | catuṣpathe śmaśāne vā etallavanamuttamaṃ ||
yasya dīyate sa vaśo bhavati nātra saṃśayaḥ |
<101b>
oṃ namo bhagavati prītirī svāhā |
svānajihvā vacākuṣṭaṃ mṛtanirmālyameva ca | etatmaṃtrasamāyuktamavaśānāṃ vaśaṃkarī ||
oṃ vacakutrāya(?) svāhā |
aṃjanaṃ haritālaṃ ca vacākuṣṭhaṃ tathaiva ca | sūkṣmacūrṇamidaṃ kṛtvā vaśīkaraṇamuttamaṃ ||
oṃ kuṭu <2> svāhā |
etaccūrṇaṃ saptāhaṃ parijāpya strīṇāṃ deyācettonmādakārakaṃ | pāsvatapurīṣaṃ ca indragopaṣkarasāṃjanān guggulu tvaktakhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vījāni kanakasya tu |
eṣa dhūpaṃ prakartavyaṃ guḍena saha yojayet | dhūpoyaṃ sarvabhāṇḍānāṃ lābhaviṃkraya kārakaṃ ||
oṃ cili <2> mili <2> puttalīke vaśamānaya svāhā |
indrayavaṃ vacāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tagaraṃ sarpapaṃstathā | sūlā nāgapuṣpaṃ ca bhāgaṃ sarjarasasya ca ||
etena dhūpitā patyā śighraṃ gacchati vikriyāṃ | durbhagānāṃ ca nārīnāṃ yā nārī na prasūyati ||
saṃgrāme kalahe dhūte(?) strīṣu rājakuleṣu ca | nityaṃ dhūpitamātmāna yadicchedātmanojayaṃ ||
pathyāṃ kṛṣṇavidaṃgayā dhātṛ tailaṃ saśarkarā | sarpi taila yutaṃ khādaṃ jalayonābhi bhūyate ||
lohacūrṇaṃ sa viśveta tilān kṛṣṇayutaṃ yutaṃ | dārvī lepaḥ kasoyaṃ syāttriphalājorajastathā ||
vārāhī mūla cūrṇasya śatamadhutattathā | kṣīreṇamudgapūṃpena jāṃgalena rasena vā ||
rasāyaṃ nārthinā nityaṃ bhoktavyaṃ śāliṣaṣṭike | iṣa kṛṣṇasitopetān yaḥ khādyati tilān svayaṃ ||
puṃsānasya bhavecchardī śukrañcāpi na vekṣayaḥ | śatāvarī ghṛtaṃ musta lehaṃ śarkarayā yutaṃ ||
rasamānasya pavatī saṃmṛdutā yonettī yaḥ | tilamāṣavidārīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ piṣṭvā suśobhanaṃ ||
rasairikṣurasaikvāpi ucāraṇī huṁ svāhā | ātmasūtrañca jaṭā kṛtvā anāmikākaṃḍa vāraṇā ||
<102a>
karṇabhogātadantā ca sarvametacca vardhate | aśvagandhaṃ tilacūrṇaṃ caṃdanaṃ caiva pīṣayet ||
sarṣapaiḥ sahitaṃ kīklaṃ karṇavandhaṃ na sūtakaṃ | navanītaṃ vacāmūlaṃ pāsīsaṃ kuru vai pacet ||
padmapatragatāṃ kāṃcalepayet pramadā tanuṃ | atha parvata vidāraṇa karmaṇa kramamājñāpayāmi ||
oṃ mahāsenāya mahāvalaparākramāya mahāvināyakāya bhūmividāranāya śaktidharāya vidārayan sarvayaṃtraṃ matha <2> tarjaya <2> cūrṇaya <2> pātaya <2> svāhā | anena mantreṇa sarṣapamājuramaṃḍikātiyaṃ vajra sūci rākī(?) kṛtvā saptābhimaṃtritaṃ kṛtvā parvataṃ tāḍayet | atha bhūmi vidāraṇa karmakāra anena maṃtra vidhānena bhūmiṃ tāḍayet vidārayati | prāsādabhavyā na kartuṃ kramaḥ ||
oṃ thaṃ lokāya svāhā |
mṛttikāvalmikaścaiva sarveṣāṃ sahitaṃ tathā | saptavāramidaṃ jāpyaṃ tāḍayet prāsādaṃ tatra cūrṇitaṃ bhavati ||
hālāhalasya lāṃgulaṃ karaviraṃ sa citrakaṃ | māṣikāmarkaṭī caiva svetā ca gṛhaghodhikā ||
athavā sarvaśāstrāṇi pralepaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ | etaicchinnānarāmūlaṃ tūrṇaṃ gacchedayamālayaṃ ||
chuchuṃdarīṃ kṛṣṇasarpaṃ markaṭaṃ darduraṃ tathā | hastāhela svatasanābhaṃ kṛkalāsaṃ ca lohitaṃ ||
tāḍalepaṃ pravaktavyaṃ hariṇī laye tu mṛte | anena piṣṭhamānastṛ mṛyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
sveta karavīrasya mūlaṃ patraṃ tvacaṃ tathā | chuchuṃdarī kṛṣṇasahyaṃ ca madanasya phalāni ca ||
hālāhalasya markaṭasya tathā paṭvindumeva ca | etāni samabhāgāni lu(?)hīkṣīreṇa peṣayet ||
eṣaḥ kāṇḍa viṣaṃ proktaṃ śatrūnāśaṃ vimardanaḥ | vidāyatena kāṃḍenadabhānikhaṃḍasannipātanepi saḥ ||
<102b>
sarve te nidhanaṃ yāṃti agnidagdhā ivadrumāḥ | kṛṣṇasarpaṃsitāṃpiṣṭaṃ pacāso valikā tathā ||
chuchuṃdarī pade sāṣṭau caṣīgṛhagodhikā | kṛkalā sa padānyaṣṭau nvagrāhayet ||
lāṃgalīkanavanaṃ daṃḍa phalāsaḥ prakīrtitāḥ | etāsodhita kalkaṃ ca śrutvānaka samanvitaṃ ||
gṛhītvā sarvaśāstrāṇi pralepoya padāhṛta | vidhāyamanujā śastre prayāṃti yamamaṃdiraṃ ||
kūpavāpītaḍāgānāṃ jalame tena dūṣayet | yadi tasya ca dūṣanīyaṃ tathā vakṣyāmi taśṛṇu ||
yasthe kūpo pradātavyaṃ vācyoceva caturgulaṃ |
yaḥ pivet salilaṃ tasya sa gacchedayamadhānikāṃ | saraṭaṃ vāyasaṃkūṭaṃ markaṭaṃ cūrṇayet tathā ||
etat yogaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhakṣayeta pradāpayet | tata suṣyaṃti gātrāṇi sphuṭaṃti śataso hataṃ ||
pratyānayanavarjitaṃ |
ulūkamastakaṃ gṛhītvā lavanātha pūrayet | sthāpayedbhājane tāmre saptāhantu vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
vibhītakasya kāṣṭhena ardhūmena dāhayet | tato lavanaṃ ca saṃgṛhya ripau dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
unmatto bhavate kṣipraṃ yadi na kriyate kriyā | dhibhītakanicatyā jāyate cakṣuṣi ||
iti pratyānayanaṃ ||
mātulī mātuluṃgānī vṛścikāni tathaiva ca | hālāhalaviṣaṃ caiva cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
yāne bhakṣe pradātavyaṃ sarvaśatru vināśanaṃ | chuchuṃdarī tilāṃścaiva kaṭutailāṃśca mūlaka ||
māse naiva tu taṃ pakṣā bhaved dadyādripo naraḥ | māsakena navame gulmaṃ śūlaṃśca jāyate viṣān ||
mayūraṃ karkaṭaṃ māṃsinī tathā hariṇameva ca | pippalī śṛṃgaveraṃ ca higusau varcalaṃ tathā ||
<103a>
dīpaṃ ca mūlasaṃyuktaṃ kvāthaṣecca vicakṣaṇaḥ | etena bhuktimātreṇa śūlamutpādya yojayet ||
vījapūrakaḥ kastūrīkā puṣkarameva ca | sauvarcala samāyuktaṃ pratyānayanamuttamaṃ ||
dadyācca śatrave śīghraṃ jalodaravimardanaṃ | caturbhirmāsai mriyate yadi na kriyate kriyā ||
dadyāt tasya surārthāya matsyaṃ virohitaṃ budhaḥ | vījaṃ puṣkarasoyetaṃ tena saṃpadyate sukhaṃ ||
bhojanaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ jāṃgale narasenaṃ vā | kṣīpokṣītvāgasīmūlaṃ sarṣaka ca pasyakasya ca ||
tikṣṇe na sahapātena garbhachidrakaraṃ paraṃ | gairikaṃ mātraṃ tu yuvatī puṣpadaṃsanaṃ pivet ||
yā nārī karṣabhānaprasūte kadācana |
niṃvakāṣṭhadhūpena dhūpayitvā kṣauni tasya maithuna sauvasyāḥ |
sānaprasūte kadācana |
bhallātakarasaṃguṃjā tathā maṃḍalakārikāṃ ||
gṛhagodhāsamāyuktaṃ gandhaṃ dadyācca yo naraḥ | saptāhājjāyate kuṣṭhaṃ jāyaṃte tīvra vedanāḥ ||
dhātṛpadi samāyuktaṃ śarkarāṃ nimbameva ca | kṣīreṇa kvāthayitvā tu dadyātprāsanakaṃ ripau ||
aṣṭame hanyatāt taṃ vaikuṣṭhe nā chrīyate ripoḥ |
pūrvoktena pratyā nayanaṃ kārayet ||
kukuṭamāṃsaṃ godaṃtanmatsyamāṃsaṃstathaiva ca | ahinī mocakaṃ caiva tailatailena pācayet ||
ahinīrmocakaṃ caiva tilatailasamanvitaṃ | śasyomaṃ ca prayogaṃ ca tasya pānena dāpayet ||
hṛdogajāyate tasya śūlaṃ caiva mudāhṛtaṃ | tasya śāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi yena saṃpadyate sukhaṃ ||
mayūraṃ kukkuṭamāṃsaṃ bhakṣyaṃ tasya prapeṣayet | ghṛtena sahasaṃyuktaṃ purārogaṃ ca nāśanaṃ ||
jalā hi vadanaṃ gṛhya śoṣayitvā prayatnataḥ | tasya muke nikṣipeta sa nābhaṃ ca mahāviṣaṃ ||
<103b>
dīyate yasyabho sarva viṣaṃ cāpi ca yodita | tatkṣaṇānmṛyate śatruriti śāstrasya niścayaḥ ||
prāsāda mṛttikāṃ gṛhya ahivaktre tu niḥkṣipet | vadhniyāt kṛṣṇasūtreṇa tato mārganirodhitaḥ ||
pratyānayanamicchaṃti chālayecca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | mṛttikā sudhitaṃ mārkṣakā pṛṣṇuhalaṃ kurukasya ca ||
samabhāgāni sarvāṇi cūrṇaṃbhiṣak pradāpayet | narābhuktāmana chaṃdayati vinasyeti vachurādhayadi na kriyate kriyā | kṣīraśarkarātre pivet carinimba patrāṇi bilvapatraṣoḍaśapatra ṣoḍaśabhallātakī tathā nyaṣṭau viṃśati tathā |
etaccūrṇī kṛtaṃ deyaṃ bhakṣo na pāne viśeṣataḥ | mayūramāṃsaṃ dahilāvya tathā bhṛtīrekākṣinī ca ||
etaddeyaṃ bhakṣaṇe pāne pradāpayet | saptāhād bhavedvyādhistasyatīvrā vedanā ||
ulūkasya hṛdayaṃ varāhasya jihvā samanvitaṃ | ehibhili vipācayet tene liṃpet svagātrāṇi yasya mardayet ||
tasya kimīti suprajāyate dinatrayena vinaśyati | ajākṣīraṃ gavāṃ sarpi jyaṣṭhī madhu samanvitaṃ ||
etat pāne pradātavyaṃ pratyānayanamuttamaṃ | śūkarasya tu māṃsāni śaśakasya na kulasya ca ||
samabhāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gajamūtreṇa peṣayet | varamātraṃ pramāṇena guṭikāṃ kārayed budhaḥ ||
teṣāṃ madhye na guṭikāṃ prāgīye ca nikarṣayet | sasya dadyādimaṃ pāne paṃcarātre vyatikrānte pāṇḍurogena chādyate ||
māsaikena mṛyate kriyate yadi na kriyā | lohacurṇaṃ ca gomūtraṃ saptāhāṃ chādayet tataḥ ||
tena bhūṣita mātreṇa tatra saṃpadyate sukhaṃ | sarpanirmocanā hiṃgupittaṃ vai nakulasya ca ||
<104a>
pāne yasya pradātavyaṃ gala roge bhaveddhruvam | amṛtā īśvarī mūlaṃ vacāmaṃkoca pratikāpānaṃ tasya pradāpayet ||
kṛṣṇaścāpuriṣaṃ ca mūlaṃ lāṃgalikasya ca | vatsanābhaviṣaṃ caiva śvetaśvānasya grāhayet ||
etad cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ budhaḥ | gajānāṃ tathā vādi mahiṣagavāṃ spṛṣya mātreṇa nātra kāryāvicāraṇā ||
athānāt saṃpravakṣyāmi sarveṣāṃ viṣanāśanaṃ | yatra sthitaṃ kāritaṃ vā yasya cūrṇaṃ prayacchati ||
gehagodhāyāmapūrasya varāhasya māṃsajaṃ | etatsaṃgṛhyavasāṃ samaste candramānotī parīpeṣayet ||
puṣpārke cattathā mūlaṃ hastārke vāpi peṣayet | kanyāyāṃ ca gatā madhye śuci śukle ca vāsasā ||
peyamānastatakalka maṃtramena mudīrayet |
oṃ namaḥ puruṣasiddhāya paviṣṭaye namaḥ |
sarvādhipataye agadeśa vidhānāya kuru <2> āsurī tusāyadharmamadharatiṣṭhati <2> svāhā |
anenaliptamātreṇarānāṃ saṃvājinaṃ | sarve te nirviṣabhātti uḍīśasya vaco yathā ||
atha śiraḥ stusya sauvarṇasya ca māsata | tayaṃ nyanatakte doguṇākṣatena nārcayet ||
saptāhe ca tatotite ānayecca prayatnataḥ | chāyāśuṣkaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā lepo yasya pradāpayet ||
bhakṣayet yastato śṛṃga tasya manayī bhavati | visphoṭañca jāyate saptāhena mṛyate dhruvaṃ ||
śirīṣapuṣpa mūlaṃ ca phaṃlaṃ ca tvak tathaiva ca |
ebhirdravyai vimiśrayet |
candanapadmakeśaraṃ deva dārugirīkarṇikā | siṃdhuvāra tathā sainyaṃ karkaṭīṃ ca pradāpayet ||
etāni samabhāgāni chāgamūtreṇa peṣayet |
<104b>
vadaramātrapumānena guṭikāṃ kārayet tataḥ ||
pāne khānet pradātavyaṃ tena saṃpadyate sukhaṃ | bhojanasya pradātavyaṃ śālibhaktaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ ||
yaṣṭī madhughṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ māne tasya pradāpayet | saptarātrāt pramucyeta purābhairava kīrtitā ||
lūtāmarkaṭaguṃjā ca tathā puṃchaṃ kṛkalāśasyasitaṃ tathā | vabhavā gṛhagodhāpi sūkṣmacūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pradāpayet ||
tāṣṭāsta phalena vā bhaveta ||
guṃjā markaṭī kṣā(?) caiva viṣaṃ markaṭakaṃ tathā || vānarāsthi tathā śvetāśca vṛścikāḥ ||
etāni samabhāgāni naramūtreṇa peṣayet | adhomukhaṃ mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ yatra daśyeta mānava ||
tasyādhiṣṭhatva guphalāṃ sthāpayenmatimāṃ naraḥ | saptarātraṃ trirātragandhaṃ vā tato pralepayet ||
eṣa eva pradātavyaṃ saptarātreṇa mariṣyati | pratyānayana punaḥ kṛtvā gokṣīrasarpi rakṣata ||
yutaṃ annapāne dātavyaṃ svastho bhavati naraḥ | varāha idāṃ gopītaṃ narasya śoṇitaṃ ||
etaccurṇaṃ samāyukta śirasthāna pralepayet | svastho bhavati | matsyapīttaṃ gavāmasthi viṣaṃ markaṭakaṃ tathā ||
vānarāsthi gṛddhā caiva śveta vicchaṃ tathaiva ca | etaccūrṇaṃ peṣayitvā pralepayet |
nocetaśṛgālamalaṃ pāne tasya pradāpayet | kuśasya mātraṃ samālabdha pṛṣṭhaṃ yadi madhubhasmabhiḥ ||
tasvaiva tasya paṃcarātraṃ ca kuṣṭhaṃ prajāyate | pratyānayanaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu caiva samāsataḥ ||
saptavarṇābhagātraṃ ṣaḍaṃ ṣaṃḍaṃ ca jāyate |
mṛyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
gopitaṃ madanaphalaṃ vacāṃ kūṭaṃ ca candanaṃ | śirīṣavījaṃ māṃsīṃ ca sarṣapāṇi tathaiva ca ||
samabhāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ajākṣīreṇa peṣayet | tataḥ kuṣṭhādi bhūtānāṃ kṛṣṇāṃjanaṃ pralepayet ||
tena saṃpadyate mokṣaṃ pratyānayanamicchatā |
<105a>
saptarātraṃ prayogena tataḥ kuṣṭhādvimucyate ||
kukūṭī caiva gojihvā māṃsaṃ kṛṣṇo ragasya ca | kākamāṃsaṃ mahāmāṃsaṃ kṛṣṇoragasya ca ||
haritālaṃ manaḥ śīlā ajākṣīreṇa peṣayet | tataḥ jra(?)guṭikāṃ kṛtvā vadaramātraṃ pramānutaḥ ||
ānaṃ pṛca tataḥ sokṣatāṃ madena payasā api | pānena sahadātavyaṃ hṛdrogaṃ tasya jāyate ||
chāgamūtreṇa haritaṃ vyādhākṣīrasameva ca | evaṃ pānaṃ pradātavyaṃ hṛdayarogavināśanaṃ ||
odanaṃ ca ajākṣīraṃ saptarātraṃ pradāpayet | śaśakasya tu māṃsāni māṃsaṃ kṛṣṇoragasya ca ||
samabhāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sahīkṣireṇa bhāvayet | saptarātraṃ sthite tasmiṃ deyaṃ gatvānu lepamoṃ ||
gātraṃ tasya samātreṇa tataḥ kuṣṭhaṃ prajāyate | devadāru haridrā devīrajanimadanatva ca ||
piṣṭvā mahīṣamūtreṇa yasya lepaṃ pradāpayet | saptarātra prayogena kuṣṭharogāt pramucyate ||
mātuluṃga sa vījāni tapakarakasyāsumo(?) | cūrṇabhāgaṃ samaripau dadāti paraṃ ca sarveṣāṃ yogānāmutpādakaraṇaṃ mahat |
kṣīramārjya tathāgavyaṃ pānaṃ tasya pradāpayet ||
pratyānayanametasya munmattī kṛtanāśanaṃ | māṃsaṃ vyāghradasyakṣa kṛkalāśasya tathā ||
ulūkamāṃsasamāyuktaṃ sarvamekatra saṃgrahet | samabhāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ajākṣīreṇa peṣayet ||
etatpadiṃ pradātavyaṃ guṭikāṃ kārayet budhaḥ | kṣīrasaṃyuktaṃ tena bhakṣitamātreṇa saptarātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
bhagaṃdarādi rogāni bhaviṣyantiṃ vahuni ca |
etatprātyānayanavarjitaṃ |
vibhālamalaṃ marīcāniṇenitaṃ kṛṣṇa sarpasya | naramāṃsaṃ tathā vyāghra viṣamaṃbhakameva ca ||
gṛhagodhāśca paṃcasavikāścadaṃtu usadvi saptāhaṃ sthāpayed bhājane śubhe |
sarānāṃ ca phalāgre ca deyaṃ śatru jighāṃsayāḥ | vidhāya puruṣākāraṃ sa yāti yamamaṃdiraṃ ||
<105b>
pratyānayanaṃ vakṣyāmi yena śāntiḥ prajāyate | mayūrapittaṃ saṃgṛhya pittaṃ ca nakulasya ca ||
pippalī sāri vā drākṣā triphalā candanaṃ vacā | teṣāṃ dvedhābhibhūtānāṃ ādau yasya mahāsukhaṃ ||
matsyasya viṣaṃ datvā mārayet tatkṣaṇādbudhaḥ | ātmanā tu gṛhṇīyād dadyādāpayasyado phalaṃ ||
yaśca bhakṣayate nityaṃ mṛyate tasya māsāni māranīyā bhaṭaḥ | saṃyojayet payaḥ sarkarāmiśca cūrṇaṃ saptarātraṃ samyak saṃpadyate sukham ||
patrāṇi śatapuṣpāni aśvapuṣpaṃ tathaiva ca | śaśanābhi tathā caiva saṃkocaṃ caiva parṇikā ||
mūlaṃ girikarṇikameva ca |
ātmavījasamāyuktaṃ yasya dīyate budhaḥ | sa tasya vaśo bhavati kṣipraṃ puṣpaiḥ sarvavidhikriyā ||
mūlanakṣatre mūlaṃ phalaṃ saṃgṛhya tathā rocana caṃdanaṃ | tripuṣpasamāyuktaṃ tilakaṃ rājapūjitaṃ ||
sa tasya vaśyaḥ nātra vicāraṇā | mohaye śatrusaṃhāraṃ iti śāstrasa niścayaḥ ||
mūlanakṣatre mūlaṃ saṃgṛhya bharaṇī nakṣatre valkalaṃ citrā nakṣatre yaṃtraṃ viśākhā nakṣatre puṣpaṃ jyeṣṭhā nakṣatre phalamenānnakṣatre svetatsaṃgṛhya sūkṣmacūrṇaṃ kārayet |
locanālakṣakākarṇaṃ prayogaṃ sarvaśodhanaṃ |
puṣpe vā ādrāyāṃ haste āditye ca yadā tadā tilakaṃ kārayet prājño naranārīvasaṃ kuru |
viṣṇukrāntāṃ ca sarpākṣīṃ bhāvayecca punaḥ punaḥ | tena kṛtvā tilakaṃ surāsuraṃ mohayet ||
oṃ trailokyamohani sarvabhūtavaśaṃkarīṇi hrīṁ svāhā |
aṣṭottara śataṃ paṭhaṃti surāsuravaśamānayati | narasya locanaṃ gṛhya dviradasya madena tu ||
bhāvayitvā tu maṃtreṇāṣṭottara śataṃ priye | pāne vilepa dhūpāni sa vaśo bhavati kṣipraṃ dhanadaḥ prāṇado bhavet ||
priyaṃgukalikāmiśraṃ guggulaṃ dhūparodhitaṃ | kṛtvā aṣṭaśataṃ caiva śubhagaṃ saṃprajāyate ||
<106a>
jāti kālikā miśrāṇimadhvā jātināhuteḥ | śubhagatvaṃ mavāpnoti rūpaṃ hīnopi yo naraḥ ||
aghoreṇa kṛtaṃ homaṃ lavaṇe tilamiśrite | saptāhā ghāti sa dveṣamāyāti yātri kāyiṇenagarvitāḥ ||
rājikālavane caiva madhukṣīraṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ | gomayena samāyuktaṃ pūrvokta maṃtreṇa hunet ||
śarṣapaṃca kṛte sādhyaṃmiti śāstrasya niścayaṃ | strīyāmaṣṭapuruṣasya pādapāṃśuṃ samāharet ||
śaśigrahaṇe homayet |
aṣṭasahasraikaṃ hutvā yasya nāmnāya paurṇātaśīghramākarṣayati ||
śmaśānāṅgā rasaṃ gṛhya caturdaśyāṃ ca buddhi (*)(?) | striyo vā puruṣasyāpi ākṛtiṃ ca samālikhet ||
tasya hṛdaye ca ārūhya sahasraṃ parijapyate | pūrvaṃ maṃtraṃ mahābhāga sādhyanāmavidarbhitam ||
āditya grahane tadvarjayitvā prayatnataḥ | raktakaravīra kusumena tāḍayet ||
śirasāṃ bhūṣivikeśādi kīrṇaṃ ca strī ca nagnā caiva samākulā ca dhātu maṃtraṃ japyese karpitā rūpase viyutā || ānaye nitare tu svāmuṃ hṛtāghana saṃśayaśapūrtajorīya raktā ca saha devī tathaiva ca ||
sahadevā samāyuktaṃ grāhya somaparvaṇi | maṃtreṇānena tajjapyaṃ rocanā yojitena ca ||
tilakaṃ kārayed vidvān strīpumān vaśamānayet | somarājīṃ vacāṃkuṣṭaṃ śmaśānāṃgārameva ca ||
cūrṇīkṛtya prayatnena guṭikāṃ kārayennaraḥ | puṣpe phale ca mūle ca vaśī kṛtvā rāja pūjyo bhavati ||
pūrvokta maṃtreṇāṣṭottara śata nāma japet | athoccāṭanaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepānna tu vistarāt ||
sūryagrahaṇa saṃprāpte lāṃgalīmūlamuttamaṃ | śmaśānāṃgārasaṃyuktaṃ devadhvajasamanvitaṃ ||
tasya bhāvī kṣipraveśma maṃtreṇānena buddhimān |
oṃ huṁ phaṭ amukaṃ mohayastaṃ bhaya uccāṭaya huṁ phaṭ svāhā ||
<106b>
anena maṃtreṇa ekaviṃśati vārāṇi abhimaṃtrā yasya gṛhe nikhanet sa uccāṭayati sarṣapaṃ | pretakeśāsthi śivanirmālyameva ca |
vibhītakāsthi saṃyuktaṃ sthāpayedyasya veśmani | maṃtraḥ tasya pravakṣyāmi uccāṭana karaṃ paraṃ ||
oṃ hāṁ huṁ huṁ huṁ phaṭ svāhā |
ayaṃte rājate maṃtraṃ sugopitaṃ prakaṭi kṛtaṃ | lakṣajāpena saṃsiddhye sarvakarmāni kārayet ||
asiddha kurute karma kiṃ punaryastu sādhayet | ādityādi mukho bhūtvā sahasraṃ parijapyate ||
saptarātra prayogeṇa śatrumuccāṭayeddhṛtaṃ | sakṛtvāduritametaṃ ripunāma vidarbhitaṃ ||
uccāṭanakaraṃ jayaṃ saptajaptena saṃśayaḥ | siddhimaṃtramidaṃ kāryamasiddhasya vidhismṛtam ||
ripornāma samuccārya arcane maṃtra saṃpuṭaṃ | yajamānasya krodhā viṣṭena cetasā ||
dakṣiṇāni mukho bhūtvā ripumuccāṭayaṃt kṣaṇāt | raktakaravīreṇaṃ raktena kusumena homamācaret ||
sahasrā uccāṭayati śatruṃ aptopi gacchati | athānyacca pravakṣyāmi yogaṃ bhuvi sudurlabhaṃ ||
ye uccāṭayeta vā pravardha vāla darpitaṃ | sadyomyo vāhane sārddha svajane parivārake ||
maṃtrarājaṃ purāproktaṃ rājo nāma vidarbhitaṃ | uccāṭanakaraṃ homaṃ lakṣajāpyaṃ prakartavyaṃ śmaśāne vā vadhiradhiḥ | daśāṃśahomabhāveṣṭodyaguggulu rājīkā | tataḥ prabhāta samaye sarveṣāṃ asthisaṃyutāṃ caturdikṣu diśi nyasya prakṣipecca diśo daśaḥ ||
śīghramuccāṭayedrājā vinādravyeṇa suvrataḥ | pūrvokta maṃtraṃ saṃśodhyaṃ tataḥ karmasamārabhet ||
dakṣanāḍī pravāhena uccāṭana kriyāṃ kuru | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi viśeṣoccāṭanaṃ mahat ||
pūrvāmaṃtreṇa buddhijñā hi maṃtreva samārabhet |
<107a>
catuṣpathe kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā kākapakṣa ulūkayoḥ ||
saṃpūrṇahomena tatkṣaṇe uccāṭanaṃ bhavet | athavātena siddhye taṃ upāyaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥ ||
mahāputtalikā kāryārti nāmaṃ samālikhet | tasya putuyasthāni saṃkṣipya ripusaṃkṣaye ||
tanmaṃtreśca dine śīghraṃ kuru uccāṭanaṃ dhruvaṃ | athavā māyet śatru pravṛddha bala darpitaṃ ||
maṃtro nyāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva pārthivātmaja | karpājanāpitta saṃgṛhya ripornāma vigarbhitaṃ ||
adhomukhaṃ ca tat kṛtvā bhasmanātha prapūrayet | nadī tīre samāsādhya dedīṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ||
vidyādhvaka pānasthāpya tato homaṃ tu kārayet | rājikālavanaṃ caiva viṣaṃ nāgarameva ca ||
saptarātra prayogena avasya mṛyate punaḥ | pūrvokta maṃtrarājena saptarātraṃ ca homayet ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ pitta māyūraṃ ca samārabhet | sahasramaṣṭottaraṃ dattaṃ āyasā nirmitāya ca ||
saptarātra prayogena avaśya mṛyate punaḥ | pūrvokta maṃtrarājena saptanābhaṃ ca homayet ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ pitu maṃjulaṃ ca samārabhet | sahasramaṣṭottare datta āyasā nirmitāya ca ||
dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā muktakeśaḥ kṛṣṇavāsā svadakṣa nāḍī pravāhena homavidhimācaret ||
tatparortho sthātavyaṃ māyūraṃ kuṇḍapārśvataḥ | anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa mārayecchatru dāruṇān ||
oṃ huṁ huṁ kṣāṁ rāṃ amukaṃ māraya rāṃ kṣāṃ huṁ huṁ svāhā |
eṣā saptadaśī vidyā akṣare samudāhṛtā | māraṇe sarvabhūtānāṃ maṃtre trailokyaṃ sa carācaraṃ ||
ādāpadaṃ ca duṣṭātmā deva brāhmaṇa dūṣakaḥ | mātṛhāpi tṛhā caiva nityaṃ sā parāyanaḥ ||
śaśakamāraye rāja na vidviṣṭovasadājane | anyathā naiva kartavyaṃ aparārdha śatairapi ||
prathame mohitaṃ caiva dvitīye mayūraṇaṃ |
<107b>
uddhṛte tṛtīye uparīṣṭhastu caturthe ca dhṛti ||
paṃcame bhagnakaṃdastu ṣaṣṭhe mūrdhita retasaḥ | saptame mṛyate bhūmyāṃ mṛyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
atha prayogaṃ pravakṣyāmi yatsurairapi durlabhaṃ | staṃbhane sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃkṣepena vadāmyaham ||
viṣṇukrāntā ca sarvākṣī nāgaparṇī valā tathā | utpādyat puṣpanakṣatreṇaṃ maṃtrena na sādhakaṃ ||
kāryāṇi kṛṣṇapakṣe ca āditasya dine tathā | nikṣipedari gehe sarvamauṣadhī maṃtra saṃyutānāṃ nāśeṣiyena vadāmyahaṃ viṣṇukrāntā |
oṃ ṣajya huṁ huṁ huṁ amukaṃstaṃ bhaya <2> huṁ hrīṁ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ phaṭ |
anena maṃtreṇa staṃbhayati na cāsyadi ekodeya na caika pravivodhakaṃ | svaninīdhau mahāmaṃtraṃ staṃbhayed vilvayoni vā ||
paṭhite siddhiśuddhiṃ ca sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaḥ | māhiṣaṃ navanītaṃ ca sindūrakanakaphalaṃ ||
sudarśano nīlapuṣpī nāgītyā ca mahekamāyāṃti niścalo yate mahī pratyāyanavimaḥ malakākṣīraka na bhavati |
sarpākṣi jñāna jihvā ca madanasya phalāni ca | godhākapinākalaṣāsthi kṛkalāsaṃ ca lohitaṃ ||
etatsarvaṃ vasā gṛhya sūṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ tu kārayet | mahātailena saṃmiśraṃ yasya lepaḥ pradīyate ||
pūrvokta maṃtrasahite narasya staṃbhanaṃ bhavet | pratyānayane ca ye maṃtrā na buddhyate sadā ||
māmahīṣī yatsusānāṃ staṃbhanaṃ yadi kārayet | tadāhaṃ kārapiṣyaṃti krīḍārthaṃ maniṣibhiḥ ||
gojihvā sālaparṇi ca tathā saṃkoca patrikā | vajrī kṣīraṃ tu ruskaṃ ca śatruparṇī tathaiva ca ||
saṃgṛhya samabhāgāni suṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ tu kārayet | śisumārasya tailena miśrayecca prayatnataḥ ||
taile naiva ca saṃśiktā proktaṃ maṃtrayojitaṃ |
<108a>
staṃbhanaṃ sarvago mahiṣādi catuṣpadāṃ samaṃ tataḥ ||
uṣṇodakena prakṣālya pratyānayanadariṇa | evaṃ ca svastha māyāṃti gomahiṣapaśujātayaḥ ||
triśūlakā ca tathā gaurasarṣapau vibhītakā | sthi sindūraṃ tiktālāvukameva ca ||
uṣṇodakena sādhyasya maṃtreṇānena sādhaka |
oṃ huṁ kraṁ hastaṃbhana svāhā |
anena maṃtreṇa hastau pralipya divyaṃ staṃbhayati | sarṣapā śveta guṃjā ca jalakuṃbhī tṛtīyakā ||
kṛtāṃjali samāyuktā sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇantu kārayet | maṇḍuke jalasarpābhyāṃ carmasaṃgṛhya bhāvayet ||
sarātodhatuṣakāyamaṃtraṃ caiva vivodhayet | oṃ jalayāsi sarvalokavidhāraṇī maṃtra staṃbhanastaṃbha svāhā ||
jale yathā svecchayā jala calavarttiṣvīti | māṃsīkanakapuṣpāni saptaparṇī vacā tathā |
makarapittasaṃyuktaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ tu kārayet | saralepamedhāvi saṃviśeṣacca hutāsane ||
oṃ namayopanidīyani staṃbhani rīṃ rīṃ rūṃ rūṃ huṁ svāhā |
pūrvadvevāyutaṃ japet tataḥ siddhimeva ca |
karpāsāsthi haridrā ca śaṃkhapuṣpī suvatsalī | nāgārīmūlakāyuktā sarpasthāpi mukhe kṣipet ||
sasarpaḥ staṃbha pāyāti prasupta vatiṣṭati |
oṃ huṁ koṭarākṣi vagalāmukhi dayadīrgha sāpini gatiṃ staṃbhaya svāhā |
kumārī varjanī mūla śarapuṃkhī sahaikatā | eṣa dhūpa prayogena sarpāṇāṃ kuṇḍavandhanam ||
iti sarpastaṃbhanaṃ |
devadeva namastubhyaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavānanaṃ | senānī staṃbhanaṃ vakṣye ca bhairavena yathoditaṃ ||
<108b>
svayaṃbhu jantuke liṃge devāle keśavethavā | tatra sthitvā japellakṣaṃ dyekaṃ vibhuḥ samāhitaḥ ||
navākṣaraṃ mahāmaṃtraṃ pravakṣyāmi nibodhataḥ |
oṃ saṃ raṃ kṣaṃ saṃ laṃ vaṃ dhaṃ krīṃ svāhā |
eṣa te maṃtrarājoyaṃ duṣṭaśatrunivāraṇaḥ | bhaṃjakaśca prasaṃtyevaṃ svasainyaṃ parirakṣati ||
japitavyaṃ prayatnena sadā vijayavardhanaṃ | smaraṇāt maṃtrarājasya bhayarogāvivarjitaḥ ||
mahābhaye samutpanne pīlīgāya mayaṃ śubhaṃ | tato gṛhyaparigṛhya pralipedvasudhātalaṃ ||
aṣṭapatraṃ svaitapadmaṃ ālikhecca tathāmunā | caturdikṣūtha kalasaṃ sthāpitavyaṃ matimānnaraḥ ||
paṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ dviroṣaddhi samanvitaṃ | jayati vījasaṃtā ca tathā vacā parājitā ||
sahadevī lakṣmaṇā caiva śaṃkhapuṣpī ca saptamī | aṣṭau ca soma rājī ca kalaśābhyantare kṣipet ||
śvetavastra paricchannaṃ divyagandhānu lepayet | bhūtapallavasaṃyuktaṃ tatramaṃtraṃ ca vinyaset ||
maṇḍale pūjaye devaṃ tattan maṃtraiśca pūjayet | jāpya tasyāgrataḥ kāryo home caiva niraṃtaraṃ ||
raktapuṣpai ca tato devaṃ saṃpūrṇa bhairavaṃ vibhum | devaṃ devīṃ namaskṛtya rajasārdhanaṃ ||
akṣetrānudakaśaramiśrāṃ snāstu sarvān visecayet | athā gajāṃstathālokā udakenāpi siṃcayet ||
dhanuṣaṃ varjarīṃ khaḍgaṃ gadāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca muttamaṃ | abhiṣīcya mahātmānaṃ śatrusainyakṣayaṃ bhavet ||
anena vidhināyasturavāgaṃ kuryāttu mānavaṃ | saṃbhave ativārājñā śatrukṣayaṃkarā ||
parasainyaṃ staṃbhayati yadi indra samoripuḥ |
atha vetālasādhanaṃ |
mṛtakasya ca sāṃgṛhya rocanāṃ bhasma eva ca | kākolūkasya pakṣāni dahitvā bhaṃjanaṃ budhaḥ ||
<109a>
kartavyaṃ caiva medhāvī maṃtreṇānena maṃtritaṃ |
oṃ kṣāṁ kroṁ svāhā |
aṃjanaṃ ca prakartavyaṃ vetālaṃ paśyate dhruvaṃ | mahābhīṣaṇarūpeṇa āgasya paramojjvalaṃ ||
vada teṣāṃ prakartavyaṃ mayātava mahātmanaṃ | sādhakena yathā svecchā yatkiṃcitmanasīpsitam ||
sarvaṃ siddhyati te sarve nātra kāryā vicāraṇāt | ekaliṃge samāśritya manurājaṃ ca tryakṣaraṃ ||
japitaṃ ca jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ arddharātreyati krāṃte ete āgachati tu saḥ ||
aṣṭapadma likhet padmaṃ keśarālaya karṇikāḥ | madhye ca ālikhet maṃtraṃ jñeyaṃ patre niyojayet ||
rocanā kuṃkumakastūrī kācavapārārasena kālika | bhūrjapatre ca nāma hrīṃkāra viveṣṭitam ||
vaddhvā caiva kare kaṇṭhe sa naraḥ śubhago bhavet | vicaret pṛthivī sarvāṃ kāmadeva ivāparaḥ ||
mohani saṃpravakṣyāmi trailokyeṣu suviśrutāṃ | yā jñātvā sarvasatvānāṃ śubhagatvaṃ prajāyate ||
oṃ krīṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ saḥ eṣāvidyā parā rakṣā paṭhitā sati siddhyati |
oṃ klāṁ hṛdayaṃ oṃ hīṁ śiraḥ oṃ suśikhā | oṃ haḥ kavacaṃ | oṃ hrīṃ pādau | oṃ krīṃ jānau | oṃ līṁ uru | oṃ rīṃ kaṭīṃ | oṃ sa liṃga | oṃ oṃ maṇipūrake | oṃ vāṃ udare | oṃ vāṃ hṛdayaṃ | oṃ hrīṃ vāhū | oṃ hrīṃ kaṃṭhaṃ | oṃ huṁ cakṣuṣī | oṃ krāṃ śiraḥ | iti nyāśā sākṣāṃ vāgīśvaro bhavati | eko doṣo hi vidyāyā | jāpyamāne vijāyate naranārījanā sarve kṛtatyeva phalau budhaḥ |
uktānuktaṃ ca yatkiṃcit sakṛjjāpena sādhakaḥ | nāthasya śadṛśo maṃtro maṃtra koṭi śatairapi ||
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi paramaṃ mūlalakṣaṇaṃ | yena vā jñātamātreṇa ātmapratyaya jāyate ||
<109b>
subhagaḥ sarvalokaiko naronārī pravartate | śatru ca mitratāṃ yāti kiṃ kurvanna vidhiyate ||
duṣṭa caureṣu rājasu sarpavyāghra vṛthakādiṣu | sarve te vaśamāyāṃti ājñāṃ kurvaṃti nityasaḥ ||
oṃ bhave bharokṣa bhūkṣo bhayamohaya sarvasasvaṃ vaśamānaya kuru me hīṃ mohinīye svāhā |
idaṃ mūlamaṃtraṃ | asya jāni bhavaṃti | oṃ bhūte iti hṛdayaṃ | oṃ bhūge bhaga iti śiraḥ | oṃ khaṃ bhakṣau bhayaśikhā | oṃ sarvatva ca mama kuru kavacaṃ | hrīṁ mohinīye netrābhyāṃ svāhā | astrāya phaṭ ityarthaḥ | iti ṣaḍaṃganyāśaṃ kṛtvā japet |
ekaliṃgajapellakṣaṃ sūcirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ | raktatamālapuṣpāṇi trimadhubhāvitāni ca ||
homenā yute naikena siddhirbhavati īpsitā | khāne pāne sahate kāmān karoti karmasiddhyati ||
tasi acirāt sidhyaṃti sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ | siddhārthāt maṃtrayitvā tu maṃtritvā sammataṃstrīyā ||
śirasi saṃvidhātavyaṃ puṣpe mūle punarvasau | vaśī bhavati sā nārī ātmanā ca dhanena ca ||
athavā puruṣe kuryān maṃtranāmnorabhedataḥ | trisaptaka prayogena dāsatvaṃ puruṣaṃ nayet ||
rājñāṃstu purato rājāppaśalyocāri sādhakaḥ | aṣṭottara śate jāpye vaśo bhavati nānyathā ||
athānya ddhamamānasya rasyādau samupāharet | svāmi padena tilakaṃ sarvopadrava nāśanaṃ ||
athāsya prayogāni bhavaṃti sarvasiddhayaḥ | duṣṭānāṃ caiva nārīnāṃ madagarvena garvitaḥ ||
vaśīkaraṇa hetvarthaṃ śṛṇuṣvāṃ mimāṃ sudhī | vāmapādodbhavāṃ pāśu vāmahastena vāharet ||
saptābhimaṃtritaṃ kṛtvā tilakaṃ kārayennaraḥ | śāstrī bhavati vasyā yatpādādha tata samudbhavaṃ ||
sugopyaṃ ca imaṃ yogaṃ na dadyādyasya kasyacit |
<110a>
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ bhairavamaṃtranaṃ tathā ||
na deyaṃ duṣṭa satvānāṃ āgame gopayet sadā | śāstra bhaktāya pradātavyaṃ anyathā naiva kārayet ||
puruṣavaśīkaraṇe dakṣiṇa pādapāṃśu gṛhītyāṣṭādārāgnākarā varāgnau mahāmadyamaṣṭottaraśatahomāvasāne svāhāṃ tena kṛtvā siddhimavāpnuyāt ||
oṃ kroṃ huṁ hrīṃ hīṃ hrīṃ hoṃ eṣāmaṃtrarājñī vidyāśatroruccāṭane dhruvaṃ | ayutaṃ japitvā siddho bhavati kuryān nātra saṃśaye dhruvaṃ |
uccāṭayeta ripuṃ duragataḥ samīpasthaṃ tu kā kathā | ādau sthānaṃ prakartavyaṃ paścājjāpye samārabhet ||
oṃkāraṃ pītavarṇaṃ mūrddhnisya viciṃtayet | kroṃ(?)kāraṃ hṛdaye cintyaṃ raktapāradasaṃnibhaṃ ||
śikhāyāṃ ciṃtayed huṁkāraṃ pāṃḍuraṃ | oṃ varvasanabhyātyagni varṇābhaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ cintayet tataḥ ||
hoṃkāraṃ sarvagātrāṇi kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ viciṃtayet ||
evaṃ dhyānaṃ purā śaṃbhoḥ kṛtvā sarvaṃ samārabhet | homāvasāne punaḥ sthānaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca nivodhataḥ ||
śatroḥ saṃcitya kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ muktakeśaṃ cātmānaṃ | vaddho vai kālapāsena tādyaṃ māno mahāvalaiḥ ||
puruṣai sarvasadṛṣṭastasthānānnipate vahiḥ | sanitvā puruṣa dvāraṃ saṃkṣipto giriṃ madhyataḥ ||
evaṃ dhyānaṃ prakartavyaṃ śatrutulyo viyoripuḥ | ṣaṭpiṃḍadhvaṃ sanatsthānāt kiṃ punaḥ smānaṃ vānapi ||
oṃ ṣādū(?) pūjyaṃ tu mahākālaṃ kābhīṣama paramahāvikārālaṃ amusārūmārūṣaṣaḥ ||
oṃ lavalā amisītiṣṇosīdaṃdāgrīdehṛdayemasyadahagātrāni dahanaga tathāni uṣṭasthinī asthisya majakadahahatilakālavanaṃ chidati lavanāvibhatilavana paṃcatriśoṇitaṃ lavanastu kuto nidrā kutorati |
yadi vasati yojana śataṃ nadīnāsatītare |
<110b>
vaddho ye nāgaprākāre kṛṣṇasarpa kṛtā vedve tatraiva śīghramāne hi lavanavadha purakṛtaṃ ||
oṃ ciṭi <2> vikrāni <2> amukaṃ sādhaya saparivāraṃ va śamānaya svāhā | oṃ karṇapiśāci parṇasavarī sarvopadrava nāśanī svāhā | oṃ namaḥ śivāya | ṣaṃjarīṭa sīto śiva nirmalya saṃyuktaṃ vṛkṣamūla vadātavyaṃ sa vṛkṣaṃ patanatyajaṃti | ṣaṃjarīṭaṃ rudhireṇa guṭikā kārayet spṛśati sa vaśo bhavati | ṣaṃjarīṭa hṛdayaṃ guhyamudakena tailena vā gātraṃ samābhyukṣya yudhi parājito bhavati | ṣaṃjarīṭasya śiroroma ca yoni maleṣu raya vaśo bhavati | ṣaṃjarīṭasyāṃkikamalesu vā manaḥśilā cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā yasya dīyate sa vaśo bhavati | karaṃjavījaṃ vālakaṃ kormapī tathaiva prītyā vandhyā prasūyate | mṛtakasya puṣpaṃ ca etaccūrṇaṃ pradātavyaṃ adṛśo vaśī bhavati yoṣitā | oṃ cāmuṇḍe dū(?) amukaṃ vaśamānaya svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa saptavāraṃ parijapya yasya dīyate vaśo bhavati | mṛgasthi dvaṃdvayoḥ kīlakaṃ kṛtvāyaṃ cāṅgūla pramāṇaṃ yasya nāmnā nikhanet tasya mṛtavat pari bhavati | oṃ vaṭadahi svāhā | api ca | oṃ kāmeśvarīye svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa tāṃvūlapuṣpaṃ vā ekaviṃśati japitaṃ yasya dīyate sa vaśo bhavati | chuchaṃdarī tailena kajjalaṃ kṛtvā tadaṃjanena nayane drāvayedyasya dṛśyati tasya vaśo bhavati | anenāṃjanena tilakaṃ kārayet | rājapriyo bhavati | haridrā haritālau samaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā strīnāṃ śirasi dāpayet vaśo bhavati puruṣasya pradātavyaṃ haritāla gorocanā nāmikā rudhirena tilakaṃ kārayitvā | yamicchatitaṃ labhet | aṃgare aṃgavāṇi svāhā | tagaraṃ saiṃdhavaścaiva uśīraṃ yeṣṭhī madhustathā |
<111a>
madhumupadhīmān strīṇāṃ rājayoṣitāṃ sa priyo bhavati | vātāri uttaramūlaṃ hastanakṣatre utpādya taddine sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vāṭikāṃ kārayet | strīṇāṃ mastake deyaṃ vaśo bhavati | oṃ namo bhagavānāya amukavaśo bhava | oṃ huṁ phaṭ svāhā | anena tāṃbulādi japatimaṣṭhottaraṃ saṃjapya saptābhimaṃtritaṃ vā yasya dīyate tadā vaśo bhaviṣyati | oṃ raladāya oṃ ali <2> kalivala dhūlī cauraghra yogaṃḍa sarpāvināvaddhnāmiva svāhā | caturaṃgula yuta kāṣṭhaṃ saptābhimaṃtritaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇakarṇe dāpyagamanāccoravyāghradināṃ bhayaṃ na bhavati | oṃ rāmanijamme(?) sthaubhaniṃ staṃbhane mohanī mohe andhanī andhe amukasya hṛdaye cakṣuḥ śirasarvāṃgaṃ mohaya he phaṭ astrā na vide saptavārān cāryagacchedvidyā kevalikeyaṃ | rocanāyā'ṣṭa sahasrāṇi abhimaṃtritaṃ tilakaṃ kārayet yasya sa vaśo bhavati dṛśyate | ayaṃ maṃtraḥ rājakule gaccha mahāpriyo bhavati | oṃ maṃtranāthāya trailokya vijayaṃ strīpuruṣasya hṛdayaṃ asādhitasya karma bhavati | aṃjanenaḥ prātarutthāya udakaṃ saptābhimaṃtritaṃ kṛtvā prakṣālyamukhaṃ yasyā dṛṣṭaṃ tava svaṃ evaṃ tailaṃ daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ saptābhimaṃtritaṃ bhakṣet mātrāṃ vaśo bhavati | oṃ hāṁ vadha svāhā | oṃ hili <2> mānupī phaṭ svāhā dinānta kāmaṃ vṛṣa(?) | oṃ klaṁ rakṣame huṁ phaṭ svāhā | eṣā vidyā paṭhitvā siddhidā hrīrakṣāya namaḥ | asya āditya dine ādityābhimukhaṃ sthitvāyananasi kṛtvā japaṃ kurumārṣa dhruvaṃ | oṃ cūrṇaparṇenaktaṃ haḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ yannāmnoccārye ekaviṃśati parijapya sarpirmadhumadaṃpradagarvitā ca yā ca nārīṇāṃ lepo ye snehavardhanaḥ | uddhṛtasya vijāni hi pippalītaṃdulena ca |
<111b>
pārāvatapurīṣāni madhunā sahayojitaṃ |
lepoyaṃ snehavandhanaṃ |
ātmaśoṇitaṃ satapuṣpākṣodakaṃ karavīra vṛhatī phalaṃ | strīvaśakāritaṃ sarṣapapriyaṃgu tagarapadmakeśaragomūtraṃ piṣṭvā madhunā sahatulā mātraṃ yākīniṃ pradātavyaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamaṃ | gṛddhapurīyamāṃsāmarbhakamasdhimātmaśatru samāyuktaṃ lepanaṃ maraṇāṃtaka vaśyaṃ karoti | oṃ hrīṁ hrīṁ sa anena vīrabhavāmaṃguṣṭhānāmikaṃ yā japya gṛhītvā lalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā trailokya vasayalayeṃ | ataḥ prayogaṃdhā sa ucyate |
samudhvajo na jānāti bhramate yo mahītale | vṛṣabhayaṃ bhavet tasya vijñānaṃ vetti yo naraḥ ||
oṃ hrīṁ vijñānaśakti gurunātha pādukebhyo namaḥ | oṃ hrīṁ staṃbhana sāvarī hara ārāhasanabhivā hrīṁ phaṭ <2> hana <2> hara <2> vasanīye ye rārīmārastaṃbhaniye staṃbhaya ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā | staṃbhane gavāditaskarāhi vyāghrāriṣṭabhayaṃ nāśayati | paṭhatu mahāsiddhi sisirāvatīti niścitaṃ | punaranenamaṃtreṇa siṣiyīsisvāṃ samāgṛhya śikhāyavaṃdhyayataḥ | puṣpārkaśaṃyoge tathā sūryagrahepi rocana yā tilakaṃ kārayetyā sarvakāryeṣu staṃbhayati atha khaḍgastaṃbhana ucyate | oṃ pātulaṃthe kalikamalaku apretalalitaṃ ya | bhūratasaruvadhamotasilaṃ sarvanāśaye ṣaḍete taṃ kavarigrahanumaṃte yaha hanayā udyāvatānepi ca | aṣṭottaraśataṃ maṃtrī vayaṃ abhimaṃtrya udakaṃ japya punaḥ pibet | āpaṃ me muttamaṃ | gandhaṃ suvarṇavat dṛṣṭvā avalokayecchudhā | divyastaṃbhanati kathyate | oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ bhagavate divyayoginī divyāni staṃbhaya agne manu kūṭhāramatelamatuḥ māra ṭha jalamaḥ aṣṭadivyāni maṭha oṃ siddhiśvarī bhagavatī mama divya staṃbhaniye svāhā |
<112a>
sitalīpatratī siṃhalayānāmaḥ |
paṭhitā siddhidā mahāmaṃtraiḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ | anenaiva maṃtreṇa jahajāni maubadhayāṃ tathaiva ca ||
kāṣṭhaṃ vahutagrahamaṃdukaṃ vasayā sajyāsitanī patrasaṃyuktaṃ peṣaye dalavārinā | tenaikaro tānipyastaṃbhaya jalaṃ kṛtvā nādikaṃ || tena pādau samāhṛtya agnau parivahet tataḥ | oṃ namo narasiṃhāya asurakulaghātakara huṁ phaṭ kālī kachulīnāya eti vīmaśānaṃ ca ivīmaśca eyiśikara śubhitaiḥ | sneho hanna uttārade vahni kaṭi ājñā na kalaśe pānīyamabhimaṃtrya aṣṭottareṇa pādau prakṣālayet | taptalohādi stabhanaṃ | lohita pīta mādāya raṇḍaṃ e tathaiva ca | vyāghrīrūpaddāṣu prakṣipya vacuke samanvitaṃ | padanena veṣṭayet | puṣpe prakṣipya etajjalastaṃbhanaṃ kārayet sudhīmān | rājādi sāmyādiṣu ākarṣaṃ(?) yat(?) śabde mekaṃ kathayet sāramuttamaṃ | vidveṣa nāni kathyaṃte | puraṃ mūle vidhūli dhānya prāpte | yadi ūrdhvaṃ vāhu tataḥ | kṛtvā vā nānu vartena bhrāmayet | yasya gṛhe ca kṣipet dhūli anyonyaṃ vidveṣayet | gṛhe ca kakhaho nityaṃ nikṣiptaṃ yatra tiṣṭhati | oṃ ṣaradhīranī <2> vidveṣanī dhūlanīye svāhā | amukāṃ amukayorvidveṣaṃ kuru uccāṭana karinīye svāhā | ākṛṣya jvālinī tat kathitaṃ yugathano ubhau svānau paraspara virodhimau tayordhūliṃ samādāya prasipedvayohi prati niṃvakāṣṭhāṃgāre nānyonyaṃ vidveṣayet | śatrūnātra kārya vicāraṇā | oṃ kālī karālinī mahiṣāsura vāhinī | amukā'mukavidveṣini svāhā | kailāśa ṣīṣare ramya devagandharva seviteḥ | nānādrumalatāṃ kīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite sukhāsīnaṃ
<112b>
jagannāthaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavī priyaṃ |
lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya bhairavī pṛcchate haraṃ |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
bhagavandevadeveśa sarvajña parameśvara | nānya bhrātā ca lokesmin trailokye sa carācare ||
tvaṃ bhrātā sarvabhūtānāṃ lokānāṃ caiva śaṃkara | teṣāṃ samupakārāya ca saṃkṣepena sureśvara ||
atha nānā valokesmin janāye dviṭ(?) prapīḍitāḥ | pītiḍitā vahubhirmukhairnityaṃ rodvigna cetasaḥ ||
vahukleśā yadā svalpa buddhi parākrame | evaṃ sarve klisya mānā vidyamāne (***) śvare(?)||
tvannāma guṇa <2> gāyantaḥ kaṃpate kleśa bhāginaḥ | bhītā(?) satyadharāni tyaṃye(?) devatithi pūjakāḥ ||
kena sadyena na teṣāṃ siddhirna vidyate sadā | tvayā deva pratijñātaṃ anuṣṭhānaṃ na naśyati ||
tatkathaṃ ca mahādeva anuṣṭhānopi naśyati | saṃśaya ca mahādeva kathayasva maheśvara ||
devānāmavadhūtānāṃ klīṣṭhānāṃ ca sureśvaraḥ |
śrībhairavovāca ||
kathayāmi mahābhāge lokānāṃ hitakāriṇī | na vistaraṃ ca saṃkṣepāt kathayiṣyaṃ samāsataḥ ||
yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ sārātsārataraṃ priye | ḍāmareti vikhyātā tasya nāma hi durlabhaṃ ||
tasya sārataraṃ sāraṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | trilokānāṃ hitārthāyamidṛṃśāstraṃ suśobhanaṃ ||
dināya dukhītāye ca kuleṣu ca rājakṣare ghṛtā | bhagnānāṃ hatatejānāṃ samupāyaṃ vadāmyahaṃ ||
saṃkṣepeṇa varārohe pravakṣyāmyanu pūrvaśaḥ | kartavyaṃ ca prayatnena gopanīyaṃ vadāmyahaṃ ||
satyamidaṃ prayogāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu bhairavī | kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ ||
ekānte nirvikalpena kartavyaṃ ca prayatnataḥ | gomayenopalipyātha catuḥkoṇaṃ tu maṇḍalān ||
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpāni samabhyarcya nivedayet | ānayitvā paṭṭasūtraṃ sindūre na vilepitaṃ ||
nirālaṃ svenataṃ dhāryā yathā saunamasīyate |
<113a>
maṃtracāsya pravakṣyāmi yena tatparimaṃtrayet |
oṃ namaścaṃḍikāyai girīṃ turī ṭha ṭha anena maṃtreṇa abhimaṃtrayet | śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yāvat | tena kumārikāṃ pūjayitvā proktavidhinā paṭṭaṃ darśayet | yasye niściṃtitaṃ naṣṭaṃ hṛtaṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇameva ca | iti vastraprasannam | athātaḥ khaḍgaprasannāṃ bhavati | tasya ca pūrvokta vidhinā pūjā kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmupavāsī bhūtvā tu mayaṃ caṃḍikāgratadūda manusmaret | oṃ caṃḍikāyai kliṃ <2> ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ idaṃ maṃtraṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ sahasramāvartayet | tataḥ prabhāte samaye devīṃ paṃcopacāreṇa vidhinā pūjayitvākṣu sarve upaviṣṭāsana śata puṣpamānayitvā | ekaikena puṣpena abhimaṃtritena devīhaṃtavyāḥ | tatra pūjayet khaḍgaṃ alikena vilipyamāyā agrato darśayet | te śubhā śubhe pṛcchanti khaḍgaṃ dhāryate |
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam | kartavyaṃ nirvikalpena siddhirbhavati nānyathā ||
kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ aṣṭamīṃścaivaścitile tuṣṭārayet(?) |
atha vatya(?) gṛhaṃ kuryādvasete tasya vai punaḥ | tailagandhaipuṣpai samabhyarcya puṣpebhya śobhite ||
mātuḥ pārśvamutaṃ kṛtvā raktasūtre yā vandhayet | pūjayitvā viśeṣena sa pīta vasudhā tale ||
maṃtreṇānena pūjyai tadvāraṃ tasya na tarkayet | tato sau nirvikalpena pravised gṛhamuttamaṃ ||
tatastaddarśaye darśayet sarvaṃ yatkiṃcin manasepsitaṃ | idaṃ maṃtraṃ smaret tatra pūjaniyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
oṃ namo maheśvarāya umā pataye sarvārthasiddhaye | namo uṣṇīṣe mahākaraṃbhrāyavikarahīṭha strīya ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ||
<113b>
kanyālābhādikaṃ caiva gamanāgamanameva ca | prītimeta ca lābhaṃ ca bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ vyādhimārogyaṃ priyameva ca | yuktaṃ samīpsitaṃ caite tataḥ sarvakathāya ca ||
evametadumāṃ devī vārāhindriyena gāmini | mātā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ hitāhitanidarśinī ||
iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre atharvaṇasahitāyāṃ prayogakhaṃḍaṃ samāptam |
śrīdevyuvāca |
devadeva mahādeva paramānandanandana | prasīdaguhyavaktrena kathayasva priyaṃvada ||
sarvataṃtreṣu maṃtreṣu guptaṃ yatpaṃcavaktrataḥ | tatprakāśayaguhyākhyaṃ yathā haṃtava vallabhā ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
kathaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi guhyayacca calātmike | strī svabhāvāt mahattatvaṃ jānāsi ca sukhapradaṃ ||
susthirāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi na vaktavyaṃ kadācana | tadā tava bhaviṣyaṃti bhāvanā maṃtrasiddhagā ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
devatāguru maṃtrākhyamekabhāvanamucyate | maṃtro yo guru devā ste(?) yo guru sa ca devatā ||
kālī tārā mahāguhyā ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśvarī | bhedavicchinnamastā ca vidyādhūmāvatī tathā ||
vagalāsiddhi vidyā ca mātaṃgī kamalātmikā | etādaśa mahāvidyā mahādevī prakīrtitāḥ ||
kālikarālī cāmuṇḍācchinnamastā ca bhairavī | harasiddhāsiddhilakṣmī bhrāmarī vātavī tathā ||
mahāmārī tāmasī ca mātaṃgī śavareśvarī | carcikā śivaruṇī ca mahāmahīṣamardinī ||
ugracaṇḍā kulikā ca phetkāri ca guhyakālāpi | etāste mūrtayo ghorā yāśca saumyā sureśvarī ||
atyanta durlabha loke ṣaḍāmnāya namaskṛtāḥ | etāśca paramāvidyā striṣu lokeṣu durlabhāḥ ||
sukhadā mokṣadā nityāṃ kleśasādhyā na tādṛśāḥ | yena yena prakāreṇa siddhiryāsyati bhūtale ||
<114a>
sarvaṃte kathayiṣyāmi tava bhāvena kevalaṃ | nātrasiddhādyapakṣāsti na ṛkṣādi vicāraṇā ||
kālādi śodhanaṃ nāsti na cāmitrādi dūṣaṇaṃ | siddhividyā mahāvidyā sugamaiva pariśramaṃ ||
nāsti kiṃcit mahādevī duḥkhasādhanaḥ kadācana | yā kāli paramā vidyā saivatārā prakīrtitā ||
yā tārā paramāvidyāścaturdhā kathitā purā | etayorbhedabhāvena namāmaṃtrā bhavaṃti hi ||
uktaṃ yatkālikā kalpe tārā kalpe ca te mayā | ṣoḍaśī yā mahāvidyā caturddhā kathitā purā ||
lakṣmī vījādi bhedena paṃcamī sā bhavediha | ekākṣarī mahāvidyā vījahinā bhavatpurā ||
bhuvaneśvarī tryakṣarī tu mahādevī prakīrtitā |
śrīdevyuvāca |
iṣṭavidyā ca devaśaḥ kathitā na prakāśitā | dadātiśca(?) dayābhāvāt kathayā nandasuṃdara ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
bhuvaneśī mahāvidyā devarājena vai purā | ārādhitā ca vidyeyaṃ vajrena nāmamohinī ||
ekākṣarī vījahīnā vāgbhaveno jvarāparāḥ | kāmarājākhya vidyāyā siddhāsā puṣpadhāvinā ||
śakreṇa pūjitā pūrvaṃ bhuvaneśī prakīrtitā | kumārī yā ca vidyeyaṃ tvayā satyavatī cyutā ||
kevalaṃ śivarūpena śaktirūpeṇa kevalaṃ | māyāpratiṣṭhitā vidyā tārāścandra svarūpiṇī ||
bhairavī tu mahāvidyā mahāsaṃpatpradāyinī | chinnamastā surāmāṃsa priyārakta svarūpiṇī ||
dhūmāvatī mahāvidyā māraṇoccāṭane ratāṃ | vagalāvaśya staṃbhādi nānāguṇasamanvitā ||
mātaṃgī tu mahāvidyā trailokya vaśakāriṇī | kamalā trividhā proktā ekākṣarā tathā sthitā ||
kevalā tu mahāsaṃpadāyanī sukhamokṣadā | guhyakālī mahāvidyā trailokye cāti durlabhā ||
devyuvāca |
<114b>
akṣamālā ca kathitā yatnato na prakāśitā | akṣamāleti kiṃ nāma phalaṃ vā kiṃ vadasva me ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
akṣamālā tu deveśī kāmvabhedādanekadhā | bhavaṃti śṛṇu tadbheda vistarā ucyate mayā ||
anulomavilomasya kṣiprayā varṇabhāṣayā | ādikāṃtakṣarī kānta krameṇa parameśvarī ||
kṣakāraṃ merusaṃrūpaṃ talaṃ payet kadācanaḥ | merū hīnā ca yā mālāmekala (*)(?) ca yā bhavet ||
aśraddhāniḥ prakāśā vasāmālā niḥphalā bhavet | viśinī viśatattvābhā brahmanāḍī gatāṃtarā ||
tayā saṃgrathitā madhye sarvakāmaphalapradā | aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā dadau klīvaṃ samācaret ||
kṣatrivarṇa trayaṃ taṃtutā ca klivaṃ pracakṣate | vargānāmaṣṭamo vāpi kāmabhedā kramena tu ||
akacaṭa tapayaśa hetyevaṃ cāṣṭavargataḥ | sphāṭike mokṣalābhaḥ syāt padmākṣe vahu putradā ||
putrajīve tu dhanadā pāṣāṇai sarvabhogadā | śuddha sphaṭikamālā tu mahāsaṃpatpradā priye ||
śmaśāna dhūkṣaraiḥ kāṣṭhairmālā dhūmāvatī vidhau | narāṃgulyasthibhirmālā grathitā parvabhedataḥ ||
sarvasiddhipradā mokṣa dāyinī varavarṇinī | nānā āsagrathane kārye rakte nābhā samāpriye ||
sadā gopyā prayatnena mātuśca jāravat priye | paṃcadhā kathitā mālā sarvasiddhiphalapradā ||
mauktikairgrathitā mālā sarvaiśvarya phalapradā | maṇiratna pravālaiśca hemarajatasaṃbhavā ||
mālākāryā purāgraṃthā sarvamokṣa phalapradā | nāḍibhirgrathitā mālā mahāsiddhi pradāpriye ||
triṃśadaiśvarya phaladā paṃcaviṃśastu mokṣadā | caturdaśamayi mokṣa dāyinī bhogavardhinī ||
paṃcadaśātmikā devī māraṇoccāṭane sthitā | staṃbhane mohane vaśye nirodhānejjanemanau ||
<115a>
pādukāsiddhisaṃge ca tāraṃ saṃkhyā prakīrtitā | aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryādathavā sarvakāmadaṃ ||
japaṃ nityaṃ kare kuryānna tu kāmyadhano vidhānāt | kāmyamapi kare kuryādyā mālā vai priyaṃvade ||
atrāṃgulī japaṃ kuryāt sāṃguṣṭhāṃgulibhirjapet | aṃguṣṭhena vinā karma kṛtaṃ tadaphalaṃ bhavet ||
anāmikā dvayapūrvaṃ kaniṣṭhādi krameṇa tu | tarjanī mūlaparyantaṃ karamālā prakīrtitā ||
meruṃ pradakṣīṇī kurvan anāmāmūla parvata | merūlaṃghanadoṣāttadanyathā jāyate phalaṃ ||
ārabhyānāmikāmūlāt prādakṣiṇya krameṇa tu | madhyato mūlaparyantaṃ meru kṛtvā na laṃghayet ||
tarjanyagre tathā madhye yojayet tatra mānavaḥ | catvāri tasya naśyaṃti āyurvidyā yaśobalaṃ ||
aṃguliṃ na vipūjita(?) kiṃcitsaṃkocayedvalaṃ | athāto graṃthanaṃ vakṣye mālānāṃ tatra bodhanaṃ ||
pūjāṃ vidhāya bhaktyā tu śuci pūrvamupoṣitaḥ | vijanagraṃthaye maunī svayaṃ mālāṃ sasādhakaḥ ||
kṛtanitya kriyaḥ śuddhaḥ śuddhakṣetre ca maṃtravit | yathākālaṃ yathālābhaṃ (***)(?) niyayatnataḥ ||
anyonya samarūpāṇi nāti sthūlakṛśāni ca | kīṭādibhiraduṣṭāni na nirṇoni cāni ca ||
gandhaiśca paṃcabhistānī prakṣālya ca pṛthak pṛthak | tato dvijendra puṇyastrī nirmitaṃ graṃthi varjitaṃ ||
triguṇaṃ triguṇī kṛtya paṭṭasūtramathāpi vā | śuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ śāntibhasmāni cārake ||
aśvasya patrairṇavakai padmākāreṇa sthāpitaiḥ | śubhramaniśca gandhāmukṣālitaṃ tatra nikṣipet ||
śmaśānavāriṇā vā pīṭhaprakṣāli tena ca | śuddhodakena raktena kastūrī kuṃkumena ca ||
tāraśaktiṃ mātṛkāṃ ca sūtre caiva maṇiṃ tathā | vinyasya pūjayedājyairjuhuyāccaiva yatnataḥ ||
<115b>
homakarmanya śaktaśced viguṇaṃ japamācaret | maṇimekaikamādāya sūtre saṃpātayet sudhīḥ ||
mukhe mukhaṃ tu saṃbhojye pucche pucche niyojayet | gopucchaśabdaśīkāryātha vā sarvākṛtirbhavet ||
tatsaṃpātāvamekākṣaṃ merutve cāgrato nyaset | ekaikamaṇi madhye tu brahmagraṃthī prakalpayet ||
japamālāṃ vidhāyetta tataḥ saṃskāramācaret | kṣālayet paṃcagavyena sadyojātena tajjalaiḥ ||
oṃ sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ | bhave bhave nāti bhave bhavaśca māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ ||
ṅeṃ tāṃ taṃ praṇavādyamenaṃ namo tena kramāmbujata(?) | candanā gurugandhādyairvāmadevena paryayet ||
oṃ vāmadevāya namo(?) balapramathanāya sarvabhūta damāya nalemanādve(##?) karavikaraṇāya namo valavīkaraṇāya namo valāyaḥ | namo valapramathanāya namaḥ | sarvabhūtadamanāya nama unmanonmanāya |
dhūpayennāmaghoreṇa tathā tatpuruṣena vaiḥ | oṃ aghorebhyotha ghorebhyo ghora ghoratarebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sarvasarvebhyo namastestu rūpebhyaḥ |
oṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāyadhimahi tato rudraḥ pracodayāt | maṃtroyaṃ paṃcame naiva pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ śataṃ īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvassarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇodhipatiṃ sadāśivomestu brahmā sadāsarvostu |
praṇavādyo mahāmaṃtraṃ sadāśiva iti kramāt | meruṃstu paṃcame naiva maṃtreṇa maṃtrayet tataḥ ||
saṃskṛtyaivaṃ budhomālāṃ tatprāṇāṃ tatra sthāpayet | bhūtamaṃtreṇa deveśī saṃpūjya bhaktibhāvataḥ ||
guruṃ saṃpūjyataddhastādgṛhṇīyādvakṣamālikāṃ | aśucirna spṛdeśe nāṃ gurorapi na darśayet ||
bhuktau muktau tathā duṣṭau madhyamāṃ vā japet sudhīḥ |
<116a>
aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu japeduttarakarmaṇi ||
tarjanyaṃ guṣṭhayogena māraṇoccāṭane japet | kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhayogena japetmāraṇakarmaṇi ||
japāṃtakāle tāṃ mālāṃ pūjayitvā sugopayet | japakāle sugoptadyā japamālā vaśā śubhā ||
guruṃ prakāśayedvidvān na tu maṃtraṃ kadācana | akṣamālāṃ ca mudrāṃ ca na kadācit prakāśayet ||
bhūtarākṣasavetāla siddhagandharva nāraṇāḥ | haraṃti prakaṃpaṃyat yasmāt tasmād guhyāṃ samācaret ||
jīrṇe sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ graṃthayitvā śataṃ japet | pramādāt patite hastāt śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet ||
tāvanniṣiddhasaṃsparśe kṣālayitvā tatorpitaṃ | japamālā mayā devī kathitā bhuvidurlabhā ||
sadāgopyā prayatnena yaditvaṃ mama durlabhā |
śrīdevyuvāca ||
sthānāsane devadeva kathayānaṃdasundaraḥ | yadācāryāvilaṃvena sarve maṃtrāḥ susiddhidāḥ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
nadītire bilvamūle śmaśāne śūnyaveśmani | mahāraṇye parvate vā yatra vā syān manolayaḥ ||
sthānante kathitaṃ devī āsanaṃ kathyate dhunā | vyāghrājinaṃ sārddhaṃ siddhau jñāna siddhau mṛgājinam ||
vastrāsanaṃ rogaharaṃ vetrajaṃ prītivardhanaṃ | kośeyaṃ puṣṭidaṃ proktaṃ kevalaṃ sarvasiddhidam ||
śuklaṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇaṃ viśeṣādrakta kaṃvalaṃ | mṛdukaṃvalamāstīrṇaṃ saṃgrāme patitaṃ hi tat ||
jaṃtuvyāpāditaṃ cāpi mṛtaṃ vā nāramāsanaṃ | garbhacyutatvavaṃ vāpi nārīṇāṃ yonijaṃ tvacaṃ ||
sarvasiddhipradaṃ devī sarvabhogasamṛddhidam | tva ca vā rauravaṃ sthānaṃ kuryādvītasti kāsanaṃ ||
śmaśāna kāṣṭhaghaṭitaṃ pīṭhaṃ vā yattu dāruṇaṃ | nādikṣito vīśejjātu kṛṣṇaśārājite gṛhī ||
<116b>
tadāsanaṃ ca nāsīta jātaka brahmacāriṇaḥ | kuśājināṃ nare nākhaṃ caturasaṃ samaṃtataḥ ||
ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturaṃgulamucchitaṃ | viśuddhe āsane kuryāt saṃskāraṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ ||
sadāsanaṃ bhogakaraṃ yogadaṃ kaurmamāsanaṃ | padmāsanamiti prāhuḥ sarvaiśvarya phalapradaṃ ||
ekaṃ vīrāsanaṃ devī āsanaṃ siddhidaṃ nṛṇāṃ | ūrdhva pāde sthito devīṃ viśeṣaparimaṇḍitaḥ ||
sarvāsanaṃ vāya śreṣṭhaṃ deverami(?) suduṣkaraṃ | padmāsanena deveśī pātāla gṛhasaṃsthitaḥ ||
rātrau yo vārcayeddevī dhanavān putravān bhavet | pīṭhānāṃ devi sarveṣāṃ caturdhāpīṭhamuttamam ||
jālandharaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ tathā pūrṇā ca valaṃ bhavet | oḍḍiyānaṃ mahādevi kāmarūpaṃ tathā mahat ||
