kṛte jālaṃdharaṃ jñeya tretāyāṃ pūrṇaparvatam | uḍḍiyāne dvāpare tu kāmarūpaṃ kalauyuge ||
mahāphalapradaṃ loke bhakṣaṇātsiddhidaṃ mahat | paṃcāśatpīṭha madhye tu kāmarūpaṃ mahāphalaṃ ||
japapūjā phalaṃ tatra devī lakṣaguṇo bhavet | vahudhā kathyate devī kiṃ tasya guṇavarṇanaṃ ||
yonirūpena yatrāste svayaṃ koṭi guṇātmakaṃ |
devyuvāca |
kevalaṃ validānena tuṣṭhā bhavatu caṇḍikā | kathitaṃ pūrvamasmabhyaṃ prakāśakuruśaṃkara ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
atyaṃta guhyadeveśi vidhānaṃ valipūjanaṃ | kathayāmi varārohe susthirā bhavasāmprataṃ ||
dadhikṣīraṃ guḍaṃ sāṃnnaṃ pāyasaṃ sarvasamanvitaṃ | pāyasāt kṣaudramāṃsaṃ ca nārikelaṃ sa modakaṃ ||
rāsakaṃ bhikṣu khaṃḍaṃ vā sārdrakaṃ sakṣākaraṃ | raṃbhāphalaṃ laḍukaṃ ca nirjitā taṃtu puṣṭikaṃ ||
kṛṣṇachāgaṃ mahāmāṃsaṃ godhikāhariṇī tathā | jalajaṃ matsyamāsaṃ ca gaḍa(?)kīmāṃsameva ca ||
śānamatsyaṃ tu pāvīnaḥ sa kulaṃvikaṃ tathā | madguru ca nisaṃdadyāt māṃsaṃ mahiṣameva ca ||
pakṣimāsaṃ varārohe ḍiṃbhanānā samudbhavaṃ | nānāvīja narādhāni vyaṃjanāni madhuni ca ||
<117a>
iṣṭapīdyaṃ ghṛte nāktaṃ niśāyāṃ divasepi vā | valiṃ dayā viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇapakṣe śubhe dine ||
gacchadanta bhava vāpi matsya dantakavidhruvaṃ | māheṣe dhanasiddhiḥ syāt mṛge bhogaphalaṃ bhavet ||
pakṣidante mahardhi syāpi duṣṭasiddhiranuttayā | lalāṭahasti hṛdayaśiroka madhyadeśataḥ ||
svadeha rudhire dane rudradeha dravo paraḥ | vāṃśanāla validānena mahāsiddhiḥ prajāyate ||
surādānena deveśī mahāyogeśvaro bhavet | surā tu trividhā devī sphāṭikī ḍākinī tathā ||
kālikī sphāṭikī dāne dhanavṛddhiranuttamā | ḍākinīdānamātreṇa sarvavasyo bhavet dhruvaṃ ||
kāmīki surayā devī yorcayet parameśvarīṃ | guṭikāṃjana staṃbhādi māraṇoccāṭanādibhiḥ ||
mahāsiddhīśvaro bhūtvā vaset kalpāyutaṃdavi | arghodatte maheśāni mahāsiddhiranuttamāḥ ||
raktacandanavilvādi javākusuma varvaro | arpandatvā maheśāni sarvakāmārtha siddhayaḥ ||
surayā cārghadānena yoginīnāṃ bhavet priya | mahāyogī bhaveddevī pīṭhaprakṣāliterjalaiḥ ||
svayaṃbhū kusume dante bhavet ṣaṭkarmasādhana | susītalajalairvāpī kasturī kuṃkumānvitaiḥ ||
kuṇḍagolotthavāṃjaiva sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | sāyadhavārati saṃbhūtaṃ kuṇḍabhūtamabhūtidaṃ ||
vidhavāranisaṃbhūtaṃ golaṃ siddhi pradaṃ bhuvi | mūlamaṃtreṇa deveśī ākṛṣyanirbhayaḥ śuci ||
arpadapādviśeṣeṇa(?) cakraṃ vāmena pūjitaṃ | svayaṃbhu kusumaṃ devī trividhaṃ bhuvi jāyate ||
ṣoḍaśādanaḍhāyā untayā(?) sarvasiddhidā | valātkāleṇa ūṭhāyā madhyamā bhogavardhinī ||
rājayoga ca śādanyā adhamā sukhadāyinī | kumārī pūjane śakto kroṇārī svapnayī smaret ||
<117b>
ākṛṣya vaṃdhayogena kuṇḍagolotthapucchakaṃ | sarvaṃ kuryāt prayatnena nirbhayaḥ śucimānasaḥ ||
tāmrapātre kapāle vāṇaśāna kāṣṭhanirmite | śanibhīmadine vāpi śarīraṃ mṛtasaṃbhave ||
svarṇaraupya tathā lohaṃ vā cakramarcya vidhānataḥ | puṣpāṇyapi tathā dadyādukta kṛṣṇaśitāni ca ||
śvetaraktaṃ tathā puṣpaṃ karavīraṃ tathā priye | tagaramallikātāniṃ varvarī yūthikā tathā ||
dhattūrāśokavakulā śvetā kṛṣṇā parājitā | raktapuṣpaṃ bilvapatraṃ caṃpakaṃ nāgakeśaraṃ ||
mallikā kiṭīkācī raktaṃ yatparikīrtitaṃ | arkapuṣpaṃ javāpuṣpaṃ ca para ca priyaṃvade ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣena saṃtuṣṭā tasya pārvatī | padmapuṣpe na raktena saṃtuṣṭā sarvadevatā ||
kṛṣṇā vā yadi vā yuktaṃ kālikā varadā bhavet | śmaśāna dhature naiva tuṣṭā dhūmāyatī parā ||
śmaśāna prīti puṣpena saṃtuṣṭā kāli bhavet | vanapuṣpai vividhaiḥ saṃtuṣṭā pārvatī parāḥ ||
āmalakyā tu patreṇa tuṣṭā puṣpeṇa pārvatī | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ nānāpuṣpai samarcayet ||
śmaśāne rātriśeṣe vā śanibhauma dine niśi |
śrīdevyuvāca |
rahasyāti rahasyaṃ me puraścaryā vidhiprabho | vadasva paṭṭamuṣṇāsāt sarvakāmā bhavaṃti hi ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
gṛhītvā sadguro dīkṣā śubhe kāle divāniśi | uttamo vāmamārgaśca madhyamaḥ saiva dīkṣitaḥ ||
surāyā dīkṣito yo vai svayaṃbhūḥ paramo guruḥ | caturdaśa sahasrāṇi sevite hariśaṃ bhuje ||
tato bhavati deveśīḥ prāyapūjārataḥ pumān | kāyena manasā vācā surāvara jaṭādibhiḥ ||
saṃtoṣya parayā bhaktyā gurudīkṣāṃ samācaret |
<118a>
pūrvoktasthānamāśritya japapūjā samāśrayaḥ ||
prātaḥkālaṃ samārabhya japenmadhyaṃ dināvadhiḥ | prathamehani japtavyaṃ japtavyaṃ taddine dine ||
nyūnādhikaṃ na japtavyaṃ asamāpte sadā japet | gate prathamamāse tu tṛtīyapraharāvadhiḥ ||
niśāyāṃ ca prajaptavyaṃ rātrī śeṣe japenna ca | haviṣyaṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ ekavīraḥ su saṃyata ||
sadya(?) hāraṃ prakurvīta yuvatī pūjane rataḥ | svastrīmanyastrīyaṃ vāpi pūjayet parvaparvasu ||
nādhame saṃgatiḥ kāryā sarvaprāṇi hiterataḥ | yasyā vā yajjapaḥ proktastadvaṇaṃ śamanu kramāt ||
tattaddravyairjapasyāṃte homaṃ kuryāddine dine | homajapadaśāṃśena tapana proktameva ca ||
tarpaṇasya daśāṃśena śiromārjāramīṣyate | taddaśāṃśena vipreṃdrān yuvatī kulakanyakāḥ ||
saṃyojayet prīti yutairdravyairnānāvidhairapi | homādyaśakto deve'sī kuryāt tāvad guṇaṃ japaṃ ||
yadi pūjādya śaktasyāddravyābhāvena sundarī | kevalaṃ japamātreṇa puraścaryā vidhiyate ||
didhi vā yadi vākāśe bhuvi vā sādhakottamaḥ | svecchācāra parobhūtvā ekānte sarvadāpayet ||
matsyamāṃsādi nādena śaktaḥ kuryāt puraskṛtiṃ | ekarātrau śmaśāne vā śave vā prauḍhavālayoḥ ||
mayoktaṃ bhairavī kalpaṃ vidhānaṃ varavarṇinī | hastamātre vīrayāte kuṇḍe vā vijane vane ||
vīrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ devī sādhanaṃ bhuvidduḥkhahaṃ | kumārī pūjanādeva puraścaryā vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
nānājāti bhavākanyā yasya tāruṇyasaṃyutā | atyaṃta prauḍhavālā vā kokilā varavādinī ||
nānādravyairvaraphalairbhakṣabhojyādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ | pūjayet parabhāvena nānārūpa manoharā ||
bhaginī kanyakā cāpi dohitrī vā kuṭumvinī | mātṛvarjyaṃ sadā pūjyā nānājāti samudbhavā ||
<118b>
athavānya prakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate | sūryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvat sūrya kṣayaṃ bhavet ||
sahasrasaikhyajaptastu puraścaraṇamiṣyate | kṛṣṇāṃ caturdaśī prāpya navamyaṃ taṃ mahotsavaiḥ ||
aṣṭamīṃ navamīṃ vādau pūjāṃ kuryād viśeṣataḥ | navamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāt matsyamāṃsādibhiḥ priye ||
ṣaṭsahasraṃ japennityaṃ bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇaḥ | caturdaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadanyā caturdaśī ||
tāvajjapte maheśāni puraścaraṇamiṣyate | kevalaṃ japamātreṇa maṃtraḥ siddhyati nānyathā ||
vinā homādi dānena viśeṣāt pīṭhapūjanaiḥ | yoni pīṭhasamaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ tathāparaiḥ ||
tayorakatamaṃ rudra deha eka ivāparaḥ | tīrthe tīrthe viśeṣeṇa grahaṇe candrasūryayo ||
gurovatuṃgrahaṃ caiva dīkṣākāle śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ | adha devī pravakṣyāmi guptaṃ tribhuvaneśvarīṃ ||
yāptārādhyaṃ purā sarvo bhūti rājāṃ bhavatpurā | brahmārudra sahasrākṣo māyāśiva savo bhavāḥ ||
śaktirmāyā maheśāni vidyāvasva kṣarā parā | ṛṣīrbrahmāvirācchado devatā lokapāvanī ||
mahāmāyeti vikhyātā vījalakṣmī prakīrtitā | mayāśakti kilakaṃ ca śaiva dehamudāhṛtaṃ ||
ṣaḍaṃgāni tataḥ kuryāt māyayā dīrghamuktaye | dhyānaṃ devī pravakṣyāmi sarveśvarya phalapradaṃ ||
vidyutpuṃjanibhāṃ devī raktapadmāsanasthitāṃ | trinetrāṃ vādabhe vāsāṃ pāṇi viṃśati saunitāṃ ||
pītarakta śvetakṛṣṇa dhūmraṃ kapālamauktikaṃ | nīlapicchaṃ pavitrāṇi vaṇāti(?) kathitāni vai ||
khaḍgaṃ śūlaṃ gadāṃ cakraṃ śaṃkhacāpaḥ śarāni ca | (**********)(?) śastrāḍhyāṃ muśaladāvaninathāpaḥ(##(?)
kartrīmudrāṃ tathā yogamudrāṃ ca dadhatīṃ karaiḥ | śūlaśaktidharāṃ devīṃ sarvasiddhiphalapradāṃ ||
<119a>
pūjāyaṃtraṃ pravakṣyāmi ṣaṭkoṇaṃ śaktisaṃyutaṃ | ṣaḍaṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍaśadalai padmaṃvārasamanvitaṃ ||
trikoṇaṃ pūjayed devī māyāvāṇiharimrite(?) | iti prītikṣamā pūjyā tuṣṭi ptake(?) mano bhavā ||
yoganidrā mahānidrā mahāmāyā ca suṃdarī | mahāmudrā mahāsvapnā ṣaṭdaleṣu prapūjayet ||
vidyāparamavidyā ca mahāvidyā varapradā | saumyā paramasaumyā ca mahāsaumyā parāyaṇā ||
kālarātrī mahārātrī mahāgātrī mahātmikā | prakṛtirvikṛtirmedhā viśvarūpā kramādipāḥ ||
mahāmattā pragalbhā ca unmattā madagāminī | mahāprahlāda vikalā harṣaṇā vihvalāṃ tathā ||
vikaṭā vahurūpā ca mahārūpā mahipradā | ghorarāvā mahānityā bhaṃjabhuṃjalabhāṣiṇī ||
sarvadā sundarī pūjyā pravaraprakramāt priye | indrādayā tataḥ pūjyā sarvato digvidikṣu ca ||
caturdvāre tataḥ pūjyā bhagaklinnā bhagakṣa (*) | bhagamedhā bhagākhyā ca vidhinā vāmavartmanāṃ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjitā devī caturlakṣaṃ japetmanuṃ | homādi vidhinā kuryād daśāṃśa kramataḥ priye ||
anavayā vidhinā devī mahāsiddhīśvaro bhavet | dhanavān putravān sudhī bhogī mahāvalaḥ ||
rājyalakṣmīmavāpnoti devīputraḥ sadaiva hi | bhuvaneśī bhagavatī vahni jāyārcito mamu(?) ||
saptākṣaro mahādevī sarvasiddhi phalapradaḥ | svarṇavarṇanibhāṃ devīṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāṃ ||
kṣauma vāsāṃ trinayanāṃ śailaśṛṃgasamanvitāṃ | athavā śailasiṃhā ca iṃdrāṇī ratha devatā ||
evaṃ dhyātvā japet pūrvaṃ samastaṃ samāsataḥ | tadā kālaṃ tu tajjāpyaṃ maṃtraṃ sarvasamṛddhidaṃ ||
śivaṃ vāmena saṃyuktaṃ śrotreṇa dvitayaṃ priye | brahmāmukhena saṃyukto dvirāvṛtya manukramāt ||
nayanena samāyukta śakrānvita tayā gataḥ | dayā yukto manurayaṃ sarvavidyā phalapradaḥ ||
<119b>
vījaṃ śakti kilakaṃ ca ādyaṃta madhyayogataḥ | ṣaṭdīrghabhājā vījena ṣaḍaṃgāni prakalpayet ||
kālī karāla vadanāṃ naramālāvibhūṣitāṃ | caturhastāṃ trinayanā matsyamāṃsa karāṃvujāṃ ||
kapālacitra khaḍvāṅga dhāriṇī bhīmavādinīṃ | kaṭīcarmaparīdhānāṃ śuṣkamāṃsāni bhairavāṃ ||
trailokya grasamānāsyāṃ jihvā dvitaya bhīṣaṇāṃ | nimagna vartulārakta nayanatraya śobhitāṃ ||
evaṃ dhyātvā tato devī kulapīṭhe manohare | trikoṇaṃ caturasraṃ tu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ navakoṇakaṃ ||
vṛttaṃ dalāṣṭamarthaṃ ca caturasraṃ likhedbudhaḥ | trikoṇeṣṭa yajed devīṃ caṇḍāṃ caṇḍavibhānanām ||
caṇḍakālī ca caṇḍālī pracaṇḍākālanāyikāṃ | ṣaṭvā maṃtrā kramo devīṃ pūjayed vidhinā yathā ||
japatuṃḍa mahogrā ca bhīmāṃbhīmakapālikāṃ | aṭṭahāsinī vidyā nityāṃ pragalbhāṃ ghorarūpiṇīṃ ||
śuṣkabhīmāṃ yajed devīṃ vasukoṭi parātmike | atīkālī mahākālī mahānityāṃ mahāphalaṃ ||
vicitrāṃ citrarūpāṃ ca bhīmanādīnīnādinī | aghorāṃ pūjayed devīṃ datvāṃtadigvidikṣu ca ||
iṃdrādayaḥ tataḥ pūjyāṃ lakṣyamaṃtraṃ sadā japet | sarvāṃ kāmānavāpnoti divyāṃ bhogān rasātalāṃ ||
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi mahāvidyā mahāphalaṃ | nādavindu samāyuktaṃ māyā(?)vījamudāhṛtaṃ ||
vījaṃ maṃtreṇasaṃyuktaṃ pātena sahitaṃ priyaṃ | nādabiṃdu samāyuktaṃ dvitīyaṃ vījamuttamaṃ ||
sarve sūryapradaṃ vahni tāyāṃte manuruttamaḥ | ṛṣī sadāśivo syāstu gāyatrī chanda ucyate ||
devatāśuṃbhamathanī sarvadevanamaskṛtā | athavarjita deveśi ṣaṭdīrgheṇa ṣaḍaṃgake ||
athāta vīja yogena vījaśakti śarīrakaṃ | dhyāyeddevī trinayanāṃ pannaidī(?) varalocanāṃ ||
<120a>
padmaviṃvasamānāṃgī cārū caṃdranibhānanāṃ | aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ nityaṃ siṃhapṛṣṭhe samāśritāṃ ||
koṭi koṭi guṇairarcyāṃ(?) pāśāṃkuśa dhanukarāṃ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaghaṇṭāmudgarapaṭṭiśāṃ ||
carmakhaḍgamahāṣaṣṭhī kapālakarkaśāśvarān(?) | atha dhāpāṇi śatasaṃpūraṇe rati saṃyutāṃ ||
trikoṇāntara ṣaṭkoṇe dalāṣṭa pariśobhitā | padme trikoṇa madhye tu sivādikalālatā(?) ||
ṣaṭkoṇe pūjayed devīṃ kālīcaṇḍāṃ pracaṃḍikāṃ | icchāmūrti sadābhīmāṃ śivāni vāsavartmanā ||
athāṣṭadala madhye tu brahmādi mātaraḥ kramāt | vrāhmī māheśvarī skaṃdī vaiṣṇavī sāṃkarī tathā ||
narasiṃhī tathā caṇḍī śivadūtī prabhedataḥ | yathāvarṇaṃ yathāśāstraṃ dhāriṇyo yoginī gaṇā ||
indrādayastata pūjyā dvāranaṃdī mahāvale | paramo vijayaścaiva puṣpāṃjali yayairyajet ||
paṃcalakṣaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ taddhomādi daśāṃśataḥ | anayāsaraśī vidyā triśūlokeṣu durlabhā ||
kevalaṃ mapnuyatnena kathitāṃ kulasundarī | kramādvidyā maheśāni samastā yā hi pūjayet ||
na kiṃciddurllabhaṃ tasya (**********)(?) vidyate |
ihaloke sukhaṃ sarva devī gaṇamatonyataḥ | goptavyaṃ tatprayatnena yasmaikasmai na vinyaset ||
[iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre atharvaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ guhyakālividhānapaṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
nanameja guruṃ vipraṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ nṛpaṃ | ṣoḍhānyāsa vihino ya praṇamya parameśvarī ||
socirāt mṛtyumāpnoti narakaṃ pratipadyate | ādrāsya nanyasya nyāsāna śuṣkena kadācana ||
sahasradhānyasadgātre bhajanyā valipūrvakaṃ | vāmāṃgaśaktisaṃnaddhā kaṭākṣa sneha vikṣitaṃ ||
tāṃvūlamṛganābhaṃ ca jātipacaṃdādrākṣādyanaṃ |
<120b>
kramakalāgalidevapuṣpaṃ jātiphalaṃ vātimatsyaṃ tathāmiyaṃ vā ||
kṛtvā mukhe svaguruṇoditaṃvaityā sarājakaṃnānayā sadṛśaṃ |(?) maṃtramīhabrahmāṇḍamaṇḍale yasya mātreṇa rājarājobhaveddhruvaṃ ||(?)
catupaṃjara madhye tu tadetadvajrapaṃjaraṃ | tripurasya vadhārthāya svayaṃ devena nirmitaṃ ||
trailokyavijayī rudrastardhāsasya prabhāvataḥ | deveśīṃ kavaca divyaṃ nāstamātreṇa bhairavaḥ ||
mahāyobrahmatavyāṃ vātsākṣātparaḥ śivo bhavet | mama navātma saṃdeho nigrahānugrahe kṣamaḥ ||
vajraṣoḍhā mahānyāsairbrahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ | devāḥ sarve namaśyanti kimutānye munīśvarāḥ ||
kālīṣaṭka paranyāśaṃ yaḥ karoti dine dine | devā sarve namasyaṃti namāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||
tirthāni yānī saṃtīhabhūmidivyamarikṣagāḥ | tāsu snānena yatpuṇyaṃ nyastamātreṇa labhyate ||
kiṃ kurukṣetradānena rāhugraste divākare | kiṃ kāśyāṃ maraṇe naiva prayāge vā tanuṃ tyajet ||
kiṃ gayā piṇḍadānena (*)(?) ṣoḍhānyāsamācaret | kimutyāgena yogena brahmajñānena vāṣikiṃ ||
tu nā puruṣadānena kiṃ vā sāṇe yadāseta | mahādānādinā samyak śrīkuryādvahusādhane ||
aśvame pādikaṃ vāpi ṣoḍāyāna turīya vāk | sarvatīrtheṣu sasnāta sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ||
brahmahatyādi pāpāni koṭiśopi vilīyate | yāni kāni ca pāpāni munibhiḥ kathitāni vai ||
tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti ṣoḍhānyāsa parāṃgataḥ | na ṣoḍhā sadṛśo nyāso na ṣoḍhā sadṛśo japaḥ ||
na ṣoḍhā sadṛṣī pūjā na soḍhā śahaśo japaḥ | sarvakarmāṇi saṃtyajya ṣoḍhānyāsaṃ samācaret ||
ihaiva prāpnuyāt saukhyaṃ rājarājo bhaved dhruvaṃ | dhanadarapana sā bhūtiryābhūtiḥ sādhakasya tu ||
<121a>
sarvaśatrurvinaśyanti bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidhaṃ | brahmojjvalo bhaved vipra kṣatriyo vinayī bhavet ||
vaiśyastu vahuratnāḍhyāḥ śūdrasukhamavāpnuyāt | divā ca brahmacaryeṇa rātrau kuryādyathecchayā ||
vāmadakṣiṇa yogena mahānyāśaṃ samācaret | sahasrā vartate naiva puraścaraṇamucyate ||
tadeva saṃkhyayā devī ājñāsiddhimavāpnuyāt | ayutena khecaranyaṃ lakṣena bhairavo bhavet ||
melāpatvaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ dvilakṣena bhaveddhruvaṃ | etatparataraṃ nāsti kaulike kula śāsane ||
satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | nānayā śadṛśī vidyā triṣulokeṣu vidyate ||
eṣa eva paraṃ tatvaṃ eṣa eva paraṃ tapa | eṣa eva paraṃ jñānaṃ etad mokṣasya sādhanaṃ ||
sarvakarmāṇi satyajyaṃ sarvadharmani pārvatī | eṣanyāsaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭaṃ kuruṣvamadanugrahāt ||
sarvāvasthā gato vāpi na tyājyaṃ kālikānvaye | sadgurostu sukhoddiṣṭaṃ yadi ṣoḍhā tu labhyate ||
mātāparataraṃ kiṃcin nābhosti dharaṇī tale | saṃpradāya vihīnāya na dadyāt śaktīrūpiṇe ||
brahmavidyā svarūpā hi bhukti mukti phalapradā | gopitavyā prayatnena svayoniriva sarvadā ||
vinā guru prasādena kālī ṣoḍhā karmaṃ priye | dṛṣṭvā prajapyate yastu tad bhakṣī yoginī gaṇaḥ ||
narake niyataṃ vāso pātayet pūrvajānapi | riktahastaṃ na gṛhnīyāt nyāsaṃ bhuvana vanditaṃ ||
na siddhyati paraṃ tasya kṛtvā varṣa śatairapi | vittasoḍhyaṃ na kurvīta guruṃ saṃtoṣayet sudhīḥ ||
gajairasvaidhanairvāpi vastrālaṃkāravistaraiḥ | svātma priyābhirvahubhiḥ prathamaṃ guruṃ toṣayet ||
mithyācādaṃ na kuryāt tu guruṃ naiva tu vaṃcayet | gurau saṃtuṣṭamaṇi tu kālikā tuṣṭidā bhavet ||
<121b>
vinā guruprasādena siddhirna labhate dhruvaṃ | yaṃ yaṃ cintayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti lilayā ||
na vīrasā dharā nāpi na catuḥpī sevanāt | naniśāntanataḥ siddhi yathānyāsena bhairavī ||
sākṣāddevī mayo bhūtvā sādhako vicared bhuvi | parakṛtyādi khākhādedabhicāra grahādikaṃ ||
sakṛdeva vinaśyaṃti ugranyāsena bhairavī | sahasrāvartane nāpi sākṣāt parasito bhavet ||
maṃtre naivātra saṃdeho nigrahānugrahe kṣamaḥ | nāsti nāsti samaṃ tasya kālikāsra(?)yaśāsane ||
bhairavohaṃ śivohaṃ ca bhavayitvā tato nyaset | mahādhūpena dīpena alinā yojitena vā ||
puruṣaṃdhīpuṣpayogena guru saṃtoṣanena ca | svayaṃbhū kusume naiva kuṇḍagod bhavena ca ||
nābhi kāsmira candena raktacandana hetunā | śuṣkī kṛtya tu guṭikāṃ tilakaṃ tena kārayet ||
tataḥ kṛtvā mahānyāsaṃ śivaśakti samāgataḥ | ājñāsiddhirbhavet tasya satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvarī ||
tasya siddhirbhavet satyaṃ kaulike kālikānvaye | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prayogaṃ taṃ nibodhayaḥ ||
[iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre atharvaṇa saṃhitāyāṃ guhyakāliṣoḍhā prasaṃsā paṭalaḥ] ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
kālikrame kulaṣoḍhā nyāso bhairavi durlabhaḥ | yaḥ karoti mahārātrau tasyājñā bhuvanatraye ||
kālikramamahāṣoḍhā nyāsātsākṣāt śivo bhavet | yaṃ nāsti taṃ na siddhiḥ syānnigrahānugrahe kṣamaḥ ||

oṃ hrīṃ huṃ śrīṁ phraṁ aṃ āṃ asitāṃga bhairava brahmavatī vetyāye maṃgalā phreṃ chraṃ huṃ hrīṃ oṃ śrī sirasi oṃ <4> kāṃ rurubhairava māheśvaravatī raudritī ityāyī carcikā phreṃ priṃ huṃ hīṃ hrīṃ oṃ śrī<0> mukhe oṃ <4> cāṃ caṃḍabhairava kaumāravatī ihāpī yonāpī kaivatī phreṃ <4> śrīkaṃṭhe oṃ <4> ṭha ṭho krodhabhairavaviṣṇuvatīrīśāpīharasiddhyai ṣaṭki phreṃ <4> śrīśrī hṛdaye oṃ <4> tāṃ ḍa(?)mattabhairavarāhavatī ḷṇābhaṣṭāpīkaṃdukī phreṃ <4> śrī<0> nābhau oṃ yāṃ kāpālī bhairava indravatī ailāyī rajakī phreṃ <4> śrīliṃge oṃ yā bhīṣaṇa bhairava cāmuṇḍavatī oṃ surapīkālarātrīkṣipinī phreṃ <4> śrī<0> skadhe oṃ <4> śyāṃ saṃhāra bhairava caṃḍīvatī mahālakṣmīvatī ahalāvabhīṣanī devīnī phreṃ <4> śrīmūlādhāre khphreṃ mahācaṇḍayogeśvarī anākhyāṃ kālakālī phaṭ pādu<0> sarvāṃge iti mātṛkānyāsaḥ tataḥ pīṭhanyāśaḥ hrīṃ śrīṃ phreṃ aṃdaghānamahāpīṭhe vipanyaṃ vā śrī<0> śirasi <3> oṃ jālaṃdharapīṭhe pīṭhayaṃ(?) vā śrī<0> mukhe <3> pūrṇagirīpīṭhe puraṃdhrī paṃcā śrī<0> <1> dakṣanetre <3> īkāmarūpapīṭhe oṃ citpaṃcā śrī<0> vāmanetre oṃ prayāgakṣatre caityaṃ vā śrī<0> dakṣakarṇe <3> vārāṇasīkṣetre sautriṇyai vā śrī<0> vāmakarṇe <3> ṛṃkulāpurakṣetre kevalyaṃ pā śrī<0> dakṣanāsāpuṭo śambhū aṭṭahāsa kṣaye pradūkyaṃ vā śrī<0> vāmanāsāpuṭe <3> ḷṁ jayaṃtīkṣetre kadutyaṃ vā śrī<0> dakṣagaṃḍe ḷṃ
<126a>
caritra kṣetre rajakīnyaṃ vā śrī<0> vāmagaṃḍe <3> aiṃ ekāṃ bhukṣetre chippinyaṃ vā śrī<0> uddhvauṣṭhe <3> ai devī koṭakṣetre kodyanyaṃ vā śrī<0> adharoṣṭhe <3> oṃ rudramahopakṣetre agnivakṣāṃ vā śrī ūrdhvadaśane <3> auvirājakṣetre aṃvikāṃ vāṃ śrī<0> adhodaśane <3> aṃhastināpurī kṣetre piṃgākṣaṃ vā śrītāluṇī <3> aḥ elāpura mahākṣetre ṣarāsyaṃ vā śrīmukhe <3> kaṃgokarṇamahopakṣetre piṃgākṣaṃ vā śrī<0> dakṣavāhau <3> khaṃ maruvaka mahākṣetre maṃnyaṃ vā śrī<0> kūrpare <3> gaṃ naga mahākṣetre piṃgākṣaṃ vā śrī<0> maṇivaṃdhe <3> ghaṃ paraśūvardhanamahākṣetre cāmuṇḍāṃ vā śrī<0> aṃguliṣu <3> oṃ nepālamahākṣetre guhyeśvaryaṃ vā śrī<0> nakheṣu <3> caṃ kāsmīra mahākṣetre soradāṃvā śrī<0> vāmavāhau <3> chaṃgārdaharaṇakṣetre pārvatya vā śrī<0> kūrpare <3> aṃkurubha kṣetre jayeśvaryaṃ vā śrī<0> maṇivandhe <3> jhaṃ sindhukṣetre kūlālyaṃ vā śrī<0> aṃgulīṣu <3> traṃbhogapurakṣetre helīkhaṃ vā śrī<0> nakheṣu <3> ṭaṃ rājapurakṣetre avikāṃ vā śrī<0> dakṣakaṭyāṃ <3> ṭhaṃ mahendrapūrakṣetre mahāmāyāṃ vā śrī<0> jānau <3> uṃ anamavaidyakṣetre raktāṃ vā śrī<0> gulphe <3> ṭaṃkūravakṣetre kaṃkālyaṃ vā śrī<0> aṃgulīmūleṣu <3> naṃ ekakoṇapīṭhakṣetre trikoṇāṃ vā śrī<0> nakheṣu <3> ṣaṃ ekavīrapīṭhakṣetre mātaṃgīnyaṃ vā śrī<0> dakṣapārśve <3> haṃ halakṣetre śivadutyaṃ vā śrī<0> vāmapārśve <3> vaṃ śrī śailaparvate kṣetre satyaṃ vā śrī<0> pṛṣṭhe <3> bhadroṇa kṣetreśikyaṃ vā śrī<0> nābhau <3> maṃchāyāṃ kṣatrapurapīṭhe kṣetre cāmuṇḍāṃ vā śrī udare <3> yaṃ śailajapīṭhe kṣetre trijaṭāṃ vā śrī<0> hṛdaye <3> raṃ hakaka u kṣetre triśakyaṃ vā śrī<0> dakṣavāhu sikhare <3> laṃ devī koṭa
<126b>
kṣetre mātṛkāṃ vā śrī<0> vāmavāhu śikhare <3> vaṃ mahāmātṛ kṣetre mātṛkākṣetre kāpālinyaṃ vā śrī<0> śiṣāyāṃ <3> śaṃmacchedrapurakṣetre puramālinyaṃ vā śrī<0> hṛdīdakṣahastāṃ (*)(?) <3> ṣaṃ malayaṃtra mahāpīṭha kṣetre maṃtresvaryaṃ vā śrī<0> hṛdādi vāmahastāṃ taṃ <3> samālavapīṭhakṣetre ugrakālyāṃ vā śrī<0> hṛdādi dakṣapādāntaṃ <3> haṃ udyānapīṭhakṣetre raktacaṇḍāṃ vā śrī<0> hṛdayādi vāmapādāntaṃ <3> laṃ jālaṃdharaṃ pīṭhakṣetre kāmanākṣā vā śrī<0> hṛdaye <3> kṣaṃ pūrṇagirīpīṭhe mahāgrīvāṃ vā śrī<0> śirasi aṃ <50> kāmarūpapīṭhe manodbhavāṃ vāṃ śrī<0> vyāpakaṃ | oṃ hrīṃ huṃ hāṃ phreṃ mayeya haramahākhyāduya auṣa eṣavarī aṃ vā śrī pādukāṃ pūjāyāmi namaḥ sarvāṃge iti pīṭha nyāsaḥ ||
tato maṃtravarganyāśaḥ ||
sahasrākṣarī | oṃ hrīṃ huṃ phreṃ namo bhagavati caṇḍabhairavī vikaṭotkaṭa daṃṣṭrā raudrī huṃ <3> phaṭ <3> saṃdhyasthāne ūrdhvakeśī lolajihve sahasra dvayakara caraṇe sahasranetre sa vā śeṣaṃ cūrṇaya <2> māṃsarudhirapriye gṛhna <2> hana <2> kara <2> māraya <2> bhakṣa <2> śoṣaya <2> cośraya <2> śrīmahāyoginyai namaḥ | brahmarandhre maheśvarī sarvabhāvāt puṇyāpaya <2> huṃ strīṃ <2> huṃ phreṃ chreṃ huṃ huṃ nānārūpadharī hrīṃ <2> jrīṃ <2> prīṃ <2> prīṃ <2> śrīṃ <2> vrīṃ <2> trīṃ <2> śrīṃ <2> hrīṃ mama mahāsiddhiṃ dada <2> rasa <2> kṣau <2> śrau <2> sroṃ <2> proṃ <2> hrauṃ <2> krīṃ <2> hraiṃ ptāṃ <2> mrāṃ <2> kṣrīṃ <2> hrīṃ icchayā manasā vacasā sarvaṃ kuru <2> bhrīṃ <2> strīṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> huṃ phaṭ sirasi | śrīguhyakālike śrī <2> dhrīṃ <2> strīṃ <2> phreṃ <2> mahāmāye icche idaṃ dada sarvakarmakarī hrīṃ <2> prīṃ <2> phrīṃ <2> bhrī <2> ṣṭrīṃ <2> strīṃ <2> prīṃ <2> chrīṃ <2> hrīṃ <2> citte padakirī <2> ānaya <2> praviśraya <2> kuru <2> culu <2> kha <2> kara <2> strīṃ phreṃ phaṭ lalāṭe mahāmṛtyukāriṇī

iti maṃtravargasahasrākṣarī nyāsaḥ |
divaśataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ niśāyāṃ yo nyaset manuṃ | bhuktāvāpyatha vā bhuktā yaṃ māsāt siddhimāpnuyāt ||
ājñāsiddhimavāpnoti sarvāpadvinivāraṇaṃ | yaṃ nāsti taṃ na siddhiḥ syāt kaule kālī kulārṇave ||
[iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre atharvaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ guhyakālīkāṣoḍhānyāsapaṭalaṃ samāptaṃ] ||
atha kaulikārcanam ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi kaulikārcanamuttamaṃ | (sārdhakasya ca patni tu muttamaṃ ) sādhakasya ca patni ca sā sākṣādīśvarī bhavet ||
tasyā ramaṇamicchanvai kauliko nārakī bhavet | ekāsanena viṣṭāyāṃ bhujataścaika bhājane ||
ekapātre pibed dravyaṃ te yānti narakaṃ dhruvaṃ | sādhāre coddharet pātre ādhāreṣu vinikṣipet ||
pātraṃ na cālayet dhānātma kuryāt pātra śaṃkaraṃ | ucchiṣṭaṃ na spṛśeccakre kuladravyāṇi sundarī ||
vahiḥ prakṣālya na karakuladravyāṇi dāpayet | paṃcaśuddhi vihīnena yat kṛtaṃ na ca tatkṛtaṃ ||
paṃcaśuddhiṃ vinā pūjā agnicārāya kalpate | ātmaśu sthāna śuddhirmaṃtrasya śodhanaṃ tathā ||
dehaśuddhirdravyaśuddhirevaṃ śuddhiritiritā | vinā maṃtreṇa yā pūjā vināmāṃsena tarpaṇaṃ ||
vināśaktyā ca yatpātaṃ tatsarvaṃ niskalaṃ bhavet | vā śabdena pived dravyaṃ taṃ tathaiva ca na pūrayet ||
anyonya vaṃdanaṃ kṛtvā pived divyā mṛtaṃ punaḥ | yāgaṃ tu trividhaṃ proktaṃ divyavīrapaśu kramaṃ ||
divyaṃ devyagrataḥ pānaṃ vīramekādya vāsinaṃ |
<128a>
asaṃskṛtaṃ tu yatpānaṃ pāśupānamiti śrutaṃ | saṃskṛtaṃ siddhijananaṃ prāyaścittādi śodhanaṃ ||
sadyenoddhṛtyapātraṃ tu mudrāṃ kṛtvā paśavyataḥ | vināyogena saṃyogena kuryāt vyadresaṃgatiṃ ||(?)
yathā grāmyate(?) toyaṃ nadīṃ gacchaṃ yathā śuci | tathā mleccha gṛhā dravyaṃ yogi hastārpitaḥ śuciḥ ||
yogī ca naiva bhogī syān bhogavannaiva yoginaḥ | yogaṃ bhogaṃ ca kaulaṃ ca tasmād yogī ca kaulikaḥ ||
ekena śuṣkajanakena ghaṭaṃ pivāmi kūpaṃ pivāmi sahasā lavanodvakena | vāpī pibāmi yadi rohita muṃḍakhaṇḍaṃ gaṃgāṃ pibāmi yamunāṃ sahasāgare nāmātaraṃ bhaginīṃ vāpi kanyāṃ vāramaṇi tathā |
madhumattā yadātavyaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ naganyate |
hālāṃ pivedikṣita maṃdire susuptāḥ naśānyāṃ gaṇikā gṛheṣu | gṛhe gṛhe bhojanamācaraṃti evaṃ bhavet sādhaka cakravarti mīnā yena nakhāditā sa vanakhā veśyā ca nāliṃgitā bhagnāyena sahodarāt japito māṃsaṃ na bhakṣyaṃ tataḥ |
kanyāyena na sevitā ratikathā dravyaṃ na pītaṃ tathā | sarvaṃ vyartha guru kramopa niyamaṃ māheśvaraṃ naiva ca ||
samyak tat kratu kṛtvā yatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt | tatphalaṃ labhate bhaktyā kṛtvā śrīcakradarśanaṃ ||
sa vījayā prathamaṃ śriyaṃ ca dvitīya pātraṃ gurupāvakaiva | tṛtīyapātraṃ prathamaṃ gaṇeśaṃ caturthapātraṃ pathi daivatena ||
paṃcālya pānnasya tu bhairavena ṣaṣṭhakramenaiva pitṛmātṛkena | śaśaktināmākramaśaḥ kṛtaiva saptakrame viṃśati sādhakaiva ||
mātāpitābhrātṛṣu gotraṃ ca vamuṃ vattulajjāṃ gurusādhakaiva | guruśca patniśca tathā ca siddhirlabdhodaya jñāna tathā ca vṛddhiḥ ||
svarṇaraupya śilākūrma kapālāṃvu samṛṇmayaṃ | nārikela ca śaṃkhaṃ ca muktāṃ suktisamudbhavaṃ ||
<128b>
puṇyavṛkṣa samudbhūtaṃ pātraṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ | nāti sūkṣmamati sthūlaṃ bhinnaṃ chidra vivarjayet ||
tāmrakāṃśyādibhirlohaiḥ kāṣṭhaṃ ca niḥphalaṃ bhavet | suvarṇarūpya pātrāṇi sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca ||
śāntike ca śilāpātraṃ staṃbhane caiva mṛnmayaṃ | nārikelaṃ ca vaśyādau cābhicāre ca kūrmajaṃ ||
śaṃkhaṃ jñānapradaṃ muktā śuktijñānapradāyinī | kapālāṃvuja pātrāṇi yogasiddhikarāni ca ||
puṇyavṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ paraṃ | ukte śvete yupānteṣu ekaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
sutīrthadarśanādyasmin tatkathā smaraṇa priye | tadguṇaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ koṭiśāstrasya darśanāt ||
darśanād darśanājjāyaṃ yadi syāt paramārthibhiḥ | sahasrakoṭi kṛtkartā paramārthasya darśanāt ||
gurureva gatiryeṣāṃ gaṃgāgītākara sthitā | kāyena manasāvācā sevayet kulaguruṃ priye ||
dṛṣṭvā pūjāṃ samāpyātha na rakta pūradha(?) vrajet | datvā praṇamya paṃcāṃgaṃ yatkiṃcidātmanaḥ priya ||
yadigacchedahaṃkārāt kāmāllobhāt bhaviṣyati | tadā sarve vinaśyanti āyurvidyāyaśovalaṃ ||
śariraṃ taṃtravijñeya maṃtraṃ dehamayo bhavet | taṃtramaṃtra samāyogāt sādhayedgurumārginaḥ(?) ||
yasmin maṃtre yadā cārastatvadharmastu tādṛśaḥ | bhrāntistatra na kartavyā siddhihānistu jāyate ||
gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame pratidine snātvā pathā(?) mānasaṃ | tatrāṃtaryajanaṃ vidhāya manasādhyātvā mūrtimā ||
dravyādravya samanvitāṃ vali vidhiṃ nānāpaśu chedayet | dhanyoktaṃ vidhipūrvaka yadi kṛtaṃ bhūtādinātha svayaṃ ||
guruṃ pibati yatpātre dravyaṃ nītvā svahastataḥ | svapātre pūrayet pītvā punarjanma na vidyate ||
pītvā pītvā punaḥ pītvā punaḥ patati bhūtale | utthāya ca punaḥ pitvā punarjanma na vidyate ||
<129a>
nīlatoyadaśaṃkāso nīlakuṃjaraśobhitāṃ | nīlapuṣpavibhūṣāḍhyāṃ nīlālaṃkārabhūṣitāṃ ||
nīlāṃganāṃgasaṃsthānāṃ nīlavaiḍūryamālinīṃ | indranīlanivaddhāṃśu mahārghamaṇibhūṣaṇaṃ ||
nīlavājīsamārūḍhāṃ nīlakhaḍgāyudhāṃ parāṃ | nidrāpaṭena nīlena bhuvanāni caturdaśa ||
mohayantīṃ mahāmāyāṃ dravyanidakabhakṣiṇīṃ | virapānaratāṃ vīrā pālayaṃtīṃ samantataḥ ||
saṃketa maṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ chādayaṃtīṃ svavāsasā | paramānaṃdavapuṣīṃ paramānaṃdabhairavīṃ ||
paramānandajananīṃ praṇamāmi parāṃvikā | pātraṃ kṛtvā kare maṃtrī sarvakarmaṇabhetsudhī ||
ihaloke śriyaṃbhudakā dehāṃte bhairavo bhavet | dehasthākhila devatā gajamukhā kṣetrādhipā bhairavāḥ ||
yoginyo vaṭukāśca pakṣapitaraḥ paiśācikāśceṭakāḥ | anye bhūcarakhecarāḥ pratikhagāvetālabhūtagrahāstṛptāḥ syuḥ kulaputrakasya pibataḥ pānaṃ sadīpaṃ carum | alipisitapuraṃdhrī bhogapūtāparīhaṃ vahujanavibhavābhāraṃbhasaṃ bhāvitohaṃ |
paśujanavimuktohaṃ bhairavī mātṛtohaṃ gurucaraṇanatohaṃ bhairavohaṃ śivohaṃ ||
sakalavibudha dīkṣāmaṃtra śuddhātmakohaṃ | vividhavibudhacaryā prārthimārgonmukhohaṃ ||
sakalavikala pūjānityadantāṃtarohe jananamaraṇaduḥkhātītabhāvaṃ sadāhaṃ | paramavimala nityānaṃdabodhānvitohaṃ gurucaraṇaratohaṃ bhairavohaṃ śivohaṃ | |
vimalaṃ jaratarohaṃ suṃdarī tatparohaṃ gurucaraṇaratohaṃ bhaivohaṃ śivohaṃ | sahajapadaparohaṃ pūjyapūjyātmakohaṃ vahalasukhamayohaṃ saccinaṃditohaṃ ||
śivaśaraṇagatohaṃ bhaktalokārcitohaṃ gurucaraṇaratohaṃ bhairavohaṃ śivohaṃ ||
śivohaṃ śaktirupohaṃ devohaṃdanujāpyahaṃ | yakṣohamanujaścāhaṃ sarvohaṃ sarvadosmyahaṃ ||
<129b>
maṃtrohaṃ maṃtrakalpohaṃ maṃtrajāpyahameva ca | maṃtrakṛt maṃtravidyāhaṃ maṃtranaṃdātmakopyahaṃ ||
pūjāhaṃ pūjyaruprohaṃ pūjakopyahameva ca | pūjā kṛccāpi pūjāvitpūjāra samayopyahaṃ ||
valipātraṃ yoginīṃ ca śrīpātragurupātrayo | gurupātraṃ kuṃbhakaṃ ca vīrapātraṃ ca agrayoḥ ||
śāntipātraṃ maheśāni pātrāṇirtava kathyate | tṛptāśca sarvalokānāṃ bhuktimukti pradāyakāḥ ||
kāraṇyaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ pūjākarmaṇi kārayet | vinādravyādhi vāsena maṃtraṃ na smaraṇaṃ bhavet ||
ye smaranti mahāmūḍhā teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ pade pade | śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmimidravīṃ pūjyaṃ bhavediha ||
gaudrī paiṣṭhī tathā dhīṣarturīnārīkelajā | tālajātaṃ hutvā kāṣṭhādrākṣāścaiva vidhāsurāḥ ||
kavacaṃ raktaṃ gate muktā pravālotthaṃ ca kāṃcane | sphāṭikaṃ nārikelākhyaṃ narakāpālatuṃḍayoḥ ||
etāni naya pātrāṇi devārcana vidhau smṛtāḥ | naṭīkāpālinī veśyā rajakīnāpītāṃganā ||
brāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopāla kanyakā | mālākārasya kanyā ca navakanyāṃ prakīrtitāḥ ||
śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi dravyābhāvādī (*)(?) caret | dugdhaṃ dadhīghṛtaṃ kṣaudra tailaṃ sauvīrameva ca ||
ārdrayuktaṃ drākṣaphalaṃ nārikelaṃ jalaṃ tu vā | gonarebhāśva mahiṣavarāhāja mṛgodbhavaṃ ||
śaśakaṃ ca samāyuktaṃ devatā prītikārakaṃ | lavanārdra kapinyā kapālāṃḍuṃ māṃsapaṃcakaṃ ||
lasunaṃ ca mahādevī māṃsa pratinidhi smṛtaḥ | matsyā bhāve tu kramukaṃ tāṃvūlaṃ yadyadāstrīyaṃ ||
mudrā bhāve taṃḍulaṃ vā bhaktitaṃ ca na kādikaṃ | etāni navapātrāṇi hāhārāve prakīrtitāḥ ||
tasya puṇyaprabhāvena yadi śakrasamo bhavet | devāyatana yātrāyāṃ rājadvāre mahābhaye ||
samūhaṃ paśyatemaṃtrī dūragatvā prayatnataḥ | samūhe tu ahaṃ sākṣāt samūhastu pitāmahaḥ ||
samūhakeśavo devī samūhastu puraṃdaraḥ | nārojanasamūhastu svabhāva jantu suṃdarī ||
tvayā sākamahaṃ tatra aviharāmi yathecchayā | evaṃ stutvā tato maṃtrī kāmakleśena pūjayet ||
<130a>
yathālābhānusāreṇa patrapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ | kanyājanasamūhe tu mahāsiddhirvyavasthitā ||
tasyaivārcana puṇyasya lopamā(?) dṛśyate kvacit | yastvevaṃ pūjayed devī siddhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
maheśvaraṃ samālokya pūjayed vidhipūrvakaṃ | yathāni bhavarūpeṇa paṃcatatvaṃ nivedya ca ||
sadātuṣṭā bhavet kālī sarvān kāmān tva bhedapi | anyathā naiva siddhisyā yudhvā(?) bhavati yoginī ||
medinīṃ yastu saṃpūrṇaṃ brahmaṇe vedapārage | datvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kaulikārcane ||
aśvamedha sahasrāṇi vājapeya śatāni ca | dṛṣṭvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kaulikārcane ||
merutulya suvarṇantu brāhamaṇe dānameva ca ||
datvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kaulikārcane | vāpi kūpataḍāgādi kṛtvā yatphamāpnuyāt ||
tatphalāllakṣaguṇitaṃ kaulikānāṃ prapūjanāt | kapilāṃ caivagāṃ datvā yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ||
tatphalā koṭiguṇitaṃ kaulikānāṃ prapūjanāt | puruṣeṇa vinā kiṃcinna kṛtvā kriyate na hi ||
tathā śaktiṃ vinādevī phalaṃ dātuṃ kṣamo na hi | tasmāt puṃśaktisaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā maṃtraṃ prasādhayet ||
kaulikā(?) mārge ca pumān devo na sidhyati | ātmānaṃ tu śivaṃ dhyāyed devatāṃ śaktirūpiṇī ||
krīḍet paṃcamakāraistu suprītā tasya devatā | dakṣamārge mātṛ buddhiḥ kaulike ca yathā pathi ||
yasya jātā dṛḍhatarā tasya tuṣṭānu devatā | etadrahasyamākhyātaṃ gopyaṃ mātarijāravat ||
śaivāḥ smārtā yājñikaścitāṃ na kurvaṃti pārvatī | kaulānāmāgamajñānāṃ tāṃtrikācāravartināṃ ||
<130b>
anukalpa pradātṛṇāṃ madhyasthānāṃ tathaiva ca | devīti buddhiryoṣitsu yeṣāṃ matiraṃ caṃcalā ||
teṣāṃ kālī śubhaktānāṃ sarvadā niścitātmanāṃ | āvaśyakīṃ śaktipūjā pīṭhapūjāvadīśvarī ||
kālī buddhaiva saṃpūjyā na kāmākulayādhiyā | caturthāśca mīṇemuktāyeṃ kālyārcana tatparā ||
kaulāṣī vāpyakaulā vāpe caitatsatavartinaḥ | teṣāṃ nityā śaktipūjā prāhaivaṃ māṃ puradviṣaḥ ||
śā śaktirdvividhā jñeyā svakīyā ca parāṃganā | svajāti saṃbhavā yā tu parinītā bhavet priye ||
śāstrakīyā samuddīśya tathāneyaṃ praśaśyate | parakīyā paṃcavidhā krameṇa pravīmyahaṃ ||
saṃjīvad bhartṛkā hyekā tādṛgeva mṛtapriyā | śaśī veśyā tathā nūḍhā praśastā cottarottarā ||
ajātavatsā yuvatī sāsyādyaiva praśasyate | kadācijjātavatsāpi sā sarvarā dṛḍhī matā ||
abhāve pūrvapūrvāyāḥ parāgrāhyāhi sādhakaiḥ | sādhikāyāstu kaulāyā evameva pumānapi ||
na sādhanaṃ vinānāryo na puṃsaḥ sādhikāḥ smṛtāḥ | maṃtrāḥ siddhyanti deveśī kalpakoṭi śatairapi ||
parastrī saṃgamomadyo paśu vā prāṇimāraṇaṃ | svārthe cennarakāyaiva vyarthavasukṛtaṃ ||
padiko heturna vijānāmi devī prīti karā ime | na pāpa janakaṃ tadvat tadarthaṃ paśughātakai ||
na kilviṣaṃścaiva tadvat parastrīsaṃgamādikaḥ | na nyūnāṃgyo nādhikāṃgyo na sthūlānādhika kṛśāḥ ||
na chinnanāśāgulīkā na dīrghā na ca vāmana | na muṃḍitā na kubjā ca mūḍhāṃśca vadhirā na ca ||
na kekarā nakhaṃjā vibhinna yonigalatkucā | vālāpatyāśca vilebhyo na kāryā śaktayaṃstviva ||
vadāmi yogyāṃ sādhikyāṃyābhistusyati kālikā | gaurāṃgī yuvatī raṃbhāsmerāsyā cāruvigrahā ||
viśāla lolanaparā pinonnata payodharā | viśālajaghanābhogā valitrayavirājitā ||
supārśvā tanu madhyā ca susvarākuṃcitālakā | vicitraṃ veṣābharaṇā vicitrāṃvara dhāriṇī ||
<131a>
vicitrasraksamākīrṇā vicitrarati dāyikā | sadā prasannavadanā devyā bhakti parāyaṇā ||
kaulikācāṇatatvajñā ca sādhake bhakti tatparā | bhayahīnā smare mukhī sarvadā priyavādīnī ||
samayācāra saṃpannā maṃtrajñābhayavarjitā | vidagdhā cā prasūtā ca dhairyasvātaṃtryasaṃyutā ||
evaṃguṇasamāyuktāḥ pūjayet sarvayoṣitaḥ | sarvathā kārayed devī nānyathā yugakoṭibhiḥ ||
na hi siddhyaṃti deveśī daśapadma japena vaiḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena svasvavidyā kramaṃ caret ||
ātmīyāṃ ca parā caiva śaktimātraṃ maheśvarī | maṃtrādhi devatā buddhyā pūjāsarvopacārakaiḥ ||
vividhaiḥ phalatāṃvūlai sarvālaṃkāra hemabhiḥ | saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā vahu hetuṃ pradāpayet ||
saṃbhogavāsanāṃ dhṛtvā yaḥ kuryācchakti pūjanaṃ | sadāripumavāpnoti nārakī ca bhaveddhruvaṃ ||
vahubhiḥ kiṃ varojālaiḥ samāsāt samayaṃ śṛṇu | nirdiśyate śakti pūjā kaulikānāṃ dine dine ||
pratyahaṃ ca surādānaṃ tatsvīkāronvahaṃ tathā | nityatoktaṃ jayordevī kulamārgarateṣu ca ||
heyāheyavicāre hi viralaḥ śaktiṣu priye | anukalpa pradātṛṇāmapi nityatvameva hi ||
vihāyagarhitāḥ śaktiryogyā eva hi gṛhyate | itareṣāṃ śaktipūjā kāmyā naimittikī tathā ||
samādhisthita cittānāmitarāśāṃ nirākṛtiḥ | vidhānaṃ kalaye dāni maṃtrānapi ca pārvati ||
snātāṃ divyaṃ varadharāṃ nānālaṃkāramaṃḍitāṃ | yuvatīṃ pīnavakṣyojāṃ tathā cā kṛti bhojanāṃ ||
haste gṛhītvā vāmorau sthāpayecchaktimuttamaṃ | aśaktavānavoḍhuṃ tāṃ devyāvārmetha vāsane ||
vāmabhāge samālikhya trikoṇaṃ padmavartulaṃ |
<131b>
śvetaraktasamāyuktaṃ nālaṃ siṃdūracarcitaṃ ||
sādhakaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā devīṃ pratyaṅmukho yajet | uḍḍīyānaṃ tu tretāyāṃ kṛte purṇagiriṃ yajet ||
jālaṃdharaṃ dvāpareṣu kāmapīṭhaṃ kalau yuge | tāni catvāri vakṣyāmi guhyād guhyatarāni ca ||
śakteḥ sarvaśarīraṃ yatpīiṭhaṃ pūrṇagiraṃ mataṃ | tasyāśiraścaṃdrabhāge udyānaṃ kīrtitaṃ mayā ||
stanau jāladharaṃ proktaṃ kāmapīṭhaṃ bhagaṃ smṛtaṃ | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādi nyāsamācaret ||
ṛṣyādi ca caredādau tataḥ śodhanamācaret | ṛṣyādikaṃ vaciddānī(?) etasya suravandinī ||
śrīśaktipūjanasthāsya gonarda ṛṣirīritaḥ | vikṛtichandamākhyātaṃ śaktirūpāpadādatu ||
mahākālī devatā ca kāmovījamudāhṛtaṃ | śaktirvadhūrbhauvaneśī kīlakaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ ||
śivaśaktisāmarasya prakāśe viniyogataḥ | saṃsargā paṃcadīrghāḍhya vadhūvījai ṣaḍaṃgakaṃ ||
vidhāyātmani śaktyāṃga nyāsaṃ vā vyamathā caret | strīścecchakti padasthāne bhairaveti padaṃ bhavet ||
yodhi yoni pada sthāne syālliṃga pada kalpanā | gurūpadeśaṃ taccāpi svavadhyā vā sureśvarī ||
ūhaḥ sarvatra kartavyo liṃge tattatpadepi ca | samāsanaḥ kiṃtu gāyatryāṃ sā samāno bhayatra hi ||
nyāsoddhāramidaṃ nityaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmayaḥ | trayā kāmoramārāmo yoginīroṣayoṣitau ||
ḍākinī pralayohāraḥ phetkārī karṇikāpi ca | preto nṛsiṃhakulikaṃ cicchaktiḥ sarvaśeṣagā ||
ekaikaṃ parato dadyādvījaṃ nāmnāṃ surārcitaṃ | nānyathādau kaulīkī ca bhagamālinyanaṃtaraṃ ||
ratipriyā tathā'naṃgāṃ kulā samayapālinī | madanonmādinī kāmā veśinī tadanantaraṃ ||
cittonmāthinyapi tato yo hatyā karṣiṇī tathā | smarāsturānaṃgarūpā hṛtpramodetyanantaraṃ ||
<132a>
saṃtāpinī tataḥ saṃkṣobhinī ca tridaśārcite | sarvaśeṣe parijñeyā sāmarasya svarūpiṇī ||
etāḥ ṣoḍaśa vai kāryā ṅeṃtā pūrvāṇasaṃyutā | strīkatve puṃliṃgā bhairavārcana karmaṇī namaḥ ||
śeṣeṣu sarveṣu sthānāni kalayādhunā | śiraḥ kapolau ca galaskandhau vakṣaḥ kucyai tathā ||
pārśve kukṣi nābhiśca valirvaṃkṣaṇa eva ca | ūrujānū ca jaṃṣe ca pādau yoniśca śeṣagā ||
jīvanyāśa vade tasyāḥ sāmarasya mathācaret | etadeveti saṃproktaṃ śaktiśodhanamīśvarī ||
kṛtvā prahastaṃ duḥkaraṃ datvā tu hṛdaye jayo | kāmapīṭhetha vā devī nābhaumīliyakī mate ||
manuṃ gṛṇan vakṣyamātaṃ vāraikaṃ vātrivārakaṃ | jīvanyāsātmakamidaṃśakti śodhanamācaret ||
anenaśuddhyati śaktirnānyathā maṃtrakoṭibhiḥ | māyākāmo vadhūrlakṣmīḥ kūrcaḥ prāsāda eva ca ||
śākinī ḍākinī cāpi vījānyaṣṭau puraḥ smaret | bhogānaṃdakulādokti jīvātmaparamātmakāḥ ||
prativimvā dvaitasaṃjñātmanālaṃ yā nidhānakaṃ | daśakūṭāḥ kramāt procya brahmatadvīparītakaṃ ||
dvayaṃ daśānta uccāryameva ūrdhvārdhvaṃ saṃmitaṃ | tato mamānu hṛdayaṃ tavānu hṛdayaṃ vadet ||
dadhā tu mamavācyutkāte vācaṃ samudīrayet | marmeṃdriyeṣu tadanu pravadet kamalānane ||
nendriyāṇi ca saṃbhāḍhyaṃ mama vācaṃ tu juṣasva ca | tataḥ siddhikarālinītvāṃ mahyaṃ niyuta kuca ||
yecatvaṃ vasa evāhaṃ ya evāhamitirayet | śaivatvaṃ saṃdhinā yuktamubhautadanu kīrtayet ||
śivaśaktisamārabhya māpannau tadanantaraṃ | tadaikyamiti saṃkīrtya sādhayāva itirayet ||
sa saṃdhistāra hṛcchīrṣamastraṃ tadanu suṃdarī | ayaṃ maṃtrasamuddīṣṭaḥ śaktiśodhanakarmaṇi ||
aṣṭottaraśavārṇāḍhyo na nyūnonāpi cādhikaḥ |
<132b>
dhyānaṃ pūrvoditaṃ yatte bhagavatyāmayātava ||
śaktiṃ ca tādṛśākārāṃ dhyāyedvikṣyāṃga saṃcayaṃ | bhairava dhyānasadṛśamātmānaṃ ca vibhāvayet ||
tata āvāhayed devīṃ śaktyaṃge pīṭhasaṃnibhe | vakṣyamānena maṃtreṇa sādhakoñjalimudrayā ||
māyākāma vadhūrāva kamalāyoginīruṣaḥ | ḍākinī vāpi phetkārī na vaitānyādigāna hi ||
ehyehi bhagavat yuktvā mahākālī samīrayet | śaktipīṭhe tu sāṃnidhyamāveśaya samuddharet ||
tatastvāsahamullikhya vohayāmi ca kīrtayet | sarvaśaktisamābhāṣya svarūpiṇīḥ tato vadet ||
tāraṃ pratiṣṭhaśīrṣaṃ ca śaktimūlamanuṃ śṛṇu | māyārāvaḥ smaro nārī śaktaye īrayet tataḥ ||
maṃtro navākṣaraḥ proktaḥ śaktipūjanakarmaṇī | ṛṣyādī nāsti caitasyā na chaṃdo vīja śaktayaḥ ||
kiṃtu pādyādi naivadye sarvopavārarpaṇa hetavaḥ | japtavyo naiva cārddhaṃ hi bhairavasva vaco yathā ||
sarvopacārānye tena pradadyā kiṃtu śaktaye | pādyadānādi naivedya dānāṃ taṃ yadyadiṣyate ||
na cānyamaṃtrobhinnosti manmate jagadīśvarī | kūrcaṃ te yattu kauleyā tadamūlaṃ vibhāvyatāṃ ||
śaktipūjā vaśiṣṭaṃ yat puṣpa sranuṃ lepanaṃ | ātmane dīyate yanmatsāmarasyārcataṃ bhavet ||
tada maṃtraṃ prakartavyamevamīśānaśāsanaṃ | tato datvākaraṃ śakti yoni pīṭhe japaṃ caret ||
sādhakaḥ śakti gāyatryāḥ śatamarddhārdhameva ca | yonipīṭhe japaṃ prakhyo na japaḥ kvāpi vidyate ||
satyaprabhāvajanako maṃtrānāṃ pīṭhamuttamaṃ | maṃtrāṇāṃ valahitānāṃ prayogakṣīṇa cetasāṃ ||
anuddhṛtānāṃ sāpekṣyo nyūnādhikyārṇa vāyuṣāṃ | gurumiṣṭhānāmapī ca pradānonaujasāṃ tathā ||
ajñānavidhi pūjānāma pātrārpaṇabhāginām | tyaktānāṃ vismṛtānāṃ ca tathā caivā prabhāvināṃ ||
saṃdhukṣaṇārthamubhayaṃ proktaṃ tripuravairiṇā |
<133a>
evaṃ nirvāṇa maṃtreṇa saṃpuṭi kṛtya tajjapaṃ ||
kaulāsane nāparaṃ ca yonipīṭha japa kriyā | kaulāsanaṃ yoni pīṭhe yaḥ strībhyo manu nigrahaḥ ||
gurustrī śaktitāṃ vāpi miśrībhūya japed dvayoḥ | anyaiḥ samiṃdhanaṃ maṃtrairvajrādhikyakaraṃ paraṃ ||
athātaḥ śaktigāyatrīṃ śṛṇu devī mahāphalaṃ | kāmavījādbhagavatīṃ ṅeṃtāṃpurata īrayet ||
vighnahe yoni mālinyai dhīmahīti tataḥ paraṃ | tatra śaktiriti procya sarvaśeṣe pracodayāt ||
eṣā hi śakti gāyatrī sarvāgama sugopitā | etān vitāna śaktyācca niśakyarcāṃvinā japaḥ ||
yathāśakti japitvaināṃ tatsamarpya ca śaktaye | vāmo khavupaviśyaivaṃ kuryānmūla japaṃ priye ||
pūjayet madanāgāraṃ raktacandana carcitaiḥ | bhage tadīye vijñe yānāṅmastisu pravāhikāḥ ||
ekāntarvāhikā cāṃdrī śaurī cānyānu vāhikā | āgneyī cāparājñeyā pūjayet tatprasādhakaḥ ||
asṛksravati cāṃdrī sā puṣpaṃ sravati bhānavī | vījaṃ śravati cāgneyī tāstunāmabhirarcayet ||
vāgbhavādyairnamo yuktaiḥ pūjayet suprasannadhīḥ | dhyānaṃ kuryāt maheśāni gahvare makarānane ||
tāmracūḍaśikhākāraṃ gajavaktra samaprabhaṃ | tatrasthāṃ cintayed devīṃ vidyāṃ bhuvanamohinīṃ ||
vāgbhavaṃgaśabdāte bhage bhagini cālikhet | bhagodarī bhagāṃte tu bhagamāle bhagāvahe ||
bhagaguhye bhagaprāṃte yoniprāṃte bhagāṃtake | yoniprāṃtini sarvāṃte tato bhagavatīśvari ||
bhagarūpe tatolekhyaṃ nīrajāyatalocane | nityaklinne bhagaprānte svarūpe sarvamālikhet ||
bhagāni mehyā namoṃte varadetha samālikhet | rate svarate bhagavan klinne klinna drave tataḥ ||
<133b>
kledayadrāvayaśvātha sarvasatvān bhageśvarī | amoghe bhagavicce cakṣumakṣobhaya sarva ca ||
satvān bhageśvarī brūyād vāgbhavaṃ vrūjamādikaṃ | bhaṃ vlūṃ mauṃ vlūṃ ca klinne ca tataḥ paraṃ ||
sarvāṇi ca bhagānyattemeva saṃvānayeti ca | strīvījaṃ ca haretprāṃte valamāṃtmakamakṣaraṃ ||
bhuvaneśīṃ samālikhya vidyeyaṃ bhagamālinī | caturthyaṃte yajed devī bhage puṣpaṃ viniḥkṣipet ||
prakṣālya kuladravyena gaṃdhapuṣpaisaṃmarcayet | dhūpadīpādikaṃ kṛtvā paścādāvaraṇaṃ yajet ||
ihāpyā vāhanaṃ nāsti jīvanyāso maheśvarī | athaivaṃ ca vidhānena naitāḥ ṣoḍasopacārakaiḥ ||
iṣṭadevīṃ prapūjyātha sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet | arcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svaśivaṃ tadanaṃtaraṃ ||
athanyā saṃpravakṣyāmi śivātmānaṃ vibhāvayet | paṃcavaktraṃ mahādevaṃ kalāyuktaṃ nyaset kramāt ||
īśānaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ śaśinī prathamākalā | īśvara sarvabhūtānāmaṃgadā tadanaṃtaraṃ ||
brahmādhipati śabdānte brahmaṇodhipatiḥ punaḥ | brahmeṣṭadā śivomestu marīci saṃpuṭaṃ nyaset ||
sadāśivoṃ samuccārya aṃśumālinyathā parā | tatpuruṣāya vidmahe kalātika iti īritā ||
mahādevāyadhimahī kalāvidyā tathaiva ca | tanno rudraḥ padaṃ paścāt pratiṣṭhā kathitā kalā ||
pracodayāt samuccārya nivṛttiḥ syāt tataḥ paraṃ | pūrvapaścima yāme tu uttare svapyanu krmāt ||
hṛdaye vinyased devī aghorebhyāstataḥ kalā | atha ghorebhyo mohāṃ ca grīvāyāṃ vinyaset tataḥ ||
ghorānte syāt kriyā paścād dakṣiṇāṃse pravinyaset | namastetu kṣudhāṃ paścāt kalāṃ pṛṣṭhe nyaset kramāt ||
rudra rūpebhya ityaṃte tṛvatāranamotakā ||
vāmadevāya namo terajā syāt guhyadeśake | mukhasavye pravinyasya rakṣāṃ jyeṣṭhāya vai namaḥ ||
rudrāya namo ratiṃ paścād vāmamukhakalāmimāṃ |
<134a>
kālāya nama ityante pālinī ūrudakṣiṇe ||
kalakāmā ca deveśī vāme vikaranāya ca | namaḥ padaṃ samuccāryasaṃyamani dakṣajānunī ||
valakriyā samuddiṣṭāvāme vikaraṇāya ca | namoṃte vṛddhimuccārya dakṣiṇetkici(?) vinyaset ||
valaprathamanāya namoṃ rātriṃ vāme pravinyaset | sarvabhūtadamanāya namoṃte brahmaṇī kalā ||
kaṭi deśe pravinyasya manāṃte mohinī kalāṃ | dakṣiṇe pārśvake nyasya unmavāya namojjvalāṃ ||
pādayostananāsāsu murddhnivāhu yuge nyaset | sadyojātodbhavā samyagaṣṭau maṃtrī kalā kramāt ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pātrāṇāṃ nirṇayaṃ priye | aṣṭādaśa mahāpātraṃ guhyakālī prapūjayet ||
svaśaktiṃ vīraśaktiṃ ca dikṣitāṃ gururūpinī | pāyayitvā pibet sarpamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ ||
tasmāt sulakṣaṇāṃ śaktiṃ gandhapuṣpakṣatādibhiḥ | abhyarcya devatā buddhyā bhogapātraṃ nivedayet ||
śrīmat bhairavaśekharāmṛtarasaṃ saṃplāvitaṃ plāvitaṃ | kṣetrādhīśvara yoginījana susiddhyaiḥ samārādhitaṃ ||
ānaṃ dārṇavakaṃ navātmakamidaṃ sākṣattrikhaṇḍāmṛtaṃ vaṃde śrīprathamaṃ karāṃvujayutaṃ pātraṃ viśuddhipradaṃ || 1 ||
haimaṃmīnarasāvahaṃdayitayādattaṃ ca predyādibhiḥ | kiṃciccacalapaṃkaja dṛśā tasmai samārādhitaṃ ||
vāme śuddhiviśuddhiśuddhikaraṇaṃ pāṇaunidhāyātmake vaṃde pātra dvitīyamadhunānandaikasaṃvardhanaṃ || 2 ||
savāśrāya kalākalāpakalitaṃ kautūhaladyotakaṃ | candropendraśaśāṃkaśaṃbhuvaruṇabrahmādibhiḥ sevitaṃ ||
dhyātaṃ devagaṇai sadā navagaṇairmokṣārthibhiḥ sarvadā lokānāmabhivardhanaṃ sukhakaraṃ pātraṃ tṛtīyaṃ namaḥ || 3 ||
<134b>
madyaṃmīnarasāvahaṃ hariharabrahmāṃdibhiḥ | pūjitaṃ mudrā maithunadharmakarmanirataṃ kṣārāmlatiktāśrayaṃ ||
ācāryāṣṭaka siddhi bhairavakalāmāṃsena saṃśodhitaṃ | pāyātpaṃcamakāratatva sahitaṃ pātraṃ caturthaṃ namaḥ || 4 ||
savo dharmakulāgamādhikataraṃ vedairmukhībhāṣitaṃ | iti yajñakulāṣṭamaṃ bhramaharaṃ guptaṃ rahasyānvitaṃ ||
ānaṃdodbhavavāraviṃdu sulayāyogirasaṃ bhairavaṃ pītabrahmarasaṃ na moditamidaṃ pātraṃ sudhāpaṃcamaṃ || 5 ||
chatraṃ cāmarabhadrapīṭha paramānaṃ dāyitaṃ dāyitaṃ rāmārājyaṃ manoharasukharasaṃ sāyujyasāmrājyadaṃ | nānāvyādhibhavāṃdhakāraharaṇaṃ janmāṃtaraṃ nāśanaṃ śrīmatsuṃdarīnayanandravaruṇaṃ pātraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ || 6 ||
jogratsvapna suṣupti turyapurato caitanya sākṣātpradaṃ vidyudbhāskaravahni caṃdra dhanuṣṭhe yotiḥ kathā bhāṣitaṃ | iḍāpiṃgalamadhyagā trivalayā sa kuṃḍalī cordhvagā pātraṃ saptamapūraṇena nutaṃnānaṃdādhikaḥ pātumāṃ || 7 ||
khaḍgaṃ pādukamaṃjanaṃ ca guṭikāṃ sārasvataṃ satpadaṃ mṛtyorvacanamugrakāryagahanaṃ dehasthiteḥ kāraṇaṃ pāyāt siddhikaraṃmatasthirakaraṃ vaśyaṃ jagaghoṣitaṃ pātraṃ cāṣṭamamaṣṭasiddhikaraṇaṃ prauḍhaprasannaṃ sadā || 8 ||
sarvānaṃdakaraṃ sadāśivapadadvaṃdvaikamuktipradaṃ sāmrājyaṃ sukhadaṃ manorathakaraṃ tvajñānaviddhvaṃsanaṃ | āyuḥ kīrtiyaśovivarddhanakaraṃ saṃsāramohacchidaṃ pātraṃ śrīnavanāthaśaktinavakaṃ prauḍhapratāyoditaṃ || 9 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ devīdīnāṃ viśeṣataṃ | durlabhaṃpāvanaṃ pātraṃ daśamaṃ praṇamāmyahaṃ || 10 ||
pāpaghnaṃ śāntidaṃ śuddhaṃdatānaṃda svabhāvakaṃ | pātramekādaśaṃ vaṃde gurusevāparāṃgatiṃ || 11 ||
āśramastho na garbhastho tīrthasecanameva vā | smaraṇāt karaṇāt muktirnamāmi dvādaśaṃ paraṃ || 12 ||
dharmādharmaṃ vahiḥ kṛtvā ātmānaṃ mānuṣaṃ dhruvaṃ | saṃpūrṇamanujo nityaṃmakṣavṛttirjuśemyahaṃ || 13 ||
<135>
na yogakṣya kare pātraṃ mukhe stotraṃ sadā smaret | svachaṃda bhairavaṃ vaṃde bhuktimukti pradāyakaṃ || 14 ||
kare pātraṃ mukhe stotraṃ ānaṃdo hṛdayāṃvuje | mūrdhni śrīgurūpādābjaṃ smaraṇātkīrtayet paraṃ || 15 ||
pītvā pītvā punaḥ pītvā yāvat patati bhūtale | utthāya ca punaḥ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate || 16 ||
ādhāre bhujagādhīrāja valaye pātraṃ mahīmaṇḍalaṃ madyaṃ saptasamudravāri piśitaṃ cāṣṭau ca digdaṃtinaḥ || sohaṃ bhairavasarvayat pratidinaṃ tārāgaṇairakṣatairāditya pramukhaiḥ surāsuragaṇairājñākaraiḥ kiṃkaraiḥ || 17 ||
vāmerāmāramanakuśalā dakṣiṇe cārupātraṃ | agre mudrācanakavaṭukaṃ sūkaraṃ śuṣkamāṃsaṃ ||
skaṃdhe vīnālaliśubhagā sadguruṇāṃ pravṛtteḥ | kaulo dharmaparamagahanoyogi nāpyagamyaḥ || 18 ||
sarvadharmaṃ parityajya kuladharmaṃ samācaret | kuladharmaṃ parityajya rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
uttamānitya pūjā syāt madhyamaṃ parvapūjanaṃ | māsapūjādhamā proktā māsādūrddhva paśu bhavet || 19 ||
māse vātha trimāse vā ṣaṇmāse vatsarepi vā | śrīguruṃ pūjayed bhaktyā prāpnoti strīsutādikāt ||
tatrāvetetkulinaṃ tacchiṣyaṃ cāpi yoginaṃ | saṃtoṣayet kuladravyaiścakra pūjāparaḥ śivaḥ || 20 ||
[iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre atharvaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ aṣṭādaśapātrakālikārcaṇanirṇayapaṭalaṃ samāptam] ||
